High Holidays 5787/2026 <https://bbox.blackbaudhosting.com/webforms/service/page.redir?target=https%3a%2f%2ftinyurl.com%2f4wam22wd&srcid=62986320&srctid=1&erid=-870696026&trid=ce1f056a-35cb-4fac-adf6-198a360fef37>
Friday, September 11 – Monday, September 21

Choose from in-person and virtual services to help you welcome in 5787. Services will be at Sixth & I co-led by Rabbi Jenna and guest Rabbi Jason Kimelman-Block, alongside cellist Sarah Fredrick, guitarist Tal Mashiach, percussionist Jeff Geld, and vocalist Dana Herz. Explore our website <https://bbox.blackbaudhosting.com/webforms/service/page.redir?target=https%3a%2f%2ftinyurl.com%2f4wam22wd&srcid=62986320&srctid=1&erid=-870696026&trid=ce1f056a-35cb-4fac-adf6-198a360fef37> for service options.

We’re excited to share more ways for our 20s and 30s community to connect to each other:










Rosh Hashanah Lunch at Chaia Tacos <https://bbox.blackbaudhosting.com/webforms/service/page.redir?target=https%3a%2f%2ftinyurl.com%2f3z8a3ksd&srcid=62986320&srctid=1&erid=-870696026&trid=ce1f056a-35cb-4fac-adf6-198a360fef37>
Saturday, September 12 at 12:00 pm

Plant yourself in 5787 by starting the year off with plant-based tacos and at our neighbor, Chaia Tacos <https://bbox.blackbaudhosting.com/webforms/service/page.redir?target=https%3a%2f%2ftinyurl.com%2f3pb8yrpy&srcid=62986320&srctid=1&erid=-870696026&trid=ce1f056a-35cb-4fac-adf6-198a360fef37>. Go out on a limb to meet new people, and enjoy apples and honey for a sweet start to the year.










Honest to Goodness: A Teshuvah Workshop <https://bbox.blackbaudhosting.com/webforms/service/page.redir?target=https%3a%2f%2ftinyurl.com%2fetw3bj2m&srcid=62986320&srctid=1&erid=-870696026&trid=ce1f056a-35cb-4fac-adf6-198a360fef37>
Thursday, September 17 at 6:30 pm

Let’s be real: meaningful, lasting change requires honest acknowledgment, not self-punishment. With guest Rabbi Jason Kimelman-Block, explore the ancient practice of teshuva (return) and be guided through reflection, visioning, and concrete intention-setting across four dimensions of our lives: our relationships, our bodies, our spiritual lives, and our relationship to the planet.










Havdalah and Break Fast <https://bbox.blackbaudhosting.com/webforms/service/page.redir?target=https%3a%2f%2ftinyurl.com%2f5bvepp5d&srcid=62986320&srctid=1&erid=-870696026&trid=ce1f056a-35cb-4fac-adf6-198a360fef37>
Monday, September 21 at 7:00 pm

Wind down the High Holidays and transition to a new week and year with some singing, hear the shofar blast, and have your fill of bagels (the one day of the year we’ll let you eat in the sanctuary!). We’ll set the vibe with glow sticks to welcome in a brighter 5787.










The Bubbes are Back!

Sixth & I’s team of advice-giving bubbes made headlines <https://bbox.blackbaudhosting.com/webforms/service/page.redir?target=https%3a%2f%2ftinyurl.com%2f42af9ezn&srcid=62986320&srctid=1&erid=-870696026&trid=ce1f056a-35cb-4fac-adf6-198a360fef37> last year. We’re bringing the good vibes back during the High Holidays, so if you or someone you know is interested in volunteering as a bubbe, let us know <https://bbox.blackbaudhosting.com/webforms/service/page.redir?target=https%3a%2f%2ftinyurl.com%2fmr2ct2r9&srcid=62986320&srctid=1&erid=-870696026&trid=ce1f056a-35cb-4fac-adf6-198a360fef37>.

Newsletter Infotur Latam 10-08-26

Director General: Carlos Bernuy
Hoteles Mandarin Oriental encabezan colección Debut de guía de viajes de Forbes
Forbes Travel Guide (FTG), la autoridad mundial en hospitalidad de lujo, anunció hoy el lanzamiento de sus colecciones de descubrimiento Debut y Curated, ampliando la guía de viajes de lujo más confiable del mundo con nuevos hoteles y cruceros más allá de su aclamada cartera de hoteles con clasificación por estrellas.  Leer más Iberia se corona como la aerolínea más rentable de IAG
Iberia saca músculo dentro de IAG. La aerolínea comandada por Marco Sansavini, inmersa en la ejecución del ambicioso ‘Plan de Vuelo 2030’, ha cerrado el primer semestre del año con el mayor margen operativo del grupo, afianzándose como la compañía más rentable.
Leer más  America’s Got Talent LIVE on Stage se estrena a bordo de Legend of the Seas
America’s Got Talent LIVE on Stage, el primer espectáculo en el mar del aclamado programa de televisión, se ha estrenado oficialmente a bordo del barco más nuevo de Royal Caribbean, Legend of the Seas.
Leer másTTW presenta los 50 mejores destinos del mundo para viajar solo en 2026
Travel And Tour World (TTW) presenta hoy su lista de los 50 mejores destinos para viajar solo en el mundo en 2026 , una clasificación editorial definitiva que celebra los destinos que están elevando el arte de viajar de forma independiente.
Leer más Mincetur designa a Liz Chirinos Cuadros como nueva viceministra de Turismo
El Ministerio de Comercio Exterior y Turismo (Mincetur) designó hoy a Liz Chirinos Cuadros como nueva viceministra de Turismo, mediante la Resolución Suprema N° 004-2026-MINCETUR, publicada en el Diario Oficial El Peruano.
Leer más  Big Sur se merece un gran respeto
Con el fin de garantizar un recorrido más seguro, fluido y agradable por Big Sur, el County of Monterey ha establecido una prohibición de aparcamiento de 12 meses cerca del puente de Bixby. See Monterey anima a los visitantes a seguir el Camino Correcto (The Right Path™) planificando su visita con antelación, viajando de forma responsable y respetando este extraordinario paisaje.
Leer másSouthwest Airlines ofrece más ventajas para los viajes de negocios
Southwest Airlines anuncia hoy nuevos beneficios para Southwest Business con la introducción de Business Priority y la conectividad New Distribution Capability (NDC). Diseñadas para programas de viajes corporativos, estas nuevas ofertas brindan a los viajeros de negocios elegibles asistencia el día del viaje y a los socios mayor flexibilidad y opciones para acceder al contenido de Southwest a través de herramientas de reserva de terceros participantes.Leer más SLS Playa Mujeres, lujo y universo culinario en el Caribe Mexicano
Hay destinos que se descubren a través de sus paisajes, y otros que se recuerdan por sus sabores. En SLS Playa Mujeres, el Caribe se vive también desde la mesa: entre una cocina italiana inspirada en recetas familiares, la intensidad de los sabores mexicanos, el ritual de un corte perfectamente preparado o la frescura de un cóctel frente al mar.
Leer más  La Unesco incorpora veintiséis nuevos tesoros del patrimonio mundial
La Lista del Patrimonio Mundial de la Unesco volvió a expandirse con la incorporación de 26 nuevos sitios de excepcional valor cultural, natural y mixto, una decisión que refuerza los esfuerzos internacionales por preservar algunos de los lugares más representativos de la historia, la biodiversidad y la identidad de la humanidad. La actualización fue aprobada durante la más reciente sesión del Comité del Patrimonio Mundial, consolidando un nuevo paso en la protección de espacios considerados irremplazables por su importancia universal.
Leer más Belize consolida su posición como referente del turismo sostenible en el Caribe
Entre selvas tropicales de un verde intenso, ríos sinuosos, cascadas revitalizadas por las lluvias y comunidades profundamente conectadas con la naturaleza, Belize vive uno de sus períodos más especiales del año. Con la apertura oficial de la ventana promocional de la campaña “Green Season” (Temporada Verde), válida entre el 15 de agosto y el 15 de noviembre, el destino refuerza su propuesta de ofrecer una experiencia de viaje más sostenible, inmersiva y genuina.
Leer másEstados Unidos resiente millonarias pérdidas por caída del turismo canadiense
El turismo estadounidense enfrenta uno de sus escenarios más complejos de los últimos años como consecuencia de la significativa reducción en la llegada de visitantes procedentes de Canadá, su principal mercado internacional. La disminución de los viajes ha comenzado a traducirse en pérdidas económicas estimadas en unos 3.000 millones de dólares, afectando especialmente a estados fronterizos, destinos vacacionales y negocios que tradicionalmente dependen del gasto realizado por los viajeros canadienses durante todo el año.

'+ my FREE sales training next week!**I don’t think I need to apologize for this, Dave, but I DID get a lot of replies to last week’s email about my 5 Wholesale Myths that are costing you time, money, and confidence.**

Most surprising was folks saying “Myth 1: I can figure this out on my own” rubbed you the wrong way, so I want to address it.

**But before I do:**

******join my LIVE Wholesale Success System training next Tues, Aug 18 or Wed, Aug 19, where you DON’T have to figure out how to grow sales on your own!** 

**Click here to save your free spot.** http://www.alliball.com/highsales

** **

**So to be 100% clear: I love a scrappy founder who DIY’s it! **

(and there’s a difference between DIY’ing it, and building your biz blindly, without guidance - stick with me!)

Scrappy biz building was my jam for 

**years** when I started my business in 2014. 

I DIY’d my website, my business cards, my email funnels, my marketing, my trade show flyers, my Retail Ready® workbooks - basically everything. 

It was the right move in that era, because THE THING I had to invest in building my biz was time. I didn’t have much money to invest, but I had time to figure things out. 

It got me quite far, and helped me build something I was proud of, that covered (just barely!) my rent in San Francisco in the early days. 

**And then - at some point in my biz - I realized that what had gotten me HERE wasn’t gonna get me THERE.**

I had big goals. I had huge dreams of helping more people, and working with more brands.

**I bet you have those big dreams too - to see your product on more shelves and in more homes!**

**And I knew that figuring everything out on my own was slowing down my growth, profitability, and - maybe worst of all - my sanity.**

You see, I was OVERWHELMED. I was working wayyyy more than I wanted to in my biz, and while I WAS growing, it was coming at a cost: non-stop thinking about my biz, solving problems in my head while out with friends, never fully present with my husband bc I was almost always “figuring it out” in my brain instead of really having a convo with him.

Tell me you can relate to that, Dave.

So what did I do? I started to slowly invest in learning from others who could shortcut my growth. 

**Let me be crystal clear: I kept DIYing it**- I was still the person who DID the things in my biz - 

**but I started to learn sales systems, business strategy, best-practices, and profitability frameworks from people who knew more than I did.**

That year (2016!) - the first year that I moved from “I need to figure everything out myself!” to “oh wait, someone has done this online course thing before me and maybe I should use their system instead of reinventing the wheel and learning through trial and error….” - I DOUBLED my revenue the same year.

**Ready to stop DIYing it alone?**

Save your free spot here! https://www.alliball.com/highsales

That was 10 years ago, and it was the year that Retail Ready® was born. HOLY MOLY, RETAIL READY® IS 10!

That proved even though I didn’t have the budget to hire a team or get people to take things off my plate - I could invest MY time, using someone else’s proven systems, and see massive changes in my biz.

So that’s the point I wanted to make last week: 

**DIYing it isn’t the thing that’s slowing you down.** I LOVE a founder who DIY’s it!

**What’s slowing you down is DIYing it all by yourself, thinking you’ve got to figure it all out on your own.**

****

So if you have a product that you KNOW deserves to be in your dream accounts - and you’re ready for a step-by-step system on how to do it:

Alli

August 10, 2026

*Updates*

For more business updates and live support from business experts, visit *Business.NJ.gov [ http://business.nj.gov/ ].*
Already have an account? *Log in [ https://navigator.business.nj.gov/onboarding?page=1 ].*

 
*Employers Must Comply with Expanded Job-Protected Leave Requirements [ https://nj.gov/labor/myleavebenefits/worker/job-protection-information/more-protections.shtml?utm_source=govdelivery&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20260810_nwsltr&utm_content=biz&utm_term=ben ]*

As of July 17, 2026, New Jersey employers must provide job-protected leave to more workers. The law has expanded in two key ways:

Workers receiving Temporary Disability Insurance or Family Leave Insurance benefits now have job protection during their leave if not already covered by the New Jersey Family Leave Act or the federal Family and Medical Leave Act. There's no minimum employer size for this requirement. A worker's eligibility for benefits is based on their *recent earnings [ https://nj.gov/labor/myleavebenefits/worker/tdi/#earnings?utm_source=govdelivery&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20260810_nwsltr&utm_content=biz&utm_term=ben ].*

The New Jersey Family Leave Act now covers employers with 15 or more employees worldwide (down from 30), in addition to continuing to cover both State and local government agencies of all sizes. Employees qualify after three months and 250 hours worked (down from 12 months and 1,000 hours). These workers remain eligible for up to 12 weeks of protected leave in a 24-month period.

Review the updated guidance to ensure you're in compliance.

Review Guidance [ https://nj.gov/labor/myleavebenefits/worker/job-protection-information/more-protections.shtml?utm_source=govdelivery&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20260810_nwsltr&utm_content=biz&utm_term=ben ]

New Jersey changed its ACH banking routing and account numbers on May 27, 2026. If you make automated tax or employer payments to the State and haven't updated your payment software, your payments are failing now.

The deadline to update your software was June 30. Payments submitted with old banking information after that date will not go through. Failed payments are your responsibility to correct and may subject you to penalties and interest.

Contact your financial institution or software provider immediately to update the State's routing and account numbers for all New Jersey ACH credit tax and employer payments.

Learn More [ https://www.nj.gov/treasury/revenue/eft1.shtml?utm_source=govdelivery&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20260810_nwsltr&utm_content=biz&utm_term=tax ]

________________________________________________________________________


 

*Keep Up-to-Date With Your Tax Filings [ https://account.business.nj.gov/?utm_source=govdelivery&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20260810_nwsltr&utm_content=biz&utm_term=tax ]*

A Business.NJ.gov account gives you personalized information on starting and managing your New Jersey business. You can find out what licenses you need, form your business, get a calendar with your tax due deadlines, see your annual reporting deadline, and more.

Get Started [ https://account.business.nj.gov/?utm_source=govdelivery&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20260810_nwsltr&utm_content=biz&utm_term=tax ]

Welcome to Edition 452 of Institute InBrief.

In many therapeutic spaces, there is an unspoken ideal of what a "good client" looks like. They are reflective, articulate, insightful and motivated. On the surface, these clients appear to be doing everything right. They say the right things, make connections to their past and often demonstrate a clear intellectual understanding of their patterns. Yet, despite this apparent engagement, something can feel subtly off.

In this edition, we explore what can be conceptualised as the "good client" problem: the ways in which clients may engage in therapy in ways that align with expectations of insight and participation, while remaining emotionally disconnected from the deeper processes required for psychological change. We examine the tension between performing and experiencing and consider how helpers can recognise and work with this often-overlooked dynamic in the therapeutic relationship.

We also invite you to hear from Bachelor of Counselling graduate, Jesica who shares how she realised that counselling was the right career path for her. Her story offers a personal reflection on the motivations that draw people to the helping professions and the impact that counselling can have on both practitioners and the communities they serve.

The "Good Client" Problem: When Clients Perform Healing Instead of Experiencing It

When Therapy Looks Like It’s Working

In many therapeutic spaces, there is an unspoken ideal of what a “good client” looks like. They are reflective, articulate, insightful, and motivated. They engage in sessions, complete tasks, and demonstrate self-awareness. On the surface, these clients appear to be doing everything right. They say the right things, make connections to their past, and often demonstrate a clear intellectual understanding of their patterns.

Yet, despite this apparent engagement, something can feel subtly off. Progress stalls. Emotional depth remains limited. Insight does not translate into change. What emerges in these moments is not resistance in its traditional form, but something far more complex: the performance of healing.

Here we explore what can be conceptualised as the “good client” problem: where clients engage in therapy in ways that align with expectations of insight and participation yet remain emotionally disengaged from the deeper processes required for psychological change. Drawing on literature related to emotional processing, experiential avoidance, and psychotherapy process research, we argue that therapy can become performative when emotional experiencing is replaced with intellectualisation, ultimately limiting therapeutic outcomes.

What Creates Change in Therapy?

A central assumption across multiple therapeutic modalities is that insight alone is insufficient for meaningful psychological change. While cognitive understanding can support awareness, enduring change is more consistently associated with emotional processing and experiential engagement (Greenberg, 2011; Elliott et al., 2004).

Emotion-Focused Therapy (EFT), for example, posits that transformation occurs when clients access, experience, and reorganise emotional responses in-session (Greenberg, 2011). Similarly, process-experiential approaches emphasise the importance of “felt experience” as a mechanism of change, rather than purely cognitive insight (Elliott et al., 2004).

From an Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) perspective, psychological distress is often maintained through experiential avoidance, where individuals attempt to avoid or control internal experiences such as thoughts, emotions, or bodily sensations (Hayes et al., 1996). In therapy, this avoidance can be subtle and not presented as overt resistance, but more so as over-intellectualisation or narrative detachment.

Research on common factors further reinforces this position. While the therapeutic alliance is a strong predictor of outcomes, it is not simply agreement or rapport that drives change, but the depth of emotional engagement within that relationship (Norcross & Lambert, 2019; Wampold & Imel, 2015).

body:
y’all love a listHi Dave!

**Turns out you like lists! Earlier this week I sent a list of 5 Myths about Wholesale, and I got more replies to that email than any other this season.**

**(and some of the replies were grumpy - more about that on Monday!)**

Soooo, let’s do another list, shall we? 

**Look, I know you’ve thought about getting help in your biz so that you can land in your dream accounts and finally do that IG post saying, “you can now find us at XYZ market!”**

You’re looking at other brands, and wondering, “how are they growing so quickly?!” 

Here are 5 Things Those “IT BRANDS” stopped telling themselves about getting support + putting a wholesale strategy in place:

Founder Mindset Mistake 1:  “I don't have the budget right now to invest in a system.” 

Million Dollar Mindset → “I’m wasting so much money, time, and resources by winging my sales strategy.” 

**You’ve got high hopes for the trade show that just doesn’t bring the right leads. You invested in Pop Up Grocer, only to realize it’s a costly marketing play that has negative ROI. You priced yourself incorrectly, and now you’re LOSING money on the shelf. You spent soooo much time getting that new account, but they haven’t ever reordered. You’re constantly pitching and following up, and following up and following up but feel like you’re spinning your wheels. **

**Mistakes are expensive - whether that’s with your time, money, or energy.**

** **

****

****

Founder Mindset Mistake 2: “I don't have time.” 

****

Million Dollar Mindset → “I don’t have time TO WASTE.” 

Real talk: Y

**ou don't feel like you have time BECAUSE you don't have a system that you use over and over to land new accounts and hit your sales goals once there.** What’s more - you don’t have a system that WORKS. 

30 minutes a week inside a proven framework saves you dozens of hours of trial-and-error. 

**Systems ARE the thing that will save your sanity!**

 

Founder Mindset Mistake 3: “I need to build brand awareness first.”

****

Million Dollar Mindset → “Building brand awareness is a procrastination technique I’m using to avoid selling my product.” 

This one is tough to hear! 

**Building brand awareness is BS, and I get riled up when founders say they need to spend more time focusing on that before they launch into retail. **

**Wholesale buyers do not care that you have followers on Instagram** and get great engagement on your posts. They do not care that you’re “building in public” and document your founder journey. 

**They simply care that you are going to sell in their account.**

And how do you do that? You ACTIVELY SELL IN THOSE ACCOUNTS. (Inside Retail Ready® we call this The Coordinated Kickoff and Reorder Magic tools - so you’ve got a crystal clear plan for high sales in the first 30 days of landing your new account, and then a quarterly plan to hit your sales goals year round). 

Our brains want “easy.” It’s an easy win to post on IG. But 

**if we’re REALLY being honest with ourselves - is “building brand awareness” impacting your revenue this season?** If so - great. If not - time to go get closer to the sale.

Founder Mindset Mistake 4: “The last time I trusted an expert it cost me money and didn't work.” 

****

Million Dollar Mindset → “that wasn’t the right help for me, or my stage of business.” 

You’ve spent money before - on agencies, consultants, courses or programs. I’m sure some of it helped, and a lot of didn’t. So now you have your guard up, which makes sense! 

**The problem with being burned in the past means you think help doesn’t exist - which isn’t true.** It simply means you didn’t get the RIGHT help for your biz - yet!

 

Founder Mindset Mistake 5: “I'm successful at everything else. Why does wholesale make me feel like I have no idea what I'm doing?” 

****

Million Dollar Mindset → “I’ve never done this before. Of course it feels like I’m learning a new language.” 

It's not you. It’s that 

**our industry is far from transparent:**big brands, big corporations, busy buyers, and the little guys just trying to get by! I started Retail Ready® because the rules of retail 

**weren't** written down. The language wasn't taught. 

So you’re not incompetent, or too old, or too young for this -  you're just operating without information that 

**should** be more accessible.

Ok ouffff I did NOT expect that to go so long - but what can I say? I love writing, and I don’t rely on ChatGPT to edit for me 😆

Happy weekend,

Alli

PS. 

**On Monday, I’ll tell you more about the founders who wrote back, upset about my comment on DIYing it,** and what I wish I had said in my previous email.  

Plus,

**you’ll get your first invite to our free Wholesale Success System training on Aug 18 and 19th.** 

**Stay tuned ‘til then.**

 

https://www.alliball.com/retailready 

**Alli Ball**(she/her)

Founder & CEO at Food Biz Wiz® h

Disgraced. Beheaded. And out for revenge . . .

We all know what happened to Henry VIII’s second wife, Anne Boleyn. But what if she woke up the day after her execution and took it upon herself to seek justice?

“Nobody was surprised at Anne’s conviction. The world loves to put a woman in her place.”

The Beheading Game begins in the hours after Anne Boleyn’s beheading, when she wakes to find herself unceremoniously in an arrow chest, her head wrapped in linen at her knees. Discarded by King Henry VIII for not being able to give him a male heir, reviled by Cromwell for being too smart for her own good, and executed based on trumped-up charges, Anne escapes the tower, sews her head back on, and sets out on a quest for vengeance.

Traveling the streets of London in the guise of a commoner, with the help of a prostitute who becomes a trusted friend, Anne navigates the London streets she never before walked and soon realizes how little she knew about life in the real world. If Kelly Link had teamed up with Hilary Mantel, the result might be The Beheading Game. An epic journey through the wilds of British royal history and a prescient reminder that “mouthy” women have always been punished, The Beheading Game finally allows one of history’s most maligned women a chance to tell her side of the story.

For years, building a proper funnel meant one of two things: either you paid a designer & developer a small fortune, or you spent your own precious hours wrestling with a page builder trying to make it look halfway decent.

Neither of those is a great use of your time or money - especially when you're testing new offers & you need to move FAST.

That's what makes this so exciting. With a tool called [Claude Design](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uxs6-JFNmeQ), you can now describe the funnel you want & have AI build it for you - in your brand's exact colors, fonts & style.

A Design System is what teaches the AI everything about YOUR brand - your logo, your colors, your fonts, your voice & your style - so that every funnel it builds actually looks like it belongs to your business.

You simply describe your company in a sentence or two, drop in your website URL & upload your logo _(I also like to add a photo of myself)_. The AI then studies your entire site - all your colors, icons, cards, layouts & branding - & builds a complete Design System around it.

NH BOSS 

A Message from the Director

tiffany  [ https://dlcp.dc.gov/jobs ] 

Dear Customers, Colleagues, and Friends,

August marks a long‑awaited milestone for the Department of Licensing and Consumer Protection (DLCP) as we proudly welcome BOSS, our new platform designed to make business registration and licensing easier, faster, and more intuitive. We’ve been working hard to build a modern system that meets the needs of our business community, and we are excited to share it with you.

We welcome you to the first edition of the BOSS Bulletin, providing an update on this important moment for DLCP. Along with information about the launch of BOSS, this newsletter also features highlights from the agency’s recent work, including key initiatives and activities from the past several weeks. 

BOSS brings essential DLCP services together in one convenient place, giving businesses a modern experience that simplifies every step of the process. From licensing updates to corporate registration, everything will soon be accessible through a single, streamlined system built with customers in mind. The platform officially launches next week, marking an important step in how businesses access and manage essential services.

We’re grateful for your support as we begin this new chapter and look forward to the positive impact BOSS will have in the District.

 
signature

Tiffany Crowe
Director

________________________________________________________________________


 

Shaping and Elevating the District’s Licensing Experience

UAT  

DLCP completed a focused round of External User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for the District’s new consolidated licensing platform, BOSS. As the launch approaches, external partners were invited to test the system the week of July 20 to help confirm that the platform is intuitive, functional, and ready for public use.

BOSS 2  

Participants included individuals familiar with DLCP’s current licensing systems as well as those exploring the new platform for the first time. Each tester received instructions, login details, and guided scenarios that allowed them to move through BOSS in the same way they would during a real filing. Their involvement gave DLCP a clear look at how the system operates from the perspective of everyday users.

BOSS 3  

The feedback from testing was encouraging. Many participants shared that logging into Access DC was very easy, and once inside the system, finding the correct application was straightforward. Most users described completing their tasks in BOSS as easy, and several noted that the new platform feels much better than the systems they previously used.

BOSS 4 

Participants also offered helpful observations that will support future refinements. Users generally found the on-screen questions easy to follow and appreciated how the system walked them through each step. A few suggestions, such as adding a timeline on the payment page to help applicants know what happens next, will help strengthen the experience even further.

This round of testing offered insight into how BOSS functions in real scenarios and highlighted thoughtful ways to enhance the user journey. DLCP is grateful for the time and feedback that participants contributed, and their input is helping shape the final adjustments ahead of the platform’s launch.

________________________________________________________________________


 

BOSS Matters for Businesses
Why BOSS Matters 
________________________________________________________________________


 

Platform Features
Platform Features 
________________________________________________________________________


 

Agency Partnership for Improved Customer Experience

In addition to sharing data with DLCP to support licensing and compliance efforts, the *Office of Tax and Revenue (OTR)* [ https://otr.cfo.dc.gov/ ] and the *Department of Buildings (DOB) [ https://dob.dc.gov/ ]* has implemented several system enhancements of its own. These improvements are designed to help businesses complete key licensing‑related tasks more efficiently and to streamline the review process for staff.

Denial Reason Highlights 

Clear, standardized denial reason flags have been introduced within the licensing workflow. These updates help staff quickly identify the specific issue that triggered a denial, reduce follow‑up time, and give applicants more accurate guidance on resolving outstanding concerns. This enhancement supports consistent decision‑making and improves transparency across the licensing process.

Newsletter Infotur Latam 07-08-26
Si no puede visualizar bien este boletín haga clic AQUÍLima, viernes 07 de agosto del 2026
Director General: Carlos Bernuy
Four Seasons llega a Venecia con la reapertura de Danieli
La esperada reapertura de Danieli, Venezia, A Four Seasons Hotel ya es una realidad con la llegada de sus primeros huéspedes. Ubicado en un enclave privilegiado sobre la Riva degli Schiavoni, el hotel ofrece vistas a San Giorgio Maggiore desde su terraza en la azotea, mientras que muchas de sus habitaciones se asoman a la laguna. En ellas, las cortinas se abren como en un gran teatro para revelar el paisaje veneciano.
Leer más Iberia fletará un vuelo exclusivo para contemplar el eclipse total de Sol
Iberia ha organizado un vuelo especial para observar, a más de 10.000 metros de altitud, el fenómeno astronómico más esperado del año: el eclipse total de Sol del próximo 12 de agosto. Con el objetivo de compartir esta experiencia única, la aerolínea retransmitirá el evento en directo a través de sus redes sociales. De esta forma, cualquier usuario podrá disfrutar en tiempo real de imágenes inéditas desde una posición privilegiada, por encima de las nubes.Leer más
Regent Seven Seas Cruises eleva la experiencia de la Clase Explorer
Regent Seven Seas Cruises, anunció sus planes para transformar algunas de las suites a bordo de sus barcos de la Clase Explorer, incorporando suites más amplias, una nueva categoría de suite y una menor capacidad para ofrecer una experiencia a bordo aún más espaciosa y lujosa. Tras las renovaciones previstas para 2027 y 2028, Seven Seas Explorer, Seven Seas Splendor y Seven Seas Grandeur navegarán con un máximo de solo 344 suites, frente a las 373 actuales. La eliminación de 29 suites en cada barco proporcionará aún más espacio inigualable.
Leer másUn día en la vida de un baño de aeropuerto: todo lo que ocurre antes de las vacaciones
Son las seis de la mañana y la terminal ya está en movimiento. Las primeras maletas recorren las cintas, las cafeterías empiezan a llenarse y los paneles anuncian las salidas del día. Mientras los pasajeros buscan su puerta de embarque, hay otro espacio que comienza a recibir un flujo constante de usuarios: el baño del aeropuerto.
Leer más 7 datos que invitan a viajar a Chequia ya mismo
América Latina ha encontrado a su nuevo destino favorito en Europa. Las cifras oficiales lo confirman: durante los primeros cinco meses de 2026, la llegada de viajeros latinoamericanos a Chequia creció un impresionante 12.8% en comparación con 2025, marcando un récord histórico sin precedentes para el país.
Leer más  Descubre la Ruta de Sabores Latinos de Kissimmee
Con una diversa selección de restaurantes, cafeterías, food trucks y bares, la Ruta de Sabores Latinos de Experience Kissimmee invita a los visitantes a experimentar la riqueza y el dinamismo de la escena culinaria en constante evolución de esta ciudad de la Florida, ubicada a 25 minutos del Aeropuerto Internacional de Orlando. Creada originalmente en octubre de 2025, como resultado de una alianza con Atlas Obscura, la ruta gastronómica se amplió a 40 restaurantes, resaltando aún más el vibrante legado hispano y latino del condado de Osceola.
Leer másEasyjet vendida a Apollo por 6.700 millones de eurosLa segunda low cost de Europa, Easyjet, aceptó en la tarde de este jueves su venta a Apollo, un fondo de inversiones americano.
Leer más El Grand Cayman Marriott Resort inaugura la recuperación de su zona de playa
El Grand Cayman Marriott Resort inicia una nueva etapa al restaurar su zona de playa e introducir una serie de mejoras diseñadas para elevar la experiencia de los huéspedes a lo largo de la costa más famosa de la isla.
Leer más  Priority Pass anuncia la llegada de Priority Lane al Aeropuerto Internacional Jorge Chávez
Priority Pass, el programa original y líder mundial de experiencias aeroportuarias, continúa fortaleciendo su propuesta de valor en Perú con la incorporación de Priority Lane al Aeropuerto Internacional Jorge Chávez. Este nuevo servicio permite a los pasajeros acceder a los filtros de seguridad mediante carriles exclusivos, reduciendo los tiempos de espera y ofreciendo una experiencia aeroportuaria más fluida desde el inicio de su recorrido.
Leer más India fortalece su turismo como motor clave del crecimiento
El sector de los viajes y el turismo continúa consolidándose como uno de los principales impulsores de la economía de India, al registrar una contribución estimada de 263.600 millones de dólares durante 2025. Esta actividad no solo mantiene un crecimiento sostenido, sino que también reafirma su importancia como una fuente estratégica de inversión, generación de empleo y desarrollo económico en un país que busca fortalecer su posición entre los principales destinos turísticos del mundo.

subject: What $3.1 Billion in Customer Data Reveals About Your Ads
body:
There's a Question that every single business must know the answer to - and almost none of them actually do.

It's not your revenue. It's not your number of customers. It's not even your average order value.

The Question is this: How much is a customer actually worth to you at every single day of the journey - for every product, every funnel, every traffic source & every affiliate?

I know that's a mouthful, but stick with me here - because once you see what I'm about to share, you won't be able to unsee it.

I recently sat down for an incredible episode of the Marketing Minds Podcast with Tyler Ryan - a former NASA software engineer (yes, actual rocket science) & the Founder & CEO of Data-Driven OS. Tyler's team has analyzed over $3.1 Billion in customer data, & what he shared completely reframes the way you should think about your Lifetime Value (LTV) & Cost to Acquire (CAC).

This one hits close to home for me, because it connects directly to something I preach all the time: The Business that can afford to spend the most to acquire a customer WINS. And the only way to know how much you can actually afford to spend... is to know what your customers are truly worth.

As a Reminder, Our Goal with this Newsletter is to Give You the Highest Level of Value Possible. That's my Promise to you & I intend to Over-Deliver!

**Here's a Sneak Peek at What's Inside This Email:**

* Why the "single LTV number" you're using right now is not just ineffective - it's potentially dangerous

* The "Fog" that's silently dragging down your margins (& why you can't see it)

* How your LTV can be $60-$80 higher on one platform vs another - & why the "average" makes you wrong everywhere

* The big risk of blindly dumping your data into AI to get your numbers

Alright, let's Dive In...

———————————————————————————

# Watch the Full Video on YouTube:

Youtube: Why Your 'Average' LTV Is Killing Your Ad Spend (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JtKZAxCXw4A)

Watch the Full Video on YouTube! (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JtKZAxCXw4A)

———————————————————————————

# The $300 LTV Trap 

Let me ask you a simple question: What's your LTV?

If your answer is a single number - let's say "$300" - I've got some tough love for you. That number is essentially meaningless.

Here's why, & this was one of my favorite parts of the conversation with Tyler. The moment you say "my LTV is $300," the very next question should be: At what day?

Because that number could represent 30 days... or it could represent 5 years. And those are wildly different realities.

Most businesses calculate LTV the lazy way - they take all their revenue & divide it by all their customers. Tyler put it perfectly: when you do that, you're blending apples, oranges & pears together into one number. You're taking customers who are 1 day old, 275 days old & 3 years old, mashing them all together, & landing on the highest possible version of that number.

And here's the dangerous part - if you then go spend on ads based off that $300 figure, thinking "I can afford to spend up to $300 to acquire a customer," but it actually takes your customers 2-3 years to hit that number... you're going to get crushed.

As Tyler said it: Averages kill insights.

———————————————————————————

# LTV Isn't a Number - It's a Curve

This is the mindset shift.

Real LTV isn't a single point. It's a curve that tells a story over time:

* Day 0 = your Average Order Value (the money you make right when they buy)

* Then a Day 1 value, Day 7, Day 14, Day 30, Day 60, Day 90, Day 180, Day 365... & beyond

When you can see that full curve, everything changes. Now you can have the real conversation every business SHOULD be having:

"Based on my LTV, how much can I actually afford to spend to acquire a customer - & how long am I willing to wait to make that money back?"

Maybe you're comfortable spending against your 30-day LTV. Maybe you can afford to spend against your 90-day LTV because your cash flow allows you to wait a little longer. Either way - THAT is how you unlock the ability to outspend your competition.

Think about it. If all you knew was your $300 AOV, you'd be terrified to spend more than $300 to acquire a customer. But if you could see that those same customers grow to $383 over the next year... you now have a competitive advantage. You can confidently spend more up front to win, because you KNOW the backend is coming.

That's the exact concept I talk about with ROAS & Risk Arbitrage - but it only works when you can actually SEE the full picture.

Here's what's happening in August.**HELLO MEMBERS!**

**I hope you're all doing well!**

I don't know about you, but summer always makes me eager to get out, socialize, and connect with new people. 

If you feel likewise, I'd encourage you to check out the community events calendar for your Launch location. 

Our Community Directors have a ton of events planned in August, and they're a great way to break up your workday and meet fellow members.

On another note, I recently read the book Do Hard Things: Why We Get Resilience Wrong and the Surprising Science of Real Toughness by Steve Magness https://www.goodreads.com/en/book/show/59088361-do-hard-things.

The author offers an interesting take, challenging traditional myths about toughness and arguing that real strength comes from within—through self-awareness, emotional intelligence, and listening to your body.

I'd give it 3.97 stars and say it's worth a read if you're curious about new perspectives on what it means to achieve your high ambitions in the face of hard things.

That's all for now. 

**Talk to you next month!**

**Mike Kriel**

CEO

**ALEXANDRIA ** *

* 

**Breakfast with Launch**: This month, we'll be hosting our breakfast events every Tuesday and Thursday at 9:30 a.m.!

**INTERESTING READS**

**Your top five hand-curated links on the ways people work… **

 

1 

 

A deep dive into what makes certain things go viral https://mackensiedebello.substack.com/p/i-spent-hours-studying-why-things.

 

2 

 

Why the number of "solopreneurs" earning $1 million per year doubled between 2023 and 2025 https://www.stripeeconomics.com/p/the-age-of-the-solopreneur (and is multiplying faster than employer businesses).

 

3 

 

What 16 Harvard Business School professors are reading this summer https://www.library.hbs.edu/working-knowledge/harvard-business-school-faculty-summer-reader-2026.

 

4 

 

Professional athletes share their secrets to getting a good night’s sleep https://www.theguardian.com/lifeandstyle/2026/jul/18/sports-stars-on-sleep-tips-ezri-konsa-katarina-johnson-thompson-adam-peaty.

 

5 

 

"Grey hat" GEO: how companies are influencing AI chatbots to smear their competitors https://sherwood.news/tech/companies-are-getting-ai-chatbots-to-smear-their-competitors.

**AI TOOL OF THE MONTH**

**A quick recommendation for using AI to work better. **

**AI note-takers typically linger in your meetings like an awkward, uninvited guest. Granola gets rid of that problem while offering all the same benefits (and then some). **

The simplest win you get when using Granola https://www.granola.ai/ is that it never actually joins your meeting. 

Instead, it sits on your computer or phone, listens in the background, and leaves you free to talk naturally. 

Then, you walk away with a transcript. If you scribble a few fragments mid-call, you can drop them into the tool, and it'll bake them into your meeting notes. 

But you also get a ton of tertiary benefits. You can use Granola for other purposes, like: 

* 

**Making sure your calls feel human:** No bot ever joins, so sales pitches and delicate conversations keep their natural feel while every word still gets captured.

* 

**Instantly prepping for future calls:** Ask what a client said last month, or what you committed to over your last three calls, before the next one starts.

* 

**Turning meetings into deliverables:** Recipes turn a wrapped call into a follow-up email, a proposal outline, or an action list in one command.

Newsletter Infotur Latam 06-08-26
Si no puede visualizar bien este boletín haga clic AQUÍLima, jueves 06 de agosto del 2026
Director General: Carlos Bernuy
Marriott International Caribe y Latinoamérica brindan experiencias para conectar con el destino
A medida que los viajeros buscan cada vez más experiencias centradas en la conexión, el descubrimiento y el significado, Marriott International Caribe y Latinoamérica ofrece estancias cuidadosamente diseñadas que invitan a los huéspedes a descubrir destinos más allá de la habitación. Desde la combinación de ciudades vibrantes con costas apartadas y la participación en programas culturales interactivos hasta la adopción de la tendencia emergente de contemplar el atardecer a través de significativos rituales, el portafolio de Marriott ofrece un sinfín de maneras de vivir experiencias más profundas.
Leer más Southwest Airlines ofrece el Pase de Compañero para miembros de Rapid Rewards
Southwest Airlines lanza hoy una oferta promocional especial de Companion Pass para miembros de Rapid Rewards, que facilita más que nunca volar con un familiar, amigo o ser querido de forma gratuita. 1 Los clientes elegibles pueden designar a su acompañante y viajar con el Companion Pass promocional, que es válido para uso ilimitado en vuelos que califiquen desde el 5 de enero hasta el 3 de marzo de 2027.
Leer más  Royal Caribbean lanza promoción "Niños y adolescentes viajan gratis" para el verano 2027
Royal Caribbean lanza su oferta «Niños y Adolescentes Viajan Gratis» más ambiciosa hasta la fecha, lo que brinda a las familias la oportunidad de planear con mayor anticipación las aventuras del próximo verano en una destacada flota de barcos revolucionarios e itinerarios de ensueño.
Leer másTurismo y Negocios en Cusco: mi aprendizaje en su tercera edición
Viajar a Cusco por negocios no tiene pierde: es la oportunidad perfecta para conocer la ciudad desde una mirada corporativa, más allá del recorrido turístico tradicional.
Leer más 5 libros que se ganan un lugar en la maleta
Hay decisiones pequeñas que dicen mucho de un viaje, y una de ellas es el libro que entra en la maleta. No siempre es el que se estaba leyendo antes de salir ni el que llevaba meses en espera, es otro, uno que se adapta al ritmo del trayecto, a los tiempos muertos y al estado de ánimo que acompaña cada desplazamiento.
Leer más  Viajar a la segunda ciudad, una tendencia sustentable para la comunidad viajera
El turismo masivo es un problema global que se manifiesta con mayor intensidad en ciertos destinos, donde la infraestructura se ve desbordada y resulta cada vez más difícil equilibrar las necesidades de los viajeros con las de los residentes. Esta situación ha dado lugar a una tendencia cada vez más relevante: llamada «viajar a la segunda ciudad», que consiste en elegir destinos cercanos a las grandes urbes, pero menos masivos, que ofrecen experiencias más auténticas y con menor afluencia de turistas.
Leer másAir Canada y su Fundación brindan ayuda por los incendios forestales en el norte de Ontario
Mientras los incendios forestales siguen afectando a las comunidades del norte de Ontario, Air Canada, la Fundación Air Canada y Air Canada Cargo están trabajando junto con su socio humanitario de larga data, GlobalMedic, para ayudar a brindar apoyo fundamental a los bomberos de primera línea, los evacuados y las comunidades afectadas por la emergencia en curso.
Leer más
Mundo Imperial: donde los grandes eventos encuentran su mejor escenario
En la industria de reuniones, el éxito de un evento comienza mucho antes de que se abra el registro de asistentes, se construye desde la elección de una sede capaz de ofrecer infraestructura de primer nivel, operación impecable, capaces de simplificar la logística, enriquecer la experiencia de los asistentes y generar un entorno propicio para crear conexiones, cerrar negocios y dejar una impresión duradera.

Ubicada en la costa norte de Anguilla – territorio británico de ultramar en el Caribe oriental – Crocus Bay Beach se revela como uno de los enclaves más auténticos de la isla. subject: AI Moves Beyond Discovery into Booking, The Self-Guided Opportunity for Attractions
body:
AI search has been rapidly transforming how travelers search for things to do, but until now it has mostly been limited to discovery. But the next frontier for AI in travel — booking – is fast approaching. Satisfi Labs is the latest to get on board with their agentic AI ticketing agen t — here’s more on that and what it means for the future of travel experiences [ https://arival.travel/article/ai-agents-selling-attraction-tickets/?&utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=article_brand_awareness&siq_name=${Contacts.Contact%20Name}&siq_email=${Contacts.Email} ] .
Also, the latest Arival consumer data shows something interesting: despite all the hype around AI-powered self-guided tours, attractions are where the real opportunity lies. Travelers are roughly three times more likely to use self-guided technology inside an attraction than for a standalone self-guided walking tour… read more [ https://arival.travel/article/the-real-self-guided-opportunity-attractions/?&utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=article_brand_awareness&siq_name=${Contacts.Contact%20Name}&siq_email=${Contacts.Email} ] .

- Janelle Visser

ARIVAL INSIGHTS

The Real Self-Guided Opportunity: Attractions

Despite all of the AI-powered excitement around self-guided tours, the much bigger opportunity is with attractions, latest Arival data shows.
READ MORE [ https://arival.travel/article/the-real-self-guided-opportunity-attractions/?&utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=article_brand_awareness&siq_name=${Contacts.Contact%20Name}&siq_email=${Contacts.Email} ]

In DC, The Future of Experiences Executive Summit brought CEOs and senior leaders of the experiences sector into one room for a day of closed-door conversation about capital, growth, and building businesses that are forward-looking. If you lead an experiences business, this room is for you.

LEARN MORE [ https://arival.travel/event/experience-horizon-summit-apply/?&utm_source=promo&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=event_spokane&siq_name=${Contacts.Contact%20Name}&siq_email=${Contacts.Email} ]

TOP NEWS IN EXPERIENCES

1) Google-Viator Integration Makes Tours, Activities Bookable in Gemini [ https://techgenyz.com/gemini-viator-integration/ ]
With the “Gemini Viator” app, currently active for U.S. users only, users searching for things to do in Google’s AI chat interface, Gemini, can now book experiences directly in the chat. With this, AI search is rapidly progressing from the discovery phase to the booking phase of travel planning.

2) Airbnb Builds Tickets Team to Challenge Viator [ https://www.travelerstoday.com/articles/60669/20260731/airbnb-builds-tickets-team-challenge-viator-plans-traveler-wallet.htm ]
Standalone tickets to major attractions like the Colosseum and the Empire State Building have been bookable on Airbnb Experiences for awhile — Airbnb’s Head of Experiences Doug Weiss discussed this shift in Airbnb’s strategy recently at Arival [ https://arival.travel/sessions/airbnb-rebooted-experiences-one-year-in/ ] — but now, job postings for senior positions in a ticketing team suggest the company is planning to scale this sector of its experiences business more aggressively, competing with Viator, GetYourGuide, and even Expedia which recently acquired Tiqets [ https://www.phocuswire.com/expedia-group-tiqets-acquisition-expand-tours-and-activities-business ] .

3) Tours and Activities Growth is Outpacing Travel Overall, Distribution is Lagging [ https://www.phocuswire.com/news/distribution/tours-activities-distribution-phocuswright-research-2026 ]

PR teams have access to more data than ever before. But more data doesn’t always mean more clarity.

*Slower decision making when speed is critical 
*Blind spots that leave your brand exposed 
*Narratives being shaped out of your control

subject: Your go-to guide for accessible events
5 Myths about Wholesale
body:
this costs you time, money, and confidenceI was just interviewed for a podcast that will publish in a few months, and I outlined 

**5 things almost every founder believes about wholesale that are flat-out wrong.**

Wanna see the list, Dave?

The bad news is these beliefs are costing you accounts, margin, and your sanity - but the good news is that you can fix them all! 

**Wahooo!**

The challenge is that 

**these beliefs come from all the industry advice that’s flying around out there** - some of it’s good, but most of it was built for brands with $10M in revenue, a broker, multiple distributors, and a full team. That’s 

**likely not** you, so following their rules at your stage of biz is one of the most expensive mistakes you can make.

**I figured it would be helpful for you to hear them without having to wait until the Fourth Quarter, so here we go: **

 

Myth 1: “I can figure this out on my own.” 

Most founders believe this because they've figured out everything else and have been totally successful in another career, figuring it out.. 

But wholesale is a different language, and an entirely different world.

**Nowhere else are you out $25k because you didn’t know the difference between two acronyms on an invoice.**

Myth 2: You need a copacker, broker, and distributor to grow.

**Most of the advice for brands out there is for big brands, selling millions of dollars a year.**They tell brands to 'use a copacker / get a broker / get a distributor / get investment' and that doesn't work for MOST brands in the early stages. 

If you’re sitting here thinking you HAVE to use a distributor - think again.

**It’s your pitch that’s falling short, not that you don’t have a distributor**

(and again - that’s good news, bc the pitch we can fix!). We have Retail Ready® students land their dream accounts (Whole Foods! Erewhon! Sprouts! Local small chains!) - 

**all without a broker or distributor.** It’s true.

 

Myth 3: Sales “should” be simple.

☎️

**“If I just call these people, I'll get sales.”**

****

🍪

**“If I just swing by, the buyer can see how good my product is and they’ll want to carry it."  **

Nope. 

**We’ve got rules of retail**(do NOT swing by, do NOT drop off samples without an appointment, do NOT pitch come October, do NOT call during ordering/inventory hours, etc etc etc.) 

**that just aren’t known by the average founder.**

Myth 4: Getting into stores is the hard part.

Landing the account is actually the easy part. 

**Sustaining sell-through, getting reorders, staying profitable once you're there then become the hard part! **

Myth 5:  Other founders have some secret to success.

We get so caught up in these stories that we see on LinkedIn and Instagram - like the founder who looks like they're in every store or popped up as an overnight success. 

Social media is fake. 

**You're comparing your behind-the-scenes, low day to their highlight reel.**

My shameless plug is that

**YES - some founders DO have a secret to success**

**(actually over 3,500 have a success secret!)**- and it’s our Retail Ready® sales training program 🛒💪🏽

**More on that next week, when we kick off our August enrollment period with some juicy bonuses,** like the rest of August for FREEEEE, a $500 discount, our Gift Guide Magic cheatsheet for getting into holiday round ups, and your chance to lock in the lowest price of the year before it increases on August 22nd.

**So which myth did you need to hear today?** Write back and let me know - I’ll expand upon them if needed!

AI is an integral part of vendor research
66% regularly use AI to research vendors and solutions for work

AI shapes the shortlist 
92% say AI influenced the vendors they considered, and 83% say it affected their final decision.

Relevance beats brand recognition 
Only 7% notice a vendor because they already know the brand. Buyers care far more about whether it matches their specific use case. This creates opportunities.

AI doesn't replace search
After getting a recommendation, most buyers visit the vendor's website, search Google, compare alternatives, and check reviews before making a decision.

Con el objetivo de ofrecer un modelo que responda a un viajero que valora la identidad del destino, el servicio personalizado, el diseño, el bienestar y la posibilidad de vivir experiencias auténticas dentro de una propiedad independiente, Grupo Paseo del Sendero anunció una nueva etapa para Chukum Lagoon Hotel & Residences, con la incorporación al portafolio global de Preferred Hotels & Resorts. Dear Dave,

This Friday: Celebrate the last month of summer at our Embassy Row Rooftop Havana under the Stars! A partner or prior dance experience is not needed to attend, so join us on your own or with friends to experience a magical evening of dancing under the stars to a Latin band after salsa lessons. Make your reservations now to enjoy mojitos, and a night of dancing, as you make new friends. Space is limited. Watch video & reserve your spot!

Embassy of Sri Lanka Dinner Reception & Garden Soiree with Live Music & Dance Performances: Discover the Exotic Tropical Island Paradise of Sri Lanka on Friday, September 18.

The International Club of DC cordially requests the pleasure of your company for a very special evening at the Embassy of Sri Lanka. The evening includes an authentic dinner buffet of Sri Lankan delicacies prepared by the embassy chef along with the opportunity to learn about Sri Lanka, its people, geography, history, and culture

Newsletter Infotur Latam 03-08-26
Si no puede visualizar bien este boletín haga clic AQUÍLima, lunes 03 de agosto del 2026 Director General: Carlos Bernuy  Los mejores destinos del Caribe y México para la aventura y el bienestar
El verano de 2026 marca el regreso de los viajes con un propósito claro: buscar experiencias que nutran el espíritu, deleiten el paladar y fomenten una conexión más profunda con el mundo que nos rodea. Hoy, el verdadero lujo se define no solo por el destino en sí, sino por las historias que se crean a través de una gastronomía excepcional, un bienestar integral y una exploración local inmersiva.
Leer más Lufthansa inicia las pruebas de la nueva generación de AeroSHARK
Un Airbus A319 perteneciente a Lufthansa City Airlines se ha convertido en el primer avión de prueba a nivel mundial para una nueva generación de la tecnología de eficiencia de combustible AeroSHARK. La unidad, registrada con la matrícula D-ABGK y bautizada con el nombre de la ciudad de «Starnberg», sirve como plataforma para evaluar el rendimiento de aproximadamente 70 parches de película transparente, con dimensiones de 20 × 20 centímetros cada uno.Leer más
Holland America inicia reservas para primeros viajes del Zuiderdam a Europa
Holland America Line ha abierto las reservas para la primera serie de viajes del Zuiderdam tras su transformación a través de Holland America Evolution, la mayor inversión en flota de la compañía en sus 153 años de historia. Las mejoras del barco se estrenarán el 2 de abril de 2028, cuando el Zuiderdam vuelva a operar en el Mediterráneo antes de pasar el verano navegando desde Ámsterdam en viajes por el norte de Europa e Islandia.Leer másCopa Mundial FIFA 2026 ha redefinido el mapa de búsqueda de viajes
La Copa del Mundo FIFA 2026 no solo emocionó a los aficionados dentro de los estadios, también transformó el mapa turístico global. Nuevos datos de búsquedas de la plataforma Airbnb durante las fechas del torneo revelan cuáles de las naciones participantes registraron los mayores incrementos en el interés de los viajeros en comparación con el mismo período de 2025.
Leer más Un viaje por los más bellos paisajes de Cuba
Cuba tiene muchas maravillas, rincones que hoy los guías de turismo recomiendan para un paseo muy particular que permita sensaciones y conocer mejor la isla.
Leer más  España al alza con 46,6 millones de turistas en primer semestre del añoEspaña mantuvo su tendencia al alza en turismo internacional, con la llegada de cerca de 46,6 millones de visitantes internacionales en el primer semestre del año en curso.Leer másAir France-KLM registra ingresos por €9.300 millones en el segundo trimestre
Air France-KLM registró ingresos por €9.300 millones durante el segundo trimestre de 2026, un crecimiento interanual de 9,9%, impulsado por el desempeño positivo de todas sus líneas de negocio, especialmente la red de pasajeros y carga, favorecidas por una sólida demanda y una mayor preferencia por productos premium.
Leer más Four Seasons at The Surf Club da la bienvenida al chef ejecutivo del restaurante Lido
El Four Seasons Hotel at The Surf Club da la bienvenida a Michele Esposito como chef ejecutivo del restaurante Lido, el aclamado restaurante italiano del hotel, ubicado en el salón de baile original del histórico Surf Club.
Leer más  Brasil consolida avance de turismo internacional
Brasil se ubicó como el cuarto país de mayor incremento en la llegada de turistas internacionales de 2019 a 2025, al registrar un crecimiento de 46 por ciento, divulgaron hoy medios de prensa a partir de un informe oficial.Leer más Onfly llevará a México las tendencias que definirán el futuro de los viajes corporativos
Inteligencia artificial, automatización, analítica de datos y una nueva generación de viajeros corporativos están redefiniendo la forma en que las empresas administran sus viajes de negocios. En este contexto, las principales tendencias que marcarán el rumbo de la industria se discutirán del 3 al 5 de agosto durante la GBTA Convention 2026, el encuentro más importante a nivel mundial del sector, donde Onfly, la travel tech B2B más grande de América Latina, participará como expositora para acercar ese conocimiento al mercado mexicano.
Leer másAeropuerto de Filadelfia se asocia con Interplay Learning para ampliar capacitación en mantenimiento
Interplay Learning, proveedor líder de capacitación inmersiva para oficios especializados y artesanía industrial, anunció hoy una alianza con el Aeropuerto Internacional de Filadelfia (PHL) para ampliar la capacitación en mantenimiento de instalaciones del aeropuerto mediante la plataforma de aprendizaje bajo demanda basada en simulación de Interplay. Esta iniciativa está diseñada para apoyar el desarrollo de técnicos a medida que el personal experimentado se jubila y aumenta la demanda de personal de mantenimiento calificado en uno de los aeropuertos más transitados del país.

subject: The loneliest job in CPG
body:
your mom doesn’t get it**I’ve been thinking about loneliness a lot recently, Dave.**

Not in a “I’m so sad, boo hoo hooo” way, but more about the POWER of community, and what happens when you’re in a room with people who really get you - not people who make you feel less than, incompetent, or like a total newbie even though you’re not.

**Case in point: when I go to Expo West and patronizing old men look right past me to see who’s more important in the room, or ask me “What company do you work for, sweetheart?” **

 

**So yes, it can be lonely in our industry…**

💸 Your partner doesn’t understand why you have pretty good sales, but no cash in the checking account

🍪 Your friends think you have a cute side project, and you must LOVE your job bc all you do is bake cookies all day!

🙄 Your industry Slack group makes you feel further behind, or like you’ll never keep up with the VC-funded bro brands…

**But when you DO find your people - magic happens! **

Someone who says, “I’ve been where you are, and you’re thinking correctly about this.” or “Oh, I have the best resource for whole cumin seeds, with free shipping too!” 

**Why am I telling you this, Dave?**

☎️ It’s probably because

**I did our first group coaching call in Sales Bad-A$$ this week,** and SAW what happens when dozens of folks raise their hand with the same question, or nod along as I coached through pricing, pitching, following up, and sales emails.

**💞 Or because our Retail Ready® community has been SO DARN HELPFUL to each other this season** - like 2 founders going back and forth on regulation on protein claims yesterday (beyond my expertise, that’s for sure!).

So if you’re feeling a little lonely this season - find your people - who are at the same level as you or just a few steps ahead. 

**(seriously - stop taking advice from $10M brands when you haven’t even hit $1M! I know “How I Built This” is inspirational, but it’s not actually CHANGING how you’re operating in the day-to-day this week).**

See y’all next week!

Alli

PS. 

**I’m putting the final touches on our free Wholesale Success System training right now**, along with some FUUUNNNN bonuses for our next round of Retail Ready® enrollment this month, so stay tuned! 

**Invites to follow once I’m back from a quick vacay.**

Email from Chef Luigi Diotaiuti Hi, just a reminder that you're receiving this email because you have expressed an interest in Chef Luigi Diotaiuti. EU Residents, Per GDPR, you may unsubscribe via the link below at any time. Please see the Privacy Policy at http://www.luigidiotaiuti.com/privacy-policy/ for more info.  You may unsubscribe if you no longer wish to receive our emails. Happy National Wellness Month! In August National Wellness Month and Happiness Happens Month coincide. Regardless of whether I'm managing the Luigi Diotaiuti Foundation, preparing a plate of handmade pasta at Al Tiramisu, and or organizing events, making others happy and healthy has always been my goal. Last month I also had the exciting opportunity to inaugurate my latest initiative, Casirino, an artisan cheese company that my partners and I just opened in Basilicata. Follow us here on Instagram and here on Facebook for updates. It was an honor to participate in ARA Basilicata's event dedicated to the Podolico race of cows at Lago Sirino last month. We even had Italian Minister of Agriculture Francesco Lollabrigida stop by our stand! From Al Tiramisu.... Don't miss out on our refreshing Italian summer specials - available at lunch and dinner Monday-Friday and dinner on Saturday and Sunday! Reserve your table here. In Honor of Summer.... Pappa al pomodoro/Tuscan Tomato Soup *From The Al Tiramisu Restaurant Cookbook This rustic tomato soup is Tuscan comfort food at its best. So popular is this dish that it inspired a hit song in the 1960s called “Viva la pappa al pomodoro!” sung by Italy’s beloved recording star Rita Pavone. One of the original “green” recipes, pappa al pomodoro was traditionally prepared by frugal casalinghe, or housewives, to make use of leftovers. Over the years, this homey and satisfying dish has become a staple on the menus of Florence’s trendiest restaurants. The soup’s flavors intensify as it sits, and it can be served hot or at room temperature, making it a good choice for a buffet table. For an original and modern presentation, pour it into elegant individual-portion glasses. Note that you will need good Italian bread that is at least two days old, as well as the end rind of Parmigiano-Reggiano or Pecorino-Romano cheese. Serves 4 Ingredients 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, divided 5 garlic cloves, minced 2 cups peeled and chopped or pureed tomatoes 10 fresh basil leaves, shredded 1 cup good quality Italian bread cubes (1-inch) (at least 2 days old) 3 ounces rind from a wedge of Parmigiano - Reggiano or Pecorino Romano cheese  Salt 4 cups Vegetable Stock (page 346) Preparation Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a medium saucepan over medium - high heat. Add garlic. When it is golden, add the tomatoes and cook for 4 minutes, allowing the flavors to blend. Add basil, bread, cheese rind, and a pinch of salt. Stir well. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer. Stir every 10 minutes, adding 1 cup of stock at a time. Be sure to stir firmly from the bottom to prevent sticking. Cook until soup is thick and has a uniform consistency, about 40 minutes. Before serving, heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a small saucepan over low heat. When soup is ready, remove the cheese rind, stir, and drizzle hot olive oil over the top. Serve warm or cold. Italian Cooking Primer Leftover bread and cheese are the basis of many Italian home-style dishes. Bread that is a few days old can be used to make breadcrumbs (page 336) or croutons. You can soak it in milk and add it to ground meat to tenderize meatballs, or mix it with other ingredients to create croquettes or bread puddings. Add cheese rinds to sauces, soups, and stews for extra richness, flavor, and complexity. Sommelier’s Pick Chianti Classico *Quote From Amazon... "This unique collection of more than 100 mouthwatering recipes reveals the history of Al Tiramisu, Washington, D.C.’s “most authentic” Italian restaurant, as well as the life story of its Chef/Owner Luigi Diotaiuti. The book welcomes readers to Al Tiramisu – sharing memories and favorite dishes of both celebrity diners and cherished clients. Chef Luigi then leads a culinary tour back to his homeland of Basilicata, Italy and shares secrets from some of the finest dining establishments around the globe where he began his career. The final chapter outlines Chef Luigi’s life in America and includes recipes that he served at the James Beard Foundation and in cross-cultural culinary venues on both sides of the Atlantic. Each beloved recipe represents Al Tiramisu’s “elevated” Italian cooking style and features an Italian cooking tip and a wine pairing." Si no puede visualizar bien este boletín haga clic AQUÍLima, viernes 31 de julio del 2026 Director General: Carlos Bernuy  Santuarios de Marriott International: El arte de vivir el ultra lujo en Latinoamérica
En la nueva era del lujo, la exclusividad ya no se define por la ostentación, sino por valores más íntimos y silenciosos: el tiempo sin interrupciones, la privacidad absoluta y una conexión genuina con el entorno. Esta filosofía cobra vida en las Residential Suites y Villas de Ritz-Carlton Reserve, una extensión de la experiencia Reserve diseñada para quienes buscan desconectarse del ritmo cotidiano y sumergirse plenamente en el destino. En estos refugios naturales de extraordinaria amplitud, la privacidad y las amenidades cuidadosamente seleccionadas crea una experiencia inmersiva que invita a conectar con algunos de los destinos más extraordinarios del Caribe y Latinoamérica y redefine los estándares de la hospitalidad de lujo.
Leer más Tras las huellas del pasado en las ciudades de Canadá
Canadá alberga más de mil sitios que forman parte de su patrimonio histórico y que relatan los acontecimientos, las culturas y los personajes que dieron forma a esta nación. Desde fortalezas centenarias hasta pueblos históricos, cada lugar ofrece una ventana al pasado y una oportunidad para conocer cómo era Canadá en la antigüedad.
Leer más
Regent Seven Seas Cruises celebrará 35 años de lujo inigualable en alta mar
Regent Seven Seas Cruises, la línea de cruceros de ultra lujo líder en el mundo, celebrará en 2027 sus 35 años de historia con una exclusiva colección de cruceros Conmemorativos a bordo de seis barcos de la Flota Más Lujosa del Mundo, incluido el esperado Seven Seas Prestige.
Leer másJair Palacios: «Ofrecemos una experiencia capaz de satisfacer distintos estilos de viaje»
Con una propuesta que combina experiencias para familias, parejas y grupos, Royalton Bavaro, An Autograph Collection All-Inclusive Resort & Casino, se ha consolidado como uno de los resorts más completos de Punta Cana. Desde su apertura, la propiedad ha fortalecido su oferta con nuevas experiencias y una mejora continua de sus servicios, un camino que alcanzó un nuevo hito al incorporarse a Autograph Collection de Marriott International, integrando la personalidad de Royalton con estándares internacionales de hospitalidad de una de las compañías hoteleras más importantes del mundo.
Leer más
Patagonia argentina: Por qué visitar este destino en temporada baja?Durante años, la Patagonia argentina ha sido un destino predilecto para los viajeros en dos temporadas: en verano, ideal para vacaciones familiares de descanso y aventura en la naturaleza, entre cascadas y lagos; y en invierno, para quienes disfrutan del frío, la observación de pingüinos y los días nevados en las montañas.
Leer más  Barcelona establece límite anual para un turismo más sostenible
Barcelona ha decidido dar un paso decisivo hacia un modelo turístico más equilibrado al establecer un límite de 16 millones de visitantes al año, una medida con la que busca frenar el crecimiento del turismo masivo y preservar la calidad de vida de sus residentes. La iniciativa responde a la creciente presión que soporta la ciudad como uno de los principales destinos urbanos de Europa y plantea un cambio de estrategia orientado a priorizar la sostenibilidad por encima del incremento continuo del número de viajeros.
Leer másInauguran el renovado Aeropuerto Internacional Washington Dulles con apoyo de United
La Autoridad Metropolitana de Aeropuertos de Washington, United Airlines y el Departamento de Transporte de los Estados Unidos anunciaron hoy una transformación histórica del Aeropuerto Internacional Washington Dulles con un programa de inversión de capital de más de 20 mil millones de dólares. El proyecto transformará el aeropuerto durante la próxima década en una puerta de entrada moderna y de clase mundial que reflejará la importancia y el alcance global de la capital del país y mejorará la experiencia de millones de viajeros.
Leer más Nobu inaugurará un hotel, restaurante, villas y residencias en Monte Rei, Portugal
Nobu se complace en anunciar sus planes para un nuevo destino de lujo en Monte Rei, el galardonado resort ubicado en el Algarve oriental de Portugal. El proyecto Nobu será la pieza central de un programa de inversión más amplio liderado por Norfin, que abarcará hostelería, viviendas, instalaciones de ocio y futuras incorporaciones, incluyendo un club de playa. Se prevé que la construcción comience en 2027 y que el Hotel Nobu reciba a sus primeros huéspedes en 2029.

body:
Dear Dave,

Just Announced: Concert Followed by French Wine Reception at the Embassy of France La Maison Francaise on Friday, October 9

You are invited to a delightful evening of classical music followed by a French wine reception to meet International Club of DC members and make new friends. Enjoy a delightful evening of 21st century classical music at the Embassy of France, La Maison Francaise featuring the music performed by Timur celebrating songs of love and satire. You are welcome to attend on your own or with friends. Tickets availability is limited. Reserve your tickets now.

NEXT WEEK: A partner or dance experience not needed to join us for our Embassy Row Rooftop Havana under the Stars on Friday, August 7 to experience a magical evening of dancing under the stars to a Latin Band after salsa lessons. Space is limited, make your reservations now to enjoy mojitos, and dancing to a Latin band after salsa lessons. Even if you've never danced before, our salsa lessons will have you dancing to the sounds of Havana performed by our Latin band as you make new friends.

** Last chance: You’re invited to participate in the D.C. Policy Center’s Business Sentiments Survey.
------------------------------------------------------------

You’re invited to complete the D.C. Policy Center’s Business Sentiments Survey. (https://www.dcpolicycenter.org/business-sentiments-survey/?mc_cid=58c1f0ca32&mc_eid=UNIQID) This round focuses on access to capital for D.C. and regional businesses, as well as economic expectations for the months ahead. The survey will take no longer than 20 minutes to complete, and the link will remain open through 11:59 PM today (July 31, 2026).
Click here to take the survey (https://dcpc.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_bjefd6mb2PaHz4W?mc_cid=58c1f0ca32&mc_eid=UNIQID)

** About the Survey
------------------------------------------------------------

The Quarterly Business Sentiments Survey (https://www.dcpolicycenter.org/business-sentiments-survey/?mc_cid=58c1f0ca32&mc_eid=UNIQID) is a core product of the D.C. Policy Center’s Alice M. Rivlin for Economic Policy and Competitiveness. Survey results provide real-time insights about the experiences of the local business community and serve as a complement to official economic data that helps inform public debate. For more information and to read results from prior rounds, click here (https://www.dcpolicycenter.org/business-sentiments-survey/?mc_cid=58c1f0ca32&mc_eid=UNIQID) .


** Spread the Word
------------------------------------------------------------

Representatives from any business or nonprofit located in the D.C. region are welcome to participate. Participants should be knowledgeable of industry outlooks and involved in high-level decision-making.

If you know a business that should participate, please forward this email or share this link. (https://dcpc.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_bjefd6mb2PaHz4W?mc_cid=58c1f0ca32&mc_eid=UNIQID)

Thank you for your support and for participating in the D.C. Policy Center’s Business Sentiments survey.

Daniel Burge (daniel@dcpolicycenter.org (mailto:daniel@dpolicycenter.org) )
Director, Alice M. Rivlin Initiative on Economic Policy & Competitiveness

Yesim Sayin (yesim@dcpolicycenter.org (mailto:yesim@dcpolicycenter.org) )

Executive Director, D.C. Policy Center

Villa Vie Residences anunció hoy Legacy, el segundo crucero residencial de la compañía, que se espera que entre en servicio a principios de 2029. El Departamento de Cultura y Turismo de Abu Dhabi ha anunciado que el Guggenheim Abu Dhabi abrirá sus puertas el 11 de diciembre de 2026, reforzando así la posición de Abu Dhabi como capital mundial líder en las artes.

Estados Unidos continúa perdiendo atractivo para el turismo internacional pese al impulso que representó la celebración de la Copa Mundial de Clubes de la FIFA durante el primer semestre del año. Los datos más recientes reflejan que el país recibió un 4,3 % menos de visitantes extranjeros en comparación con el mismo periodo del año anterior, confirmando que el evento deportivo no fue suficiente para revertir una tendencia negativa que se ha venido consolidando en los últimos meses.
