A Message From The Director

Brian Hanlon 

The work of building a safer, stronger District happens in many ways. It happens when residents lend their voices to decisions that affect their communities, and when local businesses are connected to new opportunities, and when District agencies work together to protect the people we serve. This month’s newsletter reflects each of those commitments and the important role partnership plays in DOB’s work.  

Our* **Construction Code Development Listening Sessions* [ https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fdob.dc.gov%2Fpage%2Fconstruction-code-development/1/0101019faf2292e0-d423eea1-15e8-4b8c-a7c1-550ee956e57c-000000/4JUkhFZXlSxWyFYpUlQAfrbb65vekBgDM5X8g1ZoN2U=452 ]* *continue in August with a conversation focused on the Residential Code. Whether you are a resident, builder, design professional, or simply interested in how our built environment takes shape, I encourage you to participate. The feedback we receive throughout this process will help inform proposed updates to the city’s construction codes and future opportunities for public comment.  

We are also seeing tremendous momentum around the future of the RFK Campus. This month, I had the opportunity to speak with local construction firms about how local businesses can prepare to participate in this historic redevelopment. At the same time, the draft RFK Campus Master Plan is open for public comment, giving residents, businesses, and visitors another important opportunity to help shape the future of this site.  

Just as important as building the future is protecting our communities today. Our continued partnership with the DC Office of the Attorney General demonstrates what coordinated enforcement can accomplish. From supporting legal action against landlords responsible for dangerous housing conditions to seeing a federal court order repairs of nearly 200 violations at Razjooyan-associated properties, DOB remains committed to using every tool available to hold property owners accountable and protect District residents across all eight wards.  

Thank you for staying informed, sharing your voice, and continuing to partner with us. Together, we are not only building what comes next for DC, we are working to ensure our city remains safe, accountable, and full of opportunity for everyone who calls it home.  

Onward,

 
Director Hanlon Signature

Brian J. Hanlon, AIA LEED AP®

https://adamsmorgan.com

July 29, 2026


** Updates from Adams Morgan
------------------------------------------------------------

Click here (https://adamsmorgan.com/connect/newsletter-archive) to see previous updates in our newsletter archive.

Check ObviouslyDC.com for the latest in DC government funding and grant opportunities for businesses.


** AdMo Vibe returns to Kalorama park tomorrow!
------------------------------------------------------------

Your favorite neighborhood evening concert series is returning to Kalorama Park (https://maps.app.goo.gl/dwWk85HjanYZnn3Y8)  (Columbia Rd at Kalorama Rd, NW) on Thursdays at 6pm starting July 30. Bring your family, a blanket to sit on, and grab some takeout on the way to the park — we’ll provide the tunes!
* Thursday, July 30 - Sofa City (https://www.instagram.com/sofacityband/) ; Pop & RnB Cover Band
* Thursday, August 6 - North Cap Band (https://www.instagram.com/northcapband/) ; Pop & RnB Cover Band
* Thursday, August 13 - Langston Hughes II (https://www.instagram.com/langstonhughesii/?hl=en) ; Jazz
* Thursday, August 20 - Downtown Tumbao (https://www.instagram.com/downtowntumbao/) ; Latin Jazz

** Special youth/family programing starts at 4:30 every Thursday before and during AdMo Vibe!
------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------

Presented by Words Beats & Life (https://wblinc.org/)

Bring the family out for live music and FREE hands-on art activities for kids and teens! Guided by professional teaching artists, young creators can jump in anytime—no experience needed.
What’s Happening:
* Community Mural: Help paint a collaborative masterpiece celebrating neighborhood pride!
* Interactive Chalk Art: Turn the walkways into vibrant public canvases.
* Face & Body Painting: Get festive art painted to rock out in style!

Safe, inclusive, and fun for all ages. Come create, explore, and connect with your community!


** Free STEM Discovery Stations!
------------------------------------------------------------

Presented by Because Science (https://becausesciencedc.com/)

Bring the family for FREE, hands-on science fun while enjoying live music! Drop in anytime between 4:30PM - 7:30PM to experiment, create, and explore with expert STEM educators.
What to Expect:
* Different Hands-On Theme Each Week: Slime Science, Colorful Chemistry, Bubble Science, Fossils & Geodes, and more!
* All Ages Welcome: Fun, accessible, and interactive for the whole family.
* Easy Drop-In Format: Stop by our tent anytime during the concert!

Spark your curiosity and explore the fun side of science in the heart of Adams Morgan!


** Join Jubilee Housing on July 30th for a Community Art Project!
------------------------------------------------------------

Join Jubilee on Thursday, July 30, 2026, from 11 AM–2 PM at the 1800 Columbia Rd NW Plaza and help paint a community mural that will be displayed throughout Adams Morgan!

This round focuses on access to capital for D.C. and regional businesses, as well as economic expectations for the months ahead. ** Adams Morgan Farmers Market: Saturdays 8:30am - 1pm

The Adams Morgan Farmers Market is located in Unity Park (https://maps.app.goo.gl/rAZDqznMBdSkXQyt5) at the corner of Columbia Road and Euclid Street, NW.

subject: Top Themes from Arival Brisbane, Biggest Opportunities in Experiences Market
body:
The jet lag from Brisbane may have faded, but the glow from the event remains. Over the last couple weeks I’ve been pouring through LinkedIn posts, survey comments and session videos to attempt to sum up the highlights. What did everyone take home from this event? (Asides from, in my case, a suitcase full of ginger beer?) Find out in today’s first article [ https://arival.travel/article/5-themes-from-arival-brisbane/?&utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=article_brand_awareness&siq_name=${Contacts.Contact%20Name}&siq_email=${Contacts.Email} ] .
Also, photos and (most, but not yet all) videos from Brisbane are up now - check out the photos here [ https://www.flickr.com/photos/arival/collections/72157725146896345/ ] . On-demand videos are available to Insider Pro members here [ https://arival.travel/agenda/2026-brisbane/?&utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=event_360_brisbane&siq_name=${Contacts.Contact%20Name}&siq_email=${Contacts.Email} ] .
Next up: where are the biggest opportunities and areas for growth in in-destination travel experiences? This was the question that motivated the latest report by Arival & Phocuswright (produced in partnership with Civitatis), on the 2026 Travel Experiences market. We review four top findings from that report in today’s second article [ https://arival.travel/article/4-findings-for-experiences-market-2026/?&utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=article_brand_awareness&siq_name=${Contacts.Contact%20Name}&siq_email=${Contacts.Email} ] .

- Janelle Visser

ARIVAL INSIGHTS

5 Themes from the First Arival Australia

The industry is changing fast, but we’re moving forward together: highlights from the inaugural Arival event in Brisbane, Australia.
READ MORE [ https://arival.travel/article/5-themes-from-arival-brisbane/?&utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=article_brand_awareness&siq_name=${Contacts.Contact%20Name}&siq_email=${Contacts.Email} ]

4 Findings for the Experiences Market in 2026
Experiences bookings are outpacing travel overall, but digitization and spend patterns tell a more complicated story. Here's what the data shows.
READ MORE [ https://arival.travel/article/4-findings-for-experiences-market-2026/?&utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=article_brand_awareness&siq_name=${Contacts.Contact%20Name}&siq_email=${Contacts.Email} ]

[ https://arival.travel/2026-spokane/program-overview/?&utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=event_360_spokane&siq_name=${Contacts.Contact%20Name}&siq_email=${Contacts.Email} ]

Check out the Arival 360 | Spokane program. Six pillars covering distribution, social commerce, AI, multi-day tours, culinary, and meaningful travel, with Johnathan Mark (Trill On Wheels Hip-Hop Party Bike), Kristin Dorsett (Viator), Kevin O'Neil (Destiny Water Adventures), and Leigh Barnes (Intrepid), among others. And for the first time ever, the main stage hosts Arival Ignite: five minutes, 20 slides, no rambling.
This is ten years of Arival, come celebrate with us in Spokane.

LEARN MORE [ https://arival.travel/2026-spokane/program-overview/?&utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=event_360_spokane&siq_name=${Contacts.Contact%20Name}&siq_email=${Contacts.Email} ]

TOP NEWS IN EXPERIENCES

1) How Europe’s Wildfires are Impacting Travel
While some tour operators are still managing to operate [ https://www.travelweekly.com/Europe-Travel/Tours-operate-despite-Spain-and-France-wildfires ] by adjusting itineraries around wildfire-stricken areas in France and Spain, in other tourist areas thousands are being evacuated [ https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jul/28/france-bordeaux-lacanau-evacuation-wildfires-madrid-spain ] . Are you in a wildfire-impacted community, and has your business been affected? Please reach out [ mailto:janelle@arival.travel?subject=Wildfire%20Impacted%20Business ] if you’re open to sharing your experience. And of course, stay safe!

2) ‘Odyssey’ Stokes Demand for Greece [ https://www.travelweekly.com/Travel-News/Tour-Operators/Odyssey-film-stokes-demand-for-Greece ]
Bookings are up 76% you for one Greece-based tour operator, thanks to the interest stoked by the Odyssey film, and some Odyssey-themed itineraries. It’s yet another example of literary tourism, or “set-jetting” (traveling to visit filming locations), and a great reminder to operators about the opportunities of designing thematic experiences to attract today’s experiences traveler [ https://arival.travel/research/the-2026-experiences-traveler-report-series/?&utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&siq_name=${Contacts.Contact%20Name}&siq_email=${Contacts.Email} ] .

As a reminder, if this is your first time purchasing tickets on our new platform, you'll be prompted to reset your password to complete your new account. Your login is your email, and your password must be at least 12 characters with one number, a special character, and a mix of lower case and upper case letters. Contact us <mailto:info@sixthandi.org> if you need any help.

What services are being offered?
All services will be held at Sixth & I this year. We’re happy to offer:

	* Erev Rosh Hashanah – 1 hour 45 minutes
	* Rosh Hashanah Full Service – 3 hours
	* Rosh Hashanah Condensed Service – 2.5 hours
	* Kol Nidre – 2 hours
	* Yom Kippur Full Service – 3 hours
	* Yom Kippur Condensed Service – 1.5 hours

Check out our website <https://bbox.blackbaudhosting.com/webforms/service/page.redir?target=https%3a%2f%2fwww.sixthandi.org%2fhighholidays%2faboutservices%2f&srcid=62889556&srctid=1&erid=-873636931&trid=3ea8e1b8-6276-411a-b754-079979017962> for service dates and times.

How should I decide between the full and condensed services?
The biggest differences are time of day and length of the service, so choose what works best for your schedule. Many of the prayers and sermons from the full services will repeat in the condensed services, so please choose one or the other, not both.

Who is leading services?
Rabbi Jenna Shaw of Sixth & I and guest Rabbi Jason Kimelman-Block will co-lead alongside cellist Sarah Fredrick, guitarist Tal Mashiach, percussionist Jeff Geld, and vocalist Dana Herz. Get to know our service leaders here. <https://bbox.blackbaudhosting.com/webforms/service/page.redir?target=https%3a%2f%2ftinyurl.com%2f3b3ww7nv&srcid=62889556&srctid=1&erid=-873636931&trid=3ea8e1b8-6276-411a-b754-079979017962>

Will services be live-streamed?
Yes, all services will be streamed. Virtual tickets are required.

How much do tickets cost?
For those under age 40, we offer a subsidized ticket price of $ 22 per service to ensure young professionals or those with financial need can participate. In-person tickets are $ 72 per service for attendees aged 40 and over.

Virtual tickets are $ 22 per service for everyone. Processing fees apply.

How else can I experience the High Holidays?
We’re excited to offer other ways for our 20s and 30s community to connect including a Rosh Hashanah lunch at our neighbor, Chaia Tacos, alternative Rosh Hashanah Day 2 programming, havdalah and break fast in the sanctuary following Yom Kippur, and more. Stay tuned; tickets for these experiences will go on sale in August.

Jewish tradition has a word for this kind of spirit: kotzer ruach , which translates to "shortness of spirit" or "a constriction of the soul." It appears in the Torah to describe a moment when people are so overwhelmed by suffering that they cannot take in words of hope or direction from Moses. Hellllo Dave,

A huge thank you to everyone who joined us live yesterday for the GFTA Business Blueprint Series with Lesson #3: The Booking Decision: What Makes
Guests Say Yes?

The engagement throughout the webinar was fantastic, and it was exciting to see so many thoughtful questions from Food Tourism operators looking to better understand one of the most important moments in the customer journey: the decision to book.

More importantly, yesterday's conversation reinforced another key principle behind the Business Blueprint Series.  Building a successful Food Tourism business isn't simply about attracting more visitors. It's about understanding how trust, discoverability, guest psychology and the booking experience all work together to help more of the right visitors confidently become paying guests.

______________________________________________________________________

Kelsey Tonner & Guest Focus Explored the Psychology Behind Every Booking Decision

Kelsey delivered an outstanding presentation that challenged operators to think beyond traditional marketing and instead view their business through the eyes of their guests.
One
of the strongest themes from his presentation was this: Booking decisions are emotional before they are logical.

Long before guests compare prices or evaluate logistics, they're asking themselves questions like: "

**Will I enjoy this?", "**

**Can I trust this company?",**

**"Is this experience right for me?".**
Helping operators answer those questions before guests ever reach the checkout page can dramatically improve conversion. Some of the biggest takeaways included:

* Why uncertainty is one of the biggest reasons guests abandon the booking process.

* How operators can identify and answer the hidden questions guests are asking before they ever click "Book Now."

* Why emotional confidence often has a greater impact on conversion than simply providing more information.

* How AI can become a powerful customer empathy tool by helping operators better understand guest concerns, strengthen messaging and improve the overall customer
experience.

______________________________________________________________________

Aubrey Heth & FareHarbor Showed How Great Booking Experiences Increase Conversion

Building on Kelsey's presentation, Aubrey shifted the conversation from guest psychology to the booking experience itself.  Drawing on FareHarbor's experience working with thousands of tour and activity operators, Aubrey demonstrated how even small improvements to the booking journey can have a meaningful impact on completed reservations. One of the strongest messages from her presentation was this:
Every step of the booking journey either builds confidence or creates friction.

Rather than encouraging operators to simply drive more traffic to their websites, Aubrey focused on helping businesses convert more of the visitors they already have. Some of the major takeaways included:

* Practical ways to reduce friction throughout the booking journey.

* Why clear pricing, strong tour descriptions and intuitive
product pages build booking confidence.

* Common checkout obstacles that quietly reduce conversion.

* Simple improvements operators can implement immediately to turn more interested visitors into confirmed guests.

Together, Kelsey and Aubrey demonstrated that increasing bookings isn't simply about generating more traffic. It's about understanding how guests make decisions and creating a booking experience that makes saying "yes" feel easy.

______________________________________________________________________

Webinar Recording & Resources

subject: I ❤️ when CPG founders cry
body:
but i'm not a psycho, i swearHi Dave,

**My husband thinks I'm a psycho bc I love it when founders cry on our coaching calls. And it happens a LOT.**

I love because of two reasons:

First, because I think it's extremely important to be REAL about what's going on, how hard entrepreneurship can be, and to finally feel the relief of being a community that gets it.

🌀 It's exhausting to pitch to 20 stores in a month, go to 2 trade shows, post on IG every day, and 

**still have no idea which ones of those things "was worth it" in your business.**

**Let's be clear: you're putting in a ton of effort! Your success just might not reflect it yet and that's the exhausting part.**

😔 It's embarrassing to 

**feel like you should be further along,** or know more, or be more confident in sales conversations "at this point in your biz."

**Does it ever feel like the more you learn in this industry, the more you realize you don't know? If you started your business super optimistic but are slowly having those "uh oh this is a LOT harder than I thought it would be…" moments - welcome to the club!**

💔 It's heartbreaking to believe in your product SO MUCH and 

**still wonder if it's going to work out…** and feel like no one in your life can relate.

**Your partner doesn't get it. Your friends don't understand. And most industry groups make you feel like a total newbie, ashamed that you're self-funded, or wondering, "wait…. DO I need to hire that $20k consultant?!"**

And secondly, because it means that I've created a founder-friendly space where people can actually BE vulnerable.

**👋🏼 We show up as real people in our programs,** and we realize that everyone has ups and downs, week in and week out.

📊 We realize that 

**our financial growth cannot outpace our personal growth** - at least not for a sustained period of time (that's when burn out creeps in!).

🫣 We know that

**building a business** - and admitting where you need help -

**is THE most vulnerable thing you can do**.

**So this email is just to say that I see you, and I see you doing ALL THE THINGS and it still feels SO hard at times.**

**(spoiler alert: that IS why it feels SO hard at times! Doing allllll the things - instead of just THE most important things in your biz - IS exhausting!).**

Whether you're having an up or a down week - whether you're laughing and celebrating a big success this week, or are swearing and crying over yet another set back - that's all normal. I'm right here with you.

Xx

Alli

PS. Maybe I'm just sentimental bc we're in week two of our Sales Bad-A$$ program https://www.alliball.com/salesbadass and we've 

**spent the past two weeks going inward, working on the stories we're telling ourselves** about our ability to be successful salespeople and biz owners.

It's POWERFUL work, and I'm just in awe of the founders who are in there exploring their patterns. If that's you - great work! 🔮🌀

Or because of this - 

**I just got this Slack message this morning from a Retail Ready® student who received their Strategic Growth plan** that I created for them last week, outlining their personal path to hitting their growth goals this year. I'm a sap for making people feel seen!

subject: Tired of giving more than you're getting back?
body:
Hi Dave,

Building something of your own asks a lot of you. Your time, your focus, your energy, and often your peace of mind. For a lot of founders, those things start to feel like they're being spent faster than they're being replenished.

Our recent additions to our Achievement Institute (https://timeetc.com/resources/) resource center are all about how to start getting some of that back. From how you structure your day, the habits worth borrowing from those who've cracked the code, to the support solutions that make the biggest difference, there's plenty here to take away.

They're all here for you now...

------------------------------------------------------------

The Joy Gap: Why Busy Founders Achieve So Much and Feel So Little

When did you last finish your day feeling genuinely satisfied? For a lot of us, the honest answer is: not for a while. There's a phenomenon that shows up among high-achievers, and it rarely gets talked about because it feels like an ungrateful thing to admit, especially when things are going well. We call it the “Joy Gap.” We've pulled together what the experts say is driving it, plus the fixes that hold up in practice...
Read now 📖 (https://www.timeetc.com/resources/how-to-achieve-more/the-joy-gap-why-busy-founders-achieve-so-much-and-feel-so-little)
------------------------------------------------------------

8 Real Reasons Why Founders Struggle With Time Management
Another huge frustration for founders is knowing that your time management is costing you, yet still ending up in the same cycle. When the same pattern shows up week after week, there's usually a reason behind it, and often more than one. This article lays out the most common culprits, because knowing what you're up against makes it a lot easier to do something about it...
Read now 📖 (https://www.timeetc.com/resources/how-to-achieve-more/why-most-entrepreneurs-are-terrible-at-time-management-and-how-to-buck-the-trend/)

9 Habits Successful Founders Use To Stay Focused And Get More Done
Some of the world's most successful founders, Jeff Bezos, Warren Buffett, Richard Branson, and Arianna Huffington among them, have worked out the exact conditions they need to get the most out of each day. We've pulled nine of those habits together in one place, with what each founder figured out and what's genuinely worth taking into your own week...
Read now 📖 (https://www.timeetc.com/resources/how-to-achieve-more/9-rules-for-life-from-the-worlds-most-successful-entrepreneurs/)

One of the questions founders ask most before bringing on a VA is: what would I actually give them to do? View all articles and guides (https://www.timeetc.com/resources/)

subject: What if your media player could do more than stream?
body:
Go beyond streaming with a player built for participation.

[Performedia media player showing ASL, captions, chat, polling, and Q&A tools with the message: "Create Events Everyone Stays For."]

Hi Dave,

Think back to the last online session you sat through - not the topic, the experience.

Squinting at slides on your phone? Half-listening with the tab muted? Sitting on a question you never asked because the chat felt like shouting into a void?

It's not you, it’s the player.

Somewhere along the way, “hybrid/virtual event” started to mean “videos that play.” Stream goes live, everyone watches, stream ends, everyone forgets. That's why we built a player designed for participation, not just playback.

Everyone gets the same session
Participation starts with who can actually follow along. Every stream includes:

- Live and on-demand captions in 65+ languages
- Speech-to-speech audio translation
- On/off sign language window
- Audio description
- Designed for WCAG 2.2 AA compliance
- Built-in screen reader and keyboard support

Accessibility isn’t a setting you switch on. It’s how the player works.

And here's what makes the difference

- Launch in any browser
Attendees join on desktop or mobile with nothing to download and no plugins to chase. They click the link, and they’re in, whether they’re at a desk or on a train.
- Let them watch it their way
Give viewers up to three video windows, resizable and full-screen, with slide zoom and self-paced navigation. They take notes as they go and leave with the deck (including their notes) as a PDF.
- Keep the audience engaged
Run live Q&A, accessible chat, polling, and trivia games (with live leaderboard updates). Attendees can record video questions which are played in the room and online, and you can message any one of them directly, mid-session.
- Prove sponsor value
Rotating ad banners, with click reporting, resource downloads, and interaction data turn attention into numbers. Sponsors see exactly what their placement did.

Past the headcount
See what people opened, clicked, and stayed for, live in the dashboard, or long after the stream ends. Which, if you’ve ever had to prove an event was worth it, is the good stuff.

Same player, whatever you’re running
Whether it's a conference, webinar, annual meeting, or hybrid event, it's powered by the same player. We’ve run 1,000+ of them since 2003, for associations, medical societies, nonprofits, and government agencies. Which means you’re not relearning a platform every time you run an event, and neither is your audience.

See it carry a real session
Book a demo, and we’ll walk you through one, start to finish.

Уважаемые коллеги, 


Пишет Вам Джоджо (JoJo) из Китая. Мы являемся единственным в Китае заводом-производителем, способным производить литые металлические кольца плавающих уплотнений (Duo Cone Seal) размером более 800 мм.


Зная высокий спрос на надежные комплектующие для тяжелой техники в России, мы хотели бы предложить Вам прямые поставки уплотнений OEM-качества с нашего завода.

  • Широкий диапазон размеров: Внутренний диаметр (ID) от 22 до 1372 мм.

  • Высокое качество (Casting process): Твердость HRC 62~69, срок службы 5000–15000 часов. Материал колец: 15Cr3Mo, Fe15Cr4Mo и др. Уплотнительные кольца: NBR, HNBR, Silicone, FKM.

Мы сертифицированы по стандарту ISO9001:2015 и готовы изготовить продукцию по вашим чертежам (OEM).


Бесплатные образцы доступны для тестирования на вашем оборудовании.

subject: Tomorrow: Blueprint Lesson #3 – What Makes Guests Say Yes
body:
Why Guests Don't Book (And What You Can Do About It)Click here to see a web copy of this email https://globalfoodtourism.activehosted.com/p_v.php?c=406&m=489&s=b730db3df0b19ee283c91c10348db03b&d=406&v=2&l=2

Hi Dave!

Tomorrow we continue the GFTA Business Blueprint Series with 

**Blueprint Lesson #3**, where we'll explore one of the most important questions every Food Tourism operator faces: The Booking Decision: What Makes Guests Say Yes https://us06web.zoom.us/meeting/register/2RCpy0F1SRC__F-d41oKRg

Every day, potential guests discover your business, browse your website, compare your experiences, and imagine themselves joining one of your tours. Yet many leave without ever completing a reservation.  Why?

The answer is rarely as simple as needing more marketing. Often, the difference between an abandoned visit and a confirmed booking comes down to understanding how guests make decisions and creating a booking experience that gives them the confidence to move forward. That's exactly what we'll be discussing tomorrow.

______________________________________________________________________

What You'll Learn

During this Blueprint Lesson #3, you'll discover why guests hesitate before booking, the questions they're asking that often go unanswered, and how seemingly small moments of uncertainty can quietly reduce conversion. You'll also learn practical strategies for improving your booking experience, removing unnecessary friction, and helping more interested visitors become confirmed guests, all without increasing your marketing budget.  Whether you're welcoming a handful of guests each week or managing hundreds of bookings each month, these are practical lessons that can immediately strengthen your business.

______________________________________________________________________

Meet Your Presenters

We're excited to welcome two outstanding industry experts who will each bring a unique perspective to the conversation.

Kelsey Tonner, Founder of Guest Focus, will explore the psychology behind booking decisions and explain why understanding guest motivations is one of the most powerful ways to increase conversion. Drawing on his experience helping more than 2,000 tour operators worldwide, Kelsey will share practical insights into how guests think, why they hesitate, and how operators can use those insights to build greater confidence before a reservation is ever made.

Joining him is Aubrey Heth, Enablement Manager for FareHarbor Websites, who works with operators every day to improve their online booking experience. Aubrey will share practical strategies for reducing friction throughout the booking journey, from clearer pricing and stronger product pages to a smoother checkout process that helps convert more visitors into paying guests.

Together, these two perspectives create a complete picture of what happens between "I'm interested" and "I'm booked."

______________________________________________________________________

The Business Blueprint Series is designed to help Food Tourism operators build stronger, more profitable businesses by focusing on the core drivers of growth, trust, and profitability. Each Blueprint Lesson builds upon the last, creating a practical framework that we'll continue developing throughout the year before bringing it all together at GFTA MicroCon 2026 in Austin, TX on Friday, October 30th (more details coming soon).

Webinar Details
 

**Topic:** The Booking Decision: What Makes Guests Say Yes
 

**Date:** Tuesday, July 28
 

**Time:** 10:30am CT | 9:30am MT | 8:30am PT | 11:30am ET | 4:30pm GMT

subject: Newsletter Infotur Latam 27-07-26 🌍
body:
Newsletter Infotur Latam 27-07-26
Si no puede visualizar bien este boletín haga clic AQUÍLima, lunes 27 de julio del 2026 Director General: Carlos Bernuy  Hard Rock Hotel Cancun y Hard Rock Hotel Vallarta anuncian gran transformación
Hard Rock Hotels An-All Inclusive Experience anunció hoy una transformación sin precedentes de dos de sus resorts más emblemáticos frente al mar: Hard Rock Hotel Cancun y Hard Rock Hotel Vallarta. Ambas propiedades suspenderán temporalmente operaciones durante unos meses para volver como nuevos referentes en hotelería experiencial. Las reservaciones ya están oficialmente abiertas, permitiendo a los viajeros asegurar su estancia para las reaperturas, previstas para finales de diciembre.
Leer más Delta lanza nuevas opciones de tarifa Basic en productos premium
Tras la introducción de nuevos nombres de productos y experiencias de viaje el año pasado, y la expansión del nivel Basic a Delta Comfort el otoño pasado, Delta amplía aún más su oferta de experiencia Basic para incluir Delta First, Delta Premium Select y Delta One.
Leer más
Explora Journeys recibe la entrega de Explora III
La entrega del EXPLORA III en el astillero Sestri Ponente de Fincantieri en Génova marca hoy otro hito importante en el crecimiento de Explora Journeys, la marca de viajes oceánicos ultraelegantes del Grupo MSC. El EXPLORA III también representa la siguiente fase de la inversión del Grupo MSC de más de 3.500 millones de euros en su flota, con los seis barcos diseñados y construidos por Fincantieri en Italia, una colaboración de larga data que muestra lo mejor de la construcción naval, la artesanía y la innovación italianas..
Leer másTTW publica lista de los 50 mejores destinos de playa del mundo 2026
Travel And Tour World (TTW) reveló hoy su lista de los 50 mejores destinos de playa del mundo para 2026, una clasificación editorial exhaustiva que destaca los países que ofrecen las experiencias turísticas costeras más excepcionales del mundo. Basada en una extensa investigación global, la lista reconoce destinos que sobresalen por su belleza natural, diversidad de playas, experiencia del visitante, sostenibilidad, ecosistemas marinos, accesibilidad, infraestructura turística y atractivo cultural.
Leer más
¿Cómo aprovechar mejor tus vacaciones antes de fin de año?
Entre responsabilidades laborales, estudios, proyectos personales y compromisos familiares, muchas personas suelen llegar a los últimos meses del año con una sensación compartida: la necesidad de hacer una pausa. Lejos de ser un lujo, las vacaciones se han convertido en una herramienta para recuperar el equilibrio, reducir el estrés y dedicar tiempo a experiencias que normalmente quedan en segundo plano.
Leer más  La travel tech B2B Onfly acelera expansión en México y triplica cartera
La transformación digital de los viajes corporativos continúa acelerándose en México. En un mercado que alcanzó un valor cercano a US$17,600 millones en 2025 y que podría superar los US$30,000 millones hacia 2034, de acuerdo con IMARC Group, las empresas buscan cada vez más soluciones tecnológicas para optimizar la administración de uno de sus principales rubros de gasto, los viajes de negocios.
Leer másArajet continúa fortaleciendo su cultura de seguridad laboral con certificación oficial
Arajet, la aerolínea bandera de la República Dominicana recibió de parte del Ministerio de Trabajo de la República Dominicana la certificación de cumplimiento del Reglamento 522-06 sobre Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo para todas sus localidades operativas, reafirmando así su compromiso con la protección, el bienestar y la integridad de sus colaboradores.
Leer más Sofitel Legend Santa Clara Cartagena entre los mejores hoteles de lujo del mundo
Sofitel Legend Santa Clara Cartagena, uno de los hoteles de lujo más emblemáticos de Cartagena de Indias, fue reconocido en los Travel + Leisure World’s Best Awards 2026, uno de los premios más importantes de la industria turística internacional.
Leer más  Turistas extranjeros eligen Chile para esquiar en pleno invierno
La temporada alta de esquí en Chile vive uno de sus momentos de mayor actividad, impulsada por la llegada de turistas extranjeros que buscan nieve durante su propio periodo de vacaciones de verano. Centros como Valle Nevado, Portillo y La Parva concentran un flujo creciente de visitantes brasileños y europeos, atraídos por la posibilidad de esquiar en contraestación, es decir, mientras en sus países de origen es temporada estival.
Leer más Ayuntamiento de Madrid rechaza tasa turística y renuncia a recaudar 70 millones
El Ayuntamiento de Madrid ha descartado de forma rotunda la implantación de una tasa turística en la capital. Durante el Pleno de Cibeles, la concejala delegada de Turismo, Almudena Maíllo, defendió el turismo como un sector estratégico y de alto valor añadido, asegurando que la prioridad del gobierno municipal no es gravar una actividad que genera empleo y oportunidades, informa La Razón.

Welcome to Edition 451 of Institute InBrief.

Humour does not make problems disappear. It does not remove pain or resolve complexity. Yet it has a remarkable ability to change how we experience and carry life's challenges. In this edition, we explore the role of humour as both a coping strategy and a therapeutic process, examining how it can foster resilience, strengthen relationships and support wellbeing in both personal and professional contexts.

We also celebrate the first graduates of AIPC's Myanmar Scholarship Program, highlighting the power of education to strengthen communities and expand access to much-needed mental health support. Finally, we consider the fine art of compassion, reflecting on why compassion remains one of the most important qualities for those working in helping professions.

Humour: Why Laughter Matters in Tough Times

Introduction

When life feels overwhelming, people often turn to humour. A joke in a difficult moment, a shared laugh after a stressful day, or even making light of our own struggles—these are familiar human responses. While humour might seem trivial on the surface, it can play a powerful role in how we cope with challenges.

Most people have experienced this instinctively. Think about the moment when tension breaks because someone makes a light comment, or when laughter unexpectedly appears in the middle of a difficult conversation. These moments are not accidental. They reflect something deeply human: our capacity to use humour to manage emotional intensity, create connection, and regain a sense of perspective.

In counselling and psychotherapy, humour is already present in many conversations. Therapists and clients laugh together, use lightness to ease tension, or find moments of levity in heavy topics. Yet, despite how common it is, humour is often treated as something extra—more about personality or rapport than something meaningful in its own right.

Emerging research suggests otherwise. Humour is not just about making things feel lighter—it can actually help people think differently, feel differently, and connect more deeply (Dionigi et al., 2023; Sarink et al., 2023). In this sense, humour is not a distraction from serious work—it can be part of the work itself.

This article explores humour as a coping strategy and a therapeutic process. It considers how humour helps people navigate difficulty, how it shows up in therapy, and why paying closer attention to humour may benefit both practitioners and the broader community.

How Humour Helps Us Cope

Humour can change how we experience difficult situations. One of its key strengths is its ability to shift perspective.

When something stressful happens, it is easy to become locked into a particular way of thinking—often one that emphasises threat, loss, or overwhelm. Humour interrupts this pattern. By introducing an unexpected or playful angle, it allows us to step back and see the situation differently. This process is closely related to what psychologists call cognitive reappraisal, a strategy that involves reinterpreting a situation to alter its emotional impact (Samson & Gross, 2014).

What makes humour distinctive is that this shift often happens quickly and with less effort than more deliberate cognitive strategies. A humorous observation can instantly reframe a situation, reducing its intensity without requiring lengthy analysis. For example, someone stuck in traffic might shift from frustration to amusement by joking about the absurdity of the situation. While the external circumstances have not changed, their emotional experience has.

Humour also plays an important role in emotional regulation. It does not remove distress, but it can soften it. Moments of laughter can interrupt cycles of rumination or anxiety, providing brief relief and creating space for recovery. Newsletter Infotur Latam 24-07-26
Si no puede visualizar bien este boletín haga clic AQUÍLima, viernes 24 de julio del 2026 Director General: Carlos Bernuy  El Four Seasons Resort Maui at Wailea presenta Kai Holo Spa, un santuario de bienestar
El Four Seasons Resort Maui at Wailea, de cinco estrellas y cinco diamantes, presenta Kai Holo Spa, un destino de bienestar donde las experiencias inspiradas en la isla se fusionan con la innovación moderna. Kai Holo Spa, cuyo nombre significa «marea que fluye» en hawaiano, invita a los huéspedes a un estado de fluidez personal, donde se mueven con naturalidad a través de una experiencia acuática termal inmersiva, recorridos por el Pacífico inspirados en la isla y servicios de vanguardia. Cada detalle ha sido diseñado para restaurar y transformar.
Leer más Air Canada, el puente que te acerca a Asia-Pacífico
Atravesar el océano y aterrizar en la región de Asia-Pacífico promete robarte el aliento. Su enorme territorio, que abarca desde Asia Central, pasando por los archipiélagos tropicales del Sudeste Asiático, hasta llegar a las naciones isleñas de Oceanía, es el hogar de experiencias que van más allá de lo extraordinario.
Leer más  Oceania Cruises destaca sus exclusivos viajes de descubrimiento del bienestar
Desde practicar tai chi en Bangkok, hasta terapia de danza en Colombo, pasando por yoga y catas de vino en Santorini, Oceania Cruises, la línea de cruceros de lujo líder en el mundo centrada en destinos y gastronomía, invita a los viajeros exigentes a abrazar una nueva era de exploración a través de sus aclamados Wellness Discovery Tours.
Leer másEl safari que pocos conocen y todos deberían vivir
Lejos de las rutas más conocidas de África, aún existen lugares donde la naturaleza conserva el protagonismo absoluto. En el corazón del Parque Nacional Kafue, en Zambia, se hallan Wilderness Shumba y Wilderness Busanga Bush Camp, dos campamentos estacionales que permiten descubrir uno de los ecosistemas más extraordinarios y menos explorados del continente africano.
Leer más LUXlife reconoce a Tropic Travel por una nueva forma de entender el lujo en Sudamérica
El turismo de lujo está cambiando. Cada vez más viajeros priorizan experiencias auténticas, acceso a comunidades locales y conexiones culturales por encima de los símbolos tradicionales de exclusividad. En ese contexto, Tropic Travel, DMC boutique que opera en Ecuador, Perú y Chile, fue reconocida por LUXlife Magazine como Best Tailor-Made South America Journeys Provider 2026, dentro de los Resorts & Retreats Awards 2026. LUXlife Magazine es una publicación británica especializada en viajes y estilo de vida de lujo que cada año reconoce a empresas que están redefiniendo la experiencia de viajar a nivel mundial.
Leer más
KAYAK para chats grupales en cualquier lugar: reserva el viaje
Este verano, KAYAK se ha propuesto concretar los viajes en grupo. Un nuevo estudio de KAYAK revela que el 84 % de los viajeros ha visto cómo sus viajes en grupo se quedaban estancados en el chat, con planes que permanecían en el limbo entre uno y tres meses. ¿La razón? El 90 % de los viajeros afirma que se debe a un amigo que simplemente no se compromete.
Leer másJetSMART transformó en 10 años la aviación en Sudamericana con su modelo ultra low cost
Hace diez años, se fundó JetSMART con una visión clara: conectar personas y transformar la manera de viajar en Sudamérica mediante un modelo ultra low cost que hiciera posible que todos los sudamericanos pudieran acceder al transporte aéreo, con los más altos estándares de seguridad, eficiencia y calidad.
Leer más American Express y ALL Accor amplían el poder de la membresía con alianza global
American Express y ALL Accor, la plataforma de reservas y el programa de fidelización de Accor, anunciaron hoy una nueva alianza global que se implementará a partir de 2026 en 12 ubicaciones, introduciendo la equiparación de estatus élite y una nueva opción de transferencia de puntos Membership Rewards para los titulares de tarjetas elegibles.
Leer más  Egipto lanza nuevo sistema digital de visado para una entrada más rápida y sencilla
El Ministerio de Turismo y Antigüedades de Egipto anuncia el lanzamiento de un nuevo sistema digital de visado a la llegada, un paso importante en la modernización de los procedimientos de entrada para los viajeros internacionales.Leer más Julio, el mejor momento para descubrir la esencia del tequila en Jalisco
Paisajes agaveros, recorridos en tren, degustaciones, destilerías y experiencias gastronómicas hacen de julio una de las mejores temporadas para descubrir el tequila desde su lugar de origen. En el marco del Día Internacional del Tequila, que se conmemora el 24 de julio, Jalisco invita a recorrer sus rutas tequileras y conocer la tradición que ha convertido a esta bebida en uno de los mayores símbolos de México.

subject: How to Actually Finish What You Start (80% Completion Secret)
body:
Here's a stat that stopped me in my tracks.

The average online course has a completion rate of around 6%. Free challenges? Only 10% of people even START them, let alone finish.

But my guest this week runs a 21-day challenge with an 80% completion rate.

Not 8%. Not 18%. Eighty percent.

When I heard that number, I knew I had to have him on The Marketing Minds Podcast to break down exactly how he does it - because whether you run challenges, courses, coaching programs, or you just want to actually follow through on your own goals, this is pure gold.

My guest is Brian Ford, a Follow-Through Coach & the host of the Self Improvement Daily podcast with over 21 Million Downloads.

As a Reminder, Our Goal with this Newsletter is to Give You the Highest Level of Value Possible. That's my Promise to you & I intend to Over-Deliver!

Here's a Sneak Peek at What's Inside This Email:

* The REAL reason paid challenges crush free ones (and how to engineer 80% completion)

* Why "Self-Sabotage" quietly hijacks your best intentions - and the framework to beat it

* When to Follow Through vs. When to Pivot (the answer to the "shiny object" trap)

* The Accountability reframe that turns every setback into a win

* How the Ripple Effect can propel your Follow-Through (this one's close to my heart)

Alright, let's Dive In...

———————————————————————————

# Watch the Full Video on YouTube:

Youtube: How to Build Habits That Stick: A 21-Day Challenge with Brian Ford (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mUvkx8sEyEE)

Watch the Full Video on YouTube! (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mUvkx8sEyEE)

———————————————————————————

# Why People Finish What They Pay For

Let's start with that 80% number, because it holds a lesson for anyone selling a transformation.

Brian's take is simple: when you pay, you pay attention.

There's accountability when you pay. There's investment & commitment when you pay. You're simply more serious. And that shift changes everything about whether someone shows up.

But here's the part most course creators miss - the payment alone isn't what gets someone to 80% completion. It's the environment you build AROUND that commitment.

Brian doesn't just hand over content & hope for the best. When someone signs up, he personally reaches out - his actual phone number, a video message, a voice note: "Hey, I'm Brian. I'm your accountability partner. We're starting Monday. Are you all in?"

That single human touch activates something deep in our evolutionary wiring. We're social creatures. When we make a commitment to a real person - not a robot, not an automated reminder - we feel compelled to follow through, because letting someone down carries a real emotional cost.

The takeaway for marketers & coaches: your job doesn't end at the sale. If you want people to actually get the transformation they paid for, you have to design the environment that carries them there.

———————————————————————————

# The Silent Killer: Self-Sabotage

This was my favorite part of the conversation.

Brian defines self-sabotage as your unconscious mind actively resisting something you said you were going to do. And why would your own mind do that to you?

Because the action you're about to take contradicts your current identity - and your brain is a threat-detection machine whose only job is to keep you safe. Anything uncertain gets flagged as "unsafe," so your mind quietly talks you out of it.

The tricky part is that self-sabotage almost never shows up wearing a name tag. It disguises itself as:

* Procrastination

* Limiting beliefs & negative self-talk

* Imposter syndrome

* Overthinking & confusion

* Fear, anxiety & stress

Each one hijacks your short-term decision-making and hands you a comfortable rationalization: "I'm not ready yet." "That's too risky." "Let me just do this other thing first."

And every single one of them, Brian says, traces back to a single root: fear.

So how do you beat it? Here's the framework that genuinely shifted how I think about this...

Letter from the Deputy Mayor

Deputy Mayor Nina Albert [ https://mayor.dc.gov/page/mayor-bowser-presents-grow-dc-our-fiscal-year-2026-budget ] 

Happy summer! I love this time of year in DC because traffic is easy, restaurant reservations are more easily made, and it’s a great time to connect with people, both personally and professionally!

In DMPED, July has been an important month because we announced two new pieces of legislation that are intended to continue to strengthen our housing ecosystem in the District. The Housing Investment Protection Act and Illegal Occupancy Enforcement Act work together to provide clearer, fairer, and more predictable policies that protect residents and support our efforts to provide more housing in DC. To learn more about these bills, read the *Housing Investment Protection Act*, [ https://mayor.dc.gov/sites/default/files/dc/sites/mayormb/release_content/attachments/Housing-Investment-Protection-Act-2026.pdf ] *Illegal Occupancy Enforcement Amendment Act*, [ https://mayor.dc.gov/sites/default/files/dc/sites/mayormb/release_content/attachments/Illegal-Occupancy-Enforcement-Amendment-Act-of-2026.pdf ] and *Legislation Fact Sheet* [ https://mayor.dc.gov/sites/default/files/dc/sites/mayormb/release_content/attachments/Housing-Investment-Protection-Act-and-the-Illegal-Occupancy-Enforcement-Amendment-Act-One-Pager.pdf ].

In our “Open for Business” section of today’s newsletter, you can also learn about the other pieces of legislation DMPED introduced in July to advance the *Fletcher Johnson* and the *Georgetown Boathouse* projects, as well as read about the *Draft RFK Master Plan* and *H Street Land Use and Market Study*.

Our work to grow DC’s economy and create new business and job opportunities for DC residents and entrepreneurs does not stop, even though we do get to use a little extra time in the summer months to reset and recharge!

Sincerely,

Deputy Mayor Albert

 

________________________________________________________________________

 
 
 
 
 

DC is Open for Business 

DMPED Legislative Update
Graphic image displaying four legislative items DMPED introduced to council 

Council recess began on July 15, and DMPED is using this time to advance key measures introduced by Mayor Bowser to grow our economy, build new housing, and create new opportunities for all Washingtonians. In addition to the *Housing Investment Protection Act* [ https://mayor.dc.gov/sites/default/files/dc/sites/mayormb/release_content/attachments/Housing-Investment-Protection-Act-2026.pdf ] [ https://mayor.dc.gov/sites/default/files/dc/sites/mayormb/release_content/attachments/Housing-Investment-Protection-Act-2026.pdf ] and the *Illegal Occupancy Enforcement Amendment Act*, [ https://mayor.dc.gov/sites/default/files/dc/sites/mayormb/release_content/attachments/Illegal-Occupancy-Enforcement-Amendment-Act-of-2026.pdf ] the Mayor also introduced two key real estate projects for Council approval:

*(1) Fletcher Johnson Surplus Declaration and Disposition Approval Act *

The Fletcher-Johnson bill will allow for the development of mixed-use community, office, and retail space, as well as a health care facility, 800 units of rental and for-sale housing, and affordable senior assisted living. With its passing, the District will utilize a space that has been vacant since 2011 to bring vital healthcare access to Southeast DC, and it will revitalize the Marshall Heights neighborhood, providing green space for recreational and community activities, as well as retail-commercial space. This bill represents a robust investment in the people and economy East of the river.

ADL and the Louis D. Brandeis Center for Human Rights Under Law have reached a historic settlement agreement with Reed College, resolving two Title VI complaints alleging antisemitic discrimination and harassment. Reed agreed to implement one of the nation’s most comprehensive sets of reforms addressing campus antisemitism, including adoption of the International Holocaust Remembrance Alliance (IHRA) Working Definition of Antisemitism, mandatory antisemitism training and stronger campus policies to protect Jewish and Israeli students.

ADL CEO Jonathan Greenblatt praised the settlement with the Oregon college and urged other school administrators to take similar steps: “After Jewish students were subjected to violent and persistent antisemitism on campus, we are pleased that Reed College has committed to meaningful, immediate and long-term action to ensure that the civil rights of Jewish students are protected and affirmed that antisemitism has no place on campus.”

Why Guests Don't Book (And What You Can Do About It)  ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ 

Click here to see a web copy of this email https://globalfoodtourism.acemlnb.com/p_v.php?l=29&c=405&m=488&s=b730db3df0b19ee283c91c10348db03b

Hi Dave!

We're just one week away from Blueprint Lesson #3 of the 

**GFTA Business Blueprint Series**, and we're looking forward to another engaging
discussion focused on one of the most important moments in every customer's journey: the booking decision.

During our first two Blueprint Lessons, we explored how guests build trust in your business and how they ultimately discover you online. But even when you've established credibility and successfully attracted visitors to your website, one important question remains: Why do some guests confidently click "Book Now" while others quietly leave without ever making a reservation? 

Understanding that answer is often the difference between simply generating more website traffic and converting more of the visitors you already have into paying guests.

______________________________________________________________________

The Booking Decision: What Makes Guests Say Yes https://globalfoodtourism.acemlnb.com/lt.php?x=4lZy~GE3JFOZEs78_ADFgeF0AaEik_IhluZiXHDGJXjNDHz8-ky.zuRr2Y2kk_c~j-5AXXbDKuHNTXB5zUyLwOJ

One of the biggest misconceptions in our industry is that increasing
bookings always requires spending more on marketing. While attracting new visitors is certainly important, many operators already have qualified guests browsing their websites every day. The greater opportunity often lies in improving what happens after someone arrives.

Guests compare experiences, browse photos, read reviews, evaluate pricing, and imagine themselves enjoying your tour. Somewhere during that process, however, uncertainty can begin to creep in. Sometimes it's caused by missing information. Other times it's confusing pricing, unclear messaging, too many choices, or simply a booking experience that doesn't inspire enough confidence to move forward. These seemingly small moments of hesitation can quietly reduce conversion rates without operators ever realizing they're happening.

Blueprint Lesson #3 is designed to help operators better understand those moments and identify practical ways to create a booking experience that encourages guests to confidently say
"yes."

______________________________________________________________________

Two Perspectives. One Booking Journey.

To explore this topic, we're bringing together two outstanding industry experts who approach the booking decision from complementary perspectives.

**Kelsey Tonner**, Founder of Guest Focus, will focus on the psychology behind booking decisions. Drawing from his experience helping more than 2,000 tour operators across 75 countries, Kelsey will explore what guests are really thinking before they ever click "Book Now." He'll discuss why guests hesitate, how uncertainty influences purchasing decisions, and why emotional confidence often matters more than simply providing additional information. He'll also demonstrate how AI can become a practical tool for better understanding customer questions, improving messaging, and viewing your business through the eyes of a first-time guest.

Joining Kelsey is 

**Aubrey Heth**, Enablement Manager for FareHarbor
Websites. Aubrey works with tour and activity operators every day to improve their online booking experiences, helping transform interested website visitors into confirmed reservations. Drawing on insights from thousands of operators, she'll share practical ways to strengthen the booking journey, from presenting clearer pricing and tour information to reducing unnecessary friction throughout the checkout process. Her session will focus on simple improvements that can often increase conversion without requiring additional marketing spend.

Sheraton Buenos Aires Hotel & Convention Center incorporó recientemente nuevas propuestas artísticas en sus espacios comunes, como parte de una iniciativa que busca acercar el arte local a la experiencia de huéspedes, visitantes y colaboradores.
Leer más Alaska Airlines selecciona aviones 737-800 para fortalecer a Hawaiian Airlines
Alaska Airlines, Inc. anunció hoy el plan de flota futuro para los vuelos de Hawaiian Airlines a las islas vecinas: una flota moderna de aviones Boeing 737-800 con la marca Hawaiian que reemplazará la flota de Boeing 717 de Hawaiian que se retira, lo que brindará una experiencia de pasajeros significativamente mejorada y una mayor confiabilidad para Hawái y el viajero hawaiano.
Leer más  Royal Caribbean reafirma su compromiso con el Centro Comunitario Mahahual K'iin
Royal Caribbean confirmó hoy sus planes para avanzar en el desarrollo del nuevo Centro Comunitario Mahahual K’iin, lo que representa un importante paso adelante en la creación de un espacio más grande y accesible para programas y actividades que enriquecen la vida de las familias, los niños y los residentes de Mahahual.
Leer másCabo Verde presenta incremento de búsquedas en Booking.com tras fiebre del fútbol
La Encuesta sobre Viajes Deportivos 2026 de Booking.com, la plataforma de reservas de alojamientos y otros lugares únicos para hospedarse, alquiler de autos y atracciones, de la cual participaron 1000 argentinos reflejó que casi el 60% de los viajeros realizaría un viaje específicamente para asistir a un partido de fútbol, lo que demuestra que es un poderoso motivador de viajes y una gran vidriera turística en todo el continente americano, con fanáticos dispuestos a viajar tanto dentro de su país como al exterior, especialmente entre las generaciones más jóvenes.*

Out Islands de Las Bahamas: 16 islas donde el lujo es vivir en contacto con la naturaleza
Cuando se habla de Las Bahamas, la mente suele viajar a los grandes complejos hoteleros de Nassau o Paradise Island. Sin embargo, el verdadero corazón del archipiélago late en sus Out Islands. Conformadas por 16 islas principales, este conjunto de tierras emergidas representa una frontera oceánica en sí misma, conocida por su belleza natural prístina, playas vírgenes y una atmósfera auténtica que se mantiene al margen del turismo de masas.Leer más
Marruecos acelera su infraestructura turística rumbo al Mundial 2030
Marruecos ha puesto en marcha un ambicioso plan para ampliar en un 20 % su capacidad hotelera antes de la Copa Mundial de la FIFA de 2030, torneo que organizará conjuntamente con España y Portugal. La estrategia contempla la incorporación de 60.000 nuevas plazas hoteleras en los próximos años, una medida que forma parte de un amplio programa de inversiones destinado a fortalecer la infraestructura del país y consolidar su posición como uno de los principales destinos turísticos de África.

Abra Group, empresa matriz de Avianca, Gol y Wamos Air, y Embraer anunciaron un acuerdo para que Abra adquiera 20 aeronaves E195-E2. Abra también recibirá 10 opciones de compra y 15 derechos de compra, para un total de hasta 45 aeronaves, sujeto al cumplimiento de ciertas condiciones adicionales.

El show de medio tiempo del Super Bowl 2026 logró transmitir un mensaje claro y potente: la música latina une, genera emociones y comunica cultura. Los 5 destinos más buscados por los peruanos para Fiestas Patrias
Para muchos peruanos, Fiestas Patrias es mucho más que un feriado largo: es la oportunidad perfecta para salir de la rutina, reencontrarse con familiares y amigos, y descubrir nuevos rincones del país. July 22, 2026


** Updates from Adams Morgan
------------------------------------------------------------

Click here (https://adamsmorgan.com/connect/newsletter-archive) to see previous updates in our newsletter archive.

Check ObviouslyDC.com for the latest in DC government funding and grant opportunities for businesses.


** AdMo Vibe returns to Kalorama park next week
------------------------------------------------------------

Your favorite neighborhood evening concert series is returning to Kalorama Park (https://maps.app.goo.gl/dwWk85HjanYZnn3Y8)  (Columbia Rd at Kalorama Rd, NW) on Thursdays at 6pm starting July 30. Bring your family, a blanket to sit on, and grab some takeout on the way to the park — we’ll provide the tunes!
* Thursday, July 30 - Sofa City; Pop & RnB Cover Band
* Thursday, August 6 - North Cap Band; Pop & RnB Cover Band
* Thursday, August 13 - Langston Hughes II; Jazz
* Thursday, August 20 - Downtown Tumbao; Latin Jazz
* Thursday, August 27 - Rain Date

Big thanks to Wegmans (https://www.wegmans.com/) , Volo Sports (https://www.volosports.com/washington-dc) , Lime (https://www.li.me/) , Abe’s Vegan Muffins (https://www.abesmuffins.com/) , Lafayette Federal Credit Union (https://www.lfcu.org/) , and Anthony Salinas (https://anthonysellsthedmv.com/) for sponsoring AdMo Vibe this year!

Adams Morgan businesses: Please fill out this form (https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeg-FV1RhgPezJaqGj3GTpNUbCaNiUOhrcsVyoFFR214oPtqg/viewform?usp=dialog) with any specials you would like to offer in conjunction with AdMo Vibe. We’ll include your business and special on the website.


** Special youth/family programing every Thursday before and during AdMo Vibe!
------------------------------------------------------------


** Youth Creative Arts!
------------------------------------------------------------

Presented by Words Beats & Life (https://wblinc.org/)

Bring the family out for live music and FREE hands-on art activities for kids and teens! Guided by professional teaching artists, young creators can jump in anytime—no experience needed.
What’s Happening:
* Community Mural: Help paint a collaborative masterpiece celebrating neighborhood pride!
* Interactive Chalk Art: Turn the walkways into vibrant public canvases.
* Face & Body Painting: Get festive art painted to rock out in style!

Safe, inclusive, and fun for all ages. Come create, explore, and connect with your community!


** Free STEM Discovery Stations!
------------------------------------------------------------

Presented by Because Science (https://becausesciencedc.com/)

Bring the family for FREE, hands-on science fun while enjoying live music! Drop in anytime between 4:30PM - 7:30PM to experiment, create, and explore with expert STEM educators.
What to Expect:
* Different Hands-On Theme Each Week: Slime Science, Colorful Chemistry, Bubble Science, Fossils & Geodes, and more!
* All Ages Welcome: Fun, accessible, and interactive for the whole family.
* Easy Drop-In Format: Stop by our tent anytime during the concert!

Spark your curiosity and explore the fun side of science in the heart of Adams Morgan!


** WallMountables Returns to The DC Arts Center Friday!
------------------------------------------------------------

Wallmountables (https://www.dcartscenter.org/wallmountables26) is one of DC’s largest open community art exhibitions and The DC Arts Center’s (https://www.dcartscenter.org/) annual fundraiser!

During WallMountables, DC Arts Center transforms their gallery walls into a massive grid of 2’ x 2’ squares. Anyone can purchase as many squares as they’d like, select their space on the wall, and hang whatever artwork they want to share or sell! One great way to participate in WallMountables and support DCAC is to become an Artist Member. Learn all about an Artist Membership here (https://www.dcartscenter.org/artistmember) .

While simply showing your work is exciting enough, there's always the chance that your work sells, too! Last year’s exhibition generated more than $3,500 in art sales, with artists keeping 100% of those proceeds.

Register and learn more here (http://www.dcartscenter.org/wallmountables26) .

subject: Newsletter Infotur Latam 22-07-26 🌍
body:
Newsletter Infotur Latam 22-07-26
Si no puede visualizar bien este boletín haga clic AQUÍLima, miercoles 22 de julio del 2026 Director General: Carlos Bernuy  Abren Four Seasons Hotel Mykonos que combina el lujo atemporal con la isla
El Four Seasons Hotel Mykonos ya está abierto y recibe a sus huéspedes para su temporada inaugural de verano. Ubicado sobre la bahía de Kalo Livadi, el hotel cuenta con un diseño contemporáneo, una playa privada, restaurantes con vistas al mar y experiencias inmersivas en la isla.
Leer más Air India selecciona la nueva Terminal 6 del aeropuerto JFK para sus operaciones
JFK Millennium Partners (JMP), la empresa seleccionada por la Autoridad Portuaria de Nueva York y Nueva Jersey para construir y operar la nueva Terminal 6 (JFK T6) de categoría mundial del Aeropuerto Internacional John F. Kennedy, y Air India, la principal aerolínea mundial de la India, anunciaron hoy que la aerolínea ha elegido la T6 para sus operaciones a partir de 2028.
Leer más
Cunard revela sus planes para una profunda transformación del Queen Victoria
Cunard, la línea de cruceros de lujo más emblemática del mundo, reveló hoy sus planes para una extensa transformación del Queen Victoria. Se prevé que el elegante barco salga del dique seco este otoño con espacios distintivos renovados, incluidas las suites Cunard Grills y la introducción de The Pavilion Wellness Café..
Leer másMundial impulsa récord turístico en ciudades anfitrionas del torneo
La Copa Mundial de Fútbol llegó a su fin con un campeón sobre el terreno de juego, pero el mayor legado del torneo podría haberse producido fuera de los estadios. Las ciudades anfitrionas y numerosos destinos vinculados al campeonato registraron un notable crecimiento en la actividad turística, confirmando que los grandes eventos deportivos continúan siendo una poderosa herramienta para dinamizar las economías locales, fortalecer la proyección internacional de los destinos y estimular el movimiento de viajeros durante y después de la competición.
Leer más
España conquista el mundo impulsando el turismo nacional internacional
La conquista del Campeonato Mundial de Fútbol por parte de España ha trascendido el ámbito deportivo para convertirse en un fenómeno con importantes repercusiones económicas, sociales y turísticas. El triunfo de la selección nacional no solo ha reforzado el prestigio internacional del país, sino que también ha despertado un renovado interés por conocer el territorio español, su cultura, su gastronomía y los lugares que forman parte de la identidad futbolística de una nación que vuelve a situarse en la cima del deporte mundial.
Leer más
Miami, todo un éxito como sede de la Copa Mundial de la FIFA 2026
Miami, con sus playas turquesas, sol y diversión, se lució como sede de la Copa Mundial de la FIFA 2026, atrayendo a más de un millón de turistas que llegaron a la ciudad del sur de Florida para los 7 partidos disputados en el Hard Rock Stadium y disfrutar de toda la experiencia del fútbol. Las cifras corresponden a las proyecciones brindadas por la FIFA y del Greater Miami Convention & Visitors Bureau (GMCVB), organismo oficial de promoción turística del condado de Miami-Dade.
Leer másIndiGo realiza una selección histórica de aviónica y APU de Honeywell Aerospace
Honeywell Aerospace anunció hoy que IndiGo, la aerolínea más grande de la India y una de las de mayor crecimiento a nivel mundial, ha seleccionado los sistemas de aviónica y energía insignia de Honeywell Aerospace para su pedido récord de 810 nuevos aviones de la familia Airbus A320neo. Este acuerdo representa el mayor contrato de equipos seleccionables para aeronaves nuevas en la historia de Honeywell Aerospace, lo que acelera la expansión de la compañía.Leer más Cuatro hoteles con Llave Michelin para hospedarse en The Palm Beaches, Florida
Elegir un hotel excepcional ya no depende únicamente de su ubicación o de la calidad de sus instalaciones. Hoy, la experiencia que ofrece un alojamiento es uno de los principales factores para los viajeros que buscan exclusividad y experiencias inolvidables. Si bien la Estrella Michelin ha sido durante décadas un referente mundial de la excelencia gastronómica, la Llave Michelin amplía ese prestigioso reconocimiento al sector hotelero, distinguiendo a los alojamientos que ofrecen experiencias verdaderamente excepcionales.
Leer más
Carnival Corporation amplía donación de excedentes de comida a las Bahamas
Un año después de celebrar la gran inauguración de Celebration Key en la isla de Gran Bahama, Carnival Corporation, la compañía de cruceros más grande del mundo, tiene otro motivo para celebrar: hoy lanza su programa de donación de excedentes de alimentos en las Bahamas. Esta expansión a las Bahamas representa un paso más en los esfuerzos continuos de la compañía por redistribuir los excedentes de alimentos mediante alianzas que generan un impacto positivo en las comunidades de todo el mundo.

Here's a principle that's helped me in business, fitness & honestly every area of life:

Willpower is a terrible system. Standing appointments are a great one.

body:
Employer Services
July 2026
View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/godcgo/employer-newsletter-3623647?e=0cf77505f8)
Prepare for Open Enrollment by Expanding Your Commuter Benefits🚍🍂
Summer may be in full swing, but fall open enrollment will be here before you know it! Summer is a great time to take a fresh look at your commuter benefits and consider simple ways to better support your employees' commutes. Partner with goDCgo to build or expand a commuter benefits program that meets your organization's needs. Consider options like:
* Launch a carpool or vanpool program to help employees save money, connect with coworkers, and reduce traffic.
* Offer Capital Bikeshare Corporate memberships to give employees an affordable and convenient biking option.
+ goDCgo can also host a complimentary CaBi 101 session to help employees learn how to use Capital Bikeshare with confidence.
+ Read (https://godcgo.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Success-Story_IDB_FINAL.pdf?utm_source=DC+Employers&utm_campaign=d6f69288cd-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2019_11_13_08_14_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_8b85183388-d6f69288cd-710933513)  the Inter-American Development Bank's success story to learn how they created a workplace culture that supports and embraces bike commuting.
* Install bike racks, showers, or other bike-friendly amenities to encourage more employees to bike to work.
* Support flexible work schedules to help employees avoid peak travel times and reduce commuting stress.
+ Read (https://godcgo.com/wp-content/uploads/Success-Story_NLN_R1.pdf?utm_source=DC+Employers&utm_campaign=d6f69288cd-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2019_11_13_08_14_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_8b85183388-d6f69288cd-710933513)  how the National League of Nursing (NLN) implemented a four-day work week to improve team morale and productivity.
* Promote commuter challenges and incentives to encourage cost-effective, sustainable commuting habits.

Small improvements can make a meaningful difference in helping employees save money and reduce commuting stress! Start now and schedule a meeting (https://godcgo.com/employer/?utm_source=DC+Employers&utm_campaign=d6f69288cd-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2019_11_13_08_14_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_8b85183388-d6f69288cd-710933513#team2) to discuss the best options for your organization.

Beat the Heat: 6 Tips for a Comfortable Summer Commute

Summer commutes can be very hot, especially for employees who bike, walk, or use public transportation, but you can help your team stay cool and confident by sharing goDCgo's latest commuter blog.

The blog features practical tips to help commuters prepare for hot weather, avoid overheating, and continue choosing sustainable transportation throughout the summer. From staying hydrated to planning for the heat, these simple strategies can make commuting safer and more enjoyable.

Located in Georgetown, where access to public transportation is limited, the organization faced unique commuting challenges. The survey results helped identify opportunities to expand existing benefits and develop new transportation solutions that better support employees.

Rosé, Rosado, Rosato… Incredible Pink Finds from Around the World - and It Begins with Provence’s Best Kept Secret. It’s Expressive and Age-Worthy Rosé Made from the Indigenous Mourvèdre Grape.

It is simple, this time of year, there are few wines as fun to explore as Rosé, Rosado and Rosato. From the respected soils and positioning along the French Mediterranean to well beyond the borders of Provence, there are tremendous selections to be found from all around the world, and that is what today’s feature is all about! From our favorites in Tuscany to Piemonte, Sancerre to Provence, Basque and beyond, there is a lot of excitement, value and enjoyment to be had from the 2025 vintage from across the world.

As for French Rosé, there is certainly an argument to be made that Bandol is a King. When it comes to the celebrated region, you may already know our beloved Chateau de Pibarnon (which is finally arriving), as well as the other icon of the region, Domaine Tempier; however, what you might not know is the quiet sleeper of Terreburne. It is simply a pinnacle expression that captures Bandol’s unique limestone terroir along with its sun-kissed exposure.​ We just opened the 2025 Terrebrune beside some Provence staples of Domaine Ott, Domaine Tempier, Pibarnon, and Peyrassol, and it was the Terrebune that had the us smiling​- arguably surpassing the neighboring French icons. We found the Terrebrune to be more finessed than the Pibarnon, yet fuller and more textured than the prized wine of Domaine Tempier, and with some recommended airtime, it is simply one of the most expressive and age-worthy rosés in the world, and it can be enjoyed throughout an entire meal and conversation. With its red fruit and white chocolate nuances, we say delizioso! Or in this case, délicieux!!

Our best recommendation is to build your own sampler case and experience the range and diversity of Rosé from across the world; however, be sure to include the Terrebrune and the signatures of La Spinetta, Boudignon, and Pibarnon.

Workplace trends       Payoff
AI-redesigned roles see 42% higher wage growth than legacy jobs
Companies that redesign roles around AI, rather than using AI to
just automate tasks, are seeing real payoffs for workers. Jobs
where AI handles routine tasks while employees shift to
higher-value work are also growing at twice the rate of legacy
roles, according to PwC. The catch: most companies pour resources
into technology, barely touching how teams are organized or what
individual jobs require. That gap causes transformation efforts
to stall within 12 to 18 months, the firm's research shows.
Exodus       Companies are replacing Salesforce and HubSpot with
homemade AI apps       Small firms are ditching costly enterprise
software as AI coding tools shrink build times to months.
Greenleaf Management saved $100,000 per year by switching from
Salesforce to a custom app built with Claude Code, according to
partner Dave Codrea. Five similar companies have dropped
Salesforce or HubSpot in the past six months, cutting software
costs by 40% to 80%, according to Loka CEO Bobby Mukherjee.
Sanofi is testing the same shift, targeting $10 million in yearly
savings.       Overwhelmed       84% of Middle East job seekers
say their applications are ignored       Employers across the
region are drowning in applications, many of them written or
tailored with AI. A survey of job seekers and hiring managers
found 59% now use AI or automation tools during their search, and
67% of hiring managers said they can spot AI-generated CVs, often
due to overly polished formatting. The volume has slowed hiring
at many firms, according to a Robert Walters survey of
professionals in the Middle East.       Nudge       13 hot-button
topics reveal the same AI bias       Millions of professionals
now lean on AI to draft LinkedIn posts, summarize articles, and
polish emails, often unaware that the tool is shaping opinion
along the way. Testing four AI model families on 13 contested
topics, researchers found systematic directional bias when models
drafted or edited text, according to a joint study from the Hasso
Plattner Institute, Oxford Internet Institute, and Weizenbaum
Institute. Illinois recently became the first US state to mandate
independent AI safety audits.       Untapped       Natural
History Museum licenses biodiversity data to BlackRock
Cultural and scientific institutions sitting on decades of
specialized data are discovering that licensing their data is
worth more than grant funding ever was. London's Natural History
Museum joined a UK government-backed pilot marketplace, alongside
the Imperial War Museum and the V&A, to license proprietary
datasets to AI developers instead of giving away access for free.
Museum director Doug Gurr insists institutions must negotiate
these deals as sophisticated buyers, not just data suppliers.
