"When you're on a podcast, you're not only talking to your ideal client - you're talking to the AI that refers them."

That one line stopped me in my tracks on the latest episode of the Marketing Minds Podcast...

And it comes from someone who knows podcast guesting better than just about anyone on the planet - Tom Schwab, Founder & CEO of Interview Valet, who has helped 1,500+ clients land over 75,000 podcast interviews.

Tom is also a big part of my own story. Back in early 2020, I was booking my first speaking stages when the world shut down. So I called Tom, & instead of stages, we launched a massive podcast tour. That year we 5x'd the business - & podcasts played a huge role in that growth.

Honestly, without Tom introducing me to the world of podcasting, there might not even be a Marketing Minds Podcast today!

So when Tom tells me the entire podcast game is changing because of AI... I listen. And you should too.

As a Reminder, Our Goal with this Newsletter is to Give You the _Highest Level of Value Possible._ That's my Promise to you & I intend to Over-Deliver!

Alright, let's Dive In...

———————————————————————————

# Watch the Full Video on YouTube:

Youtube: AI and Podcasting: A New Era of Content Creation with Tom Schwab (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ep3OT7Q9rLU)

Watch the Full Video on YouTube! (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ep3OT7Q9rLU)

———————————————————————————

# AI Is Listening (The New Podcast SEO)

We all know the world is shifting from SEO to AI search - call it AEO, GEO, or whatever acronym sticks. People are going straight to ChatGPT & other AI tools for recommendations on who to work with.

And here's the stat that should make you sit up: a study out of Cornell found that traffic from AI converts _9x better_ than SEO traffic.

Think about that. These are pre-educated leads. They already know your company, your offer & what you believe before they ever reach out.

So the real question becomes - how do you get the AI to recommend YOU?

Here's the answer Tom shared: **AI is listening to podcasts.**

There's a phenomenon called Model Collapse (some call it "Digital Dementia") - when AI trains on AI-generated content, it's like making a copy of a copy of a copy. The quality degrades fast.

So AI models are actively hunting for authentic _human_ content to learn from...

And podcasts are one of the last corners of the internet that are still overwhelmingly human. Real experts. Real conversations. No place to hide.

Remember when ChatGPT started showing its sources? Wikipedia at the top... then Amazon... & then long-form collaborative content: iTunes, Spotify & YouTube.

Tom saw this play out firsthand. His team leaned in hard - 5 team members actively guesting on shows - & by May of 2025, AI officially became Interview Valet's #1 referral source.

It's not a trick. It's not a hack. It's simply putting content into the world that tells both AI & your future clients: _This is the problem we solve. These are the clients we work with. This is what we believe._

### **Here's how to optimize your interviews now that AI is listening:**

**1. Never do the same interview twice.** You wouldn't publish the same blog post every Monday - so stop giving the same interview on every show. As Tom put it: "Content is King, but Context is God." Vary your themes, problems & examples for each audience so AI indexes the full range of your expertise.

**2. Bring in Multiple Voices.** If you're the only spokesperson, YOU are the bottleneck. Tom's team member who leads their health & wellness division started guesting on shows in that niche - & the leads jumped. HubSpot ran this play with six different "talents" at once. More voices = more shows, more audiences & more indexing.

**3. Rotate Your Topics.** Once you've covered a topic on a few shows, retire it & swap in a new one. Every interview becomes fresh content for humans - & new material for AI to index. (More on this in the One Sheet section below!)

———————————————————————————

# The "Better is Better" Booking Playbook

Now, how do you actually get booked?

Tom's answer flips the industry on its head: **More is not better. Better is better.**

There's a service out there bragging that you can pitch 1,500 podcasts in the time it takes to pitch one. And sure, you might get an invite... just not the one you want. You'll drown in a sea of sameness & burn your reputation along the way.

Instead, put yourself in the host's shoes. Who does any podcast host actually want on their show?

**Their Friends, Friends of Friends & People They Want to be Friends With.**

That's it. That's the list.

So here's the play - what I'd call Give, Give, Give, Give, Ask:

✓ Pick a handful of podcasts where you'd genuinely add value _(this doesn't have to be Joe Rogan - even Broadway starts Off-Broadway!)_

✓ Actually listen to the shows

✓ Leave a rating & review - we're all a little vain, & hosts read those!

✓ Engage with their content & comment genuinely

✓ THEN reach o

At a time when millions of people are turning to AI for information about the 2026 Iran War and about antisemitism, a new ADL report found that major AI chatbots are significantly less effective at identifying and rejecting antisemitism in Persian than in English.

In one key example, our researchers found that nearly every English response from a prominent AI platform acknowledged that Iran does indeed spread antisemitism, even noting that the state claims it does not. The Persian answers, in contrast, rarely did so and used language that absolved Iran of responsibility or softened claims of respected and legitimate organizations.

As ADL CEO Jonathan Greenblatt warned: “AI platforms have a responsibility to implement guardrails that prevent the promotion of antisemitism and hate. Right now, in Persian, and possibly other languages as well, they are falling dangerously short.”

In year five, she brought on a broker and 2 regional distributors, who now manage about 100 accounts for her. She still does the rest direct.

- Janelle Visser

body:
Newsletter Infotur Latam 09-07-26
Si no puede visualizar bien este boletín haga clic AQUÍLima, jueves 09 de julio del 2026 Director General: Carlos Bernuy  Four Seasons Resort Palm Beach el Resort #1 de Florida y el #4 de EE.UU.
El Four Seasons Resort Palm Beach ha sido nombrado el resort número 1 de Florida y el número 4 de Estados Unidos en la edición 2026 de los premios World’s Best Awards de Travel + Leisure. El resort también ha sido incluido en la prestigiosa lista T+L 500 de 2026, que lo reconoce entre los mejores hoteles del mundo por su excepcional calidad, servicio personalizado y experiencias memorables para sus huéspedes.
Leer más Michael O’Leary: “Von der Leyen es una inútil y debería dimitir”
Michael O’Leary, CEO de Ryanair, eleva el tono contra la presidenta de la Comisión Europea, Ursula von der Leyen, a quien acusa de no hacer nada para solucionar los retrasos en el control del tráfico aéreo de la Unión Europea, “salvo pronunciar discursos vacíos sobre la competitividad”.
Leer más  Discover Puerto Rico da vida a una canción viral de Puerto Rico con un videoclip oficial
Tras captar la atención del público en las redes sociales, la canción viral sobre Puerto Rico que se convirtió en un himno no oficial para los viajeros que sueñan con la isla ahora cuenta con un video musical oficial y una experiencia para cantar juntos , llevando el fenómeno de internet de las pantallas a algunos de los destinos más emblemáticos de Puerto Rico.
Leer másLuis Ramírez: "Cruz del Sur transportó más de un millón de turistas"
Cruz del Sur cerró el último año con una cifra que confirma su liderazgo en el transporte terrestre del país: 4 millones y medio de pasajeros transportados, de los cuales más de 1 millón corresponden a turistas que recorrieron principalmente las rutas del sur peruano. Este logro, sumado a sus 66 años de trayectoria, a la calidad del servicio que brindan a los pasajeros, al haber cumplido con los requisitos y los procesos, le sumó para recibir esta semana la licencia de uso de la Marca Perú.
Leer más
Travelsoft integra contenido aéreo de Travelport a Orchestra para más agencias
Travelport, una empresa de infraestructura de viajes inteligente que gestiona las reservas de millones de viajeros en todo el mundo, y Travelsoft, una empresa líder en tecnología de viajes de tipo Software como Servicio (SaaS), han anunciado la integración satisfactoria de la plataforma Trip Services API de Travelport a través de Orchestra, el centro de transporte del Grupo Travelsoft.
Leer más  Argentina: Conozca los destinos más buscados para el fin de semana largo
El fin de semana largo del 9 al 12 de julio se perfila como una oportunidad ideal para realizar una escapada. En un contexto en el que las vacaciones de invierno ya comenzaron en algunas provincias y están a punto de iniciarse en otras, estos días impulsarán el movimiento turístico y la actividad económica en distintos destinos del país. De hecho, seis de cada diez argentinos reconocen el impacto positivo que tiene el turismo en las economías locales.Leer más
Air Europa: beneficios récord y nueva filial de mantenimientoAir Europa dispara su rentabilidad con un beneficio neto antes de impuestos de 154,5 millones de euros en 2025, un 33% más que en 2024, cuando ganó 116 millones. Su Ebitda crece un 14,5%, ascendiendo a 235,8 millones, mientras que la cifra de negocio lo hace un 7,3%, hasta 3.146 millones.
Leer más Disfruta el final del verano: el arte de las escapadas de Slow Travel
Los viajes de verano suelen asociarse con itinerarios llenos de actividades y con aprovechar al máximo cada minuto fuera de casa. Ahora que la temporada comienza a llegar a su fin, cada vez más viajeros se suman al creciente movimiento del slow travel, priorizando experiencias significativas, estancias más largas y destinos que los inviten a hacer una pausa, recargar energías y vivir plenamente el momento.
Leer más  Expertos en fidelización afirman que estatus élite aumenta ingresos de las aerolíneas
Durante décadas, las aerolíneas han centrado sus estrategias de monetización de los programas de fidelización en los puntos, las millas y las tarjetas de crédito co-brandeadas. Sin embargo, según los expertos en fidelización, la siguiente etapa de estos programas estará menos centrada en la moneda de fidelización que acumulan los clientes y más en convertir el estatus que ostentan en un producto comercial.

Con la entrega de las placas que avalan el reconocimiento de 13 restaurantes de Jalisco en la selección 2026 de la Guía MICHELIN, el estado reafirma a la gastronomía como una de sus principales fortalezas turísticas y como una expresión de identidad que se refleja en sus destinos.

July 8, 2026


** Updates from Adams Morgan
------------------------------------------------------------

Click here (https://adamsmorgan.com/connect/newsletter-archive) to see previous updates in our newsletter archive.

Check ObviouslyDC.com for the latest in DC government funding and grant opportunities for businesses.


** July AMPBID Board Meeting
------------------------------------------------------------

The next board meeting of the Adams Morgan Partnership Business Improvement District (AMPBID) will be on Tuesday, July 14 at 5pm via Zoom. In addition to regular board business, we’ll continue our budget discussion as well as other issues.

Click here (https://us02web.zoom.us/j/88179900884?pwd=Eybb9ADa1Wf9cebzybGblOsQAmNaWI.1) to attend the board meeting via Zoom on Tuesday, July 14 at 5pm.


** AdMo Vibe returns to Kalorama park July 30
------------------------------------------------------------

Your favorite neighborhood evening concert series is returning to Kalorama Park on Thursdays at 6pm starting July 30. Bring your family, a blanket to sit on, and grab some takeout on the way to the park — we’ll provide the tunes!

Watch this space and our website (https://adamsmorgan.com/events/signature-events/admo-vibe) for more updates — we’ll be adding some fun activities for the whole family this year!
* Thursday, July 30 - Sofa City; Pop & RnB Cover Band

* Thursday, August 13 - Langston Hughes II; Jazz
* Thursday, August 20 - Downtown Tumbao; Latin Jazz
* Thursday, August 27 - Rain Date


** Adams Morgan Farmers Market: Saturdays 8:30am - 1pm
------------------------------------------------------------

LICKING CREEK BEND FARM will be at the market Saturday!

The Adams Morgan Farmers Market is located in Unity Park (https://maps.app.goo.gl/rAZDqznMBdSkXQyt5) at the corner of Columbia Road and Euclid Street, NW.

The season is progressing and lots of items are getting ready for harvest.  They expect to have fresh picked, pesticide-free: kale, spinach, arugula, radishes, scallions (green onions), Cherries, garlic, garlic scapes, peaches, sugar plums, watermelon, our own honey, tomatoes mushrooms, assorted greens, our first zucchini, maybe some apples, herbs (thyme, sage, mint, dill, and parsley) and other seasonal goodies including a new batch of Annie's jams/jellies/pickled goodies, and more from Katie's Jams and Jellies, an Amish Women's collective.

Also featured at the market: RAVENHOOK BAKEHOUSE, QUALIA COFFEE, and REMIE'S FLOWERS AND PLANTS.

Ravenhook will be featuring: Peach Ginger Pound Cake; Strawberry Basil Brioche; Bell Pepper, Onion, and Mozzarella Focaccia; Rye Crisps

Also, consider joining Licking Creek Bend Farm’s CSA (Consumer Supported Agriculture) for weekly produce directly from our farm, harvested on Fridays.  Email for details: esiegel2@igc.org (mailto:esiegel2@igc.org?subject=&body=)


** Updates from RAMW
------------------------------------------------------------

Wage & Hour Compliance Reminder

Recent wage and hour enforcement actions are a timely reminder for every employer to review payroll practices and ensure compliance with District labor laws.
* Take a Fresh Look: Review employee classifications, overtime calculations, tipped employee pay, wage notices, and recordkeeping to ensure your business is meeting all applicable requirements.
* Education Is Coming: RAMW has been working with the DC Department of Employment Services (DOES) to expand educational resources and training focused on wage and hour compliance, helping employers understand the law and avoid costly mistakes.
* Learn More: Review the District’s wage and hour guidance (https://does.dc.gov/page/office-wage-hour-employees) through the DOES Office of Wage-Hour⁠ and watch for upcoming RAMW and DOES educational programs designed to help employers stay compliant.

Cashless Protections Extended to 2027

DC Council this week extended the Entertainment Establishment Employee Safety Act (https://lims.dccouncil.gov/Legislation/B26-0710) , continuing protections that allow some restaurants and bars to operate cashless amid ongoing safety concerns.
* The Vote: At-Large Councilmember Christina Henderson introduced the extension, which keeps the temporary cash-acceptance exemption in place for businesses that serve alcohol or stay open late or 24 hours, while the Council continues to consider a permanent policy. It passed Jun. 30, 11-1. Chair Phil Mendelson cast the lone no vote.

body:
Why Guests Don't Book (And What You Can Do About It)Click here to see a web copy of this email http://globalfoodtourism.activehosted.com/p_v.php?c=401&m=484&s=b730db3df0b19ee283c91c10348db03b&d=403&v=2&l=2

Hi Dave,

We hope you're having a fantastic summer and enjoying one of the busiest seasons of the year!  Earlier this year, we introduced a new approach to Food Tour Operator education through the GFTA Business Blueprint Series.  

Here's where we are in the journey:

**Pillar 1:** Foundation & Trust

**Pillar 2:** Visibility & Discovery
➡ 

**Pillar 3:** Decision & Conversion 

**(Current Webinar)**

**Pillar 4:** Pricing & Profitability

**Pillar 5:** Leadership & Scale

With trust established and visibility in place, the next question becomes one that every operator faces:

The Booking Decision: What Makes Guests Say Yes https://us06web.zoom.us/meeting/register/2RCpy0F1SRC__F-d41oKRg

Every day, potential guests discover incredible tour businesses, browse experiences, compare options and then quietly leave without ever making a reservation.  Understanding why that happens is one of the greatest opportunities operators have to improve bookings without simply spending more on marketing.

In this webinar, we'll explore what happens between the moment a guest discovers your business and the moment they decide to click "Book Now." We'll look at the psychology behind booking decisions, the common sources of hesitation that quietly reduce conversion, and the practical ways operators can create a smoother, more confident booking experience.

Whether you're welcoming ten guests a week or hundreds, understanding why guests say yes is one of the most valuable skills a tourism business can develop.

Webinar Details
 

**Topic:** The Booking Decision: What Makes Guests Say Yes
 

**Date:** Tuesday, July 28
 

**Time:** 10:30am CT | 9:30am MT | 8:30am PT | 11:30am ET | 4:30pm GMT
️ 

**Cost:** Free
 [ https://us06web.zoom.us/j/87306794864Register Here] https://us06web.zoom.us/meeting/register/2RCpy0F1SRC__F-d41oKRg

Over the coming weeks, we'll introduce the expert speakers leading this discussion and share more about the unique perspectives they'll bring to the conversation. Together, they'll help connect the psychology of why guests choose one experience over another with the practical decisions operators can make to create a smoother, more confident booking journey.

~ GFTA

Minor Hotels da un nuevo paso en su estrategia de fidelización con el lanzamiento de Horizons Club by Minor DISCOVERY, una suscripción anual premium dirigida a viajeros frecuentes que buscan descuentos, experiencias exclusivas dentro y fuera del hotel, acceso anticipado a promociones, y beneficios con partners de viaje y ocio.
Leer más La encarnizada lucha por el legado de Spirit: Un mercado en reconfiguración
La reciente desaparición de Spirit Airlines, que cesó sus operaciones en mayo de este año tras no superar una profunda crisis financiera, ha dejado un vacío significativo en el ecosistema aéreo estadounidense.
Leer más  Holland America Line ampliará acceso a los fiordos de Noruega en 2027
Holland America Line amplía las oportunidades para que los pasajeros disfruten de los espectaculares paisajes de los fiordos noruegos en 2027, actualizando cinco cruceros a bordo del Rotterdam para incluir escalas en Flåm y Hellesylt. Estas incorporaciones brindan a los viajeros mayor acceso a algunos de los destinos de fiordos más codiciados de Noruega, incluyendo el Nærøyfjord, declarado Patrimonio de la Humanidad por la UNESCO, y el Storfjorden, puerta de entrada al Geirangerfjord. La UNESCO considera que las regiones del Geirangerfjord y el Nærøyfjord se encuentran entre «las zonas de fiordos más impresionantes del planeta», situando a los pasajeros en el corazón de dos de las maravillas naturales más célebres de Noruega.
Leer másÁfrica apuesta por aeropuertos modernos para impulsar su conectividad aérea
África vive una etapa de fuerte expansión en materia de infraestructura aeroportuaria, con inversiones que superan los 25.000 millones de dólares destinadas a la construcción de nuevos aeropuertos y la modernización de terminales existentes. La apuesta responde al interés de numerosos gobiernos por fortalecer la conectividad regional, consolidar centros de operaciones aéreas y posicionar al continente como un actor más competitivo dentro del transporte internacional. Sin embargo, este ambicioso proceso de transformación convive con una realidad compleja para muchas aerolíneas africanas, que continúan enfrentando dificultades financieras, limitaciones operativas y un mercado que aún presenta importantes desafíos.

Cruz del Sur presenta nuevos buses Confort Suite
En el marco de la conmemoración de su 66.º aniversario, Cruz del Sur recibió oficialmente la Licencia de Uso de la Marca Perú, otorgada por PromPerú. Se trata de un reconocimiento que destaca el compromiso de la empresa con la promoción del país, la puesta en valor de sus destinos y la difusión de una imagen positiva del Perú a través de sus servicios de transporte terrestre interprovincial.

Por años, las campañas entre marcas se construyeron alrededor de patrocinios, promociones cruzadas o intercambios comerciales. Hoy el modelo comienza a evolucionar hacia otro tipo de colaboración: empresas que, aún perteneciendo a industrias distintas, quieren resolver un mismo momento del consumidor y compartir audiencias con intereses comunes.

La aerolínea panameña Copa Airlines anunció la incorporación del servicio de internet satelital Starlink en su flota, trascendió hoy.
De acuerdo con un comunicado de la compañía, de esa manera la aerolínea bandera de la nación istmeña se convierte en la primera de su tipo en América Latina en ofrecer conectividad WiFi de alta velocidad a bordo de sus aeronaves. La empresa precisó que la primera nave equipada con esa tecnología realizó su vuelo inaugural el pasado 4 de julio, como parte de un proceso de implementación gradual que abarcará toda la flota y que prevé concluir durante el primer trimestre de 2027.

Bookmark and Share [ https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/DCWASH/bulletins/41f9664?reqfrom=share ] *DPR Launches Play It Forward Scholarship Supporting Former DPR Program Participants’ College and Career Goals* PLAY IT FORWARD SCHOLARSHIP [ https://recforall.splashthat.com/ ]   *(WASHINGTON, DC)* – The DC Department of Parks and Recreation (DPR) has launched the 2026 Rec for All Play It Forward Scholarship [ https://recforall.splashthat.com/ ], opening the door for eligible young adults to receive up to $5,000 for college or career programs. The program will award up to 40 scholarships, each valued at up to $5,000, to support the educational goals of District residents. *The deadline to apply is Friday, July 10, 2026. *  “This scholarship reflects DPR’s commitment to supporting young people well beyond their time in our programs,” said DPR Director Thennie Freeman. “We encourage all eligible residents to apply and take advantage of this opportunity to invest in their future.” The Rec for All Play It Forward Scholarship is designed to help former DPR program participants further their education while recognizing their engagement and success in DPR programs. The scholarship supports students enrolled in accredited postsecondary institutions, including colleges, universities, and vocational or technical programs. Eligibility Requirements: * Be a DC resident * Have earned a high school diploma or equivalent * Have participated in a DPR program * Be enrolled in post-secondary education Recipients will be selected based on the following criteria: * Strength of the application content, clarity of career goals, and adherence to deadlines * Enrollment in an accredited post-secondary institution * Demonstrated unmet financial need * Successful participation in a DPR program * Submission of two reference letters * A brief video submission Applicants can access and submit the scholarship application online at RecForAll.com [ https://recforall.com/ ]. subject: Who controls your reputation in ChatGPT?
body:
ChatGPT doesn't just read your website. It compares what your website says against everyone else. So it isn't just what you say. It's whether the rest of the web agrees.
How do you influence the narrative?
1. Don’t assume AI can find your content just because Google can
Visibility starts with access. ChatGPT uses Google and Bing to search the web.
Are you indexed in both? Have you accidentally blocked GPTbot? You can spend months optimizing content that AI systems never properly discover.
Start with Site Audit <https://engage.semrush.com/dc/9eWUrg0hSgkzWKM9cDUSAIqYSvI426V2Yvph4aKtNeeqA42Zg3ncx8hNOzIcFGfuxv2QsZEC_FaF2gNs0xz-MZCOdZgCS41zvHv80QPlyC1cRSjVqlXieom6tMuLg6vBqNZ_NhC7eP7OashS_U2G7FnzJI4qlcliImvrsw_iZbI=/NTE5LUlJWS04NjkAAAGi4BDAhkj8gfCIKRBUIxnLmmHJdjGk_LOwglrqHFAI_SpVcYC9KoC3EGIaWHfEZI2NcoF4F3o=>. Before AI can cite content, it has to reach it.
Next, give Bing a direct route to your content. Set up Bing Webmaster Tools <https://engage.semrush.com/dc/m08QRNO039KIwT-EX8o1gCovcruf0NgqjiEJaWBYLvd-4OSI_TyopAMx90kjP8Ff1D8OrbeefftidwV4aNOCqG9jtABpaYXJtQ1XWOcURAA6w_ax4ojNephsjbo0MDbDKxlXGGeo53559K6bhXwBffay-SQwAwad8SxS-1a7i6efAXyv7YaLpXhn3EHKe9yZ/NTE5LUlJWS04NjkAAAGi4BDAhkj8gfCIKRBUIxnLmmHJdjGk_LOwglrqHFAI_SpVcYC9KoC3EGIaWHfEZI2NcoF4F3o=> and submit your sitemap so new pages don't go unnoticed.
2. Your website isn't the only source AI learns from
Your website says one thing. A directory says another. An old review says something else. If those sources disagree, AI has to decide which version to trust. Hint: it often isn’t your site.
Your core brand facts (things like your business name, address, and phone number) need to be consistent across your site and the rest of the web.
Look for conflicting information that may shape how AI understands your brand. Request corrections where needed. <https://engage.semrush.com/dc/9eWUrg0hSgkzWKM9cDUSAJlVMmkCzVHpn597mGEFEvD6KdcQhn3bJuA31GEzUOu9Skxg3fAhuVYiJhI0MZtu4T82w62RjLpShpyoUrSBJJORfwF5JOebVQY0HnnQAbJhD4S2i7UJQxDwhJfmJjEdDVp8P3DRw9QQglBQ0s3Z8U8-QGpt3cifOSWLAsH07t4F/NTE5LUlJWS04NjkAAAGi4BDAhkj8gfCIKRBUIxnLmmHJdjGk_LOwglrqHFAI_SpVcYC9KoC3EGIaWHfEZI2NcoF4F3o=>
• For unlinked mentions, Google:
"Your brand name" -site:yourwebsite.com
• For linked mentions, use Semrush to spot conflicting information
3. Just because information exists doesn't mean AI will use it
The best answer buried halfway down a page is still buried. Make key answers, product details, and differentiators impossible to miss.
Use H2 and H3 headings to signal what's important. AI systems rely on structure to understand, extract, and cite information. <https://engage.semrush.com/dc/9eWUrg0hSgkzWKM9cDUSABNA_1DIZ8e_4WdDPp2rOiDVYZFmRawwBW2neTqmL4lNlqBH4RZwVCq8g8DBBWkFJgyEFwXash1tTq9PDp_lxbtyNNGIzmlGyvjIoUqNLzz_hEyFkyeYVjFRufqz1HN3WXo3ub8nMT6V_r9QciLSoTcQCyq1hdrjnVE2dhdv9h9u/NTE5LUlJWS04NjkAAAGi4BDAhkj8gfCIKRBUIxnLmmHJdjGk_LOwglrqHFAI_SpVcYC9KoC3EGIaWHfEZI2NcoF4F3o=>
4. Is your content specific or trying to rank for everything?
Trying to rank for everything is a good way to be known for nothing. Specific expertise is harder to copy.
Example: there are over a billion pages covering the history of coffee. You're unlikely to win that battle.
But you can become the best source on a precise brewing method. Or the definitive guide to fixing sour espresso shots.
Go to Prompt Research <https://engage.semrush.com/dc/9eWUrg0hSgkzWKM9cDUSAHvTkF6S17lci4-U4asqBcvvG1u_VF9YYHTVjhh8QIA5nj59B_568IfXmBgStlf3w5su-SHDTLA7vNnMqPEsnSeP--cjJEVJyMfd23sahO99lc9gwrxHFO5HaBsi98EcZRGBTONJo9GVxBNli2PPmIQeLcTTA-evVGRHzJP0fjOs/NTE5LUlJWS04NjkAAAGi4BDAhkj8gfCIKRBUIxnLmmHJdjGk_LOwglrqHFAI_SpVcYC9KoC3EGIaWHfEZI2NcoF4F3o=> to uncover content opportunities where you can build depth, not just chase larger volumes.
Academy <https://engage.semrush.com/NTE5LUlJWS04NjkAAAGi4BDAhUA_d5X-pEPLtV0heNqZbTahCOyMm49y-WrH3yCuRgfQdbFdtBWxAtfqKKKAW8sS_Hg=>

It is 1873. Mrs. Eliza Touchet is the Scottish housekeeper—and cousin by marriage—of a once-famous novelist, now in decline, William Ainsworth, with whom she has lived for thirty years.

Mrs. Touchet is a woman of many interests: literature, justice, abolitionism, class, her cousin, his wives, this life and the next. But she is also sceptical. She suspects her cousin of having no talent; his successful friend, Mr. Charles Dickens, of being a bully and a moralist; and England of being a land of facades, in which nothing is quite what it seems.

Andrew Bogle, meanwhile, grew up enslaved on the Hope Plantation, Jamaica. He knows every lump of sugar comes at a human cost. That the rich deceive the poor. And that people are more easily manipulated than they realize. When Bogle finds himself in London, star witness in a celebrated case of imposture, he knows his future depends on telling the right story.

The “Tichborne Trial”—wherein a lower-class butcher from Australia claimed he was in fact the rightful heir of a sizable estate and title—captivates Mrs. Touchet and all of England. Is Sir Roger Tichborne really who he says he is? Or is he a fraud? Mrs. Touchet is a woman of the world. Mr. Bogle is no fool. But in a world of hypocrisy and self-deception, deciding what is real proves a complicated task. . . .

Workplace trends     Elevation    Gen Z is landing
c-suite AI roles years ahead of schedule     A talent shortage in
AI literacy is accelerating an unusual career leap for the
youngest generation in the workforce. Companies struggling to
find executives who genuinely understand AI tools are
increasingly looking to Gen Z, whose native fluency with the
technology is outweighing years of experience in traditional
hiring criteria. LinkedIn's head of economics for the Americas
notes Gen Z workers are more likely to hold AI skills, giving
them an edge in roles that previously required decades of
experience.     Recalibration    Ford rehired 350 veteran
engineers after AI quality systems fell short     Experienced
workers bring something AI currently cannot replicate: judgment
built from years of handling complex, unpredictable problems.
Ford quietly reversed course on automated quality inspection,
bringing back over 350 senior engineers to lead reviews and help
train its AI systems, Bloomberg reported. The results were
measurable, with Ford ranking first among mainstream brands in
the J.D. Power Initial Quality Survey, its best result in 16
years.    Infrastructure    AI demand pushed US power sector
deals past $200bn in five months     AI's reach is now reshaping
industries with no obvious connection to technology. The energy
sector saw a record $203.6bn in deals in just the first five
months of 2026, more than 40% above last year's full-year total,
driven by the race to build power capacity for data centers, per
Deloitte. Some utilities are now forecasting 50-100% revenue
growth over the next decade, a sign of how deeply AI
infrastructure is reshaping business priorities across the
economy.    Signal    AI is driving a third of UK productivity
growth, outpacing every other sector     Britain's information
and communications technology sector expanded output by 43% this
decade, more than seven times the country's overall growth rate,
with AI accelerating the gap. Morgan Stanley calculates the
sector has accounted for roughly a third of UK growth over the
past three years, double its share from before the pandemic.
Economists note that knowledge-intensive industries such as
software and consulting give the UK an unusual structural
advantage as AI spreads across the economy.     Exposure    Women
hold 30% of AI jobs, but are nearly twice as likely to face
automation risk     The people most exposed to AI disruption have
the least influence over how it's built. Women make up just 30%
of the global AI workforce, per the International Labor
Organization, while holding a disproportionate share of the roles
AI is most likely to replace. Researchers say that gap matters
beyond fairness: systems built without diverse input tend to
reflect the blind spots of whoever designed them.

Hiring for potential in the age of AI    By
monday.com 
( https://clicks.mail.monday.com/f/a/1F2MgCRMTpOKev0yx6XbjQ~~/AAQRxRA~/5MUnHJ7kz-pG1rjxaWjCvI9qZllFRqvEDWgTlzhg8eTtv9bef0BPSKXNfJBFOJuF1oPvP-7pf-1bsxpEos3Cin6nd3lreECglf5-x93gvC-vhybbBLVE010zcpv8Y2GrC1NYUpkjh9vAf15-QYEy-josI2Hnj671nWFpfyFjIGEp-mxfChks7iDgsbKWi-8GjjpJlEzu6xxc7P_nJKed3sx_L2Xr3j-HgxUpzy8NKnM~ )
     AI has not only changed the way we work, but it’s also
changed the skills we need to succeed. Employees are now having
to solve unfamiliar problems, adapt quickly, and think
critically. While having technical AI knowledge is definitely
valuable, it’s actually soft skills that matter most. In fact,
the World Economic Forum says analytical thinking remains one of
the most important skills employees are looking for, followed by
resilience, flexibility, leadership, creative thinking,
motivation, and lifelong learning.

body:
[Producer highlight](https://sf.vervewine.com/search?type=product%2Carticle%2Cpage&q=evesham)

Is This The Best Value in Oregon Pinot Noir? For Under $25, This is One of Our Favorite House Wines, and it Should Be Yours, Too

"A lovely, drinkable, light-to medium-bodied wine. Pretty aromas of delicate red flowers, spices, wild berries, and citrus. Fresh acidity, crunchy red fruit and orange peel flavors with structured but gentle tannins. A complete wine and a good value." - James Suckling​

Founded in the 1980s, Evesham Wood is an old-school Willamette Valley producer that has stuck to its guns, crafting restrained and delicate Pinot Noirs, a deliberate counterpoint to the bigger, fruitier styles that dominate so much of the category. Fruit for all of Evesham Wood's cuvées is farmed sustainably and dry-farmed, with no irrigation - a labor-intensive approach that forces vines to dig deep for water and tends to produce smaller, more concentrated berries. 

Their entry, 'Willamette Valley' bottling, is the estate's most approachably priced wine, but it draws fruit from the same vineyards as their top cuvées: Illahe in the Mt. Pisgah, Polk County AVA, and Mahonia in the Jory hills, alongside Eola-Amity Hills sites like Prophet, Koosah, Jubilee, Cortell Rose, and Sojeau. The grapes are fermented in small, 1.25-ton open-top lots and punched down twice a day, and in 2024 the wine spent a full year in French oak to help knit the blend together. This is a superb value wine that punches well above its weight. This is a weeknight favorite for the shop - and should be yours, too. For those seeking their higher-end bottlings, their "Cuvée J" is an homage to Burgundian legend and winemaking inspiration, Henri Jayer. 

FEATURED WINE: Evesham Wood Delivers Our Domestic House Pinot Noir of the Season

https://sf.vervewine.com/search?type=product%2Carticle%2Cpage&q=evesham

[SHOP NOW](https://sf.vervewine.com/search?type=product%2Carticle%2Cpage&q=evesham)

 ADDITIONAL NOTES AND REVIEWS: 

https://sf.vervewine.com/collections/all/products/evesham-wood-willamette-valley-pinot-noir

2024 Evesham Wood Willamette Valley Pinot Noir$25.00 Regular $21.99 Special* Verve Wine Team: “Deep ruby with a bright, clear core. The nose opens with fresh red cherry and wild strawberry, then settles into forest floor and a savory smokiness. The palate is where this wine really earns its reputation: silky and textural up front, with cranberry, blood orange and ripe raspberry carried on a bright, juicy acidity. The tannins are fine and gentle rather than gripping, and there's a savory, saline minerality running underneath the fruit that keeps every sip engaging, rather than letting it go soft or jammy. Drink it now with roast chicken or mushroom anything, or tuck a few away; the structure here suggests it has legs over the next several years. Buy the case."

https://sf.vervewine.com/collections/all/products/evesham-woods-eola-amity-hills-pinot-noir-cuvee-j-2023

2023 Evesham Wood Willamette Valley Pinot Noir 'Cuvée J'$64.00 Regular $59.99 Special* Verve Wine Team: “This is Oregon Pinot Noir the way we love it, elegant, honest and beautifully drinkable. Evesham Wood has been a quiet benchmark in the Eola-Amity Hills for decades, and the Cuvée J is their calling card. The nose pulls you in with plush dark fruit, tart red berries and a lift of baking spice, backed by the forest floor and undergrowth notes that mark real Willamette terroir. The palate is medium-bodied and silky, with a bold streak of concentration you don't always find at this price. Bright acidity keeps everything fresh, chalky tannins give it grip, and cranberry, pomegranate, and a whisper of violet carry the finish. There's substance here, the kind of wine that could sneak into a blind flight of red Burgundy and hold its own. Purchase it by the case, pour it now, and enjoy it over the next several years."

Si no puede visualizar bien este boletín haga clic AQUÍLima, martes 07 de julio del 2026 Director General: Carlos Bernuy  Desarrollarán el primer Autograph Collection Hotels de Marriott International en Buenos Aires
Pride Developer anuncia el desarrollo de un nuevo hotel en el centro de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires, que formará parte de Autograph Collection Hotels, la cartera de hoteles independientes de alta gama de Marriott International, Inc. La obra tiene previsto iniciar durante el último cuatrimestre de 2026 y contempla la recuperación de un edificio histórico integrado a una nueva estructura contemporánea. El hotel estará ubicado en uno de los corredores culturales más emblemáticos de Buenos Aires, reconocido por su destacada oferta teatral, artística y gastronómica.

Con el objetivo de fortalecer la conectividad aérea, el turismo y el comercio internacional, el ministro de Transportes y Comunicaciones, Aldo Prieto Barrera, sostuvo una reunión de trabajo con Su Excelencia Abdullah bin Jassim Al Zeyara, embajador extraordinario y plenipotenciario del Estado de Qatar en el Perú.
Leer más  Cómo los ricos están reinventando los viajes de lujo en 2026
Los viajeros más exigentes del mundo están dejando atrás las multitudes de agosto en la Costa Amalfitana, cambiando las tumbonas de playa por refugios árticos y descubriendo que el secreto mejor guardado de Italia reside en sus países vecinos. Así lo revelan los nuevos datos de reservas para 2026 de Global Travel Collection (GTC), la red de asesoría de viajes responsable de más de 2400 millones de dólares en ventas anuales de viajes de lujo y de más de 1000 viajes individuales ya reservados este año por 100 000 dólares o más.
Leer másFIFA Fan Fest de Miami une a los hinchas del mundo para disfrutar del fútbol
Miami, la ciudad del sol, del mar y de la diversión, es toda una fiesta, pues ahora tiene al fútbol como protagonista. La ciudad es sede de 7 partidos de la Copa Mundial de Fútbol FIFA 2026. Los amantes del deporte rey están disfrutando los partidos en el FIFA Fan Fest que se instaló en el Bayfront Park de Miami, en pleno corazón de la ciudad, y une a los hinchas de diversas partes del mundo para disfrutar del fútbol y celebrar las diferentes culturas.Leer más
La Cordillera Blanca pone al Perú en el mapa mundial del turismo de aventura
Imponentes montañas, lagunas turquesas, glaciares y un cielo despejado serán el escenario que acompañará a los deportistas del Ultra Trail Cordillera Blanca (UTCB) 2026, una de las competencias de trail running más emblemáticas de Sudamérica, que se realizará del 2 al 5 de julio en la región Áncash.
Leer más  Europa supera los 40°C por intensa ola de calor: ¿qué deben tener en cuenta los viajeros?
Las olas de calor extremo que afectan a Europa durante los meses de verano vienen generando crecientes alertas sanitarias, especialmente entre los viajeros provenientes de América Latina. En ciudades como Madrid, Roma o París, las temperaturas superan los 38 °C, acompañadas de altos niveles de humedad, lo que eleva el riesgo de golpes de calor, deshidratación, insolación y otras afecciones relacionadas con la exposición prolongada al sol.Leer más
Visite el Museo de la Aviación de Delta, una experiencia fascinante en Atlanta
Comienza tu visita con Taking Flight, la premiada experiencia audiovisual introductoria del museo, diseñada para prepararte para todo lo que estás a punto de descubrir. Recientemente reconocida con importantes galardones internacionales, entre ellos un Gold en los Vega Digital Awards, esta presentación dinámica ofrece un adelanto de la experiencia inmersiva y llena de historias fascinantes que te espera en el interior.Leer más Ocean Signature Resorts ofrece entretenimiento multigeneracional en Punta Cana
Ocean Signature Resorts está redefiniendo la experiencia premium todo incluido en el Caribe al presentar una programación de entretenimiento de alto nivel, centrada en el deporte, en sus propiedades insignia de la República Dominicana: Ocean El Faro (Uvero Alto) y Ocean Blue & Sand (Bávaro). Pensando en una nueva era de viajeros activos y multigeneracionales, ambos resorts han integrado infraestructura deportiva de primer nivel y diversión familiar llena de adrenalina en sus ofertas frente al mar.

Inversión y turismo aceleran el crecimiento económico salvadoreño este año
La economía de El Salvador atraviesa una etapa de crecimiento superior a las previsiones iniciales gracias al impulso combinado de la inversión y el turismo, dos sectores que se han consolidado como motores fundamentales de la actividad productiva. Durante los primeros meses de 2026, el país registró una expansión del 4,8 %, un resultado que supera las estimaciones realizadas al inicio del año y refuerza las expectativas sobre la evolución de la economía salvadoreña en el corto y medio plazo.

Dear Dave,

For more than a century, compassionate people like you have confronted antisemitism when it mattered most. Not because it’s easy. But because it’s right.

In 1913, at a time when antisemitism was unchecked, Sigmund Livingston banded together a group of determined leaders who refused to accept hate as inevitable. They founded the Anti-Defamation League with a bold conviction: that the safety and dignity of Jewish people, and of all people, must be defended, without exception.

With leaders like Livingston, Abe Foxman and today, Jonathan Greenblatt, we have confronted some of the darkest chapters in our history. Abe, a Holocaust survivor, devoted his life to this work because he believed each generation had a responsibility to speak up. Jonathan carries that same conviction forward today, leading ADL through one of the most challenging moments of our time.

For 113 years, ADL supporters have led the fight. We’ve battled domestic extremism and fascist movements in the 1930s, shaped landmark hate crime laws in the 1980s and more recently, supported the creation of our Legal Action Network — a first-of-its-kind national legal network to defend victims of antisemitism in courts across the country.

These are not just milestones. They are proof of what’s possible when people choose to act. And today, we are once again at a moment that demands courage.

Antisemitic incidents are at alarming levels — in our streets, in our schools and online. Jews are facing harassment, vandalism and violence in communities across the country, from suburban Detroit, to Washington, D.C., to Boulder, Colorado. The threats are real, they are rising and they will not stop on their own.

Today, as throughout our long and impactful history, progress depends on people willing to fight back.

Dave, your support ensures that together, we can meet this moment with the strength and urgency it requires. Your donations help ADL:

	- Protect by responding in real time to antisemitic incidents and providing direct support to threatened synagogues, schools and communities
	- Advocate for lasting change by pressing lawmakers, tech platforms and institutions to take concrete, lasting action against hate
	- Educate by equipping students, educators and communities with the tools to recognize, reject and respond to antisemitism

This work is only possible because people like you have chosen to be on the right side of history, again and again and again.

This month, as we commemorate our founding in July, you’ll have the opportunity to join fellow supporters in uniting for good — coming together to confront hate with the same resolve that built this movement more than a century ago.

The fight is not over. But with people like you, it never goes unanswered.

Sincerely,

Jonathan Greenblatt
CEO and National Director
ADL

Hi Dave,

Last week, we emailed you about changes to HubSpot’s enrichment features and accompanying terms of service changes. We made a mistake in how we handled that, and we’re sorry. Nothing matters more to us than the trust of our customers.

After listening to feedback from our customers, we will not move forward with the changes communicated on July 1, 2026. Your product features and terms will remain as they are today.

Our intention with the previously announced terms of service changes was to support a vision we call Trusted Prospecting: helping you reach the right people, at the right time, with data and signals that make outreach feel timely and useful, not like spam. But we did not meet the standard you expect from us on transparency or control, and we understand why that eroded trust.

Here’s what we’re doing now:

- We are reassessing how to make opting into contact enrichment clearer, more easily governable, and simpler to manage.
- Any future enrichment capabilities that make use of your data will be fully and transparently opt‑in, with clear, upfront controls over whether you participate and how your data is used.
- Before we introduce any future changes that affect your data, we will communicate earlier, more clearly, and across multiple channels.

Si no puede visualizar bien este boletín haga clic AQUÍLima, lunes 06 de julio del 2026 Director General: Carlos Bernuy  Marriott International y The Coca-Cola Company anuncian acuerdo total
Marriott International y The Coca-Cola Company anunciaron hoy un acuerdo global que ampliará las opciones y mejorará la experiencia de los huéspedes en toda la cartera de Marriott, llevando las marcas de The Coca-Cola Company a hoteles de todo el mundo.
Leer más Easyjet acepta su venta por 6.400 millones de eurosLa dirección de Easyjet ha aceptado este domingo ser comprada por el fondo de inversiones americano Castlelake por un importe de 5.500 millones de libras, unos 6.400 millones de euros.
Leer más  TUI convierte su Marella Discovery 2 en un crucero solo para adultos
Marella Cruises, la línea británica de cruceros perteneciente al grupo TUI, ha decidido convertir su barco Marella Discovery 2 en un crucero solo para adultos de forma permanente, de cara a la temporada de invierno del año que viene. Así, el área de niños dará lugar a un bar, un escape room, un karaoke y una zona dedicada al arte y la artesanía. Este barco tendrá como puertos base a Santa Cruz de Tenerife y Las Palmas (Gran Canaria) desde noviembre de 2027 a marzo de 2028. El mes siguiente Málaga tomará el testigo. Este barco se suma así al Marella Explorer 2, que es también un crucero solo para adultos-

La Copa del Mundo está provocando un aumento considerable en la demanda de viajes en autobús interurbanos en varias ciudades anfitrionas de EE.UU., ya que los aficionados buscan formas asequibles de seguir el torneo en múltiples destinos.
Leer más La Copa del Mundo impulsa un aumento en los viajes en autobús
La Copa del Mundo está provocando un aumento considerable en la demanda de viajes en autobús interurbanos en varias ciudades anfitrionas de EE.UU., ya que los aficionados buscan formas asequibles de seguir el torneo en múltiples destinos.
Leer más  Pasajeros aéreos con discapacidad siguen enfrentando obstáculos
Mientras millones de europeos se preparan para las vacaciones de verano, este estudio pone de manifiesto una realidad que a menudo pasa desapercibida. Con casi uno de cada cuatro adultos en la UE con una discapacidad —unos 90 millones de personas—, facilitar el acceso a los viajes aéreos es una necesidad imperiosa y una prioridad cada vez mayor para el sector. Sin embargo, a pesar de las exhaustivas regulaciones y los estándares vigentes, volar sigue siendo con frecuencia una experiencia estresante y, en ocasiones, indigna para estos pasajeros. La investigación demuestra que las barreras persisten en cada etapa del viaje.
Leer más
Air Europa busca conectar a Madrid con Barranquilla en una nueva ruta directa
Air Europa ha solicitado formalmente autorización ante la Aeronáutica Civil de Colombia (Aerocivil) para operar una nueva ruta directa entre el Aeropuerto Adolfo Suárez Madrid-Barajas y el Aeropuerto Internacional Ernesto Cortissoz, que sirve a Barranquilla. Esta conexión estratégica no solo reforzará la presencia de la aerolínea española en el mercado sudamericano, sino que además establecerá el único enlace sin escalas entre la capital del departamento del Atlántico y el continente europeo.
Leer más Buenos Aires se reinventa en invierno con más cultura, gastronomía y experiencias
Las vacaciones de invierno ya no necesariamente implican recorrer cientos de kilómetros para vivir una experiencia diferente. Cada vez más personas eligen aprovechar el receso para redescubrir los atractivos de su propia ciudad, combinando descanso, entretenimiento y experiencias culturales sin necesidad de realizar grandes desplazamientos.
Leer más  Time Out destaca los mejores destinos LGBT+ en São Paulo y Rio de Janeiro
Bares que se extienden hacia la vereda, museos dedicados a la memoria y a la resistencia, y espectáculos de drag que se extienden hasta la madrugada. Con esta combinación de cultura, celebración y pertenencia, las ciudades de São Paulo y Río de Janeiro conquistaron un lugar entre los espacios LGBTQIAPN+ más interesantes del mundo, según la selección publicada por la revista Time Out. La selección fue elaborada a propósito del cierre del mes Pride, por editores y colaboradores de la publicación británica dedicada al entretenimiento y el tiempo libre. La lista incluye cuatro espacios brasileños junto a referentes internacionales de Londres, Tokio, París y otras ciudades.

El premio Travelers’ Choice Awards Best of the Best celebra la máxima excelencia en viajes. Se otorga a aquellos destinos, establecimientos y experiencias que reciben un gran número de reseñas y opiniones excepcionales por parte de la comunidad de Tripadvisor durante un período de 12 meses. De 8 millones de alojamientos, menos del 1 % alcanza este hito.

Hey Dave,

We hope you're having a fantastic summer and finding plenty of opportunities to welcome guests from around the world.  We're excited to announce that the third installment of the GFTA Business Blueprint Series is just around the corner, and we hope you'll save the date and plan to join us.

**The Booking Decision: What Makes Guests Say Yes**
 

**Tuesday, July 28**
 

**10:30am CT | 9:30am MT | 8:30am PT | 11:30am ET | 4:30pm GMT**
If you've been following the Blueprint Series so far, you know that each webinar builds upon the last to create a structured framework for understanding the foundations of a stronger, more profitable tourism business.  Rather than presenting disconnected topics throughout the year, we're taking a more intentional approach by exploring the customer journey step by step and helping operators understand how each piece contributes to long-term success.

So far, we've explored:

**Stage 1 – Foundation & Trust** How first impressions, guest expectations and operational readiness build confidence before a guest ever arrives.

**Stage 2 – Visibility & Discovery** How guests search for, discover and evaluate tourism businesses online before deciding where to book.

Now we move into what may be the most important question of all: Why do guests actually say "yes"?

Every Food Tourism Operator has experienced it. Guests visit your website. They browse your Food Tours. They compare experiences. They spend time looking through photos and reading descriptions. And then... they leave. What happened? Was it pricing? Was it uncertainty? Was it the booking process? Did they simply need one more question answered before committing?

In this next webinar, we'll explore the psychology behind booking decisions and the practical factors that influence whether guests move forward with a reservation or quietly abandon the process.

You'll gain a better understanding of:

• Why guests hesitate before booking
• The emotional factors that influence purchasing decisions
• The common points of friction that quietly reduce conversion
• How to create a booking experience that builds confidence from beginning to end
• Practical ways to improve conversion without simply increasing your marketing budget

Whether you're welcoming ten guests a week or hundreds, understanding why guests decide to book is one of the most valuable skills a tourism business can develop.
Over the coming weeks, we'll introduce our expert presenters, share more about the topics they'll be covering and provide additional insights into what you can expect from this next chapter of the GFTA Business Blueprint Series.

Save the Date

**Tuesday, July 28**
 

**10:30am CT | 9:30am MT | 8:30am PT | 11:30am ET | 4:30pm GMT**
️ 

**Cost:** Free for GFTA Members and Industry Professionals

Registration will open next week, and we'll be sharing additional details soon.
We hope you'll join us as we continue building the GFTA Business Blueprint Series and exploring another critical stage in the journey toward building a stronger, more profitable tourism business.

We're looking forward to seeing you online!

~ GFTA

Este verano, el Caribe tiene una nueva energía. Una que se mueve al ritmo de los atardeceres frente al mar, de la música que acompaña cada momento y de experiencias creadas para quienes entienden el viaje como una forma de expresión personal.
Leer más United anuncia más vuelos de Washington, D.C. y Houston a Cartagena
United anunció hoy que lanzará un nuevo servicio sin escalas desde el Aeropuerto Intercontinental de Houston (IAH) y el Aeropuerto Internacional Washington Dulles (IAD) a Cartagena, Colombia (CTG) a partir del 17 de diciembre. Estos nuevos vuelos operarán durante todo el año desde ambos centros de conexión, comenzando con cuatro vuelos por semana durante la temporada de invierno. United operará esta ruta con un Boeing 737, y los pasajeros a bordo podrán disfrutar de pantallas individuales en cada asiento con conectividad Bluetooth, compartimentos superiores más grandes con espacio para el equipaje de mano de cada pasajero y próximamente Wi-Fi Starlink gratuito para los miembros de MileagePlus. Lonely Planet nombró a Cartagena como uno de los mejores destinos de viaje de 2026 , destacando su arquitectura española bien conservada, su vibrante escena culinaria y su rica historia. Los vuelos están disponibles para su compra en United.com y la aplicación de United..
Leer más
Oceania Cruises revela su programa de cruceros especializados para 2027Oceania Cruises anunció sus cruceros especiales para 2027, que combinan itinerarios con destinos fascinantes y experiencias personalizadas donde la gastronomía, la cultura y la conexión personal son protagonistas.
Leer másLine de Atenas, el número 1 de los 50 Mejores Bares de Europa 2026
La lista de los 50 Mejores Bares de Europa 2026, patrocinada por Perrier, se dio a conocer esta noche durante una ceremonia de entrega de premios en directo en Ámsterdam. El glamuroso evento celebró la primera edición anual de este nuevo y prestigioso ranking de 50 Best, la organización responsable de la lista de los 50 Mejores Bares del Mundo.
Leer más Bariloche y Buenos Aires lideran búsquedas de los argentinos en Booking.com
Llega uno de los momentos más esperados del año, quizás más por los chicos: las vacaciones de invierno. Este año, el receso escolar se extenderá durante casi un mes debido a que las fechas varían según la provincia: mientras algunas comenzarán el 6 de julio, otras recién lo harán el 20. Esta diferencia en los calendarios escolares genera una temporada invernal más extensa para los destinos turísticos, que podrán recibir visitantes durante un período más prolongado que el habitual y que se extenderá casi todo el mes de julio.
Leer más
La inteligencia artificial transforma el futuro del turismo religioso
La transformación digital está redefiniendo la forma en que millones de viajeros organizan sus desplazamientos por motivos religiosos. La irrupción de herramientas basadas en inteligencia artificial, plataformas digitales especializadas y nuevos sistemas de recomendación está cambiando profundamente la experiencia de planificación y reserva, especialmente entre los viajeros musulmanes, uno de los segmentos turísticos de mayor crecimiento a nivel mundial.Leer más
SKY eleva la experiencia de viaje con el lanzamiento de Economy Premier
La aerolínea del grupo IAG con base en el aeropuerto de Barcelona-El Prat, Level, continúa reduciendo su operativa de cara al próximo invierno. Tras anunciar en marzo que recortaba las frecuencias en cuatro de sus rutas para este verano, ahora directamente elimina dos destinos de su programación: Boston y Los Ángeles (Estados Unidos). Estas conexiones desaparecerán de la red de Level a partir del 25 de octubre.

El histórico Hotel Gunter anuncia su transición oficial a Gunter Hotel, un Tribute Portfolio Hotel, uniéndose a la colección global de hoteles independientes de Marriott Bonvoy, reconocidos por su carácter distintivo, diseño cautivador y profunda conexión con la cultura local. Para conmemorar este hito, el hotel también ha lanzado un paquete especial de habitaciones por tiempo limitado.

El Consejo Internacional de Aeropuertos para América Latina y el Caribe (ACI-LAC) se complace en anunciar la incorporación de Expedia Group Advertising como nuevo World Business Partner (WBP), fortaleciendo la red de aliados estratégicos que apoyan el desarrollo y la innovación de la industria aeroportuaria en la región.Leer más

# The Agency Litmus Test

Before you let anyone touch your ad budget, run them through these 5 questions.

**Question 1 - Do they run their own ads?**

This is the big one. A surprising number of agencies have never spent real money on their own ads - they only spend yours. I'd never take advice from someone who doesn't have skin in the game. Ask them how much of their OWN money they've spent on ads. (For us, it's over $7.7 Million - & those aren't client ads, they're 100% ours.)

**Question 2 - Do they specialize, or do they do a little of everything?**

"We do everything" usually means they master nothing. You want a team with real depth in the channels that matter to you. Video & YouTube Ads are our specialty - it's our background & our expertise. I literally wrote the book on it: [Video Authority](https://www.amazon.com/Video-Authority-Science-Converting-Viewers/dp/B0GDH5ZKV6/ref=sr_1_1?).

**Question 3 - Will they lock you into a long contract?**

Be careful with any agency that needs you to sign a 6 or 12-month contract up front. Ask yourself why they need to trap you in. The best partners are confident enough to earn your business month after month. We're completely month-to-month - no long-term contract - because the pressure should be on us to keep delivering.

**Question 4 - Do they touch your organic content, or only paid?**

Your paid ads & your organic presence feed each other. Most agencies ignore organic completely. The right partner helps you with both. We include 1-on-1 organic content consulting for your YouTube, LinkedIn & TikTok as a bonus - weekly meetings, audits, & custom GPTs that write in your voice.

**Question 5 - Can they actually show you results & reviews?**

Talk is cheap. Look for real proof - documented results, public reviews, recognition you can verify. We've served 3,000+ businesses, earned hundreds of 5-star Trustpilot reviews, & been recognized as an Inc. 5000 fastest-growing company in America.

oh, this one stings a littleLet's talk about brokers, Dave,

**A few weeks ago, we had a new brand join Retail Ready®, after they had spent $36,000 on a broker who brought in TWO accounts with them during their six-month required engagement.**

💸💸💸 That's $6k/month, for six months, with only two new accounts to show for it. 💸💸💸

THIS is exactly why I'm so riled up about not outsourcing your sales to a broker before you've figured it out yourself.

Don't misunderstand me: I see the value in brokers, for sure. But I believe it's so much more affordable for an emerging brand to 

**build the sales strategy YOURSELF instead of paying a broker to trial and error it for you until something sticks.**

And I get the appeal. You're busy. You're pulled in a million directions. Handing off the sales responsibility to someone else feels like a HUGE relief.

But here's the thing I've watched play out over and over again with the brands I've worked with: 

**outsourcing the problem is not the same as solving it.**

****The founders who WIN - the ones who end up in hundreds of stores with strong velocity and reorders coming in - they became sales badasses FIRST.****

They learned how to sell their own product, built the playbook, knew what resonated with wholesale buyers, knew how to handle any objection from a retailer, knew what promotions worked to move product OFF the shelves… and THEN handed it off to someone who could scale what they'd already proven.

**The broker is the accelerator who puts fuel on the fire. The broker is NOT the starting point.**

When you skip the step of owning your own sales, you end up dependent on someone else to figure out what only you can figure out, and that is a position most early-stage brands simply can't afford.

Hit reply and tell me: are you in the "I'll just hire a broker" camp? 

There's no judgement from me, just want to see if this lands, and what other info you need to make a smart decision here!

Talk soon,

Alli

View as a webpage / Share [ https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/DCWASH/bulletins/41b8f1f ]

  
DLCP sign [ https://dlcp.dc.gov/ ]  
*July 2026*
White Space
A Message from the Director

tiffany  [ https://dlcp.dc.gov/jobs ] 

Dear Customers, Colleagues, and Friends,

This year, we gather not just for the Fourth of July, but for the nation’s 250th anniversary [ https://250.dc.gov/ ]. This moment invites us to reflect on the history that shaped our nation, our city and the people who continue to strengthen our neighborhoods every day. As festivities take place throughout the month, I encourage everyone to enjoy the season with care and awareness. Whether you’re attending a community gathering or participating in American 250 activities, please keep safety at the center of your plans.

Our team continues to make steady progress toward the launch of the District’s new unified licensing and registration platform, offering a Business One Stop Solution (BOSS). We expect BOSS to go live on August 10, bringing a clearer and more modern experience to businesses across the District. More updates will be shared on our website and social media as we move closer to launch day.

DLCP’s work supports many businesses and consumers across the District, including restaurants, food service operators, and other licensed establishments that contribute to the city’s vibrancy. Recently, I had the opportunity to attend the 2026 RAMMY Awards hosted by the Restaurant Association of Metropolitan Washington (RAMW) [ https://www.ramw.org/ ]. The event recognized outstanding achievements in the community, and I extend congratulations to all finalists and winners. Click here [ https://washingtonian.com/2026/06/29/here-are-the-restaurant-and-bar-industry-winners-for-dcs-2026-rammy-awards/ ] to view the winners.

This month, we are also sharing a Vending Consumer Advisory [ https://dlcp.dc.gov/release/protect-yourself-tips-safe-purchasing-vendors-national-mall ] for businesses operating in the District. The advisory provides important guidance, including key requirements and helpful reminders for staying compliant. You can find this resource — along with additional updates — in the Consumer Protection section below.

As we move through a busy and eventful July, I want to thank you for your continued partnership. The work we do together strengthens the District’s business community and supports the residents who rely on those businesses. We look forward to the progress ahead and to the momentum this season brings.

 
signature

Tiffany Crowe
Director

________________________________________________________________________

 

Save the Date | Where Industry Leaders Keep Learning

Stay informed on upcoming industry engagement opportunity.


  * *DC Real Estate Commission Course Offerings* — Hosted by the DC Board of Real Estate Commission on July 23–24, 2026, from 8:00 a.m. to 6:15 p.m. at the MLK Jr. Memorial Library, 901 G Street NW, Washington, DC 20001. *NOTE: This event is "Open only to licensed Real Estate Commissioners."* 

________________________________________________________________________

 

DLCP Observance of the Fourth of July

4th of July  

As the District celebrates Independence Day, we hope you enjoy time with family, friends, and community. July brings a moment to reflect on our shared history and the energy that makes the District such a vibrant place to live, work, and visit.

In observance of the holiday, *DLCP will be closed on Friday, July 3*, and will *resume normal operations on Monday, July 6*. We encourage residents and businesses to plan ahead for any licensing or consumer protection needs during this brief closure.

Wishing everyone a safe and enjoyable Fourth of July.

________________________________________________________________________

 

Spotlight | Urban Garden Brewing’s Story of Heritage and Innovation

DLCP Hub [ https://dlcp.dc.gov/blog/urban-garden-brewing-legacy-rooted-culture-craft-and-community ] 

Our newest DLCP Hub [ https://dlcp.dc.gov/blog/urban-garden-brewing-legacy-rooted-culture-craft-and-community ] article features Urban Garden Brewing [ https://www.urbangardenbrewing.com/ ], a woman‑ and Black‑owned craft beer brand in Northwest DC founded by CEO Eamoni Collier. The brewhouse brings together craft beverages, music, art, and neighborhood history — creating a space that reflects the vibrancy and cultural depth of the community. From its Juneteenth opening to the family influences woven throughout the building, Urban Garden Brewing stands as a celebration of Black creativity and the stories that shape the District.

Read the full feature on the DLCP Hub to explore Urban Garden Brewing’s origins and its growing role in the community.

________________________________________________________________________

Banyan Group, una compañía hotelera global independiente, presenta oficialmente Mamula Island by Banyan Tree en su primera temporada completa bajo su marca insignia Banyan Tree, lo que marca el primer resort de Banyan Tree en Europa.
Leer más Hawaiian Airlines presenta en la librea el slogan "Aloha en todo el mundo"
Hawaiian Airlines presentó hoy una librea especial para sus aviones que celebra su pertenencia a la alianza one world con un diseño que rinde homenaje a ʻŌlelo Hawaiʻi, el idioma hawaiano, con la frase «Aloha a puni ka honua», o «Aloha en todo el mundo».
Leer más
Celebrity River Cruises innova las experiencias pre y post crucero en Europa
A partir de hoy, los pasajeros de Celebrity River Cruises podrán descubrir aún más de Europa con las estancias guiadas de varios días «Before and After Stays» (Antes y después del crucero): experiencias integrales cuidadosamente diseñadas. Estas estancias, la innovadora propuesta de Celebrity para experiencias previas y posteriores al crucero, están disponibles antes de que comience o después de que finalice el viaje. Ya se pueden reservar los programas de 2027 en Praga y Budapest, así como los de 2028 que incluyen Ámsterdam y Lausana.
Leer másEl Mediterráneo consolida su liderazgo mundial en cruceros durante 2026
El Mediterráneo reafirma su posición como uno de los grandes referentes de la industria internacional de los cruceros al concentrar durante 2026 el 15% de la capacidad mundial de este mercado. La región se mantiene como el segundo destino más importante del planeta para este tipo de turismo, únicamente por detrás del Caribe, y continúa mostrando una sólida evolución gracias al incremento de pasajeros, la incorporación de nuevos buques de gran capacidad y el creciente interés de las principales navieras por operar en sus rutas.
Leer más
8 de cada 10 argentinos incluiría en lista de deseos ver final de un torneo de fútbol
Para los argentinos, el deporte en general y el fútbol en particular representan mucho más que la posibilidad de asistir a un estadio para presenciar un evento deportivo. El fútbol es pasión, emoción y sentido de pertenencia. En ese contexto, no sorprende que 8 de cada 10 argentinos consideren ver una final de fútbol como una de las experiencias que más desean vivir alguna vez. Este dato refleja que se trata de una aspiración colectiva, profundamente arraigada en la cultura futbolera del país, donde asistir a una definición histórica trasciende lo deportivo para convertirse en un momento inolvidable y significativo.

Central Park Bangkok gana el premio Top Retail Asia
Elevándose sobre el horizonte de Bangkok y redefiniendo la vida urbana en el corazón de la capital tailandesa, Central Park se ha convertido rápidamente en uno de los destinos nuevos más importantes de la ciudad, reuniendo restaurantes de clase mundial, marcas selectas, espacios públicos verdes, experiencias de estilo de vida y una conectividad perfecta en un único proyecto emblemático.
Leer más KLM impulsa su participación en el WorldPride Ámsterdam 2026
La aerolínea del grupo IAG con base en el aeropuerto de Barcelona-El Prat, Level, continúa reduciendo su operativa de cara al próximo invierno. Tras anunciar en marzo que recortaba las frecuencias en cuatro de sus rutas para este verano, ahora directamente elimina dos destinos de su programación: Boston y Los Ángeles (Estados Unidos). Estas conexiones desaparecerán de la red de Level a partir del 25 de octubre.

PAM Hotels continúa fortaleciendo su propuesta para sus aliados comerciales de América Latina con la incorporación de NOBU Hotel Chicago a su programa de incentivos Amplified Rewards; una plataforma creada para reconocer y premiar el trabajo de los agentes de viajes que impulsan las ventas de sus propiedades.

Desde hace décadas, una actividad se repite en la costa de Mazatlán y se ha consolidado como parte de la identidad del puerto. La escena dura apenas unos segundos. Un hombre se coloca sobre una roca a gran altura, observa el mar, estudia las olas y espera. La atención se concentra en él mientras la expectativa crece. July 1, 2026


** Updates from Adams Morgan

** Mayor Bowser Activates Extreme Heat Alert, Urges Residents and Visitors to Plan Ahead for Several Days of Dangerously Hot Temperatures
------------------------------------------------------------

Mayor Muriel Bowser is urging residents and visitors to prepare for a heatwave expected to bring triple-digit temperatures to the District beginning today, Wednesday, July 1, and continuing through the Fourth of July holiday weekend. Due to the anticipated high temperatures and humidity levels, Mayor Bowser has activated an Extreme Heat Alert for Wednesday, July 1 through Sunday, July 5, with the possibility of an extension or revision dependent on the forecast. With outdoor gatherings planned across the region over the holiday weekend, residents and visitors should prepare for prolonged heat exposure, drink lots of water – even before feeling thirsty, take frequent breaks in air-conditioned spaces or the shade, and sign up for free weather updates at alert.dc.gov.

Click here (https://mayor.dc.gov/release/mayor-bowser-activates-extreme-heat-alert-urges-residents-and-visitors-plan-ahead-several) for the full release including tips to stay cool and hotline numbers in the event of an emergency.


** Adams Morgan Movie Nights concludes Thursday with Rocky
------------------------------------------------------------

Adams Morgan Movie Nights (https://adamsmorgan.com/events/signature-events/adams-morgan-movie-nights) is a beloved community tradition that brings neighbors and visitors together under the stars for free outdoor film screenings.

This week, we’ll be showing our rescheduled screening of Rocky, which is celebrating it’s 50th anniversary this year.

Screenings begin after dark (30 minutes after sunset) and are free and open to the public. Guests are encouraged to bring a blanket, pick up a picnic dinner at an Adams Morgan restaurant, and enjoy a relaxing evening in one of D.C.’s most vibrant neighborhoods. Local restaurants offer takeout specials to pair with your movie night, making it the perfect way to support small businesses while enjoying a night out.  Visit our website (https://adamsmorgan.com/events/signature-events/adams-morgan-movie-nights) for a list of takeout specials offered in conjunction with the movies.

In Massachusetts, ADL and our allies stepped in when Jewish public school students faced an alarming pattern of antisemitic bullying and harassment, including from fellow students who identified themselves as “Team Auschwitz” and “Team Hamas.”

READ: 
https://click.adlmail.org/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MjR9AAEAAAAAAPishUvumfcZ28CJqk94n10oclQ9GqRe9qL-OXjVp70x6LVMck99lYhmDv2BuFIrS7SzFmpa6Me6eNkVevOwIfQrwV0-ObM0IS9Wfw 
What happened next? 

2. In NY, It’s Getting Better to Go to Synagogues

https://click.adlmail.org/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MjR9AAEAAAAAAPishUvvzKblmOx4EvNn2Zojg6xchNch36VvNy_hIjtywS5besWbjwCAEh4JGj3uuPHaq06of-BIYvta8ii3v4S5XhIf4kXNIadk-Q 

In New York State, there just weren’t enough protections for people to rely on as they entered synagogues and other houses of worship. Angry protesters were intimidating, shouting, jeering those who just wanted to pray in peace.

READ: 
https://click.adlmail.org/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MjR9AAEAAAAAAPishUvwByWA1HQTfMDLOIApVvbh-NBju4iphXuntT0fZ_yeVNIdHZsmnXGpj0NBCCiKp9cUtS65agN-BgG02RVQSD7GeoXKdD0X8A 
How We Sent a Clear Message, and Were Heard. 

3. Protecting Jewish Communities Around the World

https://click.adlmail.org/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MjR9AAEAAAAAAPishUvxQaUiIR2T2b0X0GU-x6xOG5aVUPu4NJDgK-JUpOY2lAs3e8hLWKzIfzaRv95oaY-Nt_fH0MKVGXGl1Ya823yNGqf0eIxksg 

Our experts monitor dark, ugly corners of the internet. Recently, analysts from the ADL Center on Extremism identified a Telegram user with possible imminent plans to detonate explosives and carry out a mass shooting at two synagogues on Réunion Island (a French territory in the Indian Ocean).

READ: 
https://click.adlmail.org/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MjR9AAEAAAAAAPishUvyAunaX3nYszL2ouE4gwnwMFDVVGFo-Hot4CUNoWjxcE4OOpETigThGzsZwAvpz000SrWrS6BfGcSIRMPatpNhrZAyitNrfw 
How We Raised the Alarm on this Credible Threat 

4. A Shield Against Antisemitic Harassment

https://click.adlmail.org/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MjR9AAEAAAAAAPishUvzBrBuIebXZCQk7yLAHA8aBkof17xP7sAnffekqGAfl0HBcvlha9eCfIiPNh9z9y2WoXo3pOb08yLh_5QfGzfhx99386SzSQ 

Judges, attorneys and others in Connecticut faced severe harassment and threats on a virulently antisemitic website run by a man angry at the “JEW-dicial branch.” The victims needed stronger legislation against online harassment, and support in working with law enforcement. That’s where we stepped in.

VIEW: 
https://click.adlmail.org/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MjR9AAEAAAAAAPishUv08tLorttEenjgXwG_o6Co-ihVL1AamP-9ru1kmA_JlYuNfJgm06Ztjlx0jk3vk0fhya3kiWR5ZBsaW0-mFF_sWLysdQFiUA
