body: Email from Chef Luigi Diotaiuti Hi, just a reminder that you're receiving this email because you have expressed an interest in Chef Luigi Diotaiuti. EU Residents, Per GDPR, you may unsubscribe via the link below at any time. Please see the Privacy Policy at http://www.luigidiotaiuti.com/privacy-policy/ for more info.  You may unsubscribe if you no longer wish to receive our emails. Read the articles from Il Messaggero and watch the video from RAI News here. Watch the Luigi Diotaiuti Foundation’s docufilm, “Transumanza: Un’antica pratica con valori moderni” - “Transumanza: an ancient practice with modern values” trailer here: From Al Tiramisu.... Tune in to ABC 7's Good Morning Washington at 10:00 AM on July 13th to watch me prepare some of our favorites on air! Take advantage of the warm weather and the chance to eat inside or outside at lunch and happy hour (Mon-Fri) and dinner (7 days a week)! Reserve your table here. In Honor of Summer.... Semifreddo al croccantino/ Praline Semifreddo *From The Al Tiramisu Restaurant Cookbook Semifreddo is a type of Italian semi-frozen dessert with the smooth, creamy texture of frozen mousse. I first made this dessert as chef of the elegant Ristorante Gourmet in Montecatini, where I left a piece of my heart. “Il Gourmet” as everyone calls the place—still going strong today—was like a laboratory of culinary ideas where we worked as a close team and stimulated each other’s imaginations. Its owner Brunello Sichi and I often traveled around Tuscany visiting wine producers in the Chianti Classico area. It was his enthusiasm that instilled in me a desire to learn more about wine and the art of pairing food and wines in ways that enhance both. For this semifreddo, for example, I suggest Moscato di Noto, a fine, young, perfumed Sicilian dessert wine. Many varieties of semifreddo have appeared on the Al Tiramisu menu but this is the one that clients always remember. I have nicknamed it the “smile catcher” because when guests taste it they inevitably break out into a huge smile, while making very pleasant “mmmm” sounds. Note that since this dessert must set in the refrigerator for 6 to 24 hours, it’s a perfect make-ahead dish. Garnishes are strictly optional. Serves 8 Ingredients For the praline 1 ounce whole raw hazelnuts 1 ounce whole raw almonds 1/3 cup granulated sugar 1 teaspoon vegetable or canola oil for greasing, if desired For the semifreddo 6 large egg yolks* 1/2 cup granulated sugar 1/2 cup confectioner’s sugar 1 cup whipping cream 1 teaspoon vanilla 8 chopped Amaretti di Saronno cookies (See Where to Buy Guide.) 8 Chocolate Designs (page 354 ), for garnish, optional 1 recipe Strawberry Coulis (page 352 ), for garnish, optional Preparation For the praline Place hazelnuts, almonds, ¼ cup water, and sugar in a small pan over medium heat and stir well until sugar is absorbed. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and cook uncovered, without stirring, swirling pan until the mixture turns deep golden and caramelizes. Wearing oven mitts carefully pour the mixture onto a marble slab or a metal tray greased with oil. (Care is required since the caramel mixture is very hot.) Let the mixture cool. When the praline is completely cool, chop it finely with a knife and place the pieces into a container. For the semifreddo In a medium bowl combine the egg yolks and sugar. Beat with an electric mixer on medium speed for 5 minutes or until the mixture is creamy and lemon colored. Add confectioner’s sugar and whipping cream and continue mixing until it becomes thick and mousse-like but not too stiff. Add vanilla, praline pieces (reserving 8 small pieces for garnish), and crumbled Amaretti cookies. Transfer the mixture into ramekins or serving cups that are about 3-inches wide and 1 1/3-inches tall. Chill in the refrigerator for 6 to 24 hours. Serve chilled. If desired, garnish by placing a Chocolate Design in the center of the semifreddo. Also optional: place the Strawberry Coulis into a squeeze bottle with a small tip, and squeezing make 6 round designs on the side of each plate in gradually increasing sizes, starting with a design the size of a dime, and ending up with one the size of a silver dollar. Italian Cooking Primer Amaretti are light, airy, and wonderfully chewy almond macaroons from Italy. The centuries-old company Lazzaroni of Saronno sells the cookies in iconic red tins full of pretty paper packets with two amaretti back to back. Amaretti are often crumbled into Italian desserts, in the same way that Americans might use bits of gingersnaps or Oreos. *Note that consuming raw or undercooked meats, poultry, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of food-borne illness. Si no puede visualizar bien este boletín haga clic AQUÍLima, miercoles 01 de julio del 2026 Director General: Carlos Bernuy  Dos hoteles LBA Hospitality reciben el premio Marriott Chairman's Award
LBA Hospitality se enorgullece en anunciar que dos de sus propiedades administradas, Renaissance St. Augustine Historic Downtown en St. Augustine, Florida, y Delta Hotels by Marriott Ashland Downtown en Ashland, Kentucky, han recibido el prestigioso premio Marriott Chairman’s Award, uno de los honores más respetados que se otorgan dentro del sistema Marriott.

Delta refuerza su compromiso con Los Ángeles con la inauguración de la Fase 1 de su segundo Delta One Lounge en el Aeropuerto Internacional de Los Ángeles (LAX): un espacio íntimo de 4.000 pies cuadrados con capacidad para 75 personas, ubicado en el entresuelo de la Terminal 2. Está previsto que la Fase 2 de la renovación de este segundo Lounge finalice en 2028.

Ámsterdam prohíbe publicidad de viajes porque contaminan
Si usted viaja a Ámsterdam, las paradas de autobús, tranvía o estaciones de tren no tienen imágenes ni de cruceros, ni de aviones, ni de paradisíacas playas del Caribe. Han sido prohibidas por la municipalidad porque “promocionan productos con altas emisiones de carbono”. El acceso a esta misma publicidad en televisión o en Internet, en cambio, no se ha podido paralizar.

Civitatis, la plataforma líder en la distribución online de visitas guiadas, excursiones y actividades en español, inglés y portugués en todo el mundo, anuncia el lanzamiento de Civitatis Pro, la nueva identidad que agrupa e impulsa su propuesta para los profesionales del turismo.
Leer más Sanya regresa a la Fórmula E como sede del inicio de la temporada asiática 2027

La carrera se celebrará el 17 de abril de 2027, dando inicio a la etapa asiática de la nueva temporada. La ciudad acogerá la primera carrera de Fórmula E de la era GEN4 en suelo chino. Con un calendario de 21 carreras en 13 ciudades de todo el mundo, el más extenso de la historia de la serie, este evento histórico trae la nueva generación de carreras eléctricas al singular circuito urbano costero de Sanya.
Leer más
«Travel maxxing»: la tendencia de los viajes multidestino
Viajar está dejando de ser una pausa en la rutina para convertirse en una forma de vivirla. Cada vez más personas están replanteando la manera en la que construyen sus viajes, alejándose de la idea de un solo destino y optando por trayectos que combinan varias ciudades, experiencias y momentos en un mismo recorrido. No se trata necesariamente de viajar más lejos, sino de aprovechar mejor cada desplazamiento.

La aerolínea del grupo IAG con base en el aeropuerto de Barcelona-El Prat, Level, continúa reduciendo su operativa de cara al próximo invierno. Tras anunciar en marzo que recortaba las frecuencias en cuatro de sus rutas para este verano, ahora directamente elimina dos destinos de su programación: Boston y Los Ángeles (Estados Unidos). Estas conexiones desaparecerán de la red de Level a partir del 25 de octubre.

For a lot of advertisers, the honest answer is: everything would shake. Because they've built their entire lead flow on ONE platform. Usually Meta.

I want to show you a better way - the same approach we use to run ads for our clients & the way I've structured my own marketing after spending $7.7 Million on ads. I call it The Compounding Ad Stack.

# The Compounding Ad Stack

Most people think about ad platforms as an either/or. "Should I run YouTube OR Meta?" The advertisers who scale think about it completely differently. They run a Stack - where each platform does a specific job & feeds the next. Here's how the layers work together.

**Layer 1 - YouTube (Authority & Arbitrage)**

This is our bread & butter, & it's where I'd start. YouTube gives you something no other platform does at the same scale: time. You get to deliver a longer, more persuasive message & build real authority before you ever ask for the sale. & right now the attention is still underpriced compared to Meta - what I call YouTube arbitrage. You're reaching high-intent buyers for less.

**Layer 2 - Meta (Volume & Reach)**

Meta is incredible for volume & for staying in front of people. Once YouTube has introduced you & built trust, Meta keeps you everywhere your prospect scrolls - Facebook & Instagram - reinforcing your message & pulling in additional reach you won't get from YouTube alone.

**Layer 3 - Google Search (Intent Capture)**

When your YouTube & Meta ads do their job, people go search for you. They Google your name, your brand, your offer. Google Search ads let you capture that piping-hot, high-intent traffic at the exact moment they're looking - instead of handing it to a competitor running ads on your name.

**Layer 4 - ChatGPT Ads (The New Frontier)**

This is the one almost nobody is running yet - which is exactly why it's such an opportunity. As AI search becomes how people find answers, ChatGPT Ads are opening up a brand-new channel to reach buyers. & that brings me to something I want you to really understand...

# The First-Mover Math on ChatGPT Ads

Every new ad platform follows the same pattern. Early on, there's very little competition, attention is cheap, & the early movers get outsized results. Then everyone floods in, costs rise, & it normalizes.

I've lived this. I was early to YouTube Ads back when almost no one was running them - & that head start is a huge part of why we're where we are today.

ChatGPT Ads are at that exact early stage right now. The businesses that get in early & learn the platform while it's wide open will have a real advantage over the ones who wait until it's crowded. That's First-Mover Math - & the window is open today.

Here's the catch with running all four layers...

A Message From The Director

Brian Hanlon 

At DOB, there are no lazy days of summer; this season is all about progress. Construction projects move forward, neighborhoods come alive, and residents take on everything from home improvements to new business ventures. Throughout it all, DOB remains committed to keeping the built environment safe, green, and moving. 

This month, we’re launching a new chapter in the future of DC’s construction codes with the start of our Construction Code Development Listening Sessions. I encourage you to attend and share your feedback [ https://forms.office.com/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=8Unkj5SLt0-ZBm-Tnagtc3le1U1vgD5FvgxoQ6i1ZTdUQzdTOFlXWjRNR0VCTEJDQkVZRlRVQjdFMC4u ] as DOB helps shape the next generation of building code regulations for the District. 

Now that outdoor dining is in full swing I’m pleased to announce that streateries have been added to our Instant Permits program! Coupled with recent program expansions of residential solar installations and window replacements, this shows we’re finding new ways to streamline permitting while maintaining the high standards that protect our communities. 

A new lawsuit brought by the Office of the Attorney General (OAG) against the owners of two apartment buildings in Ward 4 demonstrates how we continue to leverage our partnership to hold landlords accountable for poor housing conditions. To view our efforts over a longer timeframe, I encourage you to explore our Fiscal Year 2025 Annual Enforcement Report, which reflects Team DOB’s commitment to accountability, transparency, and customer service. It also highlights the progress we’ve made to strengthen enforcement and protect residents, businesses, and visitors across all eight wards. 

Thank you for staying engaged with DOB and for partnering with us to build a stronger, safer District. I hope you have a wonderful summer, and I look forward to continuing our work together in the months ahead. 

Onward,

 
Director Hanlon Signature

Brian J. Hanlon, AIA LEED AP®
Director

________________________________________________________________________

 

Help Shape the Future of DC’s Construction Codes 
constrcut 

* *The future of DC’s construction codes is being written, and we want to hear from you. 

As the District’s new lead agency for construction code development, DOB is guiding the next generation of regulations to better reflect today’s safety standards, emerging technologies, energy efficiency goals, and the needs of our growing city. Through a series of virtual public listening sessions, residents, property owners, contractors, architects, engineers, developers, and other stakeholders are invited to share their experiences and help shape future code updates. 

Thank you to everyone who joined us for our first listening session on June 25, covering property maintenance, swimming pool, and spa codes. The conversation continues on Thursday, July 9, with a discussion focused on building and existing building codes. Whether you work in the industry or simply want to help shape the future of the built environment in the District, your perspective matters. 

Learn more, and view the full listening session schedule. 

*MORE ON THE CODE DEV PROCESS HERE* [ https://dob.dc.gov/page/construction-code-development ]  

________________________________________________________________________

 

Fiscal Year 2025 Enforcement Report Highlights Progress in Building Safety 

fiscalyear

Workplace trends     Friction    Utah is the first
state to let AI renew prescriptions independently     AI is
moving into the doctor's office. Utah launched a pilot program
allowing an AI service to renew patient prescriptions without a
physician, a first for any US state. It seems to be working, as
doctors who review decisions agree with the AI 91% of the time.
The program is part of a growing national debate over how far AI
should go in healthcare, with some states exploring new clinical
licenses for autonomous AI services, while others move to block
AI from doing so altogether, according to the Wall Street
Journal.     Elevation    Entry-level roles exposed to AI are 7x
more likely to require senior skills     AI isn't eliminating
junior roles. It's transforming them. Employers across 27
countries are now expecting entry-level candidates to demonstrate
leadership, strategic decision-making, and stakeholder management
skills that once took years on the job to develop. These
expectations are being added on top of existing ones, not
replacing them, leaving educators and employers to work out how
to keep pace, according to PwC's 2026 Global AI Jobs Barometer.
Blindspot    Half of C-suite leaders lack visibility into how AI
is reshaping their own workforce     Most executives are moving
faster with AI implementation than they can measure, and many are
aware of this gap. A LinkedIn survey of 1,252 C-suite leaders
across the US, UK, and India found that 50% lack clear visibility
into the roles and skills their organizations will need as AI
matures, while 78% say they are advancing AI adoption faster than
they can effectively track. The companies navigating it best are
those where leaders are genuine users of the tools themselves,
not just advocates for the strategy, according to LinkedIn's
research.     Shift    AI is influencing how dealmakers assess
company acquisitions     Private equity firms are now using AI to
rapidly build working replicas of software companies they are
considering acquiring, testing whether the technology is actually
hard to reproduce before committing to a deal. These drastic
measures come as private equity dealmaking in tech collapsed by
69% in early 2026, with buyers growing reluctant to pay for
software that AI could simply recreate, according to the
Financial Times.    Counterpoint    Jeff Bezos says AI will
create a labor shortage, not unemployment     Most headlines
about AI focus on job losses, but Jeff Bezos disagrees. Speaking
at the VivaTech conference in Paris, the Amazon founder argued AI
will generate more jobs than there are people to fill them,
predicting a labor shortage rather than mass unemployment. His
view puts him at odds with a Reuters/Ipsos poll finding that half
of Americans fear AI will put them or someone in their household
out of work, and with Goldman Sachs data estimating that AI is
eliminating roughly 16,000 US jobs per month.

The AI era demands management skills from
everyone    By monday.com 
( https://clicks.mail.monday.com/f/a/Rl0Ua8iA95FVtbbERXSnCA~~/AAQRxRA~/nItNfB0UdZCHBEtdtncOvZFfoSwf9oFRXXBlABAg9aE4I_oILrHGzJGHJywHqFTdWC0Fvc5_zdRTjEwdiwI383JwZVp1kBU0vicWkuSC2k1ids3DfPY8izESxEZapbDAgFCP2VAm2whB29t0ivdj-uAKwVo8JsOgvtBqIvXgb8n0LdjUyy_5TvMUzUzzmiEZqp2sNL7NmNCD8v9beg379PnCsD3spyPgO8f59yTWOJc~ )

expectations, delegating work, and reviewing results have long
been associated with managers. But as AI becomes a bigger part of

[Producer highlight](https://sf.vervewine.com/products/adrien-renoir-le-terroir-extra-brut-champagne-nv)

For Grower-Geeks: Adrien Renoir Is One of Champagne's Most Exciting Young Growers, and his 'Le Terroir' Grand Cru Is a Vinous, 100% Barrel Fermented Expression Worth Seeking Out

"The NV Le Terroir, a blend of equal parts Pinot Noir and Chardonnay from Verzy is a fine introduction to this range. Bright, sculpted, and airy Le Terroir has a lot to offer. Dried citrus peel, chamomile, crushed flowers, and a hint of spice all take shape in a delicate Champagne endowed with notable character."  - Antonio Galloni, Vinous​

Rising star Adrien Renoir took over his family's five-hectare domaine in Verzy from his father in stages, assuming full control around 2016 and bottling exclusively under his own name starting in 2019. The Estate's vines  (100% Grand Cru, all massale selection plantings from 1961 and 1971) sit on the chalky, northern-facing slopes of the Montagne de Reims. Farming has been organic since 2020, with biodynamic treatments layered in.

The story begins with a father-son disagreement. When Adrien pushed to convert the family vineyards to organic and biodynamic farming, his father, Vincent, was convinced it simply could not be done this far north in Champagne. Adrien proceeded anyway, one parcel at a time, until the entire estate received organic certification. He then turned his attention to the cellar, moving completely away from stainless steel in favor of neutral oak barrels and large foudres for fermentation and aging. Reserve wines rest in foudre before joining the final blend at roughly 20%. The resulting wines are fermented with native yeasts, aged on the lees for a minimum of 24 months in bottle, and disgorged with a dosage so low it barely registers. This is Champagne made with purpose.

Le Terroir is the estate's signature non-vintage cuvée and the clearest expression of everything Adrien has built: a 50/50 blend of Pinot Noir and Chardonnay delivers genuine Grand Cru presence with concentration, structure, minerality, and precision. The mousse is fine and persistent. The acidity cuts clean. There is a depth here that separates it decisively from most non-vintage Champagne at any price, and certainly at this one.

Allocations to the United States remain extremely limited. We were fortunate to secure a small parcel, and it will not last. This is the kind of wine that top sommeliers purchase quietly and do not broadcast. We are happy to broadcast it for them.

NV Adrien Renoir 'Le Terroir' Extra Brut Champagne$99.00 Regular $89.99 Special* Verve Wine Team: “This is grower Champagne for people who want to taste the work in the glass, and one of the most exciting bottlings in the shop right now. Pours a deep, vinous gold (a tell, before you even taste it, that this spent considerable time in oak.) The nose is generous and a little wild: Meyer lemon and pastry cream up front, with dried flowers, toasted shortbread, and a faint nuttiness. On the palate, it's powerful and textural rather than racy, with a broad, almost chewy mid-palate, orchard fruit folded into baking spice, and a chalky grip on the finish that anchors the richness. The mousse is fine but restrained, more about lift than fizz, which suits a wine this serious. Drink or hold." ​Kristaps Karklins, Robert Parker:"Sourced from 25 small plots of vines spread across the village of Verzy, Renoir's latest NV Verzy Grand Cru Le Terroir (2021 base) is a blend of equal parts Chardonnay and Pinot Noir. Based on the 2021 vintage and complemented by 20% reserve wines from 2020, it was disgorged in February 2024 with a dosage of 0.8 grams per liter. Aromas of crisp pear, orange zest and white flowers waft from the glass. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, bright and tensile, with an incisive spine of acidity reflecting both the cool vintage and the northern slopes, concluding with a long, mineral finish."​

[Producer highlight](https://ny.vervewine.com/products/terlano-vorberg-pinot-bianco-riserva-2022)

New Release. Northern Italy’s Great White Producer Delivers “Liquid Magic” and "Desert Island Pick" The Age-Worthy Mountain White Impresses Today and Remains an Under-the-Radar Value

"This wine is liquid magic... The Cantina Terlano Alto Adige Terlano Pinot Bianco Riserva Vorberg [2017] is one of the most impressive expressions of the grape to emerge from this mountainous region in the far north of Italy… If I were stranded on a deserted island with just one bottle of wine of my choosing, it very well might be Cantina Terlano's Vorberg [2018]." - Monica Larner, Robert Parker’s Wine Advocate
 How do you surpass the "liquid magic" that was delivered with the 2017, 2018, and 2021 Terlano Pinot Blanc Riserva Vorberg with thousands of bottles sold? How about the new release of the 2022 Terlano Pinot Blanc Riserva Vorberg! We are going to have to agree with this old quote from Monica above, as 2017 was "liquid magic" and 2018 is absolutely a "desert island pick." As you know by now, we taste thousands of wines each year, and this is just one of those whites that makes you want to stand up and scream about it – it's that good once again!​

Yes, the Terlano Pinot Blanc Riserva Vorberg is known for its age-ability, but who wants to wait? This is awesome today. It is the perfect alternative to Chardonnay and remains one of the great pairing wines for northern Italy's rich pasta dishes and beyond. Best of all, this is one of Italy's benchmark wines, and it is available under $50! It is approachable in the pocket and on the palate with the ability to age another two decades.

The reality is, when we think of Italy's great whites, we often gravitate to Burgundian-influenced wines of Gaia & Rey, Cervaro, and Batar; the esoteric whites of Gravner, Radikon, and Bea, as well as the ground-breaking whites of Fiorano. However, there are more selections to explore with Italy's treasure trove of varietals and regions. One that is simply not talked about enough is the age-worthy Pinot Bianco of Terlano and Alto Adige. It might just be "Italy's best white wine producer," region, and varietal you may not know or have had the opportunity to taste often enough.

Cantina Terlano is a benchmark producer for Alto Adige. The historic cooperative takes the name of the town in which it resides and dates all the way back to 1892. While the estate does produce some noteworthy blends such as the phantom-like Terlaner I Grand Cuvee, it is the flagship Cantina Terlano Pinot Blanc Riserva Vorberg that is easily the pinnacle expression of Pinot Blanc and the region. The prized bottle is produced from Pinot Bianco, also known as Weissburgunder in this part of the world, and is grown at an impressive altitude of 400 to 650 meters on heavy volcanic soils rich in crystals and minerality. In fact, "Vorberg" translates to "in front of the mountain," and refers to the awesome altitudes that provide this generous grape with additional acidity. 

Well, we just tasted the inspiring 2022 Cantina Terlano "Vorberg" Pinot Bianco Riserva release this past weekend, and yes, the wine is magic once again - with a little more verve and minerality than in the past – despite the warmer vintage! Sure, the wine can age, but save the aging to Cantina Terlano and the estate's library releases. Enjoy this perfect Summer white today with a pasta dish over some fun conversation with your family.​

FEATURED WINE: Liquid Magic from Terlano and Italy's Iconic White

https://ny.vervewine.com/products/terlano-vorberg-pinot-bianco-riserva-2022

Ancient winemaking tradition, privileged positioning and microclimates, an infusion of Roman, German, and Austrian heritage: Alto Adige may just be Italy's best-kept secret. In the Northernmost province of Italy lies the cultural crossroads of Trentino-Alto Adige. It is here in this mountainous zone, squeezed between the borders of Austria and Switzerland, that one of Europe's oldest wine-growing sites resides (predating 15 BC). This land has passed from the Romans to the Austro-Hungarian Empire and back to the Italians, absorbing a potpourri of tradition and technique in its viticulture along the way. The people of Alto Adige carry on a unique mélange of cultures; though clearly filled with Italian ways, they still speak German, and German names and quality classifications are very important to the region's wine producers.

Bookmark and Share [ https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/DCWASH/bulletins/41e5b66?reqfrom=share ] As we continue our country’s commemoration of its 250th birthday, the Bowser Administration invites you to celebrate Independence Day by joining us at two community events taking place here in DC on Saturday, July 4. Newsletter Infotur Latam 30-06-26
Si no puede visualizar bien este boletín haga clic AQUÍLima, martes 30 de junio del 2026 Director General: Carlos Bernuy  Meliá firma su primer hotel en Corfú
Meliá suma su séptimo hotel en Grecia con la firma de un nuevo hotel en Corfú, el primero de la cadena en la isla. El establecimiento, propiedad de Concord Group y actualmente conocido como St Georges Bay Country Club & Spa, abrirá este verano bajo la enseña de Affiliated by Meliá.
Leer más Air Europa abrirá una ruta inédita en ColombiaAir Europa reforzará próximamente su presencia en Colombia, donde ya opera vuelos directos desde Madrid a Medellín y Bogotá. El plan de la aerolínea española pasa por abrir una nueva ruta en Barranquilla, en el norte del país.
Leer más
Turismo gastronómico: espacios temáticos se consolidan como nuevos atractivos
La búsqueda de experiencias auténticas y memorables está transformando la manera en que turistas nacionales e internacionales disfrutan de la gastronomía. Hoy, los viajeros ya no solo buscan degustar platos y bebidas, sino también conectar con historias, tradiciones y espacios que les permitan vivir una experiencia cultural completa. En este contexto, los restaurantes y bares temáticos vienen consolidándose como una de las principales tendencias dentro del turismo gastronómico en el Perú..
Leer más¿Próxima parada, Escocia?
Mientras otros planean su ruta hacia la final, Escocia planea la ruta de regreso a casa, ¡pero no es momento para la decepción! Los vibrantes aficionados escoceses, el Ejército Tartán, se han ganado el corazón y la mente de todo Estados Unidos gracias a su reconocida calidez, humor y contagioso espíritu festivo. Ahora es el momento de seguirlos a casa para descubrir aún más.
Leer más Temporada de alta demanda: ¿estás listo para el viaje?
Mundiales, maratones, festivales, carnavales y conciertos internacionales suelen movilizar a miles de personas hacia un mismo destino en cuestión de días. Esta concentración de viajeros no solo transforma la experiencia en las ciudades anfitrionas, sino que también incrementa la demanda de servicios como transporte, alojamiento y atención médica.
Leer más
Gentrificación en Colombia: un problema estructural más allá del turismo
La transformación de los espacios urbanos es inevitable. Nada puede permanecer estático para siempre. Es una tendencia histórica. Según la CEPAL, mientras la población urbana de 1950 en América Latina era solo el 41%, para 2010 ya iba en un 80%, y para 2050 será del 90%.
Leer más Ryanair modifica su política de asignación de asientos para familias
La aerolínea de bajo coste Ryanair ha confirmado una modificación en su histórica política de asignación de asientos para familias con el objetivo de alinearse con los estándares de la industria en Europa. Este ajuste responde directamente a las presiones de los organismos reguladores del continente, particularmente de la Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) del Reino Unido, a pesar de que la directiva de la compañía ha calificado la medida como un retroceso para los consumidores.
Leer más Accor presenta su estrategia de sostenibilidad para 2026-2030
En diversos sectores, incluido el hotelero, la sostenibilidad ha dejado de ser una agenda paralela para convertirse en parte integral de la forma en que se gestionan los negocios, se toman decisiones y se diseñan experiencias. Para Accor, líder mundial en hospitalidad, este compromiso a largo plazo se ha incorporado al día a día de sus hoteles, con foco en la medición, la reducción de impactos ambientales, la innovación y la generación de valor compartido para huéspedes, colaboradores y comunidades.
Leer más
Omán impulsa un turismo exclusivo con visión sostenible futura
El Sultanato de Omán está consolidando su posición como uno de los destinos más atractivos para el turismo de alta gama a nivel internacional gracias a una estrategia que combina exclusividad, sostenibilidad y autenticidad cultural. En un contexto en el que los viajeros con mayor poder adquisitivo buscan experiencias diferenciadas y alejadas de la masificación, el país árabe se presenta como una alternativa singular dentro de la región del Golfo, impulsando una nueva etapa de crecimiento respaldada por una importante inversión hotelera prevista para los próximos años.
Leer más Crecen ingresos por turismo internacional en Colombia
El turismo internacional se consolida hoy en Colombia como una importante fuente generadora de divisas para el país que percibió un ingreso de 13 mil 498 millones de dólares el pasado año por ese concepto.
Leer másIndonesia impulsa turismo interno con campaña de compras
El Gobierno de Indonesia lanzó hoy una campaña nacional de compras durante las vacaciones escolares con el objetivo de estimular el consumo interno y fortalecer el turismo doméstico.Leer más

subject: What WCAG 2.2 actually requires from your event platform?
body:
See which accessibility features your platform should support.

[Laptop displaying live captions and accessibility icons for captions, audio, keyboard, and screen reader support. Build Events Everyone Can Access.]

Hi Dave,

WCAG 2.2 is the current international standard for web accessibility. Most event planners have heard the acronym. But what does it actually mean, and what does it ask of the people designing the experiences, not just the technology behind them?

Here's what planners own.

- Captions must be on by default and accurate.
"Available upon request" doesn't meet the standard, and auto-generated captions without human review don't either. Both are decisions made during platform setup and briefing the production team. Budget for reviewed captions the same way you budget for AV.
- On-demand content needs captions before it goes live — not after.
Session recordings posted without captions are a WCAG failure and, for public entities, a legal one. Adding them retroactively costs more and takes longer. Make captions a production deliverable with a delivery date, not a follow-up task.
- Your platform vendor's accessibility is your legal responsibility, too.
Under ADA Title II, if your event platform is used by a state or local government entity, the accessibility of that platform falls on the organizer — not just the vendor. The deadline for larger public entities is April 26, 2027. That's closer than it sounds.
- Ask for a VPAT before you sign.
A Voluntary Product Accessibility Template maps a platform's features against each WCAG criterion. If your vendor can't produce one, that's your answer. Make it a standard part of your procurement process — the same way you'd ask for insurance certificates or SLAs.

We put together a 25-point checklist of what to look for in an accessible event platform — written for planners, not developers.

— The Performedia Team

June 2026

Letter from the Deputy Mayor

Deputy Mayor Nina Albert [ https://mayor.dc.gov/page/mayor-bowser-presents-grow-dc-our-fiscal-year-2026-budget ] 

As Summer comes into full swing, DMPED continues to advance priorities that support economic growth for our businesses and residents. DC has already hosted a number of incredible events this month, including Capital Pride, World Cup watch parties, the Wizards first pick in the NBA draft, the re-opening of the National Geographic Museum, and Eat250, where 200 DC local restaurants participated.

As we get ready for the July 4th weekend, we invite you to enjoy the DC250 events our city has planned. From museums that bring our nation’s history to life, to local activities throughout the city, there is a lot to explore. Visit DC250.us to learn more!

Beyond the fireworks and festivities, this Independence Day is also a time to reflect on the societal values and aspirations contained within the Declaration of Independence. In addition to its political ideals, the Declaration of Independence sought to address the American colonies’ core grievances, which were deeply economic. By celebrating our foundational freedom to work, trade, and prosper, we are reminded that our strength as a community is achieved by building our collective prosperity.

Enjoy everything DC has to offer this Independence Day – and stay hydrated!

Sincerely,

Deputy Mayor Nina Albert

 

________________________________________________________________________

 
 
 
 
 

DC is Open for Business 
 
 
 
 

Washington, DC Retail Strategic Plan
Retail Strategic Plan Vibrant Commercial Corridor with cars lining the street and people walking 

Mayor Bowser, DMPED, and the Washington DC Economic Partnership (WDCEP) recently released a new Retail Strategic Plan – a comprehensive study and action framework designed to strengthen Washington, DC’s retail sector and position the District for long- term growth in the current economy.

The new study finds that the District’s retail market remains strong, supported by nearly 700,000 residents, 743,000 jobs, and more than 27 million annual visitors. Together, that demand generates an estimated $14 billion spending base citywide. At the same time, the report notes that retail performance varies significantly by submarket, with residentially anchored corridors outperforming office-dependent areas that have been impacted by reduced daytime foot traffic. 

Key recommendations outlined in the Retail Strategic Plan include to:


  * Promote the attraction of priority retail categories, including food and beverage, fitness and wellness, and entertainment, while continuing to support other retail categories that are important neighborhood amenities. 
  * Implement tenant attraction strategies specific to key retail submarkets. 
  * Continue to make it easier for retailers to open and expand in DC by streamlining permitting, licensing, and interagency coordination.  

Read the Executive Summary of the Retail Strategic Plan [ https://wdcep.com/news/washington-dc-retail-strategic-plan/ ].  

________________________________________________________________________

 
 
 
 
 

Opportunities across the District
 
 
 
 

DMPED Grant Opportunities

Washington, DC is home to more than 75,000 small businesses, over 98% of all businesses in the District, power our economy and employ nearly half of our private sector workforce.  Under Mayor Bowser’s leadership, the District has continued to invest in an inclusive business environment that supports entrepreneurs at every stage. DMPED currently has a few grant programs accepting applications, supporting small businesses and community vitality across DC. Key open opportunities include:


  * *Rhode Island Avenue Support Grant* [ https://www.obviouslydc.com/business-funding-opportunities ] – Up to *$350,000* to offset rent or tenant improvements for long‑term leases in Rhode Island Avenue NE corridor. Applications close *Friday, July 3, 2026.* 
  * *Vitality Fund* [ https://www.obviouslydc.com/business-funding-opportunities ] – Incentive for large companies relocating or expanding in DC. Applications close *Wednesday, July 15, 2026, at 4 PM*. 
  * *Commercial Property Acquisition Fund* [ https://www.obviouslydc.com/business-funding-opportunities ] – Up to *$300,000* for DC businesses purchasing commercial property. Rolling applications until funds are allocated.

Este verano, Four Seasons Hotel Madrid invita a descubrir la capital a través de una selección de experiencias que combinan gastronomía, bienestar y alojamiento en pleno centro de la ciudad. Desde el regreso de Dani’s Cinema Club y la llegada de Las Hamburguesas de Dani a la azotea de Dani Brasserie, hasta las propuestas wellness de su spa y los espacios para disfrutar del buen tiempo, el hotel se consolida como uno de los destinos imprescindibles de la temporada.
Leer más Air Canada da inicio a los viajes de verano celebrando lo mejor de Canadá
Air Canada espera recibir a más de un millón de pasajeros a bordo durante esta semana, dando inicio a la temporada de verano con un programa completo de vuelos por todo Canadá. Con más de 50 destinos en todo el país, la aerolínea celebra lo mejor de Canadá de costa a costa y más allá, conectando a los canadienses con las personas, los lugares y las experiencias que hacen de Canadá un lugar muy especial para todos nosotros. Con motivo del Día de Canadá, los pasajeros pueden esperar detalles especiales durante su experiencia de viaje que reflejan el orgullo que siente cada empleado como la aerolínea de bandera de nuestro país..
Leer más
Royal Caribbean se asocia con la maravillosa Fundación Infantil de Roald Dahl
Royal Caribbean anunció hoy una nueva alianza con la Fundación Benéfica Infantil de Roald Dahl, conocida como «The Marvellous Children’s Charity», antes del debut europeo del Legend of the Seas en julio de 2026. El Legend, que presenta el exitoso musical de Broadway «Charlie y la fábrica de chocolate » de Roald Dahl , dará vida a esta alianza a bordo, ofreciendo a los pasajeros maneras significativas de apoyar a la fundación y recaudar fondos vitales para las enfermeras especializadas de Roald Dahl que atienden a más de 50.000 niños gravemente enfermos y sus familias en todo el Reino Unido.
Leer másTTW destaca los 100 mejores hoteles de lujo del mundo para 2026
Travel And Tour World (TTW) presentó hoy su lista de los 100 mejores hoteles de lujo del mundo para 2026 , un prestigioso ranking mundial que reconoce propiedades excepcionales que redefinen la hospitalidad moderna. Seleccionada por los expertos editoriales de TTW, esta lista destaca el lujo excepcional, el servicio personalizado, el diseño icónico, el bienestar, la alta gastronomía, la sostenibilidad, la privacidad y las experiencias auténticas, inspirando a los viajeros más exigentes a explorar los mejores destinos del mundo.
Leer más
Machu Picchu aumenta capacidad para atender mayor demanda
Machu Picchu se prepara para recibir un mayor número de visitantes durante la temporada alta tras la decisión de ampliar su capacidad diaria de acceso. La medida busca responder al creciente interés turístico por uno de los destinos patrimoniales más importantes del mundo, al tiempo que intenta mantener un equilibrio entre el desarrollo económico asociado al turismo y la preservación de un sitio arqueológico considerado símbolo de Perú y referente cultural de alcance global.
Leer más
La IA cambió la forma de viajar y transformó la industria hotelera en 2026
La forma en que las personas planean, comparan y reservan sus viajes está cambiando más rápido de lo esperado. Durante la primera mitad de 2026, la inteligencia artificial (IA) dejó de ser una promesa tecnológica para convertirse en un factor que ya influye en las decisiones de los viajeros y en la manera en que la industria turística se relaciona con sus clientes.

En junio de 2016, Copa Airlines inició sus operaciones en Chiclayo. Desde entonces, ha transportado a miles de pasajeros, conectando a la ciudad con más de 80 destinos internacionales en Norte, Centro, Suramérica y el Caribe, manteniendo su firme propósito de acortar distancias y conectar con todo el continente a la región de Lambayeque facilitando el turismo, los negocios y el reencuentro entre familias.

Hilton anunció hoy la apertura de Motto by Hilton Guadalajara Centro Historico, un hotel de 154 habitaciones con enfoque lifestyle ubicado en el corazón del centro histórico de Guadalajara. Desarrollado y operado por Grupo Megaterra, la propiedad ocupa un edificio Art Déco restaurado de la década de 1950 e introduce la experiencia de hospitalidad característica de Motto by Hilton, inspirada en la esencia y la vida del vecindario, en uno de los destinos urbanos con mayor riqueza cultural de México.

**************************
4 ways to get a lower rate
**************************

Wondering why everyone has a different interest rate?
That’s because rates are personalized for each buyer based on a
combination of factors that you can and can’t control.

what's in and out of your control when
trying to lower rate  what's in and out of your control when
trying to lower rate In your control

* Credit score: A strong financial track record is the most
universal way to get a lower rate.
* Down payment: If you borrow less, the lender has less risk,
which can lower your rate.
* Loan type: FHA, VA and conventional loans have different rates.
* Loan term: A shorter term (and faster payoff) can net a
lower rate.
Out of your control

* Inflation: Mortgage rates rise with the general cost of goods
and services.
* Federal Reserve policy: Mortgage rates closely follow these
benchmark rates.
* Market conditions: Things like lender competition and investor
demand will affect rates.

Welcome to Edition 449 of Institute Inbrief.

#top

ACA Counsellor of the Year 2026: Rayma Torresan's story

At AIPC, one of the greatest privileges is seeing our graduates go on to make a meaningful difference in the lives of others.

So when we heard that Rayma Torresan had been named the Australian Counselling Association’s (ACA) Counsellor of the Year for 2026, we were thrilled for her and eager to hear more about the work that led to this well-deserved recognition.

We connected with Rayma for an interview to hear about her journey, the impact she’s making in her community, and what the award means to her.

“It’s a funny story as to how I got nominated,” she says. “I have a colleague that rings me and says, ‘I’ve seen these awards and I’d love to nominate you.’ And I basically hung up on her. I said, ‘I’m too busy, go away. This is not me.’”

As we chatted with Rayma, one thing became clear: while the award is a significant achievement, Rayma is far more interested in talking about her clients, their progress and the lives they’ve rebuilt.

It comes as no surprise then as to why she received this award!


** Rayma’s Pathway to Becoming a Counsellor: The Role AIPC Played
------------------------------------------------------------

Before becoming a counsellor, Rayma spent years as a singer and singing teacher. Looking back, she can see how those experiences helped shape the counsellor she would eventually become.

“I noticed that I had this little knack for connecting with people,” she says. “I’m a singing teacher, but they’re telling me all this stuff about their life.”

It wasn’t long until counselling began to feel like a natural next step.

“It just felt right,” she says. “So I did it.”

That decision eventually led her to study the Bachelor of Counselling at AIPC, where she completed her studies while raising three young children.

“I never believed I could do a degree with three small children,” she says.

What stood out most to Rayma wasn’t just the course content, but the support and connections she built along the way.

“The course content was brilliant, but they were also so good at supporting you.”

One of those connections has stayed with her throughout her career. Through AIPC’s residential schools, Rayma met a facilitator who would later become her clinical supervisor.

More than 15 years later, they still work together.

Looking back, it’s those relationships, alongside the practical learning and support she received throughout her studies, that continue to influence her work today.


** The DCJ Thursday Initiative
------------------------------------------------------------

A significant part of the work that led to Rayma being named Counsellor of the Year centres around the DCJ Thursday Initiative, a program supporting women experiencing trauma, addiction, domestic violence and child protection involvement.

The idea grew from more than a decade spent working with children in foster care.

While supporting children, Rayma found herself thinking about their parents and wondering what might be possible if they could access the right support earlier.

“If I could rehabilitate parents, that would be truly meaningful,” she says.

body:
Recommended for you

ARIVAL 360 | SPOKANE
12-15 OCTOBER 2026

Over four days this October, we will assemble a global community of operators, OTAs, destinations, and marketing and technology leaders in Spokane, Washington. Tuesday through Thursday, we will focus on deep industry integration through our signature format and the important conversations that only happen when the right people are in the room.
* Interactive workshops and sessions designed to provide actionable ideas for business growth .
* Access to exclusive, leading-edge research to help navigate industry shifts .
* Opportunities for peer-to-peer conversations to exchange successful strategies and address common challenges .
* Beyond the ballroom: The event is designed to welcome our community into the city itself, a unique backdrop for professional inspiration and connection. With the PNW Food & Wine Festival [ https://www.davenporthotelcollection.com/experiences/#!/collection/c2f1693b-7807-4181-b1a7-d40e15b5af38?date=2026-06-04 ] taking place Oct 9-11, and Monday featuring the Executive Summit and a new Experiential Learning Day , Spokane will be the perfect place for a week of bleisure travel. **Tickets for the Experiential Learning and Executive Summit will be on sale in the coming weeks.**

Why Spokane? Because hidden gems are experiences, and experiences are kind of our thing. Spokane is the Lilac City, birthplace of Father’s Day [ https://www.seattletimes.com/life/travel/a-fathers-day-guide-to-spokane-the-holidays-hometown ] , childhood home of crooner Bing Crosby [ https://www.seattletimes.com/life/travel/finding-history-and-elegance-in-spokane ] , and host of Hoopfest, the world’s largest three-on-three outdoor basketball tournament. It is right-sized for both exploration and a connected Arival community. From goats to the shire to Danny DeVito, Spokane's offbeat charm will make this an Arival destination to remember.

Spring Savings tickets are available through 30 June, with savings of up to $1,010 . Register with confidence: tickets are fully refundable up to 60 days before the event.

ARIVAL 360 | BRISBANE

The experiences industry across Australia, New Zealand, and the broader APAC region marches to it's own drummer - different booking patterns, a different distribution mix, and different conversations from the US and European markets.

Last week in Brisbane, operators, marketing and technology companies, and distributors from across the region gathered for the first Oceania Arival 360, with three days of sessions on AI adoption, distribution strategy, connectivity, and what building a modern experiences business looks like in this market in 2026.

Recap and photos coming this week, with 2027 dates to follow.

2026 ARIVAL SPOTLIGHT AWARDS: NOMINATIONS OPEN NOW
--------------------------------------------------
Who's raising the bar for tours, activities, attractions, and experiences? The Arival Spotlight Awards celebrate the companies and leaders shaping the industry's future through innovation, outstanding guest experiences, and meaningful impact. Think your company deserves the spotlight, or know someone who does? Submit a nomination today. Entries close on Sunday, 9 August 2026

> LEARN MORE [ https://arival.travel/arival-awards/arival-spotlight-awards/?&utm_source=promo&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=event_360_spokane&siq_name=${Contacts.Contact%20Name}&siq_email=${Contacts.Email} ]

THE BUSINESS OF ADVENTURE: WHAT'S DRIVING THE ADVENTURE TRAVEL BOOM
-------------------------------------------------------------------
Adventure travel is booming, and it's no longer just for thrill-seekers. In this episode of The Best Part of Travel, Adventure Travel Trade Association CEO Shannon Stowell joins Janelle Visser to discuss what's driving the sector's growth, the ATTA's definition of adventure travel, the category growing fastest, and how travel experiences can create lasting benefits for local communities.

> LISTEN / WATCH

ARIVAL 360 | BILBAO
13-17 APRIL 2027
THE BASQUE COUNTRY AWAITS!
Arival 360 heads to Bilbao, Spain in April 2027, a city that knows a thing or two about transformation and what a great experience can do for a place . This city is a global leader in innovation and sustainability, a UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy, and home to some of the most exciting food cultures in all of Europe. (Pintxos, anyone?)

Bookmark and Share [ https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/DCWASH/bulletins/41dd997?reqfrom=share ] As we continue our country’s commemoration of its 250th birthday, the Bowser Administration invites you to celebrate Independence Day by joining us at two community events taking place here in DC on Saturday, July 4. These annual traditions bring together residents, families, and neighbors to celebrate our city, our communities, and our DC values.  The first opportunity to participate is the Capitol Hill Fourth of July Parade, a longstanding neighborhood tradition that has become one of the District’s signature Independence Day events. Members of the Bowser Administration will join residents and community partners as the parade travels through the Barracks Row neighborhood, creating a festive celebration for all ages.    *Capitol Hill Fourth of July Parade*  *Date*: Saturday, July 4, 2026  *Arrival Time:* 9:30 AM  *Parade Begins: *10:00 AM  *Meet-Up Location:* 8th Street and Virginia Avenue SE (under the overpass)  *Register:* https://s.dc.gov/2026CapHillParade    Later that morning, the Bowser Administration will participate in the 60th Palisades Parade and Picnic, a cherished community tradition that has brought residents together for generations. The parade and accompanying festivities offer an opportunity to connect with neighbors, celebrate local pride, and enjoy one of the District’s most beloved Independence Day events.  *60th Palisades Parade and Picnic*  *Date:* Saturday, July 4, 2026  *Arrival Time:* 10:00 AM  *Parade Begins:* 11:00 AM  *Meet-Up Location:* 4700 Whitehaven Parkway NW (enter Whitehaven from Foxhall Road)  *Register: *https://s.dc.gov/2026PalisadesParade  Whether you join us for one parade or both, we encourage you to invite your colleagues, friends, and family members to participate. St. Regis Hotels & Resorts anuncia hoy la apertura de The St. Regis Costa Mujeres Resort, Cancún, un elegante refugio frente al mar donde la belleza natural y la riqueza cultural de la península de Yucatán conviven con las célebres tradiciones y el servicio personalizado de la marca. Ubicado al norte de Cancún, en el tranquilo enclave de Costa Mujeres, el resort introduce una sofisticada nueva expresión del lujo en el Caribe mexicano, enmarcada por playas de arena blanca, aguas cristalinas, manglares protegidos y el segundo arrecife de coral más grande del mundo.
Leer más Montréal, un rincón europeo dentro de Canadá
Montréal, la ciudad más grande de Quebec y uno de los principales centros culturales de Canadá, destaca por su identidad francófona, visible en su arquitectura, tradiciones y vida cotidiana. Ubicada en una isla sobre el río San Lorenzo, este fascinante destino combina historia, cultura y una amplia oferta de actividades para sus visitantes.
Leer más
Carnival Cruise Line presenta gama con nueva ola de experiencias culinarias
Carnival Cruise Line presentó The Next Course, una nueva ola de experiencias culinarias que incluye restaurantes y bares que se inaugurarán en el Carnival Festivale en 2027 y en el Carnival Tropicale en 2028, y con nuevas e innovadoras experiencias gastronómicas que ya se están implementando en toda la flota.
Leer másEMUFEC cumplió con la meta y el Inti Raymi volvió a deslumbrar al mundo
Miles de espectadores nacionales y extranjeros fueron testigos de una nueva y majestuosa edición del Inti Raymi, la Fiesta del Sol, que convirtió una vez más al Cusco en el epicentro de la cultura andina. La puesta en escena fue organizada por la Empresa Municipal de Festejos y Promoción Turística del Cusco (EMUFEC).
Leer más La Unión Europea redefine las normas del equipaje
La Unión Europea ha dado un paso decisivo en la reforma de los derechos de los pasajeros aéreos con la aprobación de un nuevo marco regulatorio que modifica las condiciones aplicables al equipaje de mano y establece nuevas obligaciones para las compañías aéreas. La medida, impulsada por las instituciones comunitarias tras años de negociaciones entre los Estados miembros, el Parlamento Europeo y el sector de la aviación, introduce cambios que afectarán directamente a millones de viajeros en toda Europa.
Leer más
Guanajuato tiene tres museos que no puedes perderte
Guanajuato Capital sigue demostrando por qué está en el top de los destinos culturales de México. Si pensabas que los museos son aburridos, estos tres recintos van a cambiar tu opinión para siempre. Arte, historia y mucha identidad guanajuatense en un solo recorrido.
Leer másDías sin fin: Ciudades para aprovechar los días largos del verano europeo
Mientras en Perú bajan las temperaturas y vuelven las casacas, Europa se prepara para disfrutar del verano. Felizmente, los viajeros peruanos tendrán más opciones para escapar del frío. Según el Ministerio de Transportes y Comunicaciones (MTC), Lima conectó con 49 destinos internacionales mediante 28 aerolíneas y, desde junio y julio de 2026, sumará nuevas rutas y más frecuencias para consolidar al Aeropuerto Internacional Jorge Chávez como uno de los principales hubs aéreos de la región.

Venezuela enfrenta una de las mayores emergencias naturales de su historia reciente tras el devastador terremoto que sacudió el centro-norte del país y provocó graves daños humanos, materiales y económicos. Ten Shorts Around the World 2026
--------------------------------


Streaming from June 26 to Septembre 15

Join us this summer for a streaming showcase of *Ten Shorts Around the World 2026* — a curated selection of Italian short films presented by the **Italian Cultural Institute of Washington** and the **Centro Nazionale del Cortometraggio**. This program is part of **Fare Cinema**, Italy's annual global initiative by Italy's Ministry of Foreign Affairs, celebrating Italian cinema and its film industry.


Although short-film formats keep evolving with new viewing habits, cinema remains the most sophisticated visual language, the origin of all audiovisual developments. "Ten Shorts Around the World" captures Italian short cinema's essence—personal microcosms that, through filmmakers' dedication, become shared, collective critical reflection.

- JOY JELLY - Danilo Merafina – 2025, 20 min.

body:
You know I love talking about YouTube Ads... but today I want to take you onto a different platform that's quietly become one of the fastest ways to generate leads & build real relationships with your ideal clients: **Instagram**.

I recently sat down on the Marketing Minds Podcast with **Harrison Colly**, a B2B go-to-market expert who has generated over **1 Billion views** across his clients on Instagram & **8-Figures+ in revenue** directly from the platform.

We "nerded out" on the exact playbook he installs for businesses doing anywhere from $3M to $500M+ per year... & I walked away with so many golden nuggets that I had to break them down for you right here.

_As a Reminder, Our Goal with this Newsletter is to Give You the Highest Level of Value Possible._ That's my Promise to you & I intend to Over-Deliver!

Here's a Sneak Peek at What's Inside This Email:

✅ The **"Capture, Keep & Convert"** Framework for turning content into clients
✅ How to set up your Instagram Profile to build instant trust & authority
✅ The exact Content Cadence to post (Reels, Carousels & Stories)
✅ Why selling in the DMs "prints money" - & the simple 4-Step DM Framework
✅ The **"Trial Reels"** hack that gives you FREE advertising on Instagram

Alright, let's Dive In...

———————————————————————————

# Watch The Full Video on YouTube:

Youtube: The Instagram Playbook - Complete Beginner's Guide to Instagram  with Harrison Coley (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MJBbtk26CkI)

Watch The Full Video on YouTube! (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MJBbtk26CkI)

———————————————————————————

# Why Instagram Plays by a Different Set of Rules

The first thing Harrison helped me understand is that Instagram & YouTube are fundamentally different machines.

YouTube (& Google) are **search-based, intent-driven** platforms. Someone looks something up, & your content shows up to answer it.

Instagram is the opposite. It's an **interest-based, interruption-based** platform. Nobody is searching for your Reel - it just appears in their feed, & you have a split second to stop the scroll.

That changes everything. Because Instagram isn't a search platform... it's a **reputation platform**.

It's shorter, more human & more relational. Over time, you're not just posting content - you're building a world & a reputation that people come to know, trust & want to be a part of.

That's the lens to keep in mind for everything that follows.

———————————————————————————

# The "Capture, Keep & Convert" Framework

Here's where it got fun, because Harrison's signature framework is almost identical to the one I teach for YouTube (it's amazing how the best marketers independently arrive at the same core principles).

He calls it **Capture, Keep & Convert** - & it applies to every single piece of content you post:

✅ **Capture** - Your hook. The first 3 seconds. This is where the majority of your effort should go, because if you don't stop the scroll, nothing else matters.
✅ **Keep** - The body of the content. Why is someone staying? What are they actually getting in return for their attention?
✅ **Convert** - The action. Do you want them to follow, comment, DM you, or click? (& yes - a like or a share counts as a conversion on short-form content too.)

Every post should live inside one of these three buckets... & ideally, a great piece of content does all three at once.

is this you too?Hi Dave,

**Meet Raquel, a past Retail Ready® student who makes eco-friendly shampoo bars, now sold direct-to-consumer and accounts like Anthropologie and clean-beauty stores.**

(Ok her name isn’t really Raquel - but her story is real!)

She was a self-proclaimed “sales-avoidant” founder for the first two years of her business, but she believed in her product line SO much that she knew she had to figure it out.

**“In hindsight, I had three shitty beliefs that kept**

**my business small for longer than it should.” **

**Here’s what she thought: **

😔

**My product is exceptional. I shouldn’t “have” to sell. **

I think it sank in when, on a live coaching call

**, I asked Raquel to name a million-dollar beauty brand that didn’t put effort into selling.** Name ONE brand that is in hundreds of stores that just got there by luck, vibes, or relying on “brand awareness.” Nope!

🫵 

**Following up is pushy.**

Raquel would send a few sales emails, and then that 

**naggy voice would pop back into her head.** “If the buyer wanted to bring you in, they’d have written back.” 

We shifted this belief in Retail Ready® and built out her full follow-up sequence, templetized and everything, so when that voice popped up again (which it inevitably does!) she didn’t have to combat it because she’d already pre-written the BEST follow-up email sequence and had it in her drafts folder..

Now she’s landing more accounts and having buyers say “omg THANK YOU for following up!”

🚫 

**I’m just not a salesperson. **

**The irony here is that everyone is a salesperson.**Have you ever tried to convince your partner to go watch YOUR favorite show on a Friday night? Or gotten your kid to eat their veggies before leaving the table? Or recommended your favorite book to a friend? 

That’s all sales. 

**Once Raquel realized that, everything changed for her.**

You might not know that I’m a certified leadership coach, and I went through a 200 hr training program almost 7 years ago, with the world’s top coach accreditation institute…. Which means I’m a WIZ at spotting patterns, figuring out what’s keeping biz owners stuck, and helping you move forward.

**So hit reply if you’ve got a story running through your head about why you can’t, shouldn’t, or aren’t allowed to do the sales your product line deserves.** I won’t judge - I’ve practically seen it all over the years!

Talk soon,

Alli

A weekly wrap of ADL’s reports, updates and analysis on antisemitism around the world.

This Week’s Topline

https://click.adlmail.org/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MTh9AAEAAAAAAOTUX9mev9ioFRhhTaObMFUnKxiZj3HBhm8WX4NccNEuWbDw3WB0R4zOb_tiMVYqSCPouMTj3PXimUmDJRfgJ_PMpe0VdrQ0AQ 
ADL’s Legal Challenge to BDS in Massachussetts 

“Passing this ordinance will not make Somerville Jews and Jews throughout Massachusetts — who are experiencing harassment, vandalism, and intimidation — safer or more welcome in the community.”

This important reminder from ADL CEO Jonathan Greenblatt came as ADL and our allies urged Somerville, MA city officials to reject a proposed ordinance that would require the city to boycott and divest from companies that do business with Israel.

ADL warned that the proposed ordinance is unconstitutional and legally unsustainable, and would deepen community divisions, expose taxpayers to costly litigation, harm local businesses, and further isolate Jewish and Israeli residents.

→

Interconnected Hate:  A shooter opened fire in Montreal on June 22, resulting in three deaths and one injury. ADL analysis of a manifesto reportedly left behind by the shooter reveals a range of extremist views, including antisemitism, incel-linked ideas and anti-capitalist beliefs. 
https://click.adlmail.org/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MTh9AAEAAAAAAOTUX9miXeS4RhnDF_TBHMlYBNBF_o-FDgctoM2YvDxaKZ0tPiimA27iuFEV2XX3BQiCUdb6KuX_RycUy0k7-HQjxFvoAAkh4Q

Playbook for Addressing Antisemitism in Sports. Level Up Your Workplace Commuter Benefits 🚲💼

Ready to take your commuter program to the next level? Our Employer Services team can help you enhance your transportation benefits, improve workplace amenities, and build incentives that meet your employees where they are, all while positioning your workplace as a Transportation All-Star!

Through the goDCgo Transportation All-Star program, employers are recognized for their commitment to supporting smarter, more sustainable commutes. Some benefits of becoming an All-Star include:
* Invitation and shoutout at our annual All-Star Awards ceremony (https://godcgo.com/transportation-allstars/?utm_source=DC+Employers&utm_campaign=a1d722cc13-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2019_11_13_08_14_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_8b85183388-a1d722cc13-710933513#awards)
* A crystal award for Platinum-level organizations
* Featured listing on goDCgo.com (https://godcgo.com/transportation-allstars/?utm_source=DC+Employers&utm_campaign=a1d722cc13-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2019_11_13_08_14_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_8b85183388-a1d722cc13-710933513#become)
* A digital badge for your website and communications
* Opportunities to be highlighted in goDCgo success stories

Bonus: Become a Transportation All-Star or level up by June 30th, and you'll receive three Capital Bikeshare day passes to share with employees or use for employee engagement activities.

Ready to get started?
MEET WITH THE TEAM (https://godcgo.com/employer/?utm_source=DC+Employers&utm_campaign=a1d722cc13-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2019_11_13_08_14_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_8b85183388-a1d722cc13-710933513#team2)
Putting People First: An Employer Success Story

How can employers create commuter programs that truly meet the needs of their workforce? For So Others Might Eat (SOME), the answer is simple: take a whole-person approach. As a nonprofit dedicated to serving the DC community, SOME applies the same philosophy of care and support to its employees by offering commuter benefits that help staff get to work safely, affordably, and sustainably. Through its partnership with goDCgo, SOME has developed a commuter program that includes transit subsidies, bike racks, carpool resources, and flexible commuting options tailored to employee needs.

Interested in strengthening your commuter benefits program but not sure where to start? Read how SOME partnered with goDCgo to create a commuter program that supports employees through transit benefits, carpooling resources, bike amenities, and more.

READ THE FULL SUCCESS STORY (https://godcgo.com/wp-content/uploads/SOME_Success-Story.pdf?utm_source=DC+Employers&utm_campaign=a1d722cc13-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2019_11_13_08_14_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_8b85183388-a1d722cc13-710933513)
Help New Employees Navigate Their Commute 🧭
Starting a new job can be overwhelming at times, but getting to work shouldn’t be one of the hard parts. By introducing commuter benefits during onboarding, you can help new hires understand their options before day one and encourage early participation in your commuter program.

Our Employee Transportation Coordinator (ETC) Toolkit make it easy to onboard new employees. It includes:
* Answers to common commuting questions
* Guidance on explaining employee benefits
* Resources for transit, biking, walking, carpooling, and vanpooling
* Tips for promoting your commuter program internally

Whether you're onboarding one employee or an entire department, this toolkit helps ensure everyone starts with a clear, confident commute plan.

Santa Maria Valley's Most Compelling Pinot Noir. The Murphy Family's "Almost an Island" Delivers a Burgundian Benchmark at an Exceptional Value

"Earth-anchored aromas and flavors of huckleberries and mixed, crushed cherries are woven with sarsaparilla, tilled earth, bouquet garni and a saline seam through the red-tea finish. There is notable textural detail to this pinot and a length to the elegant tannins that promises fruitful evolution for years to come. Drink or hold." - James Suckling
 When we search for a Pinot Noir that genuinely earns its place on our shelves, the standard is simple: it must express its origin with clarity, carry itself with elegance, and deliver something no mass-produced bottling can replicate. The 2024 Presqu’ile Pinot Noir from Santa Barbara County achieves all three. At under $25, it may be the most persuasive argument for California Pinot we have made in years.

Presqu’ile (pronounced "press-keel") is a family-owned estate founded in 2007 by the Murphy family on 72 acres of rolling hillside in the Santa Maria Valley. The name translates from French as "almost an island" and honors a beloved family compound on the Mississippi Gulf Coast lost to Hurricane Katrina in 2005. It is a winery born from resilience and purpose. South African winemaker Dieter Cronje has helmed production since inception, with consulting input from Jeremy Seysses of the legendary Domaine Dujac in Burgundy since 2015. That Burgundian influence is unmistakable in the glass.​

The Santa Maria Valley is one of the most distinctive appellations in the United States. The valley runs east to west, a transverse orientation that allows cool Pacific marine air to penetrate deep inland, extending the growing season and preserving natural acidity. The estate vineyard sits 16 miles from the Pacific, on deep sandy soils rich in marine sediment. This is not warm-weather California Pinot. This is the cool-climate expression that made the region a destination for Burgundy lovers long before the rest of the country caught on.

The 2024 Santa Barbara County bottling draws from estate fruit and select partner sites across the valley, aged 11 months in a combination of neutral French oak and Austrian fudera, followed by six months in stainless steel. The result is a wine of genuine transparency: no heavy extraction, no new oak influence, just a pure and precise reading of place. This is the kind of Pinot that rewards attention and repays patience, though it is entirely approachable right now. At $24.99, it is a standing invitation to drink well without compromise.

The New Vintage, From One of the Most Trusted Families in Bué - Steep Slopes, Chalky Limestone, and a Sancerre Builtfor the Table

"A classic, mineral-laden Sancerre from the village of Bué, which is prized for its limestone-rich soils. This is a clean, minerally, citrusy, racy style of Sancerre. Aromatically, it tastes like someone took chalk dust, poured citrus oil over it, and added a pinch of gunflint. Vieux Pruniers truly overdelivers on every front, especially given the price escalation in quality Sancerre over the past several years." - Winemaker The 2025 vintage in Sancerre has begun arriving, and few producers deliver the classic appellation style with more reliability than Domaine des Vieux Pruniers. Christian Thirot-Fournier, together with his wife and daughter, tends roughly 10 hectares in the commune of Bué, a village tucked into dramatically steep amphitheatre slopes just two and a half miles from Sancerre proper. A handful of the family's parcels approach a 65-degree gradient, a reminder that this is farming in its most physical form. Seven hectares of Sauvignon Blanc grow on chalky Kimmeridgian limestone, with the remaining three planted to Pinot Noir on clay-limestone soils below.
The domaine's approach is refreshingly straightforward. Sustainable viticulture without herbicides across the majority of the estate, cool fermentation in stainless steel for around 15 days, and several months of ageing on fine lees before bottling. The result is Sancerre in its most textbook, honest form: crystalline, flinty, floral on the nose, and zesty through the palate. No artifice, no oak, no concession to fashion.
The 2025 offers a textbook snapshot of why this village has earned its reputation. Expect lifted aromatics, electric acidity, and that signature saline-stone minerality that makes Bué-sourced fruit such a joy at the dinner table. Purchase by the case while stocks last. At this price, it is the house Sancerre we reach for on a weeknight and serve without a second thought when guests arrive unexpectedly. FEATURED WINE: The New Vintage of the Mineral Sancerre From Domaine des Vieux Pruniers

Si no puede visualizar bien este boletín haga clic AQUÍLima, jueves 25 de junio del 2026 Director General: Carlos Bernuy  Diseño y arquitectura orgánica en el Caribe panameño
El lujo silencioso ya no se mide únicamente por el confort o la exclusividad. Cada vez más viajeros valoran aquellos lugares donde el diseño logra desaparecer para dar protagonismo al entorno. En este contexto, la arquitectura orgánica emerge como una de las grandes tendencias del turismo contemporáneo, con proyectos que buscan integrarse al paisaje en lugar de transformarlo.
Leer más Despega el primer avión de Iberia con Wi-Fi de alta velocidad de Starlink
El primer avión de Iberia equipado con wifi gratuito de alta velocidad despegó anoche desde el aeropuerto Adolfo Suárez Madrid-Barajas. El vuelo, con destino a São Paulo y matrícula EC-MAA, es el primero de la flota de la aerolínea equipado con la avanzada tecnología de Starlink, que permite a sus clientes contar con una conexión a internet de alta velocidad en cualquier lugar del planeta.
Leer más
Venezuela cierra aeropuerto de Maiquetía por graves daños tras terremotos
Dos fuertes terremotos de magnitudes 7,2 y 7,5 han sacudido el norte de Venezuela, dejando al menos 164 fallecidos y un millar heridos, según el balance provisional ofrecido por las autoridades. Los movimientos sísmicos se registraron durante la tarde del miércoles, hora local (medianoche en la España peninsular), y afectaron especialmente al estado costero de La Guaira, próximo a Caracas. En ambos lugares se han producido los mayores daños y varios edificios han quedado colapsados, incluidos algunos hoteles.
Leer másInti Raymi, la fiesta del sol que ilumina Cusco de tradición e historia
Desde las primeras horas del 24 de junio en Cusco, la luz comienza a iluminar la ciudad y se da inicio al Inti Raymi o Fiesta del Sol. El Qoricancha es el primer escenario donde el pasado vuelve a cobrar vida como en la antigua capital del Tahuantinsuyo, con una ceremonia que honra al Tayta (Dios) Inti y agradece por las cosechas recibidas, mientras se pide prosperidad para un nuevo ciclo.
Leer más Visita papal impulsa el turismo religioso en Perú
La próxima visita del papa León XIV al Perú, prevista para noviembre, ha despertado una enorme expectativa entre millones de fieles católicos dentro y fuera del país. A la espera de que la Santa Sede confirme oficialmente el itinerario que seguirá el Pontífice durante su estancia, el anuncio de su regreso ya genera un importante impacto no solo en el ámbito religioso, sino también en el turístico y cultural. Para numerosos especialistas del sector, esta visita representa una oportunidad excepcional para proyectar al mundo la riqueza del patrimonio religioso peruano y consolidar al país como uno de los principales destinos de turismo de fe en América Latina.
Leer más
Baja California entre naturaleza, senderos y memoria viva
Hay paisajes que invitan a desconectarse y otros que además permiten comprender la historia que los habita; entre San José de la Zorra y el Valle de Tempe, las actividades al aire libre adquieren un significado distinto, donde caminar entre montañas, arroyos y caminos abiertos también se convierte en una manera de acercarse a la memoria viva del pueblo Kumiai.
Leer másEconomy Premier: La nueva experiencia de vuelo de SKY que sorprende
La aerolínea SKY ha anunciado el lanzamiento de Economy Premier, una nueva experiencia de viaje diseñada para los pasajeros que buscan un mayor nivel de confort y eficiencia en sus vuelos. Esta iniciativa tiene como objetivo transformar las etapas cotidianas del trayecto en dinámicas más cómodas y fluidas, manteniendo la propuesta de tarifas accesibles que caracteriza el modelo de la compañía.

June 24, 2026


** Updates from Adams Morgan
------------------------------------------------------------

Click here (https://adamsmorgan.com/connect/newsletter-archive) to see previous updates in our newsletter archive.

Click here for Washington, DC 250 (https://250.dc.gov/) , the DC Government website for everything related to America 250


** Adams Morgan Movie Nights Features Kangaroo Thursday + Selections from Sitar Arts Center’s Student-Produced contest
------------------------------------------------------------

Adams Morgan Movie Nights (https://adamsmorgan.com/events/signature-events/adams-morgan-movie-nights) is a beloved community tradition that brings neighbors and visitors together under the stars for free outdoor film screenings.

This week, in partnership with the Embassy of Australia (https://usa.embassy.gov.au/) , we’re showing Kangaroo, the story of a disgraced TV host and a young indigenous girl who work together to rescue and rehabilitate a group of orphaned joeys in a remote Outback community.

Before the screening we’ll be featuring a selection of winning projects from Sitar Arts Center’s (https://www.sitarartscenter.org/) third annual student-produced Set in DC Film Festival.

Screenings begin after dark (30 minutes after sunset) and are free and open to the public. Guests are encouraged to bring a blanket, pick up a picnic dinner at an Adams Morgan restaurant, and enjoy a relaxing evening in one of D.C.’s most vibrant neighborhoods. Local restaurants offer takeout specials to pair with your movie night, making it the perfect way to support small businesses while enjoying a night out.  Visit our website (https://adamsmorgan.com/events/signature-events/adams-morgan-movie-nights) for a list of takeout specials offered in conjunction with the movies.

Update: Due rainouts, the series has been extended through July 2. Unless tomorrow’s movie is unexpectedly canceled, we’ll be showing Rocky on July 2. Alcohol and pets are not allowed on the field during the movie.

Click here (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3SBUyt_u0rA) to watch a preview of the series.

This year's series is generously sponsored by Pepco (https://www.pepco.com/) , Lafayette Credit Union (https://www.lfcu.org/) , LIME (https://www.li.me/) , Events DC (https://eventsdc.com/home) , Wegmans (https://www.wegmans.com/) , and The Embassy of Australia (https://usa.embassy.gov.au/) .


** DDOT wants feedback by Friday on their plans for 18th Street
------------------------------------------------------------

Last month DDOT presented their plans (https://ddot.dc.gov/sites/default/files/dc/sites/ddot/18th%20St%20NW_Restriping%20Plan.pdf) for restriping the 2300-2400 blocks of 18th Street, NW (between Kalorama Road and Columbia Road). They presented two options: one with a raised concrete center median and one with unprotected bike lanes. We've studied their proposals and we feel the option with the bike lanes is preferable but that their plan doesn’t do enough to protect pedestrians. You can read our full analysis and suggestions here (https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/80ktcvdh3uziyise119b9/Info-sheet-for-business-comments.pdf?rlkey=w4wo99rlxudgtqozs3y1tfww4&dl=0) .

It's very important that business owners voice concerns they have about this project, so please read the analysis and submit your comments to DDOT here (https://survey123.arcgis.com/share/e7d7bd62c576401891bb298801bf86e2) .

The deadline to submit comments is Friday, June 26.
