body:
Newsletter Infotur Latam 24-06-26
Si no puede visualizar bien este boletín haga clic AQUÍLima, miercoles 24 de junio del 2026 Director General: Carlos Bernuy  Cusco celebra mes jubilar con desfiles, música, danzas y show de drones
A pocas horas de la celebración central del Inti Raymi, la emblemática Fiesta del Sol que cada 24 de junio convierte al Cusco en el centro histórico cultural del Perú, la ciudad imperial ha vivido jornadas intensas de color, música, danzas y expresiones de identidad. Las actividades han congregado a miles de cusqueños, visitantes nacionales y extranjeros. Las actividades organizadas por la Empresa Municipal de Festejos y Promoción Turística del Cusco (EMUFEC) han transformado las calles y plazas en escenarios donde la tradición andina y el orgullo regional se expresan con fuerza.
Leer más JetSMART ofrece más de 16 mil asientos a Cusco por el Inti Raymi 2026
Junio se ha consolidado como uno de los meses de mayor movimiento turístico para la región Cusco. Las tradicionales Fiestas Jubilares y el Inti Raymi o Fiesta del Sol, que se celebra cada 24 de junio, y convierten a la Ciudad Imperial en uno de los principales destinos turísticos del país, atrayendo a miles de visitantes nacionales e internacionales durante varias semanas. Diversas organizaciones vinculadas al sector turismo estiman que la celebración reúne anualmente entre 100 mil y 150 mil asistentes, además de movilizar cientos de actores, músicos y agrupaciones culturales.
Leer más
GUEXT 2026 refuerza la estratégia de la innovación para el impulso del hospitality
GUEXT, el Salón Internacional de Proveedores y Servicios para el hospitality organizado por IFEMA MADRID junto a FELAC, la Federación Española de Asociaciones de Fabricantes de Maquinaria para Hostelería, Colectividades e Industrias Afines, reforzará en su segunda edición el protagonismo del segmento de equipamiento y maquinaria como uno de los ámbitos estratégicos para la evolución del sector hospitality.
Leer másCazón, el pueblo sustentable con un millón de árboles
Mientras todo parece ser solamente tecnologías de avanzada, herramientas que reemplazan la mano de obra del hombre y desconocimiento de la necesidad de cuidar la naturaleza, hay localidades en la Provincia de Buenos Aires que apuestan cada vez más a resaltar lo sano y natural.
Leer más Rio de Cores: celebraciones y experiencias en Río de Janeiro por mes de la diversidad
Durante todo el mes de junio, Río de Janeiro vuelve a desplegar su lado más diverso y acogedor con una nueva edición de Río de Cores, la iniciativa impulsada por la organización turística Visit Río junto a la Câmara de Comércio e Turismo LGBT do Brasil, que reúne a más de 40 participantes entre hoteles, restaurantes, atractivos turísticos y empresas del sector para ofrecer experiencias exclusivas, descuentos, activaciones temáticas y beneficios especiales durante el Mes del Orgullo.
Leer más
Aeropuertos comienzan a implementar zonas de bienestar post-vueloLos aeropuertos de grandes centros de conexión internacional están inaugurando hoy las primeras zonas de bienestar diseñadas específicamente para el tránsito post-vuelo.
Leer másAir Europa abre nueva ruta directa entre Madrid y El Salvador
La compañía aérea Air Europa ha anunciado de manera oficial la ampliación de su red de destinos internacionales en el continente americano con la incorporación de una ruta regular directa hacia El Salvador. A partir del próximo 17 de diciembre, la aerolínea miembro de la alianza SkyTeam conectará el Aeropuerto Adolfo Suárez Madrid-Barajas con la capital salvadoreña, fortaleciendo de forma estratégica su posicionamiento en Centroamérica, una región donde ya mantiene operaciones estables hacia Honduras y Panamá.
Leer más WorldHotels inaugura primer resort Lía Hotel Jacó – Exclusively for Adults en Costa Rica
En constante expansión en la región, especialmente en América Central y el Caribe, WorldHotels, cadena de lujo del grupo BWH Hotels con 80 años de experiencia y legado en hospitalidad, celebra la apertura de una nueva propiedad en Costa Rica: el Lía Hotel Jacó – Exclusively for Adults. Perteneciente a la auténtica colección WorldHotels Crafted, dedicada a propiedades que transforman lo ordinario en extraordinario a través del diseño y la creatividad, el hotel se ubica frente al mar en la paradisíaca Jacó Beach, donde la cadena ya goza de prestigio gracias a otras dos propiedades.
Leer más
Costalegre, la combinación perfecta entre playa, sol y la fiebre mundialistaCostalegre es una joya del Pacífico mexicano que se caracteriza por su tranquilo oleaje y sus maravillosas vistas, y eso no es todo, también ofrece una amplia gama de actividades llenas de diversión y aventura.
Leer más El destino que lidera el turismo slow cumple años
El pueblo cumple 113 años y ofrece su mejor atributo: identidad, paseos tranquilos, buena comida y un recorrido con la mayor cantidad de almacenes y puestos de campo de toda la Argentina. Festejos y Merc

Workplace trends       Pipeline
Estonia handed 20,000 students free ChatGPT accounts       As
employers increasingly demand AI fluency from new hires, Estonia
is getting ahead of the curve. Developed in partnership with
Stanford University and OpenAI, the country's AI Leap initiative
provides free ChatGPT accounts to all 10th- and 11th-graders. The
custom version is designed to guide rather than complete their
work. The move echoes Estonia's 1996 Tiger Leap, which digitized
the country's schools and is widely credited with giving rise to
Skype, Bolt, and Wise, according to the WSJ.       Protection
China's courts ruled that AI cannot justify firing workers
Employers in China now face a legal obligation to retrain workers
whose roles are automated, rather than simply letting them go.
The Hangzhou Intermediate People's Court ruled in April that
companies cannot terminate employees solely because AI has
automated their role, setting a precedent for how employers must
handle AI-driven workforce changes. With urban youth unemployment
at 15.3% in March, the pressure is on employers to reskill their
workers rather than lay them off, Bloomberg reports.       Access
Microsoft is testing a wearable AI badge for office workers
The office access badge is getting a technology upgrade.
Microsoft unveiled two concept devices at its Build 2026
developer conference: a small desktop cube and a wearable badge,
both of which let workers monitor and interact with AI agents
handling their tasks on the go. The BBC reports the devices are
currently being piloted by a few hundred Microsoft employees, as
Microsoft looks to move AI access beyond the screen.       Trust
Workers who trust their bosses adapt to AI better       Fear of
being replaced by AI is eroding workplace performance from the
inside. A University of Leicester study of over 16,000 employees
found that workers who trust their managers stay committed even
as AI reshapes their roles, while those who don't are more likely
to disengage. That means being upfront about which roles are at
risk, offering real retraining paths rather than vague
reassurances, and avoiding corporate euphemisms like "lower-value
human capital," the Economist reports.       Misfire       Amazon
shut down its AI leaderboard       Companies are learning that
measuring AI adoption by usage alone encourages the wrong
behavior. At Amazon, employees ran pointless tasks through AI
agents just to climb an internal ranking, driving up costs
without producing anything useful. Meta ran into the same problem
in April, shutting down a similar employee leaderboard for the
same reason. Amazon has since scrapped raw token counts in favor
of a metric that tracks AI-assisted work that actually delivers
results.

When to trust AI vs. your gut
By monday.com 
( https://clicks.mail.monday.com/f/a/99feKWi77TMf5oO-xSuoAA~~/AAQRxRA~/2YrFc4vdZgrDDBpE5vEL4zZR-OQOR5-7ON5ehVd6QvAXjz6DjvfDh7fQdHUpyzmXin3IXO2uHnMsmDGkCvodcUUyhrLX-3aNs4dmaLh8bBNENFRRsyVEkdN5f5jlOqmq2z8DB0CESLwi6xQ9L5BuOfsBvAD7vyxdkwowtqWYO_vxRgV2ifcStvUc8ekxYBImqPHfGSOCGHQ_PhMiubX2wGbYlZz8b6lAN_yc9aD8D2U~ )
        AI can analyze data and generate recommendations in
seconds, helping teams move more quickly. But faster decisions
aren't always better decisions.

Both AI and human intuition have strengths and limitations. AI
can process large amounts of data, spot trends that humans might
overlook, and provide a level of consistency that's difficult to
achieve on your own. Human instincts, on the other hand, are
shaped by experience, relationships, context, and countless
observations that never make their way into a dashboard, but
remain equally valuable as hard stats.

When making important decisions, the challenge isn't deciding
between AI and intuition; it's learning when each one deserves

[Producer highlight](https://sf.vervewine.com/products/benanti-etna-bianco-2024)

FOR BURG-HEADS: Your Next Obsession Should Be Carricante, and Benanti Delivers Some of the Finest Expressions in all of Sicily. Their 'Etna Bianco' Offers Superb Drinking Under $30

"An almost Champagne-like nose, with nutty, toasty aromas and then flinty, saline over richly developed fruit… All of Benanti's Etna Biancos are superlative, but it's hard for me to think of a better experience at such an accessible price." - Danielle Callegari, Wine Enthusiast​In 1988, Giuseppe Benanti founded his winery on the slopes of Mount Etna, when almost nobody was paying attention to the mountain. There were only four producers there at the time, and most of the fruit was shipped north and lost in bulk blends. Benanti brought in consulting enologists from Piedmont and academics from Burgundy, ran over 150 micro-vinifications in his first years to map the mountain's slopes and sub-zones, and committed entirely to Etna's noble indigenous varieties — Carricante for white, Nerello Mascalese and Nerello Cappuccio for red. By the time other producers started arriving on the volcano, Benanti had already spent a decade writing the playbook for what great Etna wine could be.​

Today the estate is run by Giuseppe's twin sons, Antonio and Salvino, who farm organically and ferment with proprietary yeasts developed over five years of in-vineyard research. The Etna Bianco comes from vineyards on the eastern and southern flanks, at elevations between 700 and 950 meters, where vines are trained in the old alberello bush-vine style and grown in sandy, mineral-rich volcanic soil.

For Burgundy lovers, this is the entry bottle that makes the case: the same tension between minerality and weight you chase in a great Bourgogne Blanc, only hailing here from volcanic ash instead of limestone. If Carricante is new to you, you're in for a treat.

Green apple, quince, and white grapefruit at the core with an elegant top layer of lemon balm, white roses and linden. Very long on the palate with focus and a delicious chalky grip that makes it linger on the palate. Lingering notes of grapefruit pith, preserved lemon and pear peel."​Verve Wine Team: “Carricante is Etna's noble white grape, and this is one of the most thrilling overachievers in Italian wine. Former pharmacist turned winemaker Giuseppe Benanti founded his namesake estate in the late 1980s, dedicating his life to the pioneering of Etna’s unique soils, microclimates, and native grape varieties. Fruit for the 2023 bottling is handpicked and vinified entirely in steel, yielding nutty and complex notes, with flavors of citrus, stone fruit, and volcanic ash on the palate. Featured here is the famous 1944 cover version by the Andrews Sisters. The Caribbean has been the cradle to many notable individuals of Sephardic and Ashkenazi Jewish heritages. Workplace trends       Pipeline
Estonia handed 20,000 students free ChatGPT accounts       As
employers increasingly demand AI fluency from new hires, Estonia
is getting ahead of the curve. Developed in partnership with
Stanford University and OpenAI, the country's AI Leap initiative
provides free ChatGPT accounts to all 10th- and 11th-graders. The
custom version is designed to guide rather than complete their
work. The move echoes Estonia's 1996 Tiger Leap, which digitized
the country's schools and is widely credited with giving rise to
Skype, Bolt, and Wise, according to the WSJ.       Protection
China's courts ruled that AI cannot justify firing workers
Employers in China now face a legal obligation to retrain workers
whose roles are automated, rather than simply letting them go.
The Hangzhou Intermediate People's Court ruled in April that
companies cannot terminate employees solely because AI has
automated their role, setting a precedent for how employers must
handle AI-driven workforce changes. With urban youth unemployment
at 15.3% in March, the pressure is on employers to reskill their
workers rather than lay them off, Bloomberg reports.       Access
Microsoft is testing a wearable AI badge for office workers
The office access badge is getting a technology upgrade.
Microsoft unveiled two concept devices at its Build 2026
developer conference: a small desktop cube and a wearable badge,
both of which let workers monitor and interact with AI agents
handling their tasks on the go. The BBC reports the devices are
currently being piloted by a few hundred Microsoft employees, as
Microsoft looks to move AI access beyond the screen.       Trust
Workers who trust their bosses adapt to AI better       Fear of
being replaced by AI is eroding workplace performance from the
inside. A University of Leicester study of over 16,000 employees
found that workers who trust their managers stay committed even
as AI reshapes their roles, while those who don't are more likely
to disengage. That means being upfront about which roles are at
risk, offering real retraining paths rather than vague
reassurances, and avoiding corporate euphemisms like "lower-value
human capital," the Economist reports.       Misfire       Amazon
shut down its AI leaderboard       Companies are learning that
measuring AI adoption by usage alone encourages the wrong
behavior. At Amazon, employees ran pointless tasks through AI
agents just to climb an internal ranking, driving up costs
without producing anything useful. Meta ran into the same problem
in April, shutting down a similar employee leaderboard for the
same reason. Amazon has since scrapped raw token counts in favor
of a metric that tracks AI-assisted work that actually delivers
results.

When to trust AI vs. your gut
By monday.com 
( https://clicks.mail.monday.com/f/a/acrHQVllqY75zCcObSAHyA~~/AAQRxRA~/8hQlSjWhYYBsI6F-gFl9NoVhsgJXlRjDc6sb6QLTGUcT55cLJhjSqt_UkHdVdgshwqkUXBQfexyrO2_nbsyjNplq4qCO4PMlufKwhCUd4ZsgXwA_VcRRSLp3LNu1X9PZi1xMTmb3QHGAKqj1HxJgTcAmnWj2mdpuBZYZg64PZ5_Xz3iABTmvgKKck8mBeR0uAHeCSXb8cGSFrPpFYQcsPRJv2x9aTCVglLRPTIvLwr8~ )
       AI can analyze data and generate recommendations in
seconds, helping teams move more quickly. But faster decisions
aren't always better decisions.

Both AI and human intuition have strengths and limitations. AI
can process large amounts of data, spot trends that humans might
overlook, and provide a level of consistency that's difficult to
achieve on your own. Human instincts, on the other hand, are
shaped by experience, relationships, context, and countless
observations that never make their way into a dashboard, but
remain equally valuable as hard stats.

body:
MalCare's Big 2026 Update:
--------------------------

###Vulnerability Shield

Each week new vulnerabilities are discovered and exploited within hours. But updates can take days to roll out. 

MalCare's Vulnerability Shield is the most precise defence for this gap: 


- **Instantly reads** all the vulnerable code 
- **Tests all **attacks that might happen  
- **Applies** a virtual patch to your firewall 


7000+ patches are now live, which have blocked over 650k attacks last month.

**⭐ How to enable?**
No setup needed, completely automated protection. 


- Free users: 7 day delay 
- Customers: No delay  
- Valid for all MalCare paid plans, and WPRemote's "Premium" plans.


[ Check Feature Page](https://r.mailer.malcare.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsE8LM2q11zctu09nYKtFK/Or4JQk1O26Qu "Visit Feature Page")


Most Precise Virtual Patches
----------------------------


Each patch is built from the actual code, not just the public alert. 

Our team traces the vulnerability across the entire codebase, finds every path a hacker can take, and blocks them all without touching legitimate traffic. 

Some early numbers —


- **Speed:**<6 hours patch time 
- **Quality: **40% higher attacks blocked versus competitors   
- **Coverage: **7000+ patches released already


Our team runs 100+ tests before declaring any patch "protective".


You can read more about this in this recent blog by Founder and CEO, Akshat Choudhary ⬇


[ See How We Build Patches](https://r.mailer.malcare.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsF30mRgnkBTEQ7oZCIMfS/QXJjn161P6CU "Read our launch blog")


Upto 5x More Attacks Blocked
----------------------------

Every week, we remove hacks from 100s of sites that have some security already, like Wordfence, Patchstack etc.

We didn't think much of it — no security is absolute. 

But building virtual patching has revealed some shocking gaps. 

Want to see the report? Reply "yes" and we'll send it over when it's live. 


Liked the newsletter? Have feedback? Prefer something different?
Hit reply and let us know. We read every single reply.

 

Team BlogVault

919 N Market St, 19801, Wilmington

"Hirsch is one of the most dramatic sites I have ever seen. Anywhere. The drive from Peay to Hirsch, with its dipping, curvy roads and spectacular views of the Pacific, is unforgettable. Don't worry about taking your cell phone. It won't work out here anyway. The sprawling estate covers 1,000 acres, of which 68 are under vine. David Hirsch's intuition to plant Pinot has turned out to be a divine inspiration, as this is without question one of the very best sites for Pinot Noir anywhere in California... Readers who haven't discovered the Hirsch Pinots owe it to themselves to do so. At their best, these are some of the most compelling wines being made anywhere in the world." - Antonio Galloni, Vinous

Sure, there are iconic expressions of Kistler, Kosta Brown, and Peter Michael, but there are also the pioneering terroir-driven wines of David Hirsch and his daughter Jasmine that helped redefine the American landscape for Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir. This is not Russian River Pinot Noir, nor is it Napa; absent here are the lusher fruit and higher alcohols, and you can say they built a reputation for creating ground-breaking (literally) Sonoma Pinot with structure and spine on the San Andreas faultline, overlooking the Pacific Ocean and absorbing the maritime influence. David Hirsch was the pioneer to plant in these extreme conditions and rugged terrain in the early eighties. It is now fair to say their flagship label, the Hirsch Pinot Noir San Andreas Fault, is a reference point of what American Pinot can be.​

If you appreciate the wines of Hirsch, you know that they are among the most allocated American Pinots, with the majority of the wines landing on the wine list of top restaurants scattered on both the Eastern and Western coastline. That is what makes this offering so special; thanks to Verve’s unique positioning, we are now able to share access to the flagship San Andreas Fault, along with some prized bottlings with rare depth and exceptional pricing. Carpe diem!

“how dare you sell $49 candles?!”Hi Dave,

**There are two stories that founders tell themselves that keep you in analysis-paralysis mode and avoid doing the sales activities that will ACTUALLY grow your biz.**

Which one are you stuck in? 

Story One: “I need to learn more about this industry before I can put myself out there and sell.”

**🌀 What it sounds like:** 

**“I need to learn more before I’m ready. I’ve got to update my packaging, my website, my sell sheet. I need to listen to another podcast episode, attend that educational webinar, walk the floor at the trade show, and join the networking group!”**

I see this one in women especially. And while YES, industry education is critical (I mean - there’s a reason why we’ve had over 3,500 founders go through our Retail Ready® program!), I see biz owners use this stall tactic for years!

Story Two: “I don’t want to bother people.” 

**😔 What it sounds like:**“What’s my long-lost best friend from high school going to think if she sees I’m posting about my $49 candles in THIS economy?!”  or “I’ve already sent two emails to that store. I don’t want to annoy the buyer by following up again.” 

 

I went live on Instagram yesterday and talked about these two stories that are keeping you stuck in sales.

Alli

********************
How rates impact you
********************

What’s all the fuss over rate changes? In short, a tiny
change could cost (or save) you thousands.

As interest rates go up, you’ll pay more interest each month for
your loan. If your projected payments become too high, a lender
may loan you less money for a home.

But as rates go down, the opposite happens — you’ll pay less
interest each month and may be able to borrow more (your
principal) for a home.

savings.  An informational graphic on a dark green background

------------------

Imagine you’re borrowing $300K on a 30-year
fixed-rate mortgage:

* At a 6.25% rate, your monthly principal and interest payment
will be about $1,849.
* But at a lower 6% rate, your monthly principal and interest
payment will be about $1,799.

That 0.25% rate decrease saves you about $50 a month, and after
30 years it will come out to around $18,000 less.

[Image description]

Dear %FIRSTNAME%,

For decades, gastronomy tourism has often been evaluated through
indicators of popularity such as visitor numbers, media attention,
celebrity chefs, Michelin stars, and social media visibility. While
these measures reflect awareness and reputation, they reveal little
about a destination's actual capacity to develop, sustain, and grow
its gastronomy tourism sector over time.

To address this gap, the World Food Travel Association has released
the GASTRONOMY TOURISM MATURITY INDEX, a first-of-its-kind study that
evaluates 84 countries across six dimensions: Heritage, Land,
Experience, Leadership, Stewardship, and Access.

[Image description]
[https://campaign-statistics.com/link_click/W66JXn-7pRYJvj-1tWOrX/827bedfcdaf2202baf70a003317ee1c0]

The Index was created to answer a simple but important question:

WHAT FAME DOESN'T MEASURE.

body:
Buy a Gift Card for Your Dad or Any Occasion!  https://www.milwaukeefoodtours.com/ Three Reasons to Book a Food Tour Today https://chicagofoodtours.com/ Dave, Twenty years ago, I walked down the street with a measuring wheel, calculating the distance between restaurants as I mapped out what would become our very first food tour. At the time, most people had never even heard the term "food tour." I wanted to create a way for people to experience the city through its stories, neighborhoods, and food. I never imagined that my hobby would grow into something this special. Today, I have the privilege of sharing the history, flavors, and people that make Milwaukee, Chicago, and Detroit such unique places to visit. Here are my top three reasons to join us on a food tour: 1. You taste the city, not just see it From iconic bites to local favorites, you’ll be introduced to the flavors that define a place, often in spots you wouldn’t find on your own. Withhot dogs and Italian beef https://chicagofoodtours.com/tour/iconic-foods-of-chicago/ in Chicago, our Iconic Tour showcases the foods that define the city. 2. It’s the easiest way to explore No planning, no reservations, no guesswork. We’ve mapped it all out so you can relax and enjoy. Discover the West Loop https://chicagofoodtours.com/tour/gateway-west-loop-restaurant-tour/ while tasting your way through some of our favorite neighborhoods. 3. You get the stories behind every bite Food is just the beginning. Along the way, you’ll hear the history, meet the people, and discover the community that brings each dish to life. After exploring Chinatown https://chicagofoodtours.com/tour/the-chinatown-adventure/ or enjoying our Street Foods of Pilsen https://chicagofoodtours.com/tour/tacos-tequila-tour-in-pilsen/ tour, you’ll leave with a connection to the city. Food tours are great to do with friends, family, or on your own. We offer food tours in Milwaukee https://www.milwaukeefoodtours.com/calendar/, Chicago https://chicagofoodtours.com/calendar/, and Detroit https://tourdetroit.com/. Book Today! And come hungry! Not ready to book? Consider buying a gift card https://chicagofoodtours.com/tour/tacos-tequila-tour-in-pilsen/ - a perfect Father's Day gift - or for any occasion! body:
What's the #1 thing that determines whether your YouTube video actually gets watched?

Most people say "the content."

But after 16+ years creating content on YouTube, here's the truth I've learned: The best video in the world does nothing if nobody finds it - & even when they do find it, nothing happens if they don't click.

That comes down to two assets that almost every creator underinvests in:

* Your **Short-Form Clips** - what gets your content discovered by brand-new viewers

* Your **Thumbnail** - what earns the click once they find your long-form video

Nail both, & you've solved the two hardest parts of growing on YouTube.

In today's Newsletter, I'm going to break down why these two assets matter more than almost anything else - & I'll show you how my team & I just made it possible to create BOTH from a single YouTube link. 🚀

_As a Reminder, Our Goal with this Newsletter is to Give You the Highest Level of Value Possible._ That's my Promise to you & I intend to Over-Deliver!

Here's a Sneak Peek at What's Inside This Email:

* The **Discovery vs. Decision** divide that explains why most great videos still flop

* Why your **Thumbnail** is the single highest-leverage asset in your content

* How **Short-Form Clips** became the #1 discovery engine on every platform

* The hidden cost that quietly kills most creators' consistency (& exactly how to fix it)

Alright, let's Dive In...

———————————————————————————

Youtube: You Can Now Create AI Shorts & Video Clips in ThumbnailCreator! (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s02NCF9qlqY)

Watch the Full Video on YouTube! (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s02NCF9qlqY)

———————————————————————————

## **The Two Jobs Every Piece of Content Has to Do**

Think about how someone actually becomes a viewer of your long-form content. It happens in two steps:

**Step 1 - Discovery:** They have to _find_ you. On today's platforms, that almost always happens through short-form video - a clip that shows up on their feed & stops the scroll.

**Step 2 - Decision:** Once they land on your long-form video, they have to _choose_ to click it. & that decision is made in about one second, based almost entirely on one thing: your thumbnail.

I call this the **Discovery vs. Decision** divide.

Most creators obsess over the video itself (the middle) & completely neglect the two things on either side that decide whether the video gets seen at all. Let's fix that.

———————————————————————————

## **Why Your Thumbnail Is Your Highest-Leverage Asset**

Here's something that took me years to fully appreciate: Your thumbnail is the single highest-leverage asset in your entire content strategy.

Why? Because it's the gatekeeper to _everything else._

You can pour 10 hours into filming & editing the perfect video - but if the thumbnail doesn't earn the click, none of that work ever gets seen. A great thumbnail can be the difference between a video that flops & one that takes off. Same content. Same title. Completely different results - just from the image people judge in a split second.

That's exactly why I built **[ThumbnailCreator.com](https://ThumbnailCreator.com)** - my AI YouTube thumbnail software. Instead of guessing, you paste your YouTube video, it analyzes it, & it automatically creates thumbnails trained on the top-performing YouTube thumbnails out there.

That's a big reason it's now used by thousands & thousands of YouTube creators - because it isn't "ask AI to make a thumbnail & hope." It's trained on what actually gets the click.

Si no puede visualizar bien este boletín haga clic AQUÍLima, jueves 18 de junio del 2026 Director General: Carlos Bernuy  PAM Hotels anuncia que UNICO 18°77° Hotel Montego Bay abrirá en diciembre 2026
Durante su reciente visita a Lima, Leonel Reyes, director para América Latina de PAM Hotels, compartió con Infotur Latam los detalles de la expansión de la marca UNICO Hotels y el lanzamiento de su tercera propiedad: UNICO 18°77° Hotel Montego Bay, el primero de la colección fuera de México. El ejecutivo explicó la filosofía de la marca, el crecimiento del segmento de lujo en la región y las oportunidades que representa Jamaica para el viajero latinoamericano.
Leer más Emirates lanza el seguro de viaje más completo del mundo
Emirates se ha convertido en la primera aerolínea a nivel global en ofrecer una Cobertura Integral de Viaje, un seguro pionero en la industria que centraliza todas las contingencias del viajero. Esta solución, desarrollada en colaboración con Travel Guard, busca brindar una tranquilidad total a los pasajeros desde el momento de la reserva, introduciendo coberturas de asistencia médica extendidas y soporte ante disrupciones operativas complejas.Leer más
La conectividad redefine la confianza en la experiencia viajera
La conectividad digital se ha consolidado como uno de los factores más determinantes en la experiencia de viaje moderna. Esta es una de las principales conclusiones extraídas del Foro Conect, celebrado de manera online el pasado 15 de junio, un espacio de reflexión y análisis en el que participó Antonio Santos, presidente del Tourism and Society Think Tank, junto a profesionales y expertos vinculados al ámbito turístico y tecnológico.Leer másMarriott International presenta Ask Bonvoy, nueva experiencia de búsqueda por IA
Marriott International anunció hoy el lanzamiento de la versión beta de Ask Bonvoy, una nueva experiencia de búsqueda conversacional en lenguaje natural diseñada para ayudar a los viajeros a descubrir de forma más intuitiva destinos increíbles en el portafolio de Marriott Bonvoy, que incluye aproximadamente 10 000 propiedades en 146 países y territorios. Ask Bonvoy está diseñado para ayudar a los viajeros a buscar alojamiento y planificar sus viajes mediante un lenguaje conversacional, ofreciendo resultados personalizados que les brindan experiencias inolvidables.
Leer más
La tensión geopolítica frena el crecimiento turístico internacional
El turismo internacional atraviesa una etapa de desaceleración en diversas regiones de Asia y Oriente Medio como consecuencia de la creciente incertidumbre geopolítica y del encarecimiento de los desplazamientos aéreos. La combinación de conflictos regionales, restricciones operativas en importantes corredores de transporte y el aumento de los costes de las aerolíneas está modificando los hábitos de viaje de millones de personas y afectando a algunos de los destinos que habían liderado la recuperación del sector en los últimos años.
Leer más
Miami Beach enfrenta una invasión histórica de sargazo
Las icónicas playas de Miami Beach atraviesan una de las temporadas más complejas de los últimos años debido a la llegada masiva de sargazo, un fenómeno ambiental que está alterando la imagen de uno de los destinos turísticos más reconocidos de Estados Unidos. Toneladas de esta alga marina han cubierto amplias franjas del litoral, modificando el paisaje habitual de arena blanca y aguas cristalinas que atrae cada año a millones de visitantes.Leer másSouthwest Airlines y Amazon Web Services (AWS) aceleran sus capacidades de IA
Southwest Airlines se asocia con Amazon Web Services (AWS) como su proveedor de nube preferido para modernizar su infraestructura tecnológica y evolucionar la forma en que la aerolínea opera, desarrolla y atiende a sus clientes. subject: Two Important Wins for D.C. Residents. The Work Isn't Over.
body:
Two Important Wins for D.C. Residents. The Work Isn't Over.

Dear Friend,

When people come together, change becomes possible.

This spring, SOME brought the voices of students, staff, partners, and supporters directly to the D.C. Council. And those voices were heard.

Two critical priorities. Two advocacy efforts. Real progress for our neighbors across Washington, D.C.

Give to Support Critical Needs [http://some.org/partnerships]                  CET · Workforce Education Funding

CET students stood before the D.C. Council and testified. They put a human face on the numbers, reminding decision-makers that adult education isn't a line item, it's a pathway to stable employment, economic mobility, and long-term independence.

Their voices helped move the conversation forward.

Give to Sustain Opportunity [http://some.org/partnerships]                  Jordan House · Crisis Stabilization Care

SOME staff and partners met directly with Councilmembers to protect funding for community-based psychiatric crisis care.

Their advocacy helped advance a recommendation to restore funding for these critical services, ensuring that D.C. residents experiencing mental health crises can continue receiving compassionate care in their community.

Give to Protect Care [http://some.org/partnerships]           What Comes Next

These victories matter. But they are only the beginning.

The funding process continues. Essential services remain vulnerable. And the people we serve still need champions willing to show up, speak out, and stand beside them.

Advocacy doesn't end when testimony is delivered or a committee vote is won. Lasting change requires persistence, partnership, and a community committed to returning again and again until every neighbor has the opportunity, stability, and support they deserve.

That's why your partnership matters.

Together, we're not just responding to today's challenges. We're helping shape a stronger future for Washington, D.C.

Will you help keep this momentum moving forward?

With gratitude and purpose,

All of us at SOME

subject: The most expensive sales mistake most women founders make
body:
buyers hate thisHi Dave,

Earlier this week I told you a story about a founder who pitched her snack line to me 15 years ago, but gave up after sending one email and not hearing back from me.

**Let me tell you about an opposite experience years ago, consulting on a HUGE opening of a new 80,000-square-foot retail store.** My role was to hire and train the category buyers, and lead them on product assortment, merchandising, and sales analysis through opening.

With the new buyers, I put together our product assortment, and booked meetings with potential brands, and we’d do full days of tastings and product evaluations with founders.

**There was one brand that I was particularly excited to meet with** - a new line of grain-free frozen dog food, and as a new dog mom myself - I had a personal interest in the meeting. I remember it so clearly.

Here's how the meeting went down:

**👋🏼** The founder sat down and the first thing out of her mouth was an apology: "

**Sorry for taking so much of your time today!"**

😅 Me, outloud: 

**“We’re excited to meet with you!”**

🤔 Me, in my head: 

**“Why is she apologizing? I wouldn’t have said yes to a meeting if I weren’t interested…”** 

**She literally apologized for pitching to me before she even started her pitch.**

Why am I telling you this story? Because I don’t want you to make your own version of this mistake.

I’d see this all the time.

🚫 The founder who’d start every phone call with “sorry to bother you.” 

🚫 The founder whose email would say, “sorry to take your time.” 

🚫 The founder who literally wouldn’t follow up after the meeting bc they didn’t want to bother me.

🚫 The founder who never circled back after I literally told them to reach out again after the holidays. 

🚫 The founder who got so in their head about when to follow up, and what to say, and how to say it, and how long to wait that they never took the next sales step.

**(and don’t get me started on how often it was women who doubly doubted themselves at each of these steps!)**

**These sales blocks cost you the account before you even get to the active “selling” part. **

The belief that selling is pushy is the most expensive belief you can hold - and every time you reinforce this belief, you give up your shelf space to a bigger, more funded, more confident brand who is out there doing sales in their sleep.

Collectively, that’s a lot of lost shelf space.

**So: sales is service. **

Doing sales action - pitching, following up, sending information, asking for what you need + closing the deal is wanted - and NEEDED - in this industry. 

**Permission to sell!**

Talk soon,

Alli

subject: How Valuable Is Your Time?
body:
You're sat in the coffee shop queue, watching the bloke ahead of you tap his contactless card against the machine. He's wearing a proper expensive suit, carrying a leather briefcase, looks like he's got _everything_ sorted.

"_That's what I want to be,_" you think. "_That's when I'll have made it._"

But here's what you don't see: that same bloke is stood there thinking, "_Once I get the promotion, once I pay off the mortgage, once the kids are sorted, THEN I'll start living._"

**We're all waiting for some magical moment when life finally begins.**

Jean-Paul Sartre once said: "I have led a toothless life. I have never bitten into anything. I was waiting. I was reserving myself for later on and I have just noticed that my teeth have gone."

There's a term for this madness: **Deferred Happiness Syndrome**. The feeling that your life hasn't begun yet, that everything you're doing now is just a prelude to some idyllic future.

But that future is a mirage. The closer you get, the further it moves away.

You tell yourself: "_Once I finish uni, life will start._" Then it's "_Once I get a proper job._" Then "_Once I buy a house._" Then "_Once I pay off the house._" Then "_Once the kids leave home._" Then "_Once I retire._"

**And suddenly you're 65, wondering where the bloody hell your life went.**

When are you going to arrive at life? When are you going to feel like you've made it?

That moment you're waiting for? **It DOESN’T exist.**

Remember being a kid and thinking 18-year-olds had everything figured out? Then you turned 18 and felt like a fraud. So you pushed the goalposts to 25. Then 30. Then 40.

Turns out, adults aren't some special class of people who have it all figured out. **We're all just children who've aged, each day trying to figure out what reality is.**

That person you think has it all sorted? They're just as confused as you are. They're just better at hiding it.

The woman with the corner office is wondering if she's in the right career. The entrepreneur with the fancy car is stressed about cash flow. The couple with the perfect Instagram feed had a massive row this morning about who forgot to buy milk.

**We're all just making it up as we go along.**

While you're waiting for your life to begin, you're missing the life that's happening RIGHT NOW.

**You're so busy planning for "**_**someday**_**" that you're not noticing today.**

That boring Tuesday you're having? Thirty years from now, you'd give everything to come back to this moment. To have your current health, your current energy, your current possibilities.

Your future self would KILL for your problems.

Think about it: what would you do differently if you knew this was as good as it gets? What would you do with today if you knew it was precious?

**You'd probably stop waiting for permission to be happy. You'd stop postponing the good stuff. You'd start biting into life instead of just licking around the edges.**

The entrepreneur who's waiting for the "_perfect_" moment to launch their business? They're missing the imperfect moment that's happening right now.

The dreamer who's waiting until they have more money, more time, more confidence? They're waiting for a train that's never coming.

Your life isn't going to begin tomorrow. It began the moment you woke up this morning.

You don't need to wait for the next promotion, the next relationship, the next milestone. You don't need to earn the right to be happy.

**You're already here. You've already arrived.**

The question isn't "When will life begin?" The question is "What are you going to do with the life that's already begun?"

**Stop waiting for your teeth to grow back. Start biting.**

Your dream isn't waiting for you to be ready. It's waiting for you to realise you already are.

– HelpBnk

** Adams Morgan Movie Nights Features Milk Thursday
------------------------------------------------------------

Adams Morgan Movie Nights (https://adamsmorgan.com/events/signature-events/adams-morgan-movie-nights) is a beloved community tradition that brings neighbors and visitors together under the stars for free outdoor film screenings.

This week in honor of 🌈Pride Month, we’re showing Milk, starring Sean Penn in his Oscar-winning portrayal of Harvey Milk, the first openly gay man to be elected to public office in California.

Last week’s screening of the Sitar Arts Center student films was rained out but the films will be condensed and shown before Kangaroo on June 25.

Weather note: We will monitor the weather Thursday and post updates on social media. The field is artificial turf and drains very well, so rain earlier in the day will not necessarily affect the screening.

Screenings begin after dark (30 minutes after sunset) and are free and open to the public. Guests are encouraged to bring a blanket, pick up a picnic dinner at an Adams Morgan restaurant, and enjoy a relaxing evening in one of D.C.’s most vibrant neighborhoods. Local restaurants offer takeout specials to pair with your movie night, making it the perfect way to support small businesses while enjoying a night out.  Visit our website (https://adamsmorgan.com/events/signature-events/adams-morgan-movie-nights) for a list of takeout specials offered in conjunction with the movies.
Update: Due rainouts, the series will be extended through July 2 (movie tbd).

Alcohol and pets are not allowed on the field during the movie.

Click here (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3SBUyt_u0rA) to watch a preview of the series.

This year's series is generously sponsored by Pepco (https://www.pepco.com/) , Lafayette Credit Union (https://www.lfcu.org/) , LIME (https://www.li.me/) , Events DC (https://eventsdc.com/home) , Wegmans (https://www.wegmans.com/) , and The Embassy of Australia (https://usa.embassy.gov.au/) .

⚠️ Adams Morgan restaurants: We will be encouraging patrons to get takeout from neighborhood businesses to bring with them to the movie.
Click here (https://forms.gle/1mWPNMMkp3idtXhr5) to submit your takeout specials for Movie Nights.


** Walk with Mayor Bowser in the Pride Parade

Mayor Muriel Bowser will once again lead the DC Government contingent in the 2026 Capital Pride Parade. The Mayor’s Office of LGBTQ Affairs and its Advisory Committee members (past and present), will join the Mayor, community leaders, and District agency partners in this annual Pride tradition.

Saturday, June 20: 2pm, Pre-parade meetup; 3pm Parade kickoff

** VENICE - ITALY
------------------------------------------------------------


** Venice, behind the postcards: An exclusive journey into the floating city's hidden history
------------------------------------------------------------

There is a distinct shift that happens when midsummer arrives: the sun lingers, the shadows stretch, and longer days mean longer dinner parties. En una era donde los viajeros buscan experiencias más auténticas y destinos fuera de lo común, surge una nueva generación de lugares que priorizan la conexión con la naturaleza, la cultura local y el espíritu de descubrimiento. Son lugares donde el lujo no reside en las multitudes ni en las tendencias virales, sino en la oportunidad de explorar paisajes vírgenes, vivir aventuras únicas y sentirse parte de un selecto grupo de personas que se han aventurado a llegar hasta allí..

Iberia ha estrenado sus vuelos directos entre Toronto y Madrid, reforzando la conectividad entre Canadá, España y Europa y consolidando el papel del aeropuerto Adolfo Suárez Madrid-Barajas como uno de los principales centros de conectividad entre América y Europa.

Royal Caribbean selecciona artistas famosos para Legend of the Seas
Royal Caribbean presentó el siguiente capítulo de su Programa de Descubrimiento de Artistas con su nueva generación de artistas emergentes a bordo del Legend of the Seas, el crucero ideal para las vacaciones familiares que debutará en julio de 2026 en Europa. Este verano, seis artistas del Caribe y Centroamérica presentarán obras de arte originales inspiradas en sus destinos a bordo del barco, plasmando el espíritu, el color y la cultura de la región de maneras innovadoras.

La pasión futbolera argentina también se juega fuera de la cancha. Según un estudio de Booking.com, 3 de cada 10 argentinos usan la misma camiseta para ver todos los partidos como parte de sus cábalas futboleras cuando viajan para ver a su equipo. La tradición de repetir ropa, lugar, compañía o rituales antes de cada encuentro forma parte de una costumbre profundamente arraigada entre los hinchas.

La industria turística de India se encuentra en pleno proceso de transformación y se prepara para una nueva etapa marcada por la búsqueda de experiencias más auténticas, personalizadas e inmersivas. Un reciente análisis sobre la evolución del sector apunta a que el país está dejando atrás un modelo centrado principalmente en los viajes de peregrinación para avanzar hacia una oferta mucho más diversificada, capaz de atraer a viajeros interesados en la cultura, la naturaleza, la gastronomía, el bienestar y las experiencias locales.

Los países de la Unión Europea han alcanzado un acuerdo para mantener las compensaciones económicas destinadas a los pasajeros afectados por retrasos significativos en sus vuelos, preservando uno de los mecanismos de protección al consumidor más reconocidos y valorados del continente.

subject: “You’re Alli from Bi-Rite, right?”
body:
🙄 Oh geez.Hi Dave,

“You’re Alli, from Bi-Rite, right?”

**A woman tapped me on the shoulder at an industry event last week, and told me how she pitched her snack line to me, 15 years ago, and I never brought her product line in.**

Yikes.

And yet - I’m gonna put the blame on her, not me! 

We chatted for a bit, and she shared she’s no longer in business because she “couldn’t get the hang of selling.” 

**She said she always felt like she couldn’t be authentic when she was selling, and that her anxiety around being too pushy, too annoying, and too high maintenance caused her to freeze. **

She made an INCREDIBLE product line, but was way more passionate about the product side than the biz side. Sound familiar? 

I’ve worked with over 3,500 brands at this point, and this comes up almost every week: founders who start a business bc of a passion but then realize they don’t actually love the sales and marketing side of things. I get it!

**And yet… if you don’t have sales, you don’t have a business.**

I went live on Instagram yesterday and shared more about my convo with that snack brand, 

**where she got stuck, and the trap I see most values-aligned founders make as you step into your crucial sales role (and how to fix it when you feel stuck).**

Click on through to watch the short video 

**(same video, just choose your platform!):**

**Posted on Instagram HERE** https://www.instagram.com/p/DZnxOe4SpFW/

🙏 

**And from one small biz to another - will you please like, comment, and/or share that video? **

I’m on a MISSION to help more underrepresented founders get the shelf space you deserve, and need your help amplifying my message! 

**Remember: your brand can’t grow if you’re the reason why nobody hears about it.** It’s time to shift! Here’s my recap video on **Instagram** https://www.instagram.com/p/DZnxOe4SpFW/ and **LinkedIn** https://www.linkedin.com/posts/aball_your-biz-doesnt-exist-without-sales-ugcPost-7472399979412606976-BKa3/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAAABl_JIBBJbCzpY98JOy5L3Zjvh2GdN6dxI. See you there!

Thank youuuuuuu,

Alli

Dear %FIRSTNAME%,

For decades, gastronomy tourism has often been evaluated through
indicators of popularity such as visitor numbers, media attention,
celebrity chefs, Michelin stars, and social media visibility. While
these measures reflect awareness and reputation, they reveal little
about a destination's actual capacity to develop, sustain, and grow
its gastronomy tourism sector over time.

To address this gap, the World Food Travel Association has released
the GASTRONOMY TOURISM MATURITY INDEX, a first-of-its-kind study that
evaluates 84 countries across six dimensions: Heritage, Land,
Experience, Leadership, Stewardship, and Access.

[Image description]
[https://campaign-statistics.com/link_click/wppvr8-7pRYJvj-zWUgq/bc7b4cc368b37ca151bea2026e9c6ab9]

The Index was created to answer a simple but important question:

WHAT FAME DOESN'T MEASURE.

Rather than ranking destinations based on popularity, the Gastronomy
Tourism Maturity Index assesses the underlying conditions that support
long-term gastronomy tourism success. The findings challenge
conventional assumptions and reveal that visibility and capability are
not always the same thing.

To help industry professionals understand the key findings, we have
published a complimentary Executive Summary that highlights the

subject: AI at Work: New Report on AI for Experience Operators, State of Experiences in ANZ
body:
It’s one of the most pressing questions for operators today: how do you get found by travelers using AI to search? Like social media and Google before it, AI is quickly turning discovery upside down.
The latest Trend Tracker report from GetYourGuide, produced in partnership with Arival, uses Arival’s Global Operator Landscape (4th Ed.) and 2026 Experiences Traveler research to get to the heart of this question, and offers a playbook for putting AI to work across your business. In today’s featured article , we dig into some key findings and top tips from that report.
Also, as some of our team jets off to Australia this week in preparation for next week’s Arival 360 | Brisbane event, a parting gift: our State of Experiences in Australia & New Zealand report is available right now for free! Check it out if you’re feeling the FOMO (or better yet, join us in Brisbane in person!)

Peace, Janelle

ARIVAL INSIGHTS

PARTNER ARTICLE:
How to Get Your Experiences Recommended by AI

GetYourGuide's Spring 2026 Trend Tracker report, based on Arival's Global Operator Landscape (4th Ed.) research, digs into how operators can ensure their experiences get surfaced by AI.
READ MORE

ICYMI: The State of Experiences in Australia & New Zealand
The latest report from the Global Operator Landscape research series shines a spotlight on the state and structure of the in-destination experiences marketplace in Australia and New Zealand. Available to Insider Free and Pro Access members.
READ MORE

TOP NEWS IN EXPERIENCES

1) Civitatis Expands in LATAM with Despegar Deal
Spain-based experiences OTA Civitatis has inked a deal with Latin America’s largest online travel agency, Despegar. Civitatis will offer its tour, activity and attraction listings via the Buenos Aires-based OTA.

2) Tripadvisor to sell TheFork to American Express for $700M
Tripadvisor Group CEO Matt Goldberg emphasized how the sale of the restaurant reservation platform would enable the company to focus more attention on its experiences strategy, as Viator has become the group’s “strategic anchor.”

3) How the World Cup 2026 Drives Travel Experience Patterns
Although the verdict is still out on how the World Cup is affecting tourism economies in host cities — with hotel bookings down ( except, apparently, Airbnb ) — GetYourGuide data shows experience bookings up around host cities, which presents an opportunity for operators positioned to take advantage of the increased interest.

4) Klook Launches Skypark Sentosa — Southeast Asia’s Tallest Dry Slides
Is it a slippery slope from OTA to experience operator? Perhaps: Asia-based OTA Klook is launching an attraction of its own: “Skyslides by Klook.” An OTA becoming an attraction operator is a strategic move worth watching — especially as OTAs now command 37% of experience bookings per Arival’s latest data .

For Father's Day This Sunday: Montepeloso. Fabio Chiarelotto Came to Suvereto as a Historian. He Left as One of Tuscany's Most Admired Winemakers

"Proprietor Fabio Chiarelotto continues to turn out some of the most riveting wines on the Tuscan Coast...Over the years, Chiarelotto has fine-tuned his approach by focusing on higher-quality sites for his top wines, picking earlier, and reducing the oak imprint significantly... [Those] who have not tasted the wines owe it to themselves to do so, as these are among the most compelling reds in all of Italy." - Antonio Galloni, Vinous​Fabio Chiarelotto arrived at the Montepeloso estate in 1998, a Swiss-Italian historian with a clear idea of what Tuscan terroir was capable of and an equally clear conviction that the previous owners had not yet gotten there. He overhauled the vineyards from the roots up (regrafting, retraining, replanting), accepting years of reduced production to get the raw material right. He planted higher on the hillsides to find freshness. He worked with oenologist Fabrizio Moltard, who came up through Frescobaldi and Angelo Gaja, and together they refined a house style that prioritizes elegance over extraction and freshness over density.​

The estate is 30 hectares, just 15 of which are planted. The other 15 are macchia - the wild coastal scrub of rosemary, thyme, lavender, and sage that covers the hillsides and perfumes the air. Fabio keeps it that way on purpose. It is not unused land; it is the source of Montepeloso's character. The soils beneath the vines are chalky clay and silex. The coastal winds cool what the Tuscan sun works hard to heat. That herbal, Mediterranean signature runs through every wine the estate makes: a fingerprint you can close your eyes and place.

Showcasing impeccable value and complexity for price, Montepeloso's Super Tuscan blends belong in your weeknight repertoire, and on your table this Sunday. Stock up below.

Montepeloso Toscana IGT 'A Quo' 2024$29.00 Regular $24.99 Special* Verve Wine Team: “A Quo is the door in. And what a door. The 2024 is built on Sangiovese (45%) and Cabernet Sauvignon (35%), with Malvasia Nera and other coastal varieties rounding it out. Fermented in steel, aged in neutral barriques, which is a deliberate decision and the right one. What you get is the fruit and the place: dark cherries, wild bramble, a herbal coastal note that the macchia lends to everything grown on this hillside, and a mid-palate tension that keeps the whole thing honest. James Suckling scored it 93 points and called it 'savory and delicious with lovely energy and drinkability.' Energetic, medium-weight, built for the table. Drink it alongside grilled lamb, pasta al ragù, or fabulous conversation."​Antonio Galloni, Vinous: “The 2024 'A Quo' is a terrific mid-tier wine in this range from Montepeloso. Dark-toned fruit, lavender, spice, menthol and licorice are pushed forward. A Quo offers an irresistible mix of bold fruit and vibrancy."​

https://sf.vervewine.com/collections/all/products/montepeloso-toscana-igt-eneo-2023

Montepeloso Toscana IGT 'Eneo' 2023$52.00 Regular $44.99 Special with no minimum quantity* Verve Wine: “This is Montepeloso's statement wine, and Fabio's answer to the question of what this coastal hillside does at its most considered. The 2023 is 65% Sangiovese, 30% Cabernet Sauvignon, 5% Malvasia Nera, spending 15 to 18 months in second- and third-year French oak and another 18 months in bottle before it reaches us. Bright ruby with purple reflections. Blackberry and cherry up front, followed by espresso, clove, leather, and that thread of wild coastal herb that is the Montepeloso signature. The tannins are fine-grained and well-integrated; the finish is long and harmonious. Critics have scored this wine consistently in the 93–95 range across recent vintages. The 2023 continues that trajectory. If you're opening it now, drink with a decant. If you're cellaring it, rest easy - this has time on its side."​Antonio Galloni, Vinous: “The 2023 Eneo is a terrific example of the house style these days at Montepeloso. Brisk and vibrant in the glass, with gorgeous fruit purity, Eneo is an absolute delight. Floral overtones extend the vibrant, brisk finish. This really opens with a bit of aeration. Best of all, Eneo is also very fairly priced for an artisan wine of this level."​

Workplace trends     Transformation    IKEA cut
AI-assisted design time from 6 hours to 30 minutes     The shift
reflects a broader rethinking of how AI changes labor beyond
efficiency. Room-design sessions that previously required six
hours of a staff member's time now take around 30 minutes,
freeing workers for higher-value customer interactions, according
to Ingka Group's chief digital officer. The company has also
completed AI literacy training for 40,000 of its 160,000
employees, with the goal of helping coworkers redirect their time
toward work that meaningfully adds value rather than being
consumed by repetitive tasks.     Rewiring    Companies spend 93
cents of every AI dollar on technology and just 7 cents on people
Most companies are pouring money into AI tools while
underinvesting in the humans who use them. That imbalance, cited
by Deloitte's vice chair of technology, may explain why the gains
remain so concentrated: a PwC study found that just 20% of
companies capture nearly 75% of AI's total economic value. The
organizations closing that gap aren't necessarily spending more
on technology. They're spending more on helping employees
understand it, trust it, and use it well.    Shift    Anthropic's
head of Claude Code hasn't written code by hand in eight months
That detail, shared at Fortune's Brainstorm Tech conference,
captures how dramatically AI is changing knowledge work.
Anthropic says Claude Code is now 100% written by Claude Code
itself, and major enterprise clients are trending the same way.
The broader implication extends beyond software: when AI handles
execution, the value of human work shifts entirely to judgment,
decision-making, and knowing what to build in the first place,
according to Fortune.

AI changed the work. Shift your focus from
process to outcomes.    By monday.com 
( https://clicks.mail.monday.com/f/a/HimSBEwCPf5HUrfkCn1Wow~~/AAQRxRA~/NDQ7pzS1S38jWw9ZIq0NZJbsJzGpWeEISq6iDh4oGcxc02hTbtrlYwAiUVwjYplPT92g5qMADXzlGhVuWqW3f3BE1BCZOJQdDdsNfZ5ZWbzUnGNjF4orhy9OWL7AiBVJvWhsPnCrHKPEB9KJyqeRwcAu03OiXtLCTKA7pXU2Ny1qlqGdMjxNfJTH-Hj-fwvOrPuKffY3V_j0UQXtsyP9QCCzJ7Z4itEHn4oPym1o-bs~ )
     As AI becomes more integrated into daily workflows, the
definition of an optimal process is changing fast. While AI is
removing, accelerating, or reshaping many tasks, some employees
are still learning how to think beyond the way they've always
worked – which limits their potential.

To truly reap the benefits of AI, you need to help your team get
past those mental barriers.

While many companies are working toward becoming AI-first, most
leaders underestimate what that transformation actually requires,
according to Greg Boone, CEO of Walk West and author of the
upcoming book AI at the Speed of Trust. Because Greg is a leading
expert in AI-driven processes, we recently sat down with him to
learn more about optimization – and he had a lot to say about
changing mindsets. "It’s about becoming agentic by design,” he
said. “Not simply using AI tools.”

The organizations that benefit most from AI won't simply
automate existing processes. They'll redesign them around the
outcomes they want to achieve. Every process on your team was
built around assumptions about how work gets done. AI gives us a
reason to revisit those assumptions, eliminate unnecessary steps,
and create workflows that deliver better results. "AI prioritizes
outcomes," Greg explains. "Which means it's time to reimagine
what our processes look like."     So, how can you help your team
rethink their process with AI?    Help employees reimagine their
role     One reason AI adoption can feel uncomfortable is that
employees often connect their value to specific tasks, workflows,

Black Tie Ball next week: Dance to live music after dance lessons at a magnificent 1912 Tudor mansion in the heart of DuPont Circle as you meet ICDC members and make new friends. 

TOMORROW: Embassy of China Gala Evening, Dinner, & Celebration of Chinese Festivals: Join us on your own or with friends at one of Washington’s most distinguished diplomatic settings. Don't miss this extraordinary celebration of Chinese culture featuring a dinner buffet of Chinese delicacies, live folk music, dance performances, and cultural experiences. Only a handful of reservations remain. Reserve now!


FRIDAY: Experience the magic of a tropical island paradise! Join us at the Embassy of Sri Lanka for Dinner & Garden Soiree with the Ambassador of Sri Lanka. 


You are cordially invited to our exclusive garden soiree under the stars as you indulge in authentic Sri Lankan cuisine with live music & dance performances. Discover Sri Lanka for your next overseas adventure!

The Tiny “No Frills” Artisan of Castelnuovo dell’Abate Delivers a “Grand Cru Like Expression of Montalcino” With Silk, Elegance and Power.

"There is something magical about the 2021 Brunellos...Stated simply, 2021 is a triumph for Montalcino… Beyond the complex, high-energy, incredibly successful 2021s." - Eric Guido, Vinous​"Andrea Cortonesi reflects the best of the artisan spirit in Montalcino. The Uccelliera wines are rich, layered and beautifully textured." - Antonio Galloni

We appreciate the quote above on the 2021 releases from Montalcino, and once again, it could not be more fitting after experiencing the 2021 Uccelliera Brunello di Montalcino. And like the mind-blowing Gianni Brunelli Brunello and Pieve di Santa Restituta, we preached about a few months back, what may surprise you is just how good the young 2021 Uccelliera is drinking today! Absolutely stunning right from the pull of the cork and improves after an hour or more of aeration. It may shut down in the future, and yes, it will get better with bottle age, but it is singing today! So inspired, we are now presenting a limited allocation of the 2021 Uccelliera Brunello di Montalcino with some of the best pricing! On top of that, the Brunello di Montalcino has arrived and is ready to ship!​As you know by now, Mother Nature simply blessed Italy’s prized regions of Barolo, Bolgheri and Montalcino with a classic vintage that we have not seen since 2016. In particular, the Sangiovese-based wines of Chianti Classico and Brunello di Montalcino seem to have best captured the essence of the more classic vintage. In the case of the 2021 Uccelliera Brunello di Montalcino, it is marked with more freshness, energy, charm, and texture (fine tannins with high acidity) than the riper 2020, or the more austere and structured 2019s. Well, today we return to this Verve Wine signature.​

The cult-like estate is more of a “no-frills,” small farmhouse purchased by Andrea Cortonese in 1986 than an estate. It is here on the southern tip of Montalcino in Castelnuovo dell’Abate, right next to the prized Pianrosso plot of Ciacci Piccolomini, and two kilometers from Poggio di Sotto, that the wines of Uccelliera naturally express their richer profile of Sangiovese, with supporting depth to complement the ample texture of fruit. With its heady aromatics and concentration, there is a deceiving approachability and appeal that cannot be denied – they have the delizioso facto – and the 2021 can be enjoyed today! With that velvety concentration, there is elegance and balance – Burgundian-like in its texture and fruit purity, while remaining rustic. And while pan-seared duck breast may be synonymous with Burgundy and Pinot Noir, this is a Brunello that is so generous and easy to drink, we are rethinking the signature pairing.

JetSMART cumple cuatro años de operaciones en el Perú, consolidando una etapa de crecimiento sostenido en uno de los mercados más dinámicos de la región. Desde el inicio de sus vuelos en junio de 2022, la aerolínea ha fortalecido progresivamente su presencia en el país mediante una estrategia enfocada en la conectividad, la eficiencia operacional y el acceso a tarifas competitivas.

La decisión forma parte de una estrategia preventiva destinada a reducir los riesgos de propagación de enfermedades infecciosas a través de los flujos internacionales de viajeros, en un contexto marcado por la creciente movilidad global y por la preocupación de los organismos sanitarios internacionales.

Turismo Responsable convierte tus viajes en experiencias responsables
Viajar sigue siendo sinónimo de descanso y desconexión, pero hoy es cada vez más difícil ignorar el impacto que dejamos al hacerlo. Nadie quiere llegar a un destino soñado y encontrar una playa saturada de plástico o un pueblo que perdió su identidad por el turismo masivo. Por eso, elegir destinos y proveedores conscientes ya no es una postura filosófica o de nicho, sino una necesidad práctica para asegurar que los lugares que nos gustan sigan existiendo tal como los conocemos.

Aticama, el paraíso de ostiones y mariscos en Nayarit
Los mariscos son una opción deliciosa, saludable, accesible y muy popular entre los amantes de la comida, en especial cuando se consumen frescos a orillas de las mejores playas del país como en Aticama, un pintoresco pueblo costero ubicado en el municipio de San Blas, en el estado de Nayarit.

body:
Information to keep your Viator account secure      Viator 
( http://b2click.viator.com/f/a/G4Hhult5SdHpEo_STfO9Qg~~/AAQRxRA~/ZJbfQgGa2GomjDSqRj-fDBDiGXn-1v3hOuso5DxYD0RAETi6IValzeHOYjcggWpt99FqsXd0jZKf-_6ewDsSl0kIbN1GspS55OEddlOyV9GrSpZdfbni_3LKqLlpz4U6zePdUFdRUvDBWxxUWTgwwCB5Deyywm7XtF679VL__cA~ )
       Hello,

As high season approaches and scams across the travel industry
continue to rise, Viator is committed to helping you stay
protected. Please take a moment to review this important
information from our Trust & Safety team to help keep your Viator
supplier account secure.

Increase in phishing scams targeting suppliers

Over the past few weeks, some of our tour and experience
operators have reported an increase in phishing scams targeting
their Viator accounts.

In many cases, these phishing scams involve emails that include
links to fake websites. These websites are designed to look like
the Viator Supplier Portal and prompt you to log in, allowing
scammers to capture your credentials, including two-factor
authentication (2FA) codes.

Important: The only legitimate supplier login page is
supplier.viator.com ( http://b2click.viator.com/f/a/8KJtgcIKcfkRXefsD6h__g~~/AAQRxRA~/mF3ZiyMKD3GQxpPZri2YnCQQ1NLEQMM5DJwndl_XO0crH8LTRgFNsx4-aRzMcCf651Hm0IrWFBQJ97t99YJNzczsdy20d8IzJ_ghPn824TVG7I8LuCOPOoQWY3lrU3iL ) . Always verify the web address before entering your login
credentials.

If you receive a suspicious email or encounter a website
impersonating Viator, please report it to our support team 
( http://b2click.viator.com/f/a/rgh6U4O-RZqp8OYb8SvKvA~~/AAQRxRA~/TC5YZP5FQT75v-XtMvRlHmgbK_D41liAicQKcxQPApc_CwjD41GHvox5WOsvYwhdW8Gt71MpG6AmqaqvJ5nuFYFGENVEPDib2Md8JUXe0CiUZEy9EXl6ef6H4h-mhyk1YhMCbRWfzpbhe27dRESbvFfURGZvoh-Q9orAk3I2Bz0~ )
 immediately. Do not reply to the message or enter any
information on the site.

In terms of what to look out for, phishing messages may ask you
to:

* Share banking or payment card details to continue receiving
payouts
* Respond to a formal complaint allegedly filed by a traveler to
prevent account suspension or restrictions
* Confirm recent customer bookings or payout activity
In summary: if a message creates a sense of urgency around
payouts, account suspension, or booking verification, that's a
good cue to slow down.

Learn more best practices on how to avoid phishing scams here 
( http://b2click.viator.com/f/a/1TIU5jdmkLpCCo3MOXxCsg~~/AAQRxRA~/_Yv3XtwTI3nZuZEM5-5IPReo0FxWf1PjJyR3e1ZtKd7UlWeDp9iRMyKAOb9ekIn2ZkYg49411Ah76Kb4IlQnz5G0lGGZekbP9OphHe6dwrbylgBRqTQtclAa3iEEpahzwKS3YkWqWnUsn97s09YKAtbF6Lii-HrS5r8Yau5TbxDbdFJXqgABQMq_1l8QIe4w77k4vywZ58kl_KjI7nUbOLhFYeRHIfpy2aSa1Zgzk50~ )
.

Need help or want to report suspicious activity?

subject: FREE Upcoming Events: Pride Parade, Caribbean Cultural Concert, and more!
body:
Upcoming Events

District of Pride Showcase flyer  

*_District of Pride Showcase_*

Celebrate 20 years of LGBTQIA+ leadership at the signature Pride Month talent showcase! The Mayor’s Office of LGBTQ Affairs (MOLGBTQA) proudly presents the District of Pride Showcase. Hosted at the historic Lincoln Theatre, this one-night-only experience brings together art, performance, and community in a way only the District of Pride can.

*Date*: Wednesday, June 17

*Time*: 6pm Doors open, 7pm show begins

*Location*: Lincoln Theatre – 1215 U St NW

*RSVP*: tinyurl.com/DOPShowcase2026 [ https://tinyurl.com/DOPShowcase2026 ]

 

________________________________________________________________________

 

Walk with Mayor Bowser in the Pride Parade  

*_Walk with Mayor Bowser in the Pride Parade_*

Mayor Muriel Bowser will once again lead the DC Government contingent in the 2026 Capital Pride Parade. The Mayor’s Office of LGBTQ Affairs and its Advisory Committee members (past and present), will join the Mayor, community leaders, and District agency partners in this annual Pride tradition.

*Date*: Saturday, June 20

*Time*: 2pm Pre-parade meetup, 3pm Parade kickoff

*Location*: 14th Street and U Street NW

*RSVP*: https://s.dc.gov/MMBPride2026

 

________________________________________________________________________

 

Flavors From My Barrio Flyer  

*_Flavors From My Barrio_*

The Mayor’s Office on Latino Affairs (MOLA) is teaming up with local Latino restaurants to celebrate culture, strengthen community, and boost our local economy!

With this year’s "Flavors from My Barrio" coinciding with the World Cup, participating restaurants will host watch parties for all competing Latin American teams, including Colombia, Paraguay, Argentina, Uruguay, Ecuador, Brazil, Mexico, Panama, and the United States.

*Date*: June 11 – June 27

*Time*: Various

*Location*: Various

*RSVP*: https://s.dc.gov/MOLAFlavors2026

 

________________________________________________________________________

 

*_FY27 Violence Prevention and Response Team (VPART) Grant Pre-bidders Conference_*

Ahead of the FY27 Violence Prevention and Response Team (VPART) Grant, the Executive Office of Mayor Muriel Bowser (EOM) invites all prospective grant applicants to a Pre-Bidder’s Conference. Topics will include grant eligibility, application guidelines, budget preparation, and compliance requirements. Engage with EOM staff in a Q&A session for valuable insights on the application process. We look forward to your participation!

*Date*: Tuesday, June 23

*Time*: 2pm

*Location*: 899 North Capitol St NE, Bloomingdale Room

*RSVP*: https://s.dc.gov/FY27VPARTConference

________________________________________________________________________

 

*_Veteran Resource Symposium: Housing_*

Join the Mayor’s Office of Veterans Affairs (MOVA) for the monthly Veteran Resource Symposium, held every last Thursday of the month. This symposium will provide information on available housing resources, support services, and guidance on how Veterans can access these opportunities.

*Date*: Thursday, June 25

*Time*: 12pm

*Location*: 441 4th St NW Room 1117

*RSVP*: https://s.dc.gov/MOVAHousing

________________________________________________________________________

 

*_Caribbean Certified Business Enterprise (CBE) Workshop_*

The Mayor's Office on Caribbean Community Affairs invites you to a workshop designed to guide Caribbean-owned DC businesses on the path toward becoming Certified Business Enterprises (CBEs). Discover how CBE certification can open new opportunities, support business growth, and increase access to District contracting opportunities.

*Date*: Thursday, June 25

*Time*: 5pm

*Location*: 899 North Capitol St NE

*RSVP*: https://s.dc.gov/CaribbeanBusiness

________________________________________________________________________

 

Caribbean Cultural Concert Flyer  

*_Caribbean Cultural Concert_*

The Mayor's Office on Caribbean Community Affairs (MOCCA) and the D.C. Caribbean Carnival, Inc. present the 4th Annual Caribbean Cultural Concert.

This event will engage the extraordinarily diverse Caribbean Diaspora with celebrations highlighting the beautiful and vibrant culture of the Caribbean.

*Date*: Friday, June 26

*Time*: 4pm

*Location*: Sycamore & Oak – 1110 Oak Dr SE

*RSVP*: tinyurl.com/CaribbeanConcert2026 [ https://tinyurl.com/CaribbeanConcert2026 ]

body:
Hey Dave,


Here's a quick video on this month's newsletter, followed by 3 ideas to *Stay
ahead of the summer slowdown*, *Pressure-test your AI visibility*, or *Buy
back time for your team*-


<https://8-04.na1.hs-sales-engage.com/Ctc/41+23284/8-04/Jl22-6qcW7lCdLW6lZ3pHW7pl8dF5rRnBMVKVCdk81lTyVV8Gw6H7FwSqzW7K4PGC7kz3BRW64Zwm87hrj_MW5csVgF6jjNMNN50Mcfbvf3f_W7j2jVm47fWrCN1vcwc-yxgFwW961n4d5gPfkgN16JhSJFcwbtW37BD7r89wtYnVXjB0180SsRmW2R34gz8_8p5KW63Vn5y7q50_XW2dWwRT6kLvpjW7ykn3r8-sww6W1YkC7y7XpPh_W5mqkSK1lLvDbN1_fwJxm-NF3N4WdXqX3ffRYW2WG9lB8dY10dW9hmKF-4vLNBfN5-mdDSs8tvbf3tML_K04>




Put your Prospecting Agent credits to work

If you're on a Sales Hub, your team has Prospecting Agent credits included,
and this is a great time to use them on high-intent accounts instead of
letting them sit idle.


*The goal is simple:** let the agent monitor for buying signals, surface
the right leads, and tee up timely outreach*
<https://8-04.na1.hs-sales-engage.com/Ctc/41+23284/8-04/Jll2-6qcW7Y8-PT6lZ3pTW8Ss7KK1x8vjvVsKb9v3YPB5ZW1MHHTS6VFtHCW9fNjDD7zb-2BW24851M75p__KN9h7jTnT81BnW3QLnrL5k17brW5xq-YH49lN55W3MWYQQ7XFBB-W7Ps9GC6P235zW1rmPR43C-BX4W8FxMCg2rDdhfW4y2qWZ1-mxc9VxtBLc4-QYbbW8PfJXw8nSy46W83Ny0f4pg8ypW6Rdnj53CRBnYW6QLrzQ6srl-5W7f0ckW1pM99bW3MB_gW6NdGQyW5qdFGF2lbMn1W1kFCY77YRlRJW5Rg41s2rxvqFW9hRvN-3mPDD2W2r1pYZ1DB9XgW1GbDgp7QJWSvf9387C-04>
so your team can spend less time researching and more time selling.


A simple starting point:



   -

   Pick a narrow list of target accounts
   -

   Let Prospecting Agent watch for signals
   -

   Focus your reps on the leads it recommends first

Pressure-test where demand may be leaking

A lot of businesses are seeing traffic and traditional search performance
shift
<https://8-04.na1.hs-sales-engage.com/Ctc/41+23284/8-04/JjT4YGXpW50kH_H6lZ3lWW6y2j_C80VP3nW77N6gh6MtkjKW8D8y4l16RsB8W7KjfqG3rWZrTW8dvwzL25D4-XN41bXqsLD-DGVtZHdd3fc4fqW92sSRR46p4tdW9f29fJ6kQ4fCVSGQj86sMPm_W2qGYG648mjwXW2w87Nz81frx6N3XygdmCl94xVlyS1K89JjwyW8L3kHg1rcwB1W45WGxv34XNMyW86DTBh1RN2glN1dptlKgf6V_VnCl0p7kd38YW4wfRj_1GL606W8gJz_X9lFfYXW2X2VNq7_TBsSW6djKrc3CmvVXW7LlrV_8RTX5bW8cCK3Y6CjPJVVJ4Clv2gy7Q7W6M9KbS1J8974W2j4gRM2LYcT-W6MxF9q60z1bwW21GQJ23td435W4T653s3HTY_cW64MTlg4QkjG1f8LKwRR04>,
even when they are still investing in content and marketing.


That is why now is a good time to look at AI visibility
<https://8-04.na1.hs-sales-engage.com/Ctc/41+23284/8-04/JlY2-6qcW95jsWP6lZ3mdW2S2KzG5Y_zQyW7lhQ-x7TnWzmW4FVBXc8c-TCjW8cxJH94LXKNdW7p_kfK74h1LCW5Ny7cw8lYCkXW82z_X-5LjrBrW2QGQ9085tSFhW7bX8tY75M5p8W2RyxR53mXBJwW4vJqM12P7f07W5Bw0hh18DmLvN7lY59GzVWW4W37hBmB51dpmpW5GZDCK68n7Z8VVMsc06d4nmXVZW_j76yRRm8N4x4DwhxFzHzN7vRzcd8Q4K3W8R8htM7NFdJ_W28jRpm6WZ3xYW5Drlw43y3w7jW1Nk5m07_tP1dV8HWfC47yLPCN3QNsWClhFnqW27tk7t8ZQ5rnW1J1ShN4B_cnrW5KkR8z3hrKqHV-SvC73cJn-qW6_MtFy7BDkBvf7zcT2n04>,
too. If prospects are discovering vendors through AI search and
recommendation engines, you want to know whether your brand is showing up
and where you may be missing demand.


Even a quick check can help you spot gaps before they become pipeline
problems. *Shoot me a note if you'd like me to run some additional tests on
your company.*


Buy back time for your team

Summer is often not a true “slow season” for operators. It is more like
planning season, catch-up season, and scramble season all at once.


If your team is stretched thin, this is a good moment to automate the
repetitive work you can with your available HubSpot credits:



   -

   handle repetitive follow-up/automate first line customer service
   <https://8-04.na1.hs-sales-engage.com/Ctc/41+23284/8-04/Jll2-6qcW7Y8-PT6lZ3lWW3PrY2J8FyBn7W6n3Y5Y6PCzy2W4p6zlb3BJvlDW7H4LFr28d1lpN1pWlzgKDgz3W5bmvrH5mtD8dW6RSkx_5PQwdsW6b1QLH7j2_nzW52r7sc7nsjVbN2ZW-b86HxxKW8KTC9d8CCHsSW6Hc7ty5J3tjsW2RJsRR893RVYW1czpb_8DRxNlVbSgfW22k_JwW6PKlDT572nC0W2z9ddF4wM07kW30HKNT2QxKCLMK04PYr8R0qW6CnDkK4jPqvbW3tcdZN833SkvW2d8X6h9dqh--W9gJ60g36jkhdW3LMZsc2_S52XVl2t1t6kHXWjW3nsX96602yG8f3psTX204>
   -

   capture and qualify after-hours leads
   <https://8-04.na1.hs-sales-engage.com/Ctc/41+23284/8-04/JlF2-6qcW8wLKSR6lZ3kyW173dN74Hwv52W8S9pCW6VJ85NN3-8N4hccHLgW8DMW1-1ZCJxmW7fBcVm6HGF6mW9ghjXf4qL2btW19z93L1Zm1MPN3V_gYT6Z2tmW5nB21L5jHQWKW8qRtYh20MJYjW95Gdh685TW1bW4GRx6s83xfqvW1_g8hR6mrwP3W6hj8r61C7zKgW1fDk9s1r3YZsW1ZNnrw3Wt8_GW5dTqCC3s5B7wM4z6b9cW3_gW8C_Jbp92TNVnN64ysyqDGyg6W9hSdfH22d8m9W1jT75m60Wf4SW7gW1My5mgncPW8NswpP7sFtRwW8Gfkf6437WWbN5gkHJ78T0cjN5_mZGX1JSVYV7pDmm3sTGSsf5w13Qv04>




The best summer play is not always “do more.” Sometimes it is creating more
room for the team you already have.


Thanks for the time, and have a great June!


Colin




P.S. I’ll be sending out a short update each month with HubSpot changes
that could be useful for your team. You can always reach out to me directly
or use the resources I share here to stay up to date on what’s available in
your account.




Colin McIntosh

Growth Specialist
