Si no puede visualizar bien este boletín haga clic AQUÍLima, lunes 15 de junio del 2026 Director General: Carlos Bernuy  Inauguran el JW Marriott Ranthambore Resort & Spa, la propiedad 10 mil de la cadena
Marriott International anunció hoy la apertura de su propiedad número 10,000 a nivel mundial, el JW Marriott Ranthambore Resort & Spa, marcando un hito histórico para la compañía a medida que se acerca a su centenario.
Leer más Emirates: “El A380 sigue siendo una enorme fuente de beneficios”
Emirates mantiene intacta su apuesta por el Airbus A380 pese al encarecimiento del combustible y al giro de buena parte del sector hacia aviones bimotores más eficientes, como el A321XLR. El presidente de la compañía, Tim Clark, ha defendido su rentabilidad al asegurar que “estos aviones siguen siendo una enorme fuente de beneficios”.
Leer más  Oceania Cruises destaca sus itinerarios por el norte de Europa en 2027
Oceania Cruises invita a los viajeros a descubrir los espectaculares paisajes, las ricas tradiciones culturales y los destinos costeros menos explorados del norte de Europa a bordo de sus íntimos y lujosos barcos, que ofrecen una forma relajante y elegante de experimentar esta cautivadora región.
Leer másIATA lanza campaña de seguridad para pasajeros “Salva una vida, no una maleta”
La Asociación Internacional de Transporte Aéreo (IATA) anunció hoy el lanzamiento de «Salva una vida, no una maleta», una campaña de seguridad para pasajeros que insta a los viajeros a no llevar equipaje de mano durante la evacuación de un avión.
Leer más Distrito de Cayo: El santuario de la historia y la naturaleza en Belize
El Distrito de Cayo es el corazón verde de Belize y el epicentro de la aventura, la arqueología y el ecoturismo en el país. A diferencia de las costas y los famosos cayos marinos, el Distrito de Cayo se ubica en la región occidental (hacia la frontera con Guatemala) y destaca por su geografía montañosa, sus selvas tropicales, ríos caudalosos y una impresionante concentración de vestigios de la civilización Maya.
Leer más
Las celebridades transforman el marketing del turismo mundial
Las grandes compañías turísticas, corporaciones hoteleras, empresas de cruceros y líneas aéreas han intensificado de manera drástica su dependencia de prominentes figuras del cine, los deportes, la televisión y las artes para liderar sus estrategias globales de publicidad.
Leer másSKY Airline cumple 25 años con más de 80 millones de pasajeros transportados
SKY Airline conmemora 25 años de trayectoria a nivel regional, reafirmando el compromiso estratégico del holding con la conectividad, la eficiencia y la democratización del transporte aéreo en Sudamérica. La historia de la compañía comenzó el 3 de junio de 2001 y, desde entonces, ha sostenido un crecimiento constante que la ha posicionado como una de las aerolíneas más relevantes de la región. Actualmente, con operaciones en Chile y Perú, SKY transporta a más de 8 millones de pasajeros al año, consolidando un modelo que acerca a más personas a la posibilidad de volar.
Leer más Sandos Caracol Eco Resort Eleva el Lujo Todo Incluido con Experiencias de Bienestar
Sandos Hotels & Resorts, reconocida marca hotelera todo incluido, invita a los viajeros a descubrir una nueva dimensión del bienestar en Sandos Caracol Eco Resort. En un contexto en el que el lujo contemporáneo se redefine a través de la presencia, el equilibrio y las experiencias significativas, la propiedad ofrece un entorno donde desacelerar, reconectarse y abrazar una auténtica sensación de bienestar se convierte en parte integral de la estancia.Leer más
Turismo de montaña se consolida en 2026El turismo de montaña hoy ya no es un nicho para aventureros solitarios, tal y como lo aprecian los principales turoperadores y agentes de viajes a nivel global.
En 2026, se convierte dicha modalidad en una de las franjas de más rápido crecimiento de la industria mundial de viajes, con un aumento del 18 por ciento en la demanda respecto al año anterior, según el último reporte de la Alianza Mundial de Turismo de Naturaleza.

Choix, el municipio más norteño de Sinaloa, es un pueblo donde la vida sigue ocurriendo con calma. Rodeado por montañas de la Sierra Madre Occidental, es uno de los 12 Pueblos Señoriales del estado y se ha posicionado como una de las joyas ocultas de México.

Issue 448 // Institute InBrief
Dear null,

Welcome to Edition 448 of Institute Inbrief.

In this edition, we are delighted to introduce AIPC’s new Graduate Diploma of Behaviour Therapy. Designed for professionals seeking to deepen their understanding of human behaviour and behaviour change, this innovative qualification explores evidence-based approaches that support positive outcomes across a range of helping professions.

With a strong focus on ethical, rights-based and person-centred practice, the course prepares graduates to deliver behaviour support across disability, education, community services, mental health and allied health settings. As demand grows for practical, research-informed strategies to address behavioural, emotional and lifestyle challenges, behaviour therapy continues to play an increasingly important role in contemporary practice. Together with our recently launched Graduate Diploma in Neuro-Affirming Practice, this new qualification reflects AIPC’s ongoing commitment to providing contemporary, evidence-based education for helping professionals.

A 2019 meta-analysis reviewing 96 studies found that psychiatric conditions are considerably more prevalent among autistic individuals compared to the general population (Lai et al., 2019). This crisis highlights the importance of shifting to a neurodiversity-affirming approach in mental health practices.

The neurodiversity paradigm, as defined by Walker (2021), recognises neurological variations, such as autism, ADHD, and dyslexia, as natural and valuable forms of human diversity. Rather than viewing these differences as “deficits” to be fixed, the neurodiversity paradigm challenges this outdated framework, promoting acceptance and understanding of how neurodivergent individuals navigate the world (Dallman et al., 2022). This perspective calls for moving away from pathologising language and instead focusing on creating environments where neurodivergent individuals can thrive based on their unique strengths and support needs (Moses, 2023).

Neurodiversity advocates are consistently championing acceptance and inclusion, advocating for a fundamental shift in how mental health is understood and approached. For counsellors, this shift demands more than awareness – it calls for adopting neuroaffirming practices that validate and support neurodivergent clients. Neuroaffirming counselling moves away from conventional therapeutic goals of ‘conformity’ and ‘normalisation’ instead focuses on embracing the neurodivergent client’s unique strengths and specific support needs. In a field that prides itself on inclusivity, adopting neuroaffirming practices is not just important; it is essential for creating truly safe, supportive and empowering therapeutic environments for neurodivergent clients.

# The New Platform Playbook

Here's how I think about being early on ANY ad platform. Three steps.

**Step 1: Get In Before It's Comfortable.** The whole value of a new platform is the cheap attention & thin competition I covered in the last email. That advantage exists ONLY while it feels a little uncomfortable & unproven. Comfort is the signal that the window is closing. So the move is to get in, start small, & start learning while it's still early.

**Step 2: Lead With Your Message, Not Your Targeting.** On mature platforms, targeting has been refined for years & the algorithm does a lot of the heavy lifting. On a brand new platform, the algorithm is still learning - which means YOUR message has to do more of the work. The advertisers who win early are the ones with a clear hook & a compelling offer, not the ones obsessing over targeting settings. Get your message right & you can often outperform others with stronger targeting but a less compelling message.

**Step 3: Test Small, Then Scale the Winners.** Repetition is key. I've said this before & it's never been more true than on a new platform. Don't try to nail it on attempt one. Get in, test a few angles, find what resonates, then pour fuel on what works. The early data you collect now becomes your unfair advantage later.

Here's the part that doesn't change, no matter the platform.

Whether it's YouTube, Facebook, or ChatGPT Ads, a high-converting ad still follows the **H.E.C. Formula:**

* **Hook** - Grab attention immediately by speaking directly to the problem or desire your ideal client has.

* **Educate** - Give real value & demonstrate why you're the one to solve it. Give before you ask.

* **Call to Action** - Tell them exactly what to do next.

The platform is new. Human psychology is not. The businesses that bring a proven message framework to a brand new platform are the ones that win the **Ground-Floor Window.**

** Ottawa Life Magazine’s Travel Platform
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.traveltrektour.com/allcontent/why-alabama-deserves-a-spot-on-your-travel-map


** The state that took me by surprise
------------------------------------------------------------

When I mentioned I was off to Alabama, the customs agent paused, curious.

I couldn’t blame him — most people don’t realize how much this state has to offer.

From soulful music and coastal cuisine to beaches that sparkle like powdered sugar, Alabama is a destination that is ready to be explored.
Why I can’t wait to return (https://www.traveltrektour.com/allcontent/why-alabama-deserves-a-spot-on-your-travel-map)


** Did you know this?
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.traveltrektour.com/allcontent/why-alabama-deserves-a-spot-on-your-travel-map#You%20don%E2%80%99t%20have%20to%20go%20to%20Mexico%20to%20experience%20sugar-white%20sandy%20beaches.

You don’t have to go to Mexico for white sand beaches

Alabama is a beach vacation destination (https://www.traveltrektour.com/allcontent/why-alabama-deserves-a-spot-on-your-travel-map#You%20don%E2%80%99t%20have%20to%20go%20to%20Mexico%20to%20experience%20sugar-white%20sandy%20beaches.) , with turquoise waters, exciting watersports, and endless relaxation.
Learn more (https://www.traveltrektour.com/allcontent/why-alabama-deserves-a-spot-on-your-travel-map#You%20don%E2%80%99t%20have%20to%20go%20to%20Mexico%20to%20experience%20sugar-white%20sandy%20beaches.)
https://www.traveltrektour.com/allcontent/why-alabama-deserves-a-spot-on-your-travel-map#Mardi%20Gras%20is%20a%20Mobile%20first!

The city where everything was “Born to Celebrate”

Mobile, Alabama, is the birthplace of Mardi Gras (https://www.traveltrektour.com/allcontent/why-alabama-deserves-a-spot-on-your-travel-map#Mardi%20Gras%20is%20a%20Mobile%20first!) , with squares, museums, parades and music to show for it.
Learn more (https://www.traveltrektour.com/allcontent/why-alabama-deserves-a-spot-on-your-travel-map#Mardi%20Gras%20is%20a%20Mobile%20first!)


** The Alabama Science Experience
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.instagram.com/reel/DZYDll3PSBX/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==
Discover the Exploreum (https://www.instagram.com/reel/DZYDll3PSBX/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==)

If you’re looking for a new destination that has an interesting history, delicious food and relaxing nature,Alabama is the spot for you (https://www.traveltrektour.com/allcontent/why-alabama-deserves-a-spot-on-your-travel-map) !

Dan Donovan

From being the home state of “America’s Amazon”, family-friendly astronaut training camps, to an elite food scene, Alabama has something to offer every traveller.

https://www.traveltrektour.com/allcontent/why-alabama-deserves-a-spot-on-your-travel-map#You%20don%E2%80%99t%20have%20to%20go%20to%20Mexico%20to%20experience%20sugar-white%20sandy%20beaches.

Pristine beaches for cheaper

Imagine crystal-clear beaches with endless outdoor activities and opportunities for relaxation…
Learn more (https://www.traveltrektour.com/allcontent/why-alabama-deserves-a-spot-on-your-travel-map#You%20don%E2%80%99t%20have%20to%20go%20to%20Mexico%20to%20experience%20sugar-white%20sandy%20beaches.)
https://www.traveltrektour.com/allcontent/why-alabama-deserves-a-spot-on-your-travel-map#Who%20knew%20that%20grits%20were%20so%20tasty?

The foodie paradise people miss

Alabama isn’t just home to grits but also to several affordable Michelin restaurants. You can even try lemonade whisky (https://www.traveltrektour.com/allcontent/why-alabama-deserves-a-spot-on-your-travel-map#Does%20whiskey%20really%20go%20well%20with%20lemonade?) !
I want to try! (https://www.traveltrektour.com/allcontent/why-alabama-deserves-a-spot-on-your-travel-map#Does%20whiskey%20really%20go%20well%20with%20lemonade?)

------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.instagram.com/p/DUtvQtDEY0C/
Discover Ecuador’s Top Stay (https://www.instagram.com/p/DUtvQtDEY0C/)

If you’re looking for an experience to share with avid travellers in a state ready to embrace tourists, Alabama is the spot for you!

** A Night of Music, Hope, and IMPACT!
------------------------------------------------------------

Music has always had the power to bring people together.

On June 5, it did something even more remarkable. It helped bring a community together to rebuild hope.

Photography Courtesy of: Jennifer Botros - Sojourning Studio Photography (https://www.instagram.com/sojourningstudiophotography/?mc_cid=bf65ffabcf&mc_eid=UNIQID)

Thanks to the incredible generosity of our supporters, the Benefit Concert featuring Cade Thompson (https://www.cadethompsonmusic.com/?mc_cid=bf65ffabcf&mc_eid=UNIQID) was a truly unforgettable evening.

Hosted by STSA Church (http://www.stsa.church/?mc_cid=bf65ffabcf&mc_eid=UNIQID) and produced by IMPACT Collective (http://www.impactcollective.com/?mc_cid=bf65ffabcf&mc_eid=UNIQID) , the event welcomed 285 attendees from across the Washington, DC region who gathered around a shared purpose:

Rebuilding the St. Abanoub School campus in Zambia after devastating floods damaged the classrooms and learning spaces children rely on every day.

The night was filled with inspiring music, meaningful connections, powerful stories, and a collective spirit of compassion. Through his uplifting message and performance, Cade Thompson, who has toured with Chris Tomlin, TobyMac, and Michael W. Smith, reminded us all that hope grows when people come together to serve something greater than themselves.

Because of your support, we are thrilled to share that the event raised more than $80,000 toward the rebuilding effort.

But the Story Isn't Finished Yet

We are now just $20,000 away from fully funding the project and restoring a safe, nurturing environment where children can learn, grow, and thrive.

Every gift, no matter the size, helps move us closer to the finish line.

Help Us Complete the Mission

Together, we can fully fund the rebuilding of the school and make a lasting impact on the lives of these children and their community.
Donate Today (https://www.paypal.com/ncp/payment/76YM4RG4LGUG4?mc_cid=bf65ffabcf&mc_eid=UNIQID)

To everyone who attended, donated, volunteered, sponsored, prayed, and shared this mission with others, thank you. Your generosity is helping transform a tragedy into an opportunity for hope, healing, and a brighter future.

Together, we are rebuilding more than a school. We are rebuilding hope for the future.

With gratitude,

Eddie Fam

subject: Biosafety Cabinet for Laboratory and Pharmaceutical Applications
body:
Biosafety Cabinet for Laboratory and Pharmaceutical Applications

Dear Sir or Madam,

I hope this message finds you well. I am Biona from Anne Parker.

In laboratories and pharmaceutical facilities, maintaining a safe and contamination-free working environment is essential for personnel protection, product integrity, and regulatory compliance.

Our Biosafety Cabinets (BSC) are designed to provide reliable protection for operators, samples, and the environment, making them ideal for microbiological research, pharmaceutical manufacturing, biotechnology applications, and clinical laboratories.

Key features of our Biosafety Cabinet:

  • Class II Biosafety Cabinet design
  • High-efficiency HEPA filtration (99.99% @ 0.3 μm)
  • Inward airflow for operator protection
  • Vertical laminar airflow for product protection
  • Low noise and energy-efficient operation
  • Microprocessor control system with real-time monitoring
  • Stainless steel work area for easy cleaning and disinfection

Benefits for your facility:

  • Protect personnel from hazardous biological agents
  • Minimize sample contamination risks
  • Maintain a clean and controlled working environment
  • Support GMP and laboratory biosafety requirements
  • Improve operational efficiency and safety

Our Biosafety Cabinets are widely used in pharmaceutical laboratories, vaccine production facilities, microbiology laboratories, hospitals, research institutes, and biotechnology companies.

We can provide customized solutions based on your laboratory layout, local electrical standards, and certification requirements.

If you are planning a laboratory upgrade, expansion project, or equipment replacement, we would be pleased to provide a suitable Biosafety Cabinet solution and competitive quotation.

Please feel free to share your requirements for further evaluation.

Looking forward to your reply.

Best regards,

Biona

Welcome to ADL’s Campus Alert: for the latest news, analysis and resources that affect students so you can stay informed and make your voice heard.

👉 NOTE: With the school year ending at most universities across the country, ADL’s Campus Alert newsletter will be on hiatus for the summer and will start up again with the next school year. We are very appreciative of you and all of the readers who have come to rely on the Campus Alert to stay up to date about news affecting Jewish students and faculty.

📰 Top Stories

NYU. There has been an arrest after an 
https://click.adlmail.org/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MDJ9AAEAAAAAAK0fFUmYPTeGC2DReIWlxHagV1GThbUmpHNejS5JDkduP14qIYOZC2iZ5vOdHnA_O4RqrdXRfTUrHVf_9_UGVIGuFLkzcPA3WOebRw 
ugly anti-Israel incident  at New York University marred graduation celebrations. Alexander Stepnowsky, who was an NYU student at the time, admitted to flying a flag depicting swastikas and a Star of David over NYU’s Steinhardt building. An NYU representative firmly criticized the incident, saying “the symbols that were represented are antisemitic and hateful to every person of conscience… we will immediately pursue our disciplinary procedures, which carry the most severe consequences.” 
https://click.adlmail.org/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MDJ9AAEAAAAAAK0fFUmZwNkkqHw6-8CqhUAwE79si5D3VE1K9PsF-StTMtoj2L6V_1x0UsLzSRIrd8-DZjxIfh5prOdwUjKbYHDfP0VTdqIDH1LIDw 
ADL offered support  to the campus community after the incident and praised the prompt arrest by the NYPD.

The hateful flag at NYU. (Source: Yezen Saadah/NYUNews.com)


 ~~~~~

CU Boulder. Boulder Students for Justice in Palestine (SJP) published a horrendous and hateful statement on the one-year mark after the 2025 Boulder firebombing attack on a peaceful march in support of the 10/7 hostages. They

praised  convicted terrorist Mohamed Sabry Soliman and called for his release, justifying his actions as a legitimate response to the situation in Israel. ADL 
https://click.adlmail.org/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MDJ9AAEAAAAAAK0fFUmbD07az-jfiyM4LJ-SKgGWSpcbGuys0uMYGRv5Ln6_914zPEupEY-JkMCNMAkA55P2donAHmYUg0KPPAvKlixTCgZOKqF5BQ 
condemned  the post as “beyond reprehensible,” noting that while communities were mourning Karen Diamond, who died from injuries sustained in the attack, and showing solidarity with the 28 others who were injured, SJP chose to glorify the attack. The University of Colorado Boulder also 
https://click.adlmail.org/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MDJ9AAEAAAAAAK0fFUmc155345xshftYANwdVdy8yvo8NMSGqf1b3vkV8wpKPyuuDDAKJ4C3WBvziOdo_mlZQ8I_6LjADEdFe6J7sR7ydbWBRuNLTQ 
denounced  the post, stating that “glorification of violence is abhorrent.” The university confirmed that the hateful post is being reviewed by school officials and reiterated that SJP is not a recognized student organization due to previous violations. The University of Colorado Board of Regents also 
https://click.adlmail.org/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MDJ9AAEAAAAAAK0fFUmdezZsgQjq14T0V7cUhXPX1SEK3ypsipNO6Dd-cJQNJAW2aA6Fj5Q8KWVi5-ROQPJZ3vytiugGpo9MzHj0v3ccZmn_LBSLvA 
adopted  a resolution condemning those who condone antisemitic violence, stating that “harming and killing innocent people is not resistance.”

After the deadly Boulder firebombing. (Source: Getty Images)

Zárate is that small artisanal Spanish producer we had been searching for years. Little of their wine was made, little arrived in the US, and what did arrive was poorly handled. Newsletter Infotur Latam 11-06-26
Si no puede visualizar bien este boletín haga clic AQUÍLima, jueves 11 de junio del 2026 Director General: Carlos Bernuy  Regent Hong Kong entre los primeros ganadores del Triple Corona de Condé Nast Traveler
Regent Hong Kong se encuentra entre los primeros ganadores del premio Triple Corona de Condé Nast Traveler, una distinción excepcional que reconoce a un selecto grupo de hoteles cuya excelencia ha perdurado a lo largo del tiempo.
Leer más LATAM Airlines Perú entre las 10 mejores empresas para el talento
LATAM Airlines Perú fue reconocida en la posición 9, ubicándose entre las 10 mejores empresas para atraer y retener talento en el país, de acuerdo con el Ranking Merco Talento 2026. Asimismo, la compañía mantiene por duodécimo año consecutivo el primer lugar en la categoría transporte aéreo.
Leer más
Explora Journeys y Fórmula 1 lanzan el Gran Premio de Mónaco Louis Vuitton
La adrenalina a raudales se fusionó con la refinada elegancia oceánica el jueves por la noche en Port Hercule, donde Explora Journeys organizó la fiesta de inauguración oficial del GRAN PREMIO DE MÓNACO DE FÓRMULA 1 LOUIS VUITTON 2026 a bordo del EXPLORA I. De regreso al Principado durante su fin de semana más emblemático por segundo año consecutivo, la marca de viajes oceánicos de lujo ha consolidado su presencia, transformando su barco en el epicentro definitivo del glamour, el deporte y el entretenimiento.
Leer más"Todo pasa por Armenia", nueva campaña que destaca todos sus atributos
El Ministerio de Comercio, Industria y Turismo, a través la ministra Diana Marcela Morales; el Fondo Nacional de Turismo, Fontur; la Alcaldía de Armenia; Corpocultura; y Fenalco Quindío, presentaron oficialmente «Todo pasa por Armenia», una campaña que busca transformar la percepción de la ciudad y consolidarla como la base desde donde se conectan las principales experiencias turísticas del departamento..
Leer más Boom mundialista: crecen más de 200% las búsquedas de vuelos desde Perú
A días del inicio del Mundial, se disparó el interés del viajero peruano por los paquetes vinculados al fútbol y los grandes eventos deportivos. Según datos de Airbnb, las búsquedas de vuelos desde Perú hacia Miami, una de las principales sedes, aumentaron más del 200% respecto al año anterior, lo que convierte a los peruanos en uno de los segmentos de mayor crecimiento del turismo deportivo regional.
Leer más
Impulsan cambios para fortalecer el turismo de compras en Argentina
Con el objetivo de estimular la llegada de visitantes extranjeros y generar un mayor movimiento económico en distintos puntos del país, fue presentado en el Congreso argentino un proyecto de ley que propone ampliar el régimen de devolución del Impuesto al Valor Agregado (IVA) para las compras realizadas por turistas internacionales. La iniciativa busca actualizar una herramienta que durante años fue considerada un incentivo relevante para el turismo receptivo y que, según sus impulsores, podría contribuir a mejorar la competitividad de Argentina frente a otros destinos de la región.
Leer másSouthwest Airlines inicia una alianza de colaboración con Singapore Airlines
Southwest Airlines y Singapore Airlines (SIA) se han asociado para ofrecer a los viajeros de todo el mundo viajes con un solo billete desde y hacia Estados Unidos, conectando con destinos a los que vuelan Southwest y Singapore Airlines. Los ejecutivos de Southwest anunciaron la alianza durante la Asamblea General Anual de la Asociación Internacional de Transporte Aéreo (IATA) en Brasil.
Leer más The St. Regis Hotels & Resorts y Drake’s colaboran para el Día del Padre
St. Regis Hotels & Resorts anuncia hoy una colaboración con Drake’s, la firma londinense de moda masculina reconocida por su elegancia informal y su artesanía de larga tradición, con motivo del Día del Padre. [Producer highlight](https://ny.vervewine.com/products/tiberio-cerasuolo-dabruzzo-2023)

Calling All Red Wine Lovers - The Rosato That Drinks Like a Light Rosso. Tiberio's Benchmark Cerasuolo d'Abruzzo Is one of Italy's Most Compelling Pink Wine, and it Is Here for Under $25

"The 2024 Cerasuolo d'Abruzzo is impossible to ignore. It has a vivid, perfumed bouquet of black cherry and wild blueberry, complemented by sweet lavender tones and hints of spice. This possesses amazing complexity and inner perfume. (...) This is not to be missed." - Vinous, Eric Guido

We are always searching for that rare pink wine that commands serious attention, not because it shouts, but because it whispers with authority. Cerasuolo d'Abruzzo is not Provence. It is not pale, polished, or predictable. It is a category unto itself, and no one makes it better than Cristiana Tiberio.​The Tiberio estate sits 350 meters above sea level in the hillside village of Cugnoli, 23 miles inland from the Adriatic coast of Pescara. Founded in 2000 by Riccardo Tiberio after he discovered a plot of 60-year-old Trebbiano Abruzzese vines too remarkable to ignore, the estate evolved under the stewardship of his daughter Cristiana and son Antonio into one of Italy's most exciting and meticulous producers. Cristiana, a trained chemist who also teaches enology and sommelier classes, brings a scientist's precision to every decision in the vineyard and cellar.​The 2024 vintage presented extraordinary challenges. A spring frost stunted vine growth, followed by the driest year on record. Canopies were minimal. Bunches were tiny. Cristiana made the bold and deliberate decision to forgo the 2024 Montepulciano d'Abruzzo across all labels, channeling every last gram of that fruit into a single, exceptional Cerasuolo. The wine carries the full weight of that decision, and the result is a wine of unusual concentration and depth for a rosato, the product of scarcity and resolve in equal measure.​The wine is produced from 100% massal-selection Montepulciano grown in limestone-rich soils with full southern exposure. Unlike conventional rosé, which is made from red grapes with minimal or no skin contact, Cerasuolo d'Abruzzo is a true rosato, meaning the grapes undergo a more deliberate and extended cold skin maceration. This is what produces its signature deep cherry color and the structural depth more commonly associated with a light red than a pink wine. Only free-run juice is collected, then fermented in stainless steel with indigenous yeasts and no malolactic fermentation. No fining. No filtration. The wine is bottled as it is​This is precisely the kind of find we live for at Verve Wine. A wine that defies category. A wine that pairs with grilled branzino as comfortably as it does with bistecca. A wine that opens the summer season with conviction. And it arrives at $24.99. FEATURED WINE: The Rosato Tiberio Cerasuolo d'Abruzzo 2024

It pours a striking deep cherry-fuchsia, darker and more commanding than any rosato has the right to be at this price. The nose is generous and perfumed, with layers of wild strawberry, blood orange, ripe cherry, dried rose petals, pomegranate, and crushed herbs. It feels more like a fine red in its concentration and structure. On the palate, it is taut, vibrant, and precise, with refreshing acidity and a mineral backbone that elevates every sip. Rhubarb and spice emerge mid-palate, and the finish lingers with a gentle chalky grip. This wine pairs with everything the city has to offer, from raw bar and branzino to charred lamb chops at your favorite West Village table. body:
In the last email, I told you that ChatGPT Ads are open & that I'm hosting a free live workshop to show you how to set them up.

Today, I want to make the case for WHY this matters so much - because if you understand **The First-Mover Math,** you'll never look at a new platform the same way again.

As a Reminder, Our Goal with this Newsletter is to Give You the _Highest Level of Value Possible._ That's my Promise to you & I intend to Over-Deliver!

Here's a Sneak Peek at What's Inside This Email:

* ✅ The 3 advantages that ONLY exist on a brand new ad platform

* ✅ Why "early" beats "better" almost every time in advertising

* ✅ How to claim your spot on the ground floor of ChatGPT Ads this June 18th

Alright, let's Dive In...

———————————————————————————

# The ChatGPT Ads:

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/ad34a858-ebd8-4217-935e-6497f4e21902/Screenshot_2026-06-04_at_9.23.03_am.png?t=1780589933)

Caption: _Save your spot for the FREE ChatGPT Ads Workshop Here!_

Click Here to Register for the FREE ChatGPT Ads Workshop! (https://site.adoutreach.com/chat-gpt-ads-workshop)

———————————————————————————

# The 3 Advantages That Disappear Over Time

When a new ad platform opens, there are three things that are true at the very beginning - & all three slowly vanish as the platform matures:

**1. Attention is Cheap.** Early on, there aren't enough advertisers to bid up the cost. You're reaching people for a fraction of what it'll cost in a year or two.

**2. Competition is Thin.** Your ideal client isn't being hit by ten competitors at once. You get to be the first voice they hear in a new place - & being first builds trust in a way that being the tenth never does.

**3. The Platform is Hungry.** New platforms WANT advertisers. They reward the early ones with reach, with favorable treatment, & with a real chance to grow alongside them.

Here's the key insight: every one of those advantages is temporary.

I watched it happen in real time with YouTube Ads. The advertisers who showed up in the early days locked in cheap attention & built audiences that compounded for years. The ones who waited until it was "proven" walked into higher costs & a crowded room.

Claim Your FREE Spot For The ChatGPT Ads Workshop Here! (https://site.adoutreach.com/chat-gpt-ads-workshop)

———————————————————————————

# Early Beats Better

This is the part most business owners get wrong.

They wait until a platform is "proven." They wait for the case studies. They wait until it feels safe.

But by the time something feels safe, **The Ground-Floor Window has already closed.** The cheap attention is gone. The competition has arrived. And the advantage now belongs to the people who moved while everyone else was waiting.

I'm not saying be reckless. I'm saying recognize the pattern - because this exact pattern has repeated on every major platform, & it's repeating again right now with ChatGPT Ads.

———————————————————————————

# You Don't Have to Figure This Out Alone

The good news? You don't have to be the one who burns time & money figuring out what works on a brand new platform through trial-and-error.

That's exactly why I got early access, ran the experiments, & I'm packaging up what's working into a single FREE live workshop.

I'll share my screen & walk you through it all - live.

### More Value Coming Your Way

In the next email, I'm going to actually teach - I'll share what my team & I have learned about what's working on ChatGPT Ads so far, & the framework I use to think about advertising on ANY new platform.

To Your Success,

** Adams Morgan Movie Nights Features Sitar Arts Center student films Thursday.
------------------------------------------------------------

Adams Morgan Movie Nights (https://adamsmorgan.com/events/signature-events/adams-morgan-movie-nights) is a beloved community tradition that brings neighbors and visitors together under the stars for free outdoor film screenings.

This week we’re partnering with Sitar Arts Center (https://www.sitarartscenter.org/) to present the 12 winning films from their third annual student-produced Set in DC Film Festival.

Weather note: We will monitor the weather Thursday and post updates on social media. The field is artificial turf and drains very well, so rain earlier in the day will not necessarily affect the screening.

Screenings begin after dark (30 minutes after sunset) and are free and open to the public. Guests are encouraged to bring a blanket, pick up a picnic dinner at an Adams Morgan restaurant, and enjoy a relaxing evening in one of D.C.’s most vibrant neighborhoods. Local restaurants offer takeout specials to pair with your movie night, making it the perfect way to support small businesses while enjoying a night out.  Visit our website (https://adamsmorgan.com/events/signature-events/adams-morgan-movie-nights) for a list of takeout specials offered in conjunction with the movies.
Update: Due to the week 1 rainout, the series will be extended through July 2 (movie tbd).

Alcohol and pets are not allowed on the field during the movie.

Click here (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3SBUyt_u0rA) to watch a preview of the series.

This year's series is generously sponsored by Pepco (https://www.pepco.com/) , Lafayette Credit Union (https://www.lfcu.org/) , LIME (https://www.li.me/) , Events DC (https://eventsdc.com/home) , Wegmans (https://www.wegmans.com/) , and The Embassy of Australia (https://usa.embassy.gov.au/) .

subject: Private California farm retreat, September 2026
spam_reason: [Possible Spam | role=promoter_or_vendor] Sender (Tomer from Grassfed) is promoting their own multi-day farm retreat catering to clients and inviting Mangia DC to engage without asking for a service or booking. The direction of intent is clear as the sender is the host, not the customer.
body:
Hi there,

I'm Tomer, co-founder of Grassfed, a cannabis hospitality company in LA. We're running our first multi-day farm retreat this September and I figured it might be a fit for the kind of clients you work with.

Some background: we've hosted Hash Flight, a monthly hash tasting in LA, for over two years. Same format as a wine tasting, applied to hash. The retreat takes that idea on the road. Five days through the Emerald Triangle, September 9 to 13, with guided tastings and on-farm education at every stop. These are private farms that aren't open to the public: Luma and Moon Valley in Sonoma, Huckleberry Hill in Southern Humboldt (home of Whitethorn Rose), Emerald Queen up in Trinity County, and Hash and Flowers.

A certified Ganjier leads the program, basically a sommelier for cannabis. Everything's included: chef-prepared meals, transport from San Francisco, lodging at the Ganjier Campus plus a night at Strawhouse Resort on the Trinity River.

Tickets run $2,999 to $3,999, and there's a referral commission on confirmed bookings.

If this sounds like something your clients would be into, just reply. Happy to share more or set up a quick call, whatever works.

Tomer Grassiani
Grassfed

body:
Newsletter Infotur Latam 10-06-26
Si no puede visualizar bien este boletín haga clic AQUÍLima, miércoles 10 de junio del 2026 Director General: Carlos Bernuy  Wyndham Hotels & Resorts anuncia su llegada al Valle del Cauca en Cali
Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, la compañía de franquicias hoteleras más grande del mundo, con más de 8.400 hoteles en más de 100 países, anuncia el desarrollo de Wyndham Residences Cali Renova, un innovador proyecto que marcará la llegada de la marca al Valle del Cauca y fortalecerá su presencia en Colombia. La presentación y lanzamiento oficial del proyecto se realizará mañana a las 6:00 pm en la ciudad de Cali.
Leer más MSC y Air France admiten tener interés en Easyjet
Empezó siendo una excentricidad de Castlelake, un fondo de inversión que vio en Easyjet una ganga de 3.600 millones de euros que bien merecía un sondeo y hacer un poco de ruido. Después de eso, Castlelake y MSC, la naviera suizo italiana de la familia Aponte, contactaron. Y desde ese momento las noticias se han sucedido.
Leer más
Seven Seas Prestige con excepcional enriquecimiento epicúreo en tierra y mar
Regent Seven Seas Cruises, la línea de cruceros de ultralujo líder en el mundo, invita a los amantes de la gastronomía a satisfacer sus pasiones epicúreas y demostrar su talento culinario a bordo de su nuevo barco, Seven Seas Prestige. Basándose en un concepto introducido por primera vez en los exitosos barcos de la Clase Explorer de Regent, la Cocina de Arte Culinario debutará en Seven Seas Prestige con experiencias gastronómicas inmersivas que conectan a los huéspedes con los destinos a través del sabor, la historia y la narrativa.
Leer másTripadvisor anuncia premios Travelers' Choice 2026 para los mejores hoteles del mundo
Tripadvisor, la plataforma de viajes líder en el mundo, anunció hoy a los ganadores de sus premios anuales Travelers’ Choice Awards: Best of the Best Hotels, y el GH Universal Hotel de Indonesia obtuvo el codiciado título de Mejor Hotel del mundo.
Leer más Estados Unidos impulsa visados rápidos mediante tarifa adicional
Estados Unidos pondrá en marcha un nuevo programa piloto que permitirá a determinados viajeros acceder a entrevistas para visados de turismo y negocios de manera acelerada a cambio de una tarifa adicional de 750 dólares. La iniciativa, diseñada para reducir los tiempos de espera en algunos consulados y embajadas, introduce una modalidad de tramitación preferente que busca ofrecer mayor flexibilidad a quienes necesitan viajar con rapidez al país norteamericano.
Leer más
Guía de viaje para el Mundial: Lo que no incluye tu entrada
La Copa Mundial de la FIFA 2026 ha comenzado oficialmente y se celebrará en 16 ciudades anfitrionas de Estados Unidos, Canadá y México. Como el torneo más grande en la historia del evento y uno de los eventos de mayor afluencia turística de la década, se espera que más de 1,2 millones de visitantes internacionales viajen solo a Estados Unidos.
Leer másSouthwest Airlines ofrece una semana de ofertas en vuelos, hoteles, autos y vacaciones
Southwest Airlines lanza la Semana de WOW, una de las mayores promociones del año de la aerolínea. Desde hoy hasta el 11 de junio, los clientes pueden ahorrar hasta un 40 % en las tarifas base usando el código FLYWOW para vuelos del 4 de agosto al 16 de diciembre de 2026, además de promociones en hoteles, alquiler de autos, cruceros y paquetes vacacionales Getaways by Southwest. Consulte algunas de las rutas sin escalas en oferta disponibles ahora en Southwest.com, con vuelos de ida desde tan solo un 40 % de descuento
Leer más Turtle Beach debuta en Barbados con nueva propuesta de escapadas caribeñas de lujo
Turtle Beach, Barbados, A Tribute Portfolio All-Inclusive Resort, abre oficialmente sus puertas en la Costa Sur de la isla, con lo que inaugura un nuevo y vibrante capítulo para el turismo todo incluido en el Caribe. El resort, parte del creciente portafolio todo incluido de Marriott International, presenta una visión llena de vida de lo que es estar frente al mar, donde la cultura auténtica de Barbados, el diseño cuidadosamente concebido y las experiencias sin complicaciones se unen en perfecta armonía.
Leer más
Sinaloa y el Mar de Cortés: un ecosistema lleno de vidaCon más de 650 kilómetros de costa frente al Mar de Cortés —también conocido como Golfo de California—, Sinaloa se encuentra en una de las regiones costeras con mayor riqueza natural del planeta.
Leer más Tráfico aéreo de pasajeros cae un 0,7% en Europa en la era poscovid
El tráfico de pasajeros en toda la red aeroportuaria europea cayó el pasado abril un 0,7% respecto al mismo mes del año pasado. Así lo revela un nuevo informe de la asociación europea de aeropuertos ACI EUROPE. Aunque sea una pérdida marginal, se trata de la la primera caída interanual desde la recuperación del transporte aéreo en Europa tras la pandemia de COVID-19, fechado aproximadamente en abril de 2021.

body:
Hi Dave!

Thank you so much!! It was such a pleasure working with you guys as well.

Jude was a great instructor, and I heard from many of my co-workers that he was instrumental in his constructive criticism throughout the evening. He was able to offer his passionate opinion in what could make each person’s paintings better.

I thoroughly appreciated that we were each greeted at the door by one of the Mangia employees and made to feel welcome. It was extremely organized. And, the gentleman who guided the entire evening created meaning behind the night by stating the goals of the experience and what we were to get out of it. I loved this.

One point of feedback: I thought the act of playing music was awkward at the beginning. I anticipated hearing Jude play music, but not our group playing music. I enjoyed it, but it seemed difficult for some of my co-workers to adapt to being comfortable with playing music as soon as they walked into the bar from work. It was simply too quick a change of pace. One minute we were at our computers, and the next minute we were being handed a rain stick to play music. While I personally enjoy playing music, I think it could’ve been executed a little more naturally.

Dave, you also were extremely detail-oriented, and I appreciated the process of talking with you before the event to get a general “vibe” of our group. As the World Cup kicks off this week in North America, there’s a lot of talk about the anticipated boom for local economies — but what about experiences? We recently checked in with Roisin O’Sullivan, MD of Walks and Devour Tours, on the podcast for some real talk on how large sporting events can impact local tourism operators, as well as a wider outlook on the coming summer, from competition and OTAs to AI and shifting regional demand.
Whether you’re going into summer strong or feeling uncertain, the latest article from Kelsey Tonner of Guest Focus — a preview of his upcoming Arival Pro Meetup — offers some practical advice on how to build for flexibility and stay profitable even as talks of recession loom.
Finally, we’re less than two weeks away from the first Arival 360 event in Australia ! Here’s a sneak peek of a few things we’re looking forward to:
* The legendary Graham 'Skroo' Turner , founder of Top Deck Travel and Flight Centre, takes the stage to share the behind the scenes of building a global travel empire.
* The great tech and distribution shift : Oceania and APAC often rank behind other regions on modern tech, distribution and pricing strategy adoption in Arival research. We have “heaps” of workshops and speakers ready to help operators change this!
* AI, TikTok & the new marketing funnel : Whether or not you’re operating Down Under, social video and AI search are turning discoverability upside down. From TikTok and influencer marketing to vibe coding and AI, we’re tackling these topics head on.
* Plus some epic parties, flat whites and meat pies, and so much more! We hope to see you there!
- Janelle Visser

One in four operators in Australia & New Zealand now vary prices by season, day or demand — but they’re trailing global adoption of strategic pricing
READ MORE

How to stay profitable, build for flexibility and focus on what matters when the future feels foggy and recession looms — a guide from Guest Focus.

LISTEN NOW

As FIFA World Cup 2026 gets underway, the World Travel & Tourism Council (WTTC) projects strong tourism growth across the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, driven by increased travel and visitor spending. The report serves as a reminder for operators to prepare for potential event-driven traveler demand and consider how to convert World Cup visitors into longer stays, returning customers and higher-value experiences.

2) Klook Co-Founder Bets AI Can Finally Fix Travel Experiences Discovery ($)
The Asia Pacific-based online travel agency has plans to use AI to “smooth out the messiness of experiences booking” with an AI-powered shopping agent. https://dcbrau.com/


** The Monthly Brausletter: June 2026
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.dcbrau.com

It’s outside beer drinkin’ season and we’re ready!
SEE WHAT’S ON TAP (https://untappd.com/v/dc-brau-brewing-company/67632?menu_id=13991)


** BIG EVENTS THIS WEEKEND!
------------------------------------------------------------
https://playhouse.band/brandieposey/washington-dc-jun-12-2026#tiers

Warped Tour is here & the comedy stage has a special treat for you on Warped Tour DC Eve! Come see a preview of some of the country's punk rock comedy heavy hitters in a venue unlike any other! You're gonna get Toni Nagy repping Boston, Brandie Posey from Baltimore, plus Anna Valenzuela & Gloria Alexander from Los Angeles!

This Friday - June 12th @ 7PM
GET YOUR TICKETS! (https://playhouse.band/brandieposey/washington-dc-jun-12-2026#tiers)

https://www.eventbrite.com/e/2026-us-air-guitar-qualifier-washington-dc-registration-1988787138869

Part rock show. Part comedy act. Part spectacle. US Air Guitar allows ordinary people to become ridiculous rock stars! Want to compete - sign up here? (https://www.eventbrite.com/e/2026-us-air-guitar-qualifier-washington-dc-registration-1988787138869) Or are you a roadie in the making (https://www.eventbrite.com/e/spectator-ticket-dc-air-guitar-championship-tickets-1988527904492) ? Join us Saturday June 13 and watch the spectacle.

Saturday June 13th @ 7:30PM


** MONUMENTAL BEER RELEASES
------------------------------------------------------------


** DECLARATION
------------------------------------------------------------

Helles Lager 4.5% ABV

Declaration is a classic Helles Lager brewed to honor two milestones: 15 years of DC Brau and 250 years since a bold idea was put to paper. Clean, balanced, and quietly expressive, it celebrates craftsmanship, perseverance, and the freedom of a well-made lager.

Available in the DMV in cans & draft!


** BABY WINGS
------------------------------------------------------------

Day IPA 3.5%ABV

All the attitude, none of the altitude.
Baby Wings is our fresh take on a hop-forward favorite. It brings the bold aromatics and flavor you expect, but in a lighter and more crushable package. It’s built for long sessions, warm days, and anyone who wants big IPA character without the heavy lift. Same DNA. New energy. Drink it all day.

Available in the DMV in cans & draft!


** CAN'T-MISS EVENTS
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.dcbrau.com


** THURSDAY NIGHT TRIVIA!
------------------------------------------------------------

Who doesn’t love stretching the mind a little — come to our Thursday Night Trivia — Hosted by HUNTER STEVENS of Capital City Showcase fame and get happy hour prices all night on core pints! Grab a beer and your favorite thinkin buddies and prepare for a night of laughs, head scratchin’ questions and of course beer!

Every Thursday from 7-9. Theres a $50 gift card on the line, A six pack for 2nd place and a MYSTERY last place prize… bring your friends, lovers and enemies for this game of wits.

https://www.potterywithapurpose.com/products/pottery-workshops-dc-brau-brewing-washington-dc?srsltid=AfmBOooeg0amNF1nu5kbrI59pX6SmMp9T4j4pcRmCIW54e_UGFJudjuO
https://www.potterywithapurpose.com/products/pottery-workshops-dc-brau-brewing-washington-dc?srsltid=AfmBOooeg0amNF1nu5kbrI59pX6SmMp9T4j4pcRmCIW54e_UGFJudjuO


** Clay Workshops
------------------------------------------------------------

With Pottery with a Purpose!

Unplug, unwind, and make something by hand at our feel-good pottery workshop — no experience needed. Whether you come for the joy of making, the community, or craft beer, this guided clay workshop is all about having fun while you sip and socialize. You’ll learn pottery basics and leave with a one-of-a-kind piece (or two) you built by hand, plus the option to have your work professionally fired and glazed so it’s functional, food-safe, and waterproof.

Bonus: We donate $1 from every ticket to mental health initiatives. Learn more here (https://www.potterywithapurpose.com/pages/about-pottery-with-a-purpose)  about which non-profits we’ve given back to so far, and how you can help choose who we support next.

$75 a person - Tickets Here! (https://www.potterywithapurpose.com/products/pottery-workshops-dc-brau-brewing-washington-dc?variant=47483078475996)

Sign Up! (https://www.potterywithapurpose.com/products/pottery-workshops-dc-brau-brewing-washington-dc)

Come join us First Wednesday of the Month of June, July & August for a Hot Dog Run! We’re gonna have a little run, have a dog and drink some beer. Join us at ivy & coney at 6:30 for a good time!

DIG DUG DIG Productions is bringin’ us two great events!

[Producer highlight](https://sf.vervewine.com/products/knoll-riesling-smaragd-kellerberg-wachau-2023)

From the Cellar Mountain to Your Glass. The 2023 Knoll Riesling Smaragd 'Kellerberg' Is Austria's Most Profound Dry Riesling and One of the Great White Wines of the Year

"The Kellerberg is one of Austria's most important vineyards, and this 2023 confirms why. The site sits behind the baroque Dürnstein castle above the Danube, facing southeast on gneiss and granite, cooled at night by air drawn in from a nearby ravine. What that geography produces, in the hands of the Knoll family, is Riesling of uncommon depth and precision. The 2023 opens with an aromatic, almost perfumed nose of pink grapefruit, spiced tangerine, papaya and ripe apricot, lifted by a whisper of peppermint and smoky stone. The palate is where this wine earns its reputation. It is structured and focused, with aristocratic restraint at first, then a gradual unfolding of mineral tension, bright lemon zest, and a vivid citrus-salt core that intensifies through the finish. The acidity is seamlessly integrated, not sharp but insistent, and the length is exceptional. This is a Smaragd built to develop for decades, but it is surprisingly accessible now with the right pairing: Vienna Schnitzel, turbot with capers and brown butter, freshwater fish, or raw shellfish. One of the finest dry Rieslings from Austria this year." - Verve Wine
 We do not use the word definitive lightly. But when it comes to dry Riesling from the Wachau, few producers have earned that designation as completely as Emmerich Knoll. The Knoll family has farmed the steep terraced vineyards along the Danube in Unterloiben since the early 19th century, bottling wines since the 1950s and placing their iconic baroque image of Saint Urban on every label since 1962. The estate farms 16 hectares across some of the region's most revered single vineyards: Kellerberg, Loibenberg, Pfaffenberg and Schütt. No shortcuts. No concessions to fashion. Hand-harvested fruit, native yeast fermentation and extended aging in large neutral oak casks. The wines do not rush. Neither should you.​The Kellerberg, whose name translates to "Cellar Mountain," is without question one of the Wachau's greatest sites. It faces southeast, capturing the morning sun while an open ravine brings in cool air through the night. The soils are gneiss and granite. The resulting Riesling is aromatic, mineral-driven and precisely focused, combining the texture and weight of Smaragd-level ripeness with a freshness and clarity that is impossible to replicate elsewhere. Stuart Pigott of James Suckling called the 2023 a "masterpiece" with "radical minerality." ​The 2023 vintage in the Wachau was a season of precision. Cool nights preserved acidity while adequate warmth delivered Smaragd-level concentration. The wines from this vintage are tightly structured, aromatic and built for the long term. The Kellerberg in particular shows more finesse and less overt stone-fruit weight than the opulent 2022, delivering a wine of direction, tension and remarkable longevity. Drinking window: 2026 to 2050. Only wines of remarkable quality can offer that.​For those who have followed our work with Austrian whites, from Grüner Veltliner to Wachau Riesling, this is the wine we have been building toward. It pairs extraordinarily well with Vienna Schnitzel, fresh turbot, lobster, raw oysters, and any preparation of white fish where the wine itself should be the conversation. body:
[Producer highlight](https://ny.vervewine.com/products/zarate-rias-baixas-albarino-2026)

Re-Discover the Ancient 1701 Cult-Like Find From Spain's Rugged Coastline and Albariño’s Birthplace in the Valley of the Saints That Will Put "A BIG FAT SMILE on Your Face"

"Ernesto Zárate established this winery in the Val do Salnés in 1920 and went on to become one of the pioneers for the region…what LITTLE WINE WAS MADE was solely for local consumption. These are wonderful expressions of Albariño, full of vigor, vivacity and complexity – the kind of wines that put a BIG FAT SMILE on your face.” - Robert Parker's Wine Advocate ​We had our favorite refreshing white wine of the summer yesterday with some Thai food and could not wait to share. As we have said before, this is one of those wines that puts a big smile on your face, especially when you find it. Twelve years ago, a mere handful of retailers in the US carried this celebrated insider white, but then the wine vanished from the market, increasing the mystique of this elusive estate. Zárate is that small artisanal Spanish producer we had been searching for years. Little of their wine was made, little arrived in the US, and what did arrive was poorly handled. Those that found it kept it at a low profile, whispering about it as there was simply not enough to go around. The irony is that this hushed producer from along the Galician coast is locally known as one of the great patriarchs of old-vine Albariño, releasing limited-production bottlings from single-vineyard plots that earned the Bodega a reputation for what is the equivalent of Grand Cru-level wines from the Val do Salnés region of Rías Baixas.​These prized selections are known for their signature zip, freshness, minerality, and layers of depth, and they have found their way to the wine lists of the world's most celebrated restaurants, including the Michelin-rated El Bulli and Arzak in Spain. While it is the extremely rare and highly sought-after grand cru-like El Palomar expression from 120-year-old vines that commands much attention, along with the limited production Balado and the late release Albariño cru, Tras da Viña, which comes from a south-facing site planted in 1970 with cuttings from El Palomar whose sandier, richer soil yields an intensely mineral, long-lived wine. This cuvée typically goes through malolactic fermentation and spends an extra year on the lees to tame its power. However, for Verve Wine, the fun begins with the 2025 Zárate Albariño Rías Baixas Val do Salnés at just $27.99. It's one of those happy white wines you want with food and friends.​If you are a fan of fresh, precise whites from the Kimmeridgian soils of Sancerre or Chablis, wines that make you feel their tension, energy, and bite, our recommendation is to purchase this Zárate bottling by the case. It is the perfect "Summer House Wine" and beyond, to have on hand! FEATURED WINE: Zárate’s Prized Albariño - Our Favorite White of the Season

https://ny.vervewine.com/products/zarate-rias-baixas-albarino-2026

Albariño is another one of those refreshing whites that transports you to the rugged coastline of Spain and the sacred lands of Galicia, making you crave the local langostinos (prawns), cigalas (crayfish), mariscos (shellfish), pulpo (octopus), or even the prized percebes (gooseneck barnacles). The Albariño-based wine from these ancient soils exemplifies the crisp, mineral-driven regional whites of Rías Baixas without a forbidding price tag. The prized wines of Zárate are organic and void of oak, packed with clean, unadulterated freshness, with a bite that evokes the Valley of the Saints.

[SHOP NOW](https://ny.vervewine.com/products/zarate-rias-baixas-albarino-2026)

 ADDITIONAL NOTES AND REVIEWS: 

https://ny.vervewine.com/products/zarate-rias-baixas-albarino-2026

2025 Zárate Albariño Rías Baixas Val do Salnés*$32.99 Regular $27.99 Special with no minimum quantity* Verve Wine: “It's the return of our ' zip-zam-zing ' wine - truly lightning in a bottle with the energy that is corked up here. This fresh wine is all about purity of generous, bright fruit and minerality, and it continues with the 2025 release. The wine once again captures its coastal origins and granite-based soils that add layers of depth and minerality to an explosive core of citrus. A special value treat from the great patriarch of the region, this entry-level cuvée is sourced from 35-year-old vines in eleven different vineyards and aged in stainless steel. This organic wine is all about freshness, and the Bodega's signature notes of lemon-lime citrus and saline minerality are present, accented by white flowers, herbs, a touch of green apple, pear, grapefruit, melon, green almond, ginger, and ocean salinity. In 2025, there is a little zestier fruit and texture to make it an easy summer crowd-pleaser, but the standout here is the salinity, crisp dryness of the wine, and its balancing acidity. body:
Newsletter Infotur Latam 09-06-26
Si no puede visualizar bien este boletín haga clic AQUÍLima, martes 09 de junio del 2026 Director General: Carlos Bernuy  Ofrece gratis 2 noches en el nuevo UNICO 18°77° Hotel Montego Bay
La exclusiva marca all-inclusive sólo para adultos, UNICO Hotel Collection, lanzó una atractiva promoción para sus aliados comerciales de América Latina, que busca impulsar las ventas de sus propiedades en México y, al mismo tiempo, generar interés por la próxima apertura de UNICO 18°77° Hotel Montego Bay, en Jamaica.
Leer más Grupo Abra recibe luz verde en Chile para la adquisición de SKY Airline
La Fiscalía Nacional Económica (FNE) de Chile aprobó la operación mediante la cual Abra Group —matriz de las aerolíneas Avianca, Gol y Wamos Air— adquirirá la aerolínea SKY Airline. Tras una investigación de casi cinco meses, la autoridad regulatoria chilena determinó que la transacción no afectará sustancialmente la competencia en los mercados de transporte aéreo de pasajeros, de carga y de arrendamiento de aeronaves.
Leer más
¿Cómo y en qué ahorra el argentino cuando decide viajar para ver un partido de fútbol?
Para los argentinos, viajar para ver fútbol no es simplemente turismo: es un compromiso con la pasión, con los colores y con mostrarle al mundo que están presentes. Desde reservar con meses de anticipación y aprovechar promociones, sumar millas, hacer escalas eternas o reducir gastos cotidianos, la creatividad se convierte en una herramienta fundamental, la defensa se hace fuerte y el medio apoya al ataque para llegar y ganar el partido.Leer másForbes presenta su lista de los mejores bares de hoteles de 2026
Forbes Travel Guide («FTG»), la autoridad mundial en hostelería de lujo, anunció hoy sus premios Hotel Star Bars 2026, reconociendo a 37 de los bares de hotel más excepcionales del mundo por su arte en la coctelería, su servicio de alta calidad y las experiencias memorables que ofrecen a sus huéspedes.
Leer más Turismo mundial entre récords, saturación y un nuevo viajero
El turismo a nivel mundial navega hoy por un variado espectro que incluye los récords, saturación y un nuevo tipo de viajero más exigente, tal y como lo reflejan los informes globales.Según el último barómetro de la Organización Mundial del Turismo (OMT), presentado recientemente, el sector supera ampliamente las cifras pre-pandemia, cerrando el primer semestre de 2026 con un crecimiento interanual del 12 por ciento.
Leer más
Colombia obtiene su primer premio Effie en Estados Unidos
En la gala de los Premios Effie 2026, celebrada la semana pasada, la agencia de promoción ProColombia recibió el Premio de Plata por su campaña «Hummananimal Tourism», que forma parte de la narrativa de marca «Colombia, el país de la belleza». Reconocida en la categoría de Marketing de Rendimiento/Digital, la campaña fue premiada por su eficaz combinación de creatividad, innovación y resultados medibles.
Leer másLEVEL celebra su 9º aniversario con billetes desde 9€ y Flydays desde 139€
LEVEL, la aerolínea de largo radio con base en Barcelona, celebra su 9º aniversario reafirmando su apuesta por la conectividad intercontinental desde la capital catalana. Tras un año clave, con la inauguración de la ruta Barcelona-Lima y el inicio de operaciones con su propio código IATA “LL”, la compañía celebra este hito con toda su clientela a través de dos acciones promocionales: vuelos desde 9€ y una nueva edición de los Flydays.Leer más Así se vivirá el verano en Rosewood Mayakoba
Ubicado entre lagunas, manglares y el mar Caribe, Rosewood Mayakoba presenta una propuesta de verano diseñada para familias que buscan compartir un viaje desde distintas edades, intereses y formas de disfrutar el destino. Distinguido con Cinco Estrellas Forbes y Dos Llaves Michelin, el resort reúne experiencias al aire libre, bienestar, gastronomía y espacios pensados para convivir con libertad, permitiendo que cada huésped encuentre su propia forma de vivir el día.
Leer más
Turismo activo y naturaleza impulsan la demanda europea hacia EE.UU.La demanda turística europea a Estados Unidos evoluciona, se hace más selectiva y apuesta por plazos de planificación más cortos mientras crece el interés por experiencias más diversas y auténticas que van más allá de los destinos urbanos más reconocidos.
Leer más Jalisco, listo para recibir el Mundial con una amplia oferta turística en Costalegre
El Mundial es la oportunidad perfecta para disfrutar desde paisajes agaveros hasta bosques montañosos, dejando que la gastronomía inigualable de Jalisco y la cálida cultura de la costa del Pacífico acompañe cada una de las aventuras, permitiendo disfrutar de paisajes paradisíacos para descansar después de la fiebre futbolera.

Rusia prevé la llegada de unos 16 millones de turistas internacionales en 2030, dijo hoy a la prensa el vice primer ministro del país euroasiático, Dmitri Chernishenko.Leer más

Workplace trends     Productivity    NHS productivity
jumps 2.6% as UK government bets big on AI     AI is already
moving the needle on government efficiency. The NHS (UK's
National Health Service) recorded 2.6% productivity growth in the
first half of 2025-26, and trials are expanding fast. These
trials range from fraud detection in the tax system to automated
planning decisions at local councils, according to official
statistics. Lucy Rigby, the UK's chief secretary to the Treasury,
is pushing to embed AI across Whitehall departments rather than
isolated teams, framing adoption as the clearest path to national
renewal.     Demand    BCG revenue hit $14.4 billion as AI
creates "infinite" demand for consultants     Far from replacing
consultants, AI seems to be keeping them busier than ever.
Companies rolling out AI need significant outside help doing it,
creating what Boston Consulting Group's CEO describes as near
"infinite" demand for implementation expertise, per the Wall
Street Journal. BCG's own revenue grew 7% to $14.4 billion last
fiscal year, with headcount expanding to keep pace. Fees are
increasingly tied to measurable client outcomes like cost
reductions or revenue growth, rather than flat retainers.
Spread    AI use hits 73.7% in a Virginia college town, beating
every US tech hub     AI is no longer just a tech industry story.
A new Microsoft analysis tracking AI use across all 50 states and
3,100 counties found adoption spreading well beyond traditional
tech hubs, with Texas ranking ahead of California and college
towns leading all metros. Lawyers, small business owners, and
non-technical workers are increasingly building their own AI
tools, a sign that mainstream adoption has moved well past
engineering and technical teams, according to Microsoft's US AI
Diffusion Report.     Connection    76% of workers consulted AI
over colleagues for workplace advice last year     AI is
reshaping how people interact at work. Workday's Human Connection
Workplace Index, a survey of 2,150 employees, found that 76% used
AI tools for advice over the past year, with many saying the
technology felt less judgmental and more available than
colleagues. While 62% said AI reduced their stress and burnout
risk, a third of workers said they rarely or never have non-task
conversations with coworkers each week. Gen Z feels the divide
most sharply, reporting loneliness at work at eight times the
rate of Gen X.     Pushback    Costco, Delta, and IBM are betting
AI will upgrade, not eliminate, employees' roles     Not every
CEO is using AI as a cover for headcount cuts. A growing number
of major employers are deploying AI to streamline back-end
operations while moving staff into more strategic roles. A
Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta survey of nearly 750 corporate
executives found little evidence of near-term job losses from AI,
with routine roles declining while demand for skilled,
collaborative positions grows. Costco, which has leaned into AI
across pharmacy, accounting, and IT while preserving its
workforce, posted revenue exceeding $250 billion in 2025 and
shares up 17% this year.

body:
Introducing A New Chapter for the Travel & Adventure Shows

Dear Industry Partners,

As we enter our 24th year as America's Leading Travel Trade Show Series, it's important that we share some important news: as of May 1st, Unicomm, LLC has completed the sale of the Travel & Adventure Shows to Marketplace Events (MPE), North America's largest consumer and trade show organizer.

As you can imagine, this was not a decision made lightly. When Unicomm's Executive Team sat down with MPE CEO, Mark White and his leadership team, it became abundantly clear: this is the right partner, the right platform, and the right future for these shows and for every exhibitor, sponsor and attendee who has been a part of this journey.

MPE produces 125+ shows across 50+ markets, draws 2.2 million attendees and 30,000 exhibitors a year, and operates some of the most dominant consumer events on the continent. This is not a financial buyer looking for a line item. This is an operator with the infrastructure, the sales network and the resources to take what we have built and scale it. Their message to us was simple: we're not acquiring this business to change it. We're acquiring it to grow it.

Here is what you need to know:

The shows will continue to operate under the Travel & Adventure Shows brand as a distinct division within MPE. Your contacts, your relationships, and the standards you've come to expect from TAS are not going anywhere.

The entire TAS team transitions with the acquisition. As you all know, this is one of the strongest teams in consumer events. They know the travel industry, they know our exhibitors by name, and they execute at the highest level. You can expect the same people, the same standards, and the same results.

I will continue in my role to lead the team as Vice President of the Travel & Adventure Shows as a division of MPE. What has become most important to me over the past 14 years with TAS has been the relationships that we have forged with our exhibitors, attendees, trade professionals and in-market contacts. That mentality isn't going anywhere. I can speak on behalf of our team when I say: that remains our number one priority.

I want to recognize John Golicz, TAS Founder & CEO, and Jim Forberg, our longtime COO, whose leadership, vision, and decades of industry expertise brought the Travel & Adventure Shows to where they are today.

Finally - and most importantly - thank you. To every current, past and prospective exhibitor, sponsor, destination, tour operator, cruise line, travel provider and any brand that trusted us with your marketing investment: you are the reason these shows exist. It is you who make the Travel & Adventure Shows what they are and that loyalty and partnership motivates us to provide a world class service year after year.

In closing, the future of the Travel & Adventure Shows is bright, and it is in the right hands. We are excited to continue growing the Travel & Adventure Shows as a core division of Marketplace Events, and we're looking forward to seeing you all at a Travel & Adventure Show in 2027.

Sincerely,

Jonathan Golicz
Vice President, Travel & Adventure Show Series

Let me give you the real reason I'm so fired up about this.

I spent $7.7M+ of my own money on ads. I got in early on YouTube Ads & rode that wave to tens of millions in revenue - not because I was smarter than everyone else, but because I was EARLIER than everyone else.

That's the entire game. I call it First-Mover Math.

When a new ad platform opens up, there's a window where there's almost no competition, costs are low & the algorithm is hungry for advertisers. The platform WANTS you to succeed because it needs to prove the ads work. That's the Ground-Floor Window.

We've all said it before - "I wish I got in early on Google Ads" or "I wish I'd run Facebook Ads when clicks were 10 cents."

Well, ChatGPT Ads are that opportunity right now. This is a brand new Blue Ocean, & the window is wide open.

The difference between the people who win & the people who watch isn't talent. It's timing. So let me show you how it works.

Getting in starts at [ads.openai.com](https://ads.openai.com) - you click "Start Now," verify your account, & you're into the Ads Manager dashboard.

Before you ever build a campaign, you need to set up your conversions first. If you've run Meta or Google Ads, this will feel familiar - it's a web pixel that tracks the people coming to your site so you can measure (& eventually optimize for) the actions that matter.

You create your pixel, then create conversion events - things like leads, registrations & booked appointments. You drop the pixel code on your "thank you" page, & now ChatGPT can track exactly what's happening.

New Account… Now What? Hi ya Dave,

Last week I did our

**Reorder Magic Live Sales Training, and got SO many questions about increasing reorders once you land a new account that I figured I should just spell it out** in today’s email. 

You got on the shelf, so what happens next?

While it's not 

**easy** to land that new wholesale account (between all the back and forth emails, the cold-calling, the swinging by with samples, the wondering if they even TRIED those samples, and the endless lag time... it's hard!) it's just the first step of your wholesale growth.

**Truth Talk: It's a lot easier to get ON the shelf than it is to get OFF the shelf and**

**into those shoppers' baskets**

Most people who come to me asking for sales help get stuck here. You've had okay luck getting wholesale accounts but then you stall out. You put all your energy into building an account base, only to have slow sales once you actually get there.

So what do you do instead?

You have a plan for every new wholesale account. 

**I have never seen a packaged product brand succeed without a PLAN for sales and marketing once you’re placed on the shelf, in a mini-bar, on a menu, or in an online store. **

But so often founders use allllll their energy just to land the account, and they fail to take the second, -

**dare I say -**MORE important action of outlining how they’re going to sell through once there.

Let it be simple

**. It’s time to make a doable, executable, LESS AMBITIOUS plan than you think you need. **

**A simple plan, that you can actually do each quarter, is better than no plan at all. **

InRetail Ready® https://www.alliball.com/retailready, I call it “The Coordinated Kickoff + The Reorder Checklist" but you can call it whatever you please, as long as you have these tools. 

**Have a checklist that you run through every single time you gain a new account, ensuring that you're connecting with the store, the community, the staff, and your fans in that location.** 

Ensure that you have your promotional strategy in place for that store. 

* Is your signage there, and up? 

* Is the merchandising correct? 

* Are you promoting it on your own social channels? 

* Are you driving digital and physical traffic to the store and your product? 

* Are you doing strategic demos?

* Or prioritizing staff education?

* Or running influencer campaigns? 

**Even if you have a broker. Even if you have a distributor. This is on YOU.**

ALL of that (and more!) goes into getting that reorder. Let’s be clear: you don’t need to do that entire list above every time but you’ve got to do 

**something**. 

**Why is the first reorder the most important? I'll tell ya later this week.**Dun, dun, dunnnnn!

To be continued,

Alli

body:
New Account… Now What? Hi ya Dave,

Last week I did our

**Reorder Magic Live Sales Training, and got SO many questions about increasing reorders once you land a new account that I figured I should just spell it out** in today’s email. 

You got on the shelf, so what happens next?

While it's not 

**easy** to land that new wholesale account (between all the back and forth emails, the cold-calling, the swinging by with samples, the wondering if they even TRIED those samples, and the endless lag time... it's hard!) it's just the first step of your wholesale growth.

**Truth Talk: It's a lot easier to get ON the shelf than it is to get OFF the shelf and**

**into those shoppers' baskets**

Most people who come to me asking for sales help get stuck here. You've had okay luck getting wholesale accounts but then you stall out. You put all your energy into building an account base, only to have slow sales once you actually get there.

So what do you do instead?

You have a plan for every new wholesale account. 

**I have never seen a packaged product brand succeed without a PLAN for sales and marketing once you’re placed on the shelf, in a mini-bar, on a menu, or in an online store. **

But so often founders use allllll their energy just to land the account, and they fail to take the second, -

**dare I say -**MORE important action of outlining how they’re going to sell through once there.

Let it be simple

**. It’s time to make a doable, executable, LESS AMBITIOUS plan than you think you need. **

**A simple plan, that you can actually do each quarter, is better than no plan at all. **

InRetail Ready® https://www.alliball.com/retailready, I call it “The Coordinated Kickoff + The Reorder Checklist" but you can call it whatever you please, as long as you have these tools. 

**Have a checklist that you run through every single time you gain a new account, ensuring that you're connecting with the store, the community, the staff, and your fans in that location.** 

Ensure that you have your promotional strategy in place for that store. 

* Is your signage there, and up? 

* Is the merchandising correct? 

* Are you promoting it on your own social channels? 

* Are you driving digital and physical traffic to the store and your product? 

* Are you doing strategic demos?

* Or prioritizing staff education?

* Or running influencer campaigns? 

**Even if you have a broker. Even if you have a distributor. This is on YOU.**

ALL of that (and more!) goes into getting that reorder. Let’s be clear: you don’t need to do that entire list above every time but you’ve got to do 

**something**. 

**Why is the first reorder the most important? I'll tell ya later this week.**Dun, dun, dunnnnn!

To be continued,

Alli

PS. The great news about The Reorder Checklist is that once you have it, you can also implement it with your existing accounts where you need a sales boost this summer. Don’t let those stagnant accounts drop off altogether!

https://www.alliball.com/retailready

Creator ofRetail Ready®  https://www.alliball.com/retailready

The destinations getting ahead right now are asking a different

That shift in thinking is what this June edition is about. Inside you

The Boulder Tragedy One Year Later 

In the aftermath of the attack, ADL Mountain States Regional Director Susan Rona led the ADL team that worked tirelessly to support the community she calls home. Rona looks back at a time of grief, fear and anger as we helped buoy the enduring strength of the Jewish community. 
https://click.adlmail.org/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ4OTd9AAEAAAAAAKFXVrFl0CTLetWUpkZiR0KV0dYTfHPO6TfGynHZQSVbjXEOB4nF_EXRG-Qxc06TtX6qZpgcO2hp-N7Fhdf5dTxYG7gsRUkZfxE

They were not soldiers. They were not politicians. They were friends and neighbors walking peacefully through their own community, calling attention to hostages kidnapped from Israel by Hamas on Oct. 7.

They were doing what free people do in a free society — exercising their right to free speech.

Karen Sorin Diamond, an 82-year-old mother and grandmother, did not survive. I have spent the past year carrying that and thinking about that. I think many of us have.

People ask me often what it feels like to be a member of a community that has been targeted by hate. I tell them how I often think about the survivors of the Boulder firebombing and what they described losing.

Not just their physical injuries, horrific in themselves. They also lost the ability to walk freely without threats to their safety. To gather openly, without being targeted for their religion or their views. To be in public and openly Jewish, without anxiety or fear.

What’s News
